meta.plot: Four women will have to deal with the problems of their daily lives, while trying to hide a dark secret that will make their whole world reel.

1.title: FR - Hanma Baki - S01E01 - The World's Strongest Senior
1.plot: The world is shaken by news of a man taking down a monstrous elephant with his bare hands. Back in Japan, Baki is confronted by a knife-wielding child.

1.title: FR - Hanma Baki - S01E02 - Mixed species' martial arts
1.plot: To train for his eventual battle against his father, Baki spars against an imaginary giant praying mantis he’s created in his mind.

1.title: FR - Hanma Baki - S01E03 - Prison and Hell
1.plot: In the middle of a heavily guarded parade, the President of the United States is kidnapped in plain sight by an unknown young man.

1.title: FR - Hanma Baki - S01E04 - The Second
1.plot: Baki comes across a man known as “Mr. Second,” a powerful inmate who seems to enjoy special privileges within the prison.

1.title: FR - Hanma Baki - S01E05 - Terrible Triplets
1.plot: With just a few weeks left on his sentence, Iron Michael is attacked by triplet hit men hired to make sure the ex-boxing champ never fights again.

1.title: FR - Hanma Baki - S01E06 - Man of the Sea
1.plot: Just as the Mouth triplets are about to finish their attack on Iron Michael, Guevaru rolls in and instigates a fight.

1.title: FR - Hanma Baki - S01E07 - Hyper male and Hyper male
1.plot: Guevaru refuses to believe that Biscuit Oliva, the most notorious inmate in the prison, is comfortably serving his sentence in the company of his lover.

1.title: FR - Hanma Baki - S01E08 - Gilberto Style
1.plot: The match between Guevaru and Oliva begins, and the rules are simple: They both hold onto the same piece of cloth and the first one to let go loses.

1.title: FR - Hanma Baki - S01E09 - Decision Time
1.plot: Guevaru is fighting for the people of his impoverished homeland, and he won’t go down so easily. Later, Oliva makes a discovery.

1.title: FR - Hanma Baki - S01E10 - Can't you laugh?
1.plot: Baki is surrounded by guards with their guns pointed right at him, but he doesn’t seem worried at all — he seems to be planning something.

1.title: FR - Hanma Baki - S01E11 - The Prison Guard talks about it
1.plot: Oliva inadvertently kicks off a major incident when he enters Baki’s solitary confinement cell to challenge him to a fight in two weeks' time.

1.title: FR - Hanma Baki - S01E12 - Beyond the Brawn
1.plot: Baki learns the hard way that he might not be ready to fight the man known as “Mr. Unchained” — Oliva’s power and technique are on another level.

meta.plot: To gain the skills he needs to surpass his powerful father, Baki enters Arizona State Prison to take on the notorious inmate known as Mr. Unchained.

1.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S01E01 - Rise of the Snakes
1.plot: The ninjas are snapped out of their post-hero complacency when Lord Garmadon's son Lloyd shows up and tries to pick up where his father left off.

1.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S01E02 - Home
1.plot: Back in training mode with the looming threat of Lloyd and the Hypnobrai, Zane wanders after a Falcon and lands himself in a heap of trouble.

1.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S01E03 - Snakebit
1.plot: Lloyd unlocks a second tribe, the Fangpyres, to help him regain control. The ninjas take action when the Fangpyres attack Jay's family's village.

1.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S01E04 - Never Trust a Snake
1.plot: After the Fangpyres join forces with the Hypnobrai, Lloyd awakens Pythor -- the last remaining snake of the Anacondrai tribe.

1.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S01E05 - Can of Worms
1.plot: Lloyd moves in and tries to help out but just gets in the way. Pythor awakens the Venomari and the Constrictai, and an all-out snake war breaks out.

1.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S01E06 - The Snake King
1.plot: Pythor declares himself the destined leader who'll reawaken The Great Devourer, an ancient beast that can't be killed and will consume all of Ninjago.

1.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S01E07 - Tick Tock
1.plot: When the four ninjas follow the mysterious falcon into the woods, they stumble upon a hidden workshop where Zane learns the secret about his past.

1.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S01E08 - Once Bitten, Twice Shy
1.plot: Jay and Nya must cut short their first date in Mega-Monster Amusement Park as the Serpentine are on their way to retrieve one of four fang blades.

1.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S01E09 - The Royal Blacksmiths
1.plot: The ninjas go undercover as a dance troupe and enter a talent contest in their quest to win the Blade Cup, where one of the fang blades is hidden.

1.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S01E10 - The Green Ninja
1.plot: The ninjas are suspicious when their archenemy Lord Garmadon moves in to help search for his missing son, but they realize they have to work together.

1.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S01E11 - All of Nothing
1.plot: The ninjas try to infiltrate the Serpentines' inner sanctum and walk into a trap. When Lloyd's rescue mission fails, only Lord Garmadon can help.

1.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S01E12 - The Rise of the Great Devourer
1.plot: The ninjas hastily journey to the lost city of Ouroboros to try to stop Pythor from awakening The Great Devourer, but it's a race against time.

1.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S01E13 - Day of the Great Devourer
1.plot: Disaster threatens as the ninjas must fight to defeat the all-consuming Great Devourer in a desperate attempt to save Ninjago.

2.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S02E01 - Darkness Shall Rise
2.plot: Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas realize Lord Garmadon has forged the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a mega-weapon.

2.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S02E02 - Pirates vs. Ninja
2.plot: When Garmadon accidentally brings to life the ruthless Captain Soto and his pirates, it's up to the ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City.

2.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S02E03 - Double Trouble
2.plot: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas.

2.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S02E04 - Ninjaball Run
2.plot: When the ninjas learn Dareth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed, they enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win a cash prize that will help save the dojo.

2.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S02E05 - Child’s Play
2.plot: When the ninjas prevent Garmadon from using his mega-weapon to bring to life a fossilized monster, they're turned into kids and need Lloyd's help.

2.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S02E06 - Wrong Place, Wrong Time
2.plot: When Garmadon travels back in time to undo the past and rid the future of ninjas, the ninjas follow him and try to stop him using the Golden Weapons.

2.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S02E07 - The Stone Army
2.plot: The ninjas face off with an exhibit of a stone samurai warrior that the toxic venom from the Great Devourer has brought to life.

2.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S02E08 - The Day Ninjago Stood Still
2.plot: The ninjas try to flee from the Stone Army, which has been brought to life by the Devourer's toxic venom. Garmadon tries to seize control of the army.

2.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S02E09 - The Last Voyage
2.plot: The ninjas, Lloyd, Sensei Wu and Misako journey to the Dark Island to find a Temple of Light that can restore the ninjas' elemental powers.

2.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S02E10 - Island of Darkness
2.plot: After fighting off the Stone Army, the ninjas arrive at the Temple of Light and harness their pure elemental powers, concentrating them onto Lloyd.

2.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S02E11 - The Last Hope
2.plot: The ninjas try to return Garmadon's Helmet of Darkness to its perch at the Celestial Clock to prevent the final battle between Lloyd and his father.

2.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S02E12 - Return of the Overlord
2.plot: Garmadon uses his new super-weapon to turn Jamanakai Village evil, unsettling the balance and allowing the spirit of the Overlord to possess his body.

2.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S02E13 - Rise Of The Spinjitzu Master
2.plot: A great darkness has fallen upon Ninjago as Garmadon's super-weapon has turned it evil, but the ninjas discover light is more powerful than dark.

3.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S03E01 - The Surge
3.plot: In the wake of Overlord's defeat, Ninjago City is reborn and the ninjas teach at Sensei Wu's academy. But the peace doesn't last long.

3.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S03E02 - The Art of the Silent Fist
3.plot: After being pursued to Sensei Garmadon's monastery by the Nindroids, the ninjas sneak back into Ninjago City under the guise of a circus train.

3.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S03E03 - Blackout
3.plot: Zane gives up half his power to save P.I.X.A.L. just as foes attack from all sides. Meanwhile, Lloyd and his father travel to Hiroshi's Labyrinth.

3.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S03E04 - The Curse of the Golden Master
3.plot: Underneath Ninjago City, the ninjas discover secrets about the Serpentine when they fight alongside them against the Nindroids.

3.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S03E05 - Enter the Digiverse
3.plot: The ninjas venture into the Digiverse to confront the Digital Overlord. Meanwhile, Pythor and Wu lead a Nindroid attack on Borg Tower.

3.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S03E06 - Codename: Arcturus
3.plot: Pythor and the Nindroids free the Digital Overlord. Meanwhile, Wu and Garmadon stumble upon Pythor's top-secret scheme, Project Arcturus.

3.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S03E07 - The Void
3.plot: After battling Nindroids on the outside of the Arcturus ship, the ninjas hang on as the craft takes the battle into the heart of a comet.

3.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S03E08 - The Titanium Ninja
3.plot: The Nindroids use the Golden Weapons to transform the Overlord into the Golden Master. In the ruins of Ninjago, the ninjas prepare their final stand.

4.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S04E01 - The Invitation
4.plot: After discovering that Zane may still be alive, the ninjas learn that they must compete in a Tournament of Champions if they wish to see him again.

4.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S04E02 - Only One Can Remain
4.plot: The team learns about Jade Blades and other secrets of the Tournament of Champions. Karlof is eliminated from the competition.

4.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S04E03 - Versus
4.plot: The contests begin, and soon Cole is forced to battle with Jay. Zane regains his memory with help from P.I.X.A.L.

4.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S04E04 - Ninja Roll
4.plot: The remaining Elemental Masters compete in a roller skating competition. Cole, Karlof and other eliminations must work in Chen's noodle factory.

4.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S04E05 - Spy For a Spy
4.plot: The ninjas form an alliance with the Elemental Masters after revealing Chen's plan. Cole and Zane break out of the noodle factory.

4.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S04E06 - Spellbound
4.plot: Lloyd and Garmadon learn of the great battle that once took place between Chen, the Anacondrai and the Elemental Masters for control of Ninjago.

4.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S04E07 - The Forgotten Element
4.plot: It appears that all is lost when Chen drains the powers of the Elemental Masters and vanquishes Lloyd in battle to take control of his as well.

4.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S04E08 - The Day of the Dragon
4.plot: Chen and his army invade Ninjago City, but the masters have escaped the noodle factory and follow close behind. Garmadon narrowly escapes banishment.

4.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S04E09 - The Greatest Fear of All
4.plot: Master Chen uses a spell to turn himself and his troops into fierce Anacondrai, but the ninjas visit Ninjago City's jail to recruit an unusual ally.

4.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S04E10 - The Corridor of Elders
4.plot: The final confrontation between the ninjas and the Anacondrai unfolds, but a great sacrifice must be made if the heroes are to save the day.

5.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S05E01 - Winds of Change
5.plot: Morro possesses Lloyd and uses him to infiltrate the tea shop and attack the other ninja, who have mysteriously lost their powers.

5.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S05E02 - Ghost Story
5.plot: After learning that Wu's staff holds a clue to the First Spinjitu Master's tomb, the ninja go to Stiix to retrieve the stolen Airjitzu scrolls.

5.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S05E03 - Stiix & Stones
5.plot: While Wu trains Nya in her new water powers, the ninja plot to steal the Airjitzu scrolls from Ronin but find that they must first fight Morro.

5.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S05E04 - The Temple on Haunted Hill
5.plot: The ninja go to Sensei Yang's dangerous haunted temple to learn Airjitzu, and Nya quits her training but must use her powers to elude Morro's ghosts.

5.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S05E05 - Peak-a-Boo
5.plot: Using their new Airjitzu powers, the ninja race to climb a perilous mountain to find the Sword of Sanctuary before Morro can claim it.

5.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S05E06 - Kingdom Come
5.plot: After being betrayed in the Cloud Kingdom, the ninja battle Morro for the Sword of Sanctuary and learn he is ultimately after the Realm Crystal.

5.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S05E07 - The Crooked Path
5.plot: As the ninja close in on their final clue to the location of the First Spinjitzu Master's tomb, Ronin steals the Sword of Sanctuary to give to Morro.

5.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S05E08 - Grave Danger
5.plot: The ninja journey to the First Spinjitzu Master's tomb to claim the powerful Realm Crystal, but they must navigate a series of traps -- and Morro.

5.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S05E09 - Curseworld (1)
5.plot: As the ninja race to keep Morro from releasing the Preeminent, Morro uses the Realm Crystal to summon an army of ghosts from the Cursed Realm.

5.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S05E10 - Curseworld (2)
5.plot: While the ninja try to protect Stiix, Lloyd encounters his father in the Cursed Realm, and Nya unlocks her true potential to take on the Preeminent.

6.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S06E01 - Infamous
6.plot: The ninjas find themselves going from famous heroes to hunted villains when someone impersonates them and commits crimes all over Ninjago City.

6.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S06E02 - Public Enemy Number One
6.plot: While Nadakhan schemes to steal the Realm Crystal, the fugitive ninjas are pursued by Ronin, who has been hired by the police to track them down.

6.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S06E03 - Enkrypted
6.plot: Falsely imprisoned, the ninjas meet a fellow captive who knows of a rare venom that can stop a Djinn like Nadakhan, but it's only found on one island.

6.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S06E04 - Misfortune Rising
6.plot: Nadakhan talks Jay into making a wish to win over Nya, first mate Flintlocke accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal, and Cole steals Soto's map.

6.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S06E05 - On a Wish and a Prayer
6.plot: As large areas of Ninjago City vanish, the ninjas head to Tiger Widow Island, where Jay collects the precious venom with Nadakhan in hot pursuit.

6.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S06E06 - My Dinner with Nadakhan
6.plot: Marooned on Tiger Widow Island, Lloyd, Cole and Nya try to escape on a raft, while a captured Jay battles Nadakhan's crewmates for their amusement.

6.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S06E07 - Wishmasters
6.plot: After lessons in how to talk like pirates, the ninjas infiltrate Nadakhan's ship on a mission to slip him the venom and rescue Jay from captivity.

6.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S06E08 - The Last Resort
6.plot: Flintlocke leads a mutiny, believing Nadakhan will abandon his crew once he has the power of infinite wishes, but the Djinn prevails and captures Nya.

6.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S06E09 - Operation Land Ho!
6.plot: While Nya is forced to rehearse for her wedding to Nadakhan at the Djinn Temple, Jay recruits a new team for a mission to rescue his friends.

6.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S06E10 - The Way Back
6.plot: Nadakhan marries Nya and gains the power of infinite wishes, but Flintlocke and Dogshank join the ninjas to fight the Djinn in an epic final showdown.

7.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S07E01 - The Hands of Time
7.plot: Master Wu engages in a fight left unfinished decades ago against Acronix, one of the twin Hands of Time. The ninjas try to rescue him.

7.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S07E02 - The Hatching
7.plot: The ninjas learn more about fallen Elemental Masters, Krux and Acronix, and discover they have a new enemy.

7.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S07E03 - A Time of Traitors
7.plot: Kai uses a Vermillion Warrior helmet to uncover information about Krux, while Lloyd struggles as a master-in-training and Nya tries to reboot Zane.

7.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S07E04 - Scavengers
7.plot: The Vermillion Warriors mysteriously steal items made of metal while Lloyd comes to realize that filling Master Wu's shoes is a daunting task.

7.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S07E05 - A Line in the Sand
7.plot: The ninjas fight to save an amusement park while Jay defends his family home from the Vermillion Warriors -- until the Emerald Time Blade arrives.

7.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S07E06 - The Attack
7.plot: The team enjoys a victory and retrieves the Emerald Time Blade, but the celebration is short-lived.

7.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S07E07 - Secrets Discovered
7.plot: While the rest of the ninjas try to find and rescue Master Wu, Nya confronts the Samurai X imposter and Kai seeks the truth about his parents.

7.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S07E08 - Pause and Effect
7.plot: Kai discovers both of his parents are being held captive. Meanwhile, a third Time Blade appears.

7.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S07E09 - Out of the Fire and Into the Boiling Sea
7.plot: The Hands of Time force Kai and Nya into retrieving the fourth Time Blade from the Boiling Sea.

7.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S07E10 - Lost in Time
7.plot: Kai and Nya time travel to the past, where they must help the Elemental Masters prevent the Hands of Time from changing Ninjago history.

8.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S08E01 - The Mask of Deception
8.plot: After he loses the Mask of Deception to a new villain, Lloyd reunites the scattered ninjas.

8.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S08E02 - The Jade Princess
8.plot: Lloyd befriends the spirited Princess Harumi, but an explosive attack by the Sons of Garmadon results in another relic lost and her parents missing.

8.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S08E03 - The Oni and the Dragon
8.plot: The ninjas seek the Sons of Garmadon by interrogating a captured gang member and going undercover at a karaoke bar.

8.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S08E04 - Snake Jaguar
8.plot: Zane is taken to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base, where he learns about their unseen leader. Meanwhile, Lloyd discovers the gang's true purpose.

8.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S08E05 - Dead Man's Squall
8.plot: Zane and Mr. E meet in an epic face-off as the ninjas' ship embarks on a rocky journey to find the third Oni mask.

8.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S08E06 - The Quiet One
8.plot: Separated by the crash, the ninjas try to get to the Oni mask before the Sons of Garmadon.

8.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S08E07 - Game of Masks
8.plot: A flashback reveals the truth about the Quiet One's identity as Harumi and Lloyd venture deeper into the Oni Temple seeking the third mask.

8.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S08E08 - Dread on Arrival
8.plot: Lloyd awakens a prisoner of the Quiet One, who plans to resurrect Lord Garmadon with another hostage.

8.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S08E09 - True Potential
8.plot: The ninjas celebrate at Laughy's until they learn Garmadon has broken Harumi out of prison.

8.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S08E10 - Big Trouble, Little Ninjago
8.plot: Mystake heals Lloyd's injuries but his survival comes with a heavy price. Garmadon conjures up a destructive giant to display his powers.

9.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S09E01 - Firstbourne
9.plot: Lloyd hides from the occupying forces of Emperor Garmadon and Harumi, while Young Wu and the ninjas are marooned in the Realm of Oni and Dragon.

9.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S09E02 - Iron & Stone
9.plot: Iron Baron banishes Jay, Kai and Zane to doom in an arena against a dragon. In Ninjago, Lloyd assembles a rebel group of Elemental Fighters.

9.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S09E03 - Radio Free Ninjago
9.plot: The ninjas are caged and used as bait to lure a dragon. Lloyd and his resistance fighters hijack a TV station to broadcast a message of hope.

9.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S09E04 - How to Build a Dragon
9.plot: The enslaved ninjas gather materials so that Cole and Wu can build a dragon decoy. The Sons of Garmadon strike back at Lloyd's rebels.

9.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S09E05 - The Gilded Path
9.plot: Lloyd and some of the resistance fighters are on the brink of capture in Nya's vehicle. In the Realm of Oni and Dragon, the ninjas and Wu go on the run.

9.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S09E06 - Two Lies, One Truth
9.plot: Mystake reveals her true nature and past, while Wu leads the search for Firstbourne.

9.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S09E07 - The Weakest Link
9.plot: Wu's identity is revealed while Lloyd and his comrades come up with a new plan involving Harumi.

9.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S09E08 - Saving Faith
9.plot: When Wu is captured and electro-shocked, his memories suddenly return. Lloyd uses stolen powers to try and seize the Oni Titan.

9.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S09E09 - Lessons for a Master
9.plot: An angry Garmadon looks to regain control while Wu and Iron Baron land in Firstbourne's nest.

9.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S09E10 - Green Destiny
9.plot: The ninjas return to Ninjago and head to battle just as a terrible attack is underway while Master Wu and Lloyd confront Lord Garmadon.

10.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S10E01 - The Darkness Comes
10.plot: Faith arrives with news of an invasion, forcing Lloyd to consider making Lord Garmadon an ally.

10.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S10E02 - Into the Breach
10.plot: Despite their grave doubts, the ninjas free Lord Garmadon from Kryptarium Prison so that he and Lloyd can enter the cloud of darkness.

10.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S10E03 - The Fall
10.plot: The team pays a terrible price when they attempt to rescue Lloyd and Lord Garmadon, who discover the Oni's weakness while battling the Omega.

10.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S10E04 - Endings
10.plot: The ninjas race back to the Monastery of Spinjitzu, where they must combine their powers and make their last stand against the Oni.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E01 - Wasted True Potential
11.plot: In the wake of a previous victory, the ninjas go soft — leaving Master Wu to remind them of who they truly are.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E02 - Questing For Quests
11.plot: The ninjas search for a quest to reignite their Spinjitzu training; unfortunately, Ninjago City is enjoying a period of rare tranquility.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E03 - A Rocky Start
11.plot: The ninjas take a road trip through the Desert of Doom, a region supposedly inhabited by a giant scarab beetle.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E04 - The Belly of The Beast
11.plot: To repair the Land-Bounty, the ninjas must retrieve a critical engine component that has been swallowed by a giant scarab beetle.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E05 - Boobytraps and How to Survive Them
11.plot: The ninjas team up with a reluctant Clutch Powers to enter a mysterious pyramid, where they inadvertently unleash an ancient evil.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E06 - The News Never Sleeps
11.plot: Lil' Nelson takes a job as a paper carrier, which is difficult in a city overrun by scorching Pyro Vipers and a Serpentine sorceress.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E07 - Ninja vs Lava
11.plot: The ninjas find themselves trapped in a pyramid and must escape encroaching lava to warn Ninjago City of a new Serpentine invasion.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E08 - Snaketastrophy
11.plot: Gayle Gossip and her cameraperson deliver a live newscast of the Serpentine attack on Ninjago City

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E09 - Powerless
11.plot: The ninjas rush to the Ninjago Museum of History to recover a dangerous scroll before it falls into the hands of the Serpentine Sorceress, Aspheera.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E10 - Ancient History
11.plot: While Aspheera pursues revenge on the "Treacherous Deceiver" who betrayed her, the ninjas make a startling discovery.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E11 - Never Trust a Human
11.plot: Master Wu recounts a tale from his childhood, when he and Young Garmadon met Aspheera and taught her the secrets of Spinjitzu

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E12 - Under Siege
11.plot: Having learned the identity of the "Treacherous Deceiver," the ninjas find themselves under siege at the Monastery.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E13 - The Explorers Club
11.plot: Having learned the identity of the "Treacherous One," the ninjas find themselves under siege at the Monastery.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E14 - Vengeance is Mine!
11.plot: Aspheera arrives at the monastery of Spinjitzu and confronts Master Wu, forcing one of the ninjas to make a heroic sacrifice.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E15 - A Cold Goodbye
11.plot: Master Wu prepares to go on a rescue mission, but Lloyd and the other ninjas take matters into their own hands.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E16 - The Never-Realm
11.plot: The ninjas arrive in the Never-Realm, where they quickly find themselves overwhelmed; luckily, a tribe of ice fishers help them out.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E17 - Fire Maker
11.plot: The Ice Emperor learns of the ninjas' arrival and sends his Blizzard Samurai warriors to destroy them and the villagers who sheltered them.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E18 - An Unlikely Ally
11.plot: Lloyd runs afoul of the Ice Emperor's Blizzard Samurai but is rescued by a strange wolf. Soon, they develop an unlikely friendship.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E19 - The Absolute Worst
11.plot: Back in Ninjago City, three criminals learn that the ninjas are away and break out of Kryptarium Prison after lights out.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E20 - The Message
11.plot: Lloyd and his wolf companion find a cave with the mech inside and a message from Zane that provides a clue to his fate.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E21 - The Traveler's Tree
11.plot: Cole embarks on a dangerous quest to the top of a nearby mountain in hopes of finding the legendary Traveler's Tree.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E22 - Krag's Lament
11.plot: Cole awakens inside an icy cavern belonging to a legendary beast and attempts to escape, only to discover a surprising truth.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E23 - Secret of the Wolf
11.plot: The Ice Emperor summons an enormous ice behemoth to attack Lloyd and his wolf friend — and unexpectedly reveals a secret.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E24 - The Last of the Formlings
11.plot: Akita tells the story of the Choosing and how she and her twin brother, Kataru, went into the wilds to discover their animal forms.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E25 - My Enemy, My Friend
11.plot: The Ice Emperor's terrible Ice Dragon strikes again and lays waste to the Ice Fisher's village, forcing the ninjas to go after Lloyd.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E26 - The Kaiju Protocol
11.plot: Back in Ninjago City, Wu and Pixal attempt to locate the Never-Realm and accidentally unleash a dreaded creature from the Departed Realm.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E27 - Corruption
11.plot: At a castle in the mountains, Vex witnesses Zane's arrival in the Never-Realm and seizes the opportunity to gain control of him.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E28 - A Fragile Hope
11.plot: Having discovered the terrible truth of Zane's fate, Lloyd finds himself imprisoned and alone in the clutches of the Ice Emperor.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E29 - Once and For All
11.plot: Nya, Jay, Cole and Kai face off against the Ice Emperor's dreaded dragon, while Lloyd and his newfound allies confront the Ice Emperor himself.

11.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S11E30 - Awakenings
11.plot: In the dramatic conclusion of the Never-Realm saga, the power of friendship battles the corrupting pull of the Scroll of Forbidden Spinjitzu.

12.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S12E01 - Would You Like to Enter Prime Empire?
12.plot: While investigating a heist, the ninjas discover a legendary unreleased arcade game that suddenly takes control of all the other games in Ninjago.

12.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S12E02 - Dyer Island
12.plot: When the ninjas connect Jay's disappearance to Prime Empire, they head to Dyer Island to seek answers from the game's designer, the elusive Milton Dyer.

12.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S12E03 - Level Thirteen
12.plot: Cyrus Borg discovers a shocking secret about Prime Empire, while the ninja battle an escaped Mechanic in their attempt to reach Level Thirteen.

12.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S12E04 - Superstar Rockin´ Jay
12.plot: Now inside the Prime Empire game, the ninjas find themselves in unfamiliar territory as they try to find Jay and evade an army of Red Visors.

12.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S12E05 - I am Okino
12.plot: Inside one of the game zones, a samurai named Okino faces a crisis of faith when he repeatedly fails to lead a series of masters to victory.

12.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S12E06 - The Glitch
12.plot: In order to stop Unagami, the ninjas must obtain three Key-tanas, the first of which is hidden in one of Prime Empire's most dangerous game environments.

12.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S12E07 - The Cliffs of Hysteria
12.plot: While trying to cheer Okino up, the ninjas arrive at the Cliffs of Hysteria and must figure out how to climb them.

12.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S12E08 - The Maze of the Red Dragon
12.plot: Still in the game zone Terra Karana, the samurai guide Okino has to chose between helping the ninjas or obeying the orders of his master, Unagami.

12.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S12E09 - One Step Forward, Two Steps Back
12.plot: The ninjas learn that the only way to acquire the second Key-tana is by winning a race in Terra Technica — and must find racing cars in unexpected ways.

12.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S12E10 - Racer Seven
12.plot: As the ninjas prepare for the brutal Speedway Five-Billion race, Lloyd meets a race driver named Seven — who may hold the key to victory.

12.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S12E11 - The Speedway Five-Billion
12.plot: Unagami's soldiers, the Red Visors, finally discover the secret location of Scott's garage — where they stage an attack against the ninjas.

12.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S12E12 - Stop, Drop and Side Scroll
12.plot: The ninjas barely have time to mourn the loss of their fallen friends before being thrust into the chaos of Terra Domina.

12.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S12E13 - Ninjago Confidential
12.plot: Back in Ninjago City, Zane and Pixal hit the mean streets to track down Milton Dyer, only to discover that things are not what they seem.

12.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S12E14 - The Prodigal Father
12.plot: Zane, kidnapped by the Mechanic, faces Unagami while Pixal questions Milton Dyer for information on how to shut down Prime Empire.

12.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S12E15 - The Temple of Madness
12.plot: Jay must stand alone against Unagami in the end-game. But Unagami has a bigger battle in facing the truth about his own identity.

12.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S12E16 - Game Over
12.plot: When Unagami breaks into the real world and terrorizes Ninjago, Jay, Zane and Pixal attempt to prevent disaster by reuniting him with his creator.

13.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S13E01 - Shintaro
13.plot: The ninjas travel to attend the birthday party of Princess Vania, in the distant Kingdom of Shintaro, and bring along Master Wu.

13.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S13E02 - Into the Dark
13.plot: The ninjas are welcomed to Shintaro, where Cole and Princess Vania investigate a mysterious visitor and explore a secret underground mine.

13.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S13E03 - The Worst Rescue Ever
13.plot: The ninjas attempt to rescue Cole, but the bickering of his fellow prisoners alerts the Skull Sorcerer, and soon the ninjas are prisoners too.

13.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S13E04 - The Two Blades
13.plot: In order to escape the Skull Sorcerer's chain gang, the ninja must convince the Munce and Geckles to put aside their distrust and work together.

13.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S13E05 - Queen of the Munce
13.plot: Separated from the others, Nya, Jay and Lloyd follow a Munce named Murt deep into the mountains, where they meet the Munce Queen.

13.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S13E06 - Trial By Mino
13.plot: Kai and Zane discover a party of Geckles, who suspect them of working with the Skull Sorcerer and bring them to their leader, Chancellor Gulch.

13.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S13E07 - The Skull Sorcerer
13.plot: Cole must trust his instincts and make the right choices to find his way to the surface and alert King Vangelis of the dangerous Skull Sorcerer.

13.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S13E08 - The Real Fall
13.plot: Princess Vania tries to catch the falling Master Wu and Cole. But with too much weight on her wings, they find themselves plunging into the mountain.

13.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S13E09 - Dungeon Party!
13.plot: Having survived their fall into the mountain, Cole, Wu and Princess Vania befriend a motley group of survivors called the Lowly.

13.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S13E10 - Dungeon Crawl!
13.plot: Cole leads the Lowly, Princess Vania and Master Wu in a series of fruitless efforts to find a way out of the inescapable Rock-Bottom.

13.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S13E11 - Grief-Bringer
13.plot: Nya and Kai attempt to bring the Munce and Geckles together in an effort to defeat their mutual enemy, the Skull Sorcerer.

13.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S13E12 - Masters Never Quit
13.plot: Pursued by a magma monster, Cole, Princess Vania, Wu & the Lowly arrive at a mysterious temple deep in Shintaro Mountain.

13.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S13E13 - The Darkest Hour
13.plot: The ninjas, the Munce and the Geckles take refuge in the Geckle Strong-Cave after they're all forced to flee by the Grief-Bringer's arrival.

13.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S13E14 - The Ascent
13.plot: Cole, the Lowly, Princess Vania and Wu learn that the stone-mech is powered by Elemental Earth energy and use it to blast their way out of the mountain.

13.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S13E15 - The Upply Strike Back!
13.plot: Cole and the Upply arrive at the Skull Sorcerer's Keep and find the ninjas locked into cages and the Geckles and Munce back at work in the chain gang.

13.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S13E16 - The Son of Lilly
13.plot: As Cole and the Skull Sorcerer face off, the Geckles and Munce storm the Keep. Plundar frees the ninjas from their cages so they can join the battle.

14.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S14E01 - Uncharted
14.plot: The ninjas launch a rescue mission after learning that Master Wu, Misako, and Clutch Powers have gone missing on an expedition to an uncharted island.

14.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S14E02 - The Keepers of the Amulet
14.plot: The ninjas search the island, where they find a friendly dragon and power-absorbing stone statues ready to attack!

14.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S14E03 - The Gift of Jay
14.plot: The leader of the Keepers orders Nya, Kai, Zane, and Cole into a prison. But Jay is brought to a luxurious hut with amazing food!

14.title: FR - LEGO Ninjago : Les Maîtres Du Spinjitzu - S14E04 - The Tooth of Wojira
14.plot: The ninjas try to save their friend after breaking free of their bonds. Jay finds himself in a cavern of treasure, where the real villain is revealed.

meta.plot: When the fate of their world, Ninjago, is challenged by great threats, it's up to the ninja: Kai, Jay, Cole, Zane, Lloyd and Nya to save the world.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E01 - The DVD
1.plot: An overdue DVD causes chaos (and a hefty fee) for Gumball and Darwin.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E02 - The Responsible
1.plot: Gumball and Darwin get to babysit Anais whilst their parents go to a PTA meeting but being "responsible" has a different meaning when you don't know what it means.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E03 - The Third
1.plot: Gumball and Darwin grow bored of one another and seek out a third friend to make their lives more exciting.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E04 - The Debt
1.plot: Believing that his life had been saved, Gumball vows to repay his debt by saving Mr. Robinson's life.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E05 - The End
1.plot: Gumball and Darwin, thinking that the world will end in 24 hours, decide to make the most out of their remaining time.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E06 - The Dress
1.plot: When his clothes are shrunk in the washing machine by his father, Gumball is forced to wear his mother's wedding dress to school.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E07 - The Quest
1.plot: Gumball and Darwin help Anais get her beloved doll back after it is lost on the way to school.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E08 - The Spoon
1.plot: Gumball and Darwin become unwitting accomplices in a stick-up at a gas station.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E09 - The Pressure
1.plot: When Masami claims that Darwin is her boyfriend, Gumball vows to help his friend before he gets kissed.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E10 - The Painting
1.plot: After seeing a picture that Anais drew, Principal Brown assumes that Anais finds her family dysfunctional, so he begins to meddle in their family life.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E11 - The Laziest
1.plot: Gumball and Darwin challenge their father to a laziness competition, with the loser having to do the winner's chores.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E12 - The Ghost
1.plot: When a ghost named Carrie possesses Gumball's body in order to feel earthly experiences and to eat, he must learn to say "no" to her.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E13 - The Mystery
1.plot: Gumball decides to investigate when his class finds Principal Brown wrapped up in toilet paper, shaved and, covered in green paint, or else face detention.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E14 - The Prank
1.plot: Gumball and Darwin's pranks on their father get out of hand.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E15 - The Gi
1.plot: Gumball and Darwin are ridiculed for their martial-arts outfits by their schoolmates, and their mom tries to convince them to take them off.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E16 - The Kiss
1.plot: A kiss from Grandma JoJo traumatizes Gumball, and Darwin attempts to help him forget.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E17 - The Party
1.plot: Gumball and his friends are invited to a high-school party hosted by Tobias's sister Rachel, but they must find dates in order to attend.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E18 - The Refund
1.plot: Gumball and Darwin go to great lengths to get their money back from an incompatible video game, but the rental store's policy prevents them from getting it.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E19 - The Robot
1.plot: Gumball decides to help Bobert act like a real boy. However, it soon becomes a battle for his very identity when the robot plots to take over his life.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E20 - The Picnic
1.plot: A school picnic in the Forest of Doom poses a hazard for Gumball and Darwin.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E21 - The Goons
1.plot: Gumball competes in a race in order to win Dad back.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E22 - The Secret
1.plot: Gumball tries desperately to find out Darwin's secret.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E23 - The Sock
1.plot: Mr. Small teaches Gumball and Darwin various ways of becoming more honest.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E24 - The Genius
1.plot: Darwin goes to an institute for geniuses.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E25 - The Poltergeist
1.plot: Richard believes there's a ghost in the attic but is actually Mr. Robinson who Gumball moved up there after entering a catatonic state due to being kicked out by his wife. Gumball and Darwin work on trying to restore Mr. Robinson whilst Richard, unaware of this, sets traps for the ghost.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E26 - The Mustache
1.plot: Gumball and Darwin want to become adults, Richard wants to lose weight. After accidentally having their cereal switched with supplements Richard ordered, Gumball, Darwin and Anais find themselves having very unusual growth spurts.

1.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S01E27 - The Date

5.plot: When Darwin has lunch with Idaho, he decides to stop eating potatoes in solidarity with his brotato, but he finds his obsession with his favorite food harder to kick than he ever imagined, so Gumball decides to help his friend curb his carb cravings.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E12 - The Fuss
5.plot: Nicole tries, and fails, to hide her disappointment when Richard and the kids fail to remember her special day. Richard has to figure out what special day he has actually forgotten and then make it a day to remember or else.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E13 - The Copycats
5.plot: Gumball and Darwin are confused when they meet Chi Chi and Ribbit, a pair of siblings that copy everything they do and say. Then they find out this copycat family is making money online from imitating the Watterson family.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E14 - The Outside
5.plot: The family goes to visit Richard's dad. Based on his basic living standards and extended absence from Richard's life, they assume Frankie must have done a stretch in the slammer.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E15 - The Vase
5.plot: Sick of Granny Jojo's ugly gifts, Nicole encourages the kids to take matters into their own hands and "accidentally" break her latest hideous vase. But when Gumball, Darwin, and Anais try to destroy it, they discover it is more robust than it seems.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E16 - The Matchmaker
5.plot: Gumball enlists Carrie to help bring Darwin and Teri together, but when they can't make Darwin and Teri's love blossom naturally, they decide to make it happen supernaturally.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E17 - The Box
5.plot: The Wattersons receive an unmarked package in the mail. To distract themselves from the urge to open it they all take turns to imagine what it might contain.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E19 - The Ollie
5.plot: Gumball teaches Darwin everything he knows about the world of skateboarding.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E20 - The Catfish
5.plot: When Gumball and Darwin realize Grandpa Louie has no friends, they create one called Muriel, when Granny Jojo finds out Louie has been spending time online with another woman, Muriel not existing is not going to stop her from being destroyed.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E21 - The Cycle
5.plot: Gumball, Darwin and Anais discover that Mr. Wilson has been picking on Richard for most of his life; ever since he humiliated Richard with a high school prank. The kids try to work their dad through it, but when their efforts fail they realize that getting back at Mr. Wilson is the only way to break the cycle.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E22 - The Stars
5.plot: When Richard gives Larry’s hairdresser a bad review for saying he’s bald, he gets offered a free haircut. This inspires Gumball and Darwin to go on a reviewing spree across town, forcing Larry to give them stuff with the threat of a bad review. But, just because the customer is always right doesn’t mean that what they’re doing isn’t wrong.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E23 - The Grades
5.plot: When a failed test grade brings down Gumball’s grade point average, he is forced to return to kindergarten.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E24 - The Diet
5.plot: Gumball and Darwin find out why Richard's diet wasn't working, and after they help him lose weight, he becomes more obnoxious.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E25 - The Ex
5.plot: When Gumball learns that his nemesis, Rob, has found a new nemesis, he tries to sabotage Rob's new "enemy-ship", much to the frustration of Penny.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E26 - The Sorcerer
5.plot: Gumball refuses to accept he is the only kid at school that does not have special powers. He convinces Mrs. Jötunheim, Hector's mom, to take him on as her apprentice but she soon learns leaving Gumball unsupervised around magic is a big mistake.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E27 - The Menu
5.plot: The prize jewel on the Secret Joyful Burger menu is a mysterious burger, but to order it you need to know its name. When Larry refuses to tell Richard, Gumball, and Darwin what it is called, they go to super-sized lengths to discover it.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E28 - The Uncle
5.plot: When Gumball finds out that Ocho has an uncle named Mario, he becomes desperate to meet him.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E29 - The Weirdo
5.plot: When they see the school bullies making fun of Sussie, Gumball and Darwin decide to try and help her act less weird. They carefully observe her behavior and decide that the only thing they have to change is absolutely everything.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E30 - The Heist
5.plot: Richard discovers that going into a bank whilst wearing a motorcycle helmet can lead to trouble.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E31 - The Singing
5.plot: Join the citizens of Elmore for a song and dance spectacular that will have people covering their ears with joy.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E32 - The Best
5.plot: No matter what Gumball does, Carmen thinks she knows better; when Gumball attempts to gain the moral high ground, but fails, his only option left is to bring Carmen down to his level.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E33 - The Worst
5.plot: The Wattersons compete over who has the worst life.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E34 - The Deal
5.plot: Richard goes on strike to prove that his work around the house is under appreciated by Nicole.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E35 - The Petals
5.plot: When Leslie's petals begin falling off, he feels like his good looks are fading, so Gumball and Darwin use everything they know about style and beauty to try and help him.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E36 - The Puppets
5.plot: Darwin is delighted when they discover their old childhood toys, but soon realizes that some things are best left in the past.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E37 - The Nuisance
5.plot: The Wattersons fear the worst when they are summoned to a Town Hall meeting, but are surprised when they're offered a new house - until they discover it's in a different state.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E38 - The Line
5.plot: The Wattersons will do whatever it takes to get into the first screening of the latest Stellar Odyssey sequel.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E39 - The List
5.plot: When the kids find out that Mom's life hasn't panned out as she'd hoped, they start taking on her chores, but they accidentally grab her bucket list instead of her to-do list.

5.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S05E40 - The News
5.plot: From police chases to the inside scoop on Daisy the Donkey, Channel 6 Elmore News has all the top local stories. Experienced newscaster Kip Schlezinger brings the latest news, sports and weather, even when there is absolutely nothing to report.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E01 - The Rival
6.plot: When Anais is a newborn baby, Gumball and Darwin become jealous of their new sibling, and spark a baby war.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E02 - The Lady
6.plot: Gumball and Darwin find out that Dad has been dressing as a woman to make friends.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E03 - The Sucker
6.plot: Darwin ends up in detention with Julius, who decides to make Darwin his new target. However, it backfires when Darwin ruins his life.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E04 - The Vegging
6.plot: Gumball and Darwin want to veg out all day, but their plans go awry and they have to save the rest of the family.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E05 - The One
6.plot: Tobias tries to be Gumball’s best friend.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E06 - The Father
6.plot: The kids try to help Richard bond with Frankie.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E07 - The Cringe
6.plot: Gumball and Hot Dog Guy discover why they're so awkward with each other.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E08 - The Cage
6.plot: The kids convince Mr. Corneille to become a cage fighter and set up a fight against a fearsome Russian fighter.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E09 - The Faith
6.plot: Alan has lost faith in humanity and turns the world black and white. Gumball must get over his hatred of Alan to bring the color back by singing.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E10 - The Candidate
6.plot: A group of kids get locked in the school after their parents have a charity gala. They appoint Gumball as leader to get them out but it leads to chaos.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E11 - The Anybody
6.plot: When Clayton shapeshifts into Gumball to take his detention, he starts framing others for misdemeanors so Gumball and Darwin must track Clayton down to stop him.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E12 - The Pact
6.plot: Gumball and Principal Brown make a pact to tell each other what problems their girlfriends have.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E13 - The Neighbor
6.plot: Gumball and Darwin try to find out the name of their neighbor, Antlers Guy, but accidentally blow his witness protection cover.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E14 - The Shippening
6.plot: Sarah finds a notebook from the Awesome Store which magically makes what she draws happen. Unfortunately, she draws bizarre love stories throughout Elmore.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E15 - The Brain
6.plot: The Wattersons have to stop doing stupid things in order to prevent Anais from falling into a coma from facepalming too much.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E16 - The Parents
6.plot: Nicole and her parents reconnect after a long forced absence.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E17 - The Founder
6.plot: Richard creates chaos in the Chanax building when he is mistaken for the long lost CEO. Nicole and a disgruntled employee must save everyone from Richard's dangerous ideas.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E18 - The Schooling
6.plot: Gumball and Darwin take on Larry's jobs for 5 minutes and realize how bad it is.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E19 - The Intelligence
6.plot: Technology reaches human intelligence then becomes dysfunctional as it picks up human flaws.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E20 - The Potion
6.plot: Gumball and Darwin use a magic potion to shrink Hector.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E21 - The Spinoffs
6.plot: Rob creates a variety of spinoff Elmore shows and formats to replace Gumball.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E22 - The Transformation
6.plot: Gumball is asked to settle a dispute between Penny and her family.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E23 - The Understanding
6.plot: Gumball and Darwin get into trouble misunderstanding a new kid in school.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E24 - The Ad
6.plot: The Wattersons are forced to rent their house to a pair of elderly fainting goats.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E25 - The Ghouls
6.plot: Halloween isn't what it used to be. Can Gumball and Darwin help the ghouls get their scare back?

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E26 - The Stink
6.plot: Mr. Small goes feral after Gumball and Darwin expose his hypocrisy.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E27 - The Awareness
6.plot: Gumball decides to engross himself in plant culture to appease Leslie after making an offensive comment.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E28 - The Slip
6.plot: Richard misses a package and is forced into an escalating feud with the delivery guy.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E29 - The Drama
6.plot: Gumball tries to protect Darwin from his unsuitable undead girlfriend Carrie.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E30 - The Buddy
6.plot: Anais and Jamie form an unlikely partnership when they're accused of a crime they didn't commit.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E31 - The Possession
6.plot: Richard becomes supernaturally attached to his old refrigerator.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E32 - The Master
6.plot: The Wattersons play a fantasy role-playing board game to resolve their differences.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E33 - The Silence
6.plot: Have Gumball and Darwin finally run out of things to say to each other?

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E34 - The Future
6.plot: Banana Joe's Mom can predict the future, but she can't predict her own disappearance.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E35 - The Wish
6.plot: Gumball and Darwin believe they've turned Miss Simian into a neck-cushion.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E36 - The Factory
6.plot: Gumball and Darwin save the day at the Rainbow Factory.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E37 - The Agent
6.plot: Gumball and Darwin's clothes go missing after a swimming lesson; when Gumball is forced to wear a tuxedo from the lost and found office, he believes it makes him look like a certain dapper British secret agent.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E38 - The Web
6.plot: Gumball and Darwin realize that the adult residents of Elmore are dangerously naive when it comes to being safe online, and in fact are in serious need of the boys' help with even the simplest of tasks.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E39 - The Mess
6.plot: After staying up all night, the boys baby-sit Penny's little sister and manage to lose her in the blink of an eye.

6.title: FR - The Amazing World of Gumball - S06E40 - The Heart
6.plot: Mr. Robinson tries and repeatedly fails to win back Gumball and Darwin's friendship.

meta.plot: The life of Gumball Watterson, a 12-year old cat who attends middle school in Elmore. Accompanied by his pet, adoptive brother, and best friend Darwin Watterson, he frequently finds himself involved in various shenanigans around the city, during which he interacts with various family members: Anais, Richard, and Nicole Watterson, and other various citizens.

meta.plot: À sa sortie de prison, le rappeur Bosco prépare son grand retour. Mais sa sœur Vita lui vole la vedette et met à rude épreuve les liens familiaux qui les unissent.

1.title: FR - You Are What You Eat: A Twin Experiment - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Identical twins join a scientific study and must stick to either a plant-based or omnivorous diet for eight weeks to determine what is the healthiest.

1.title: FR - You Are What You Eat: A Twin Experiment - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: The twins begin their diets with a mix of successes and struggles. The recommended dietary guidelines raise concerns. A renowned chef changes course.

1.title: FR - You Are What You Eat: A Twin Experiment - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The twins adjust to cooking their own meals. With some animal products linked to health problems, innovators turn to plants for sustainable alternatives.

1.title: FR - You Are What You Eat: A Twin Experiment - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: The study results are revealed to the twins as they review their weight, gut and brain health, and more. A movement in the food industry gains momentum.

meta.plot: Identical twins change their diets and lifestyles for eight weeks in a unique scientific experiment designed to explore how certain foods impact the body.

1.title: FR - The New Look - S01E01 - Just You Wait and See
1.plot: In Nazi-occupied Paris, Christian Dior fears for his resistance-fighter sister, Catherine. Coco Chanel makes a deal that will forever haunt her.

1.title: FR - The New Look - S01E02 - The Hour
1.plot: Christian embarks on a quest to free Catherine from German captivity. Coco is sent on an undercover mission and recruits her friend Elsa.

1.title: FR - The New Look - S01E03 - Nothing but Blue Skies
1.plot: Coco suffers the consequences of her relationship with Spatz. Christian's pursuit of Catherine takes a fatal turn.

1.title: FR - The New Look - S01E04 - What a Difference
1.plot: After Paris is liberated by Allied troops, Nazi collaborators face punishment—including Coco. Christian is conflicted about ever designing again.

1.title: FR - The New Look - S01E05 - Give Your Heart and Soul to Me
1.plot: Christian is offered a job that will forever change the course of his life. Coco struggles with her outsider status as she's self-exiled in Switzerland.

1.title: FR - The New Look - S01E06 - If You Believed in Me
1.plot: Desperate to stand up to her business partners, Coco begins a war over her most famous perfume. Christian must redefine his relationships.

1.title: FR - The New Look - S01E07 - It All Came True
1.plot: Christian takes unexpectedly bold and daring next steps to launch his fashion house. Coco figures out how to use Elsa's “talents” to her advantage.

meta.plot: The shocking story of how fashion icon Christian Dior and his contemporaries including Coco Chanel, Pierre Balmain, and Cristóbal Balenciaga navigated the horrors of World War Il and launched modern fashion.

1.title: FR - Bandidos - S01E01 - The Map
1.plot: Miguel stumbles into an old flame at the hotel, then meets a guest with a peculiar last name — and even stranger tattoo — who ignites his dreams of gold.

1.title: FR - Bandidos - S01E02 - The Sacred Place
1.plot: As their plan goes awry, the gang pivots to help Miguel. With the cops hot on their trail, Miguel and Wilson enlist a new member and dash to the cenote.

1.title: FR - Bandidos - S01E03 - The Stone
1.plot: With Miguel facing a dismaying fate, Lucas's gadgets come in handy, as does Lilí's idea — still, they're bound for an explosive confrontation.

1.title: FR - Bandidos - S01E04 - The Legend of the Three Keys
1.plot: After Lilí saves the day, the gang considers splitting, but a dire threat binds them back together. Juan offers a cryptic, yet monumental clue.

1.title: FR - Bandidos - S01E05 - The Exchange
1.plot: The bandits hit their next target: Churches. With time running out, they decide to divide and conquer... but outsmarting their pursuers won't be easy.

1.title: FR - Bandidos - S01E06 - The Traitor
1.plot: After their stunt is stalled, the group must figure out if there's a traitor among them. Soon, more than one revelation comes to light.

1.title: FR - Bandidos - S01E07 - The Treasure
1.plot: As doubt looms over Miguel, Wilson encourages him to continue the adventure. But is discovering the treasure truly written in the stars?

meta.plot: A gang of skilled misfits ventures to uncover a long-hidden Mayan treasure. Their strategy? Hazy. Their dynamic? Off. Luckily, they're pretty ingenious.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Do Min Joon, an alien who landed in Korea 400 years ago, discovers that he has three months left on Earth. And that is when he meets Cheon Song Yi, the biggest Hallyu star in Korea.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Min Joon embarrasses Song Yi in public while she films for a documentary special about her daily life.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Song Yi suffers from appendicitis, and forces Min Joon to take her to the hospital. He takes the opportunity to protect her from his premonition

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: When an actress dies from an accident, Song Yi is immediately the target for blame. She seeks refuge in Min Joon's apartment, uncovering secrets that he'd like to keep buried.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Song Yi hides away in Min Joon's apartment after the suspicious death of fellow actress Han Yoo Ra. Prosecutor Yoo Suk begins an investigation to look into whether her death was a suicide or not.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Following the Han Yoo Ra scandal, Song Yi postpones renewing her contract with her management.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: As the threats intensify, Song Yi turns to Min Joon for help. He slowly becomes more human-like by being around her so often, and agrees to be her temporary manager.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Song Yi thinks stress is contributing to her "hallucinations" of Min Joon saving her. The investigation intensifies as witnesses to Jae Kyung and Yoo Ra's relationship begin to disappear.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: Min Joon gets sick after he shares a kiss with Song Yi. Se Mi decides to finally meet Min Joon for herself.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: Song Yi has difficulty dealing with her feelings for Min Joon, who's also trying to distance himself from her and not reveal his true nature to anyone.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E11 - Episode 11
1.plot: Jae Kyung will go at any lengths to get Song Yi and Min Joon. Jae Kyung begins to view his brother in a different light.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E12 - Episode 12
1.plot: Song Yi refuses to hear what Se Mi has to say about her savior from 12 years ago. Min Joon recovers from his injuries but realizes that his heart is now broken.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E13 - Episode 13
1.plot: Min Joon does his best to distance himself from Song Yi and hold up his end of the deal with Jae Kyung.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E14 - Episode 14
1.plot: When Song Yi's wires break while shooting, it's a game to the death with no holds barred between Min Joon and Jae Kyung.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E15 - Episode 15
1.plot: Song Yi recovers from her injuries but Hee Kyung is still in a coma. Min Joon can't stay away from protecting Song Yi.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E16 - Episode 16
1.plot: Min Joon and Song Yi admit their feelings for one another and start dating, but his departure date looms near.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E17 - Episode 17
1.plot: Hee Kyung won't stop until he finds his sister-in-law and uncovers his brother's dark secrets. Song Yi and Min Joon can't deal with the fact that he'll need to leave in a month.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E18 - Episode 18
1.plot: Min Joon's powers weaken as he stays on Earth longer than he should. Hee Kyung discovers his brother's true self but it will be more difficult than it seems to have him pay for his crimes.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E19 - Episode 19
1.plot: Hee Kyung must find a way to stop Jae Kyung before he himself ends up on his brother's hit list. Song Yi discovers the price Min Joon must pay if he stays with her.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E20 - Episode 20
1.plot: With one week left before he leaves, Song Yi and Min Joon spend each day as if they had seventy more years left together.

1.title: FR - Mon amour venu des étoiles - S01E21 - Episode 21
1.plot: Do Min Joon's departure is too difficult to bear for Song Yi, even three years later.

meta.plot: An alien who came to Earth 400 years ago is almost able to return to his own planet, but when he meets a famous actress, he doesn't want to go home.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E01 - Vengeance of the Gods
1.plot: On his trip back to Earth, Ulysses' son is carried off by the Cyclops to give sight to his followers with Telemachus' life force. Ulysses destroys the Cyclops and saves Telemachus, Yumi and Numinor. In retaliation the ancient Gods then send his ship, the Odyssey, into an unknown part of space with the bulk of its crew cursed to remain lifeless, floating in mid-air until Ulysses finds the Kingdom of Hades.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E02 - The Black Sphere
1.plot: On an isolated asteroid Ulysses meets an old, blind, scholar called Heratos and his assistant, a young Zotrian woman named Atena. Heratos gives Ulysses a map that will lead him beyond the galactic glaciers - or so he claims.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E03 - Flowers of Fear
1.plot: The Odyssey comes across a lifeless city world. On hearing that its people had the technology to bring the dead back to life, Yumi takes Numinor to the planet to revive him. However, she learns why there is no life in the city.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E04 - Cronus, Father of Time
1.plot: Ulysses is saved from a Trident attack by Chronos, the god of time, who wants to use him as leverage to be allowed to reenter the home of the gods.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E05 - The Lost Planet
1.plot: Numinor is awaken when The Odyssey chances upon a satellite world that has strayed far from it's orbit around he and Yumi's home world. Ulysses, Telemachus, Nono, Numinor and Yumi head down to the planet and make the startling discovery that the entire population has been turned to stone by an evil Witch.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E06 - Guardian of the Cosmic Winds
1.plot: Aeolus, King of the winds, kidnaps Ulysses to provide entertainment for his daughter's birthday party. Unable to watch her father's cruel sport, she frees the captives and helps them escape.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E07 - The Eternal Punishment
1.plot: Ulysses encounters Sisyphus, a king condemned to fill a crater with boulders for all eternity for having dared to want the secret of immortality. Zeus has promised Sisyphus he can leave if he makes Ulysses take his place.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E08 - Mutiny on Board
1.plot: A space storm revives the companions as crazed automatons who take over the ship and try to crash it into space glaciers.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E09 - Secret of the Sphinx
1.plot: Passing through the domain of the great Sphinx, Ulysses must answer his riddle to leave safely. His treacherous daughter kidnaps the children and plots to make Ulysses her slave.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E10 - Temple of the Lestrigones
1.plot: The Odyssey arrives on a tropical planet, where the ruling tyrant uses a magic prism to shrink them.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E11 - Trapped Between Fire And Ice
1.plot: Trying to help a stranded astronaut, Ulysses tries to find a hidden base on one of the deadly twin planets Scylla or Charybdis.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E12 - The Seat of Forgetfulness
1.plot: Ulysses follows a Trident carrier in hopes of learning more about the way out of Olympus, and finds himself trapped in bizarre worlds. To save the children, he will have to give up his memories.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E13 - Song of Danger
1.plot: Pirates kidnap the children to force Ulysses and No-No to brave the danger of the Sirens, said to guard a map of the Olympus universe.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E14 - Phantoms from the Swamp
1.plot: Coming across a piece of Zotra that could bring Numinor back to life, Ulysses and Yumi pursue it to a swamp planet where they are ambushed by monsters who can copy their forms

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E15 - Before the Flood
1.plot: Ulysses and the crew land on a planet similar to prehistoric earth. They encounter a winged female named Sauria, whose people are under attack from mutant vultures called Keconopters.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E16 - The Magic Spells of Circe
1.plot: The crew of the Odyssey are enslaved by the magic of the enchantress Circe and turned into pig-people to build a tower that will house all the knowledge of the universe.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E17 - The Hidden Truth
1.plot: The shapechanger Nereus calls Ulysses for help when Shark Men, servants of the gods, take over his planet.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E18 - Lost in the Labyrinth
1.plot: Princess Ariadne comes upon the Odyssey, and asks for Ulysses' help in saving her lover Theseus, who has been exiled to her father's labyrinth to be killed by the fearsome Minotaur.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E19 - At the Heart of the Universe
1.plot: Mercurius, the bubble-dwelling "grandson of the gods," enlists Ulysses' help in taking a jewel from the brow of the giant Atlas under the promise that it will give him the power to send Ulysses home.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E20 - The Magician in Black
1.plot: Ulysses is saved from an attack by the most powerful magician in the universe who breaks the gods' curse on his crew; however, as payment for his services, demands to hunt Ulysses's best men.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E21 - Rebellion on Lemnos
1.plot: Princess Hypsipyle of the planet Lemnos is found by Ulysses; she tells them that the women of her planet are being forced by the Shark Men to build ships for the gods.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E22 - The City of Cortex
1.plot: The Odyssey is dragged to a planet populated by machines, and governed by the tyrannical computer Cortex. One of its inhabitants, a "female" robot named Nanette, falls in love with No-No.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E23 - Strange Meeting
1.plot: Ulysses and the children are sent back in time and meet the original Ulysses, Telemachus and Penelope of Homer's epic.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E24 - The Lotus Eaters
1.plot: Needing raw materials to repair the Odyssey, Ulysses travels to a world where the inhabitants are addicted to eating seeds which induce amnesia.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E25 - Calypso
1.plot: The Odyssey responds to a distress call from Queen Calypso, who tells him that if he saves her planet she will tell him the way back to earth. Calypso has been ordered by Zeus to betray Ulysses, but she falls in love with him and cannot carry out the gods' orders.

1.title: FR - Ulysse 31 - S01E26 - The Kingdom of Hades
1.plot: In the final episode, Ulysses and his companions reach the Kingdom of Hades. They meet Orpheus, who seeks Ulysses' help to find his love, Eurydice, who has been taken to the Kingdom of Hades by Charon. Hades, the god of death, tells Ulysses that he must leave his companions behind if he wishes to return to Earth. He rejects the offer, which was a final test, and they all return home.

meta.plot: Ulysses and his crew struggle against the divine entities that rule the universe, the ancient gods from Greek mythology.

1.title: FR - Les Frères Sun - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: A family emergency sends a ruthless killer from Taipei to LA. Cash-strapped Bruce takes a new gig. When a crisis erupts, estranged brothers reunite.

1.title: FR - Les Frères Sun - S01E02 - Favor for a Favor
1.plot: Charles introduces Bruce to his unique line of work while trying to get rid of a body. But he continues to be a moving target everywhere he goes.

1.title: FR - Les Frères Sun - S01E03 - Whatever You Want
1.plot: When Bruce goes missing, Mama Sun and Charles drop in on a mahjong game and a seafood restaurant for answers. A common goal makes allies out of enemies.

1.title: FR - Les Frères Sun - S01E04 - Square
1.plot: Hesitant to join the family business, Bruce vows to focus on school and improv. But when a triad meeting proves dangerous, the Suns are forced to pivot.

1.title: FR - Les Frères Sun - S01E05 - The Rolodex
1.plot: In the fallout of the attacks, Bruce works hard to be a useful asset, Mama Sun leverages her knowledge and a wounded Charles wakes up in a strange place.

1.title: FR - Les Frères Sun - S01E06 - Country Boy
1.plot: Mama Sun travels to Taiwan and hears upsetting news. A celebrity's holiday home provides the perfect safe house for the brothers. Bruce bonds with Grace.

1.title: FR - Les Frères Sun - S01E07 - Gymkata
1.plot: With the ghosts gathering in Los Angeles, the family regroups until an unexpected visitor disrupts their plans. A momentous occasion descends into chaos.

1.title: FR - Les Frères Sun - S01E08 - Protect the Family
1.plot: The Suns' lives and legacy hang in the balance as old wounds and hard truths come to light. Bruce makes a choice that could change the family forever.

meta.plot: When a mysterious enemy targets his family, a Taipei triad member heads to Los Angeles to protect his strong-willed mother and oblivious younger brother.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E01 - THE SEWN-LIP MAN
1.plot: On social media, rumors of a mysterious phenomenon, known as "Hologram Ghosts," are spreading. Hiro Amanokawa, a first-year junior high school student, activates a mysterious device left behind by his father, and encounters a Digimon called Gammamon.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E02 - THE MYSTERY OF THE MUSEUM
1.plot: Ancient Egyptian mummies are on special display at the museum. There is a rumor that a huge man fully covered in bandages was witnessed kidnapping people in the area. Hiro and Gammamon decide to visit the museum to investigate.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E03 - SCRIBBLES
1.plot: The new paranormal phenomenon is spreading. It is said that if red scribbles appear somewhere on your body in a digital photo, that area will begin to act strange. The red scribbles then appear on Ruli’s photo.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E04 - THE DOLL’S MANOR
1.plot: Trick or treat! It’s Halloween and Ruli is getting ready with decorations. However, one by one, people begin to disappear. Hiro and the gang investigate.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E05 - Divine Anger
1.plot: Something has disrupted the digital money system, angering the envoy of the god of wealth. What has caused the disruption? Hiro and the gang are on the case.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E06 - The Cursed Song
1.plot: Ruli and the gang are researching the paranormal sightings around the city when they stop to investigate a rumor about a haunted karaoke box. It’s said that if a certain song is sung, a mysterious and creepy voice begins to sing along with you.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E07 - Birds
1.plot: A mysterious group of crows are going around releasing captive birds around the city, including Ruli’s friend’s pet sparrow. The gang agrees to track down the missing bird and get to the bottom of this unknown threat.

1.title: FR - Digimon Ghost Game [SUB] - S01E08 - Nightly Procession of Monsters
