7.plot: The Siege of Mandalore begins, and Ahsoka turns to Anakin and Obi-Wan for help.

7.title: FR - Star Wars : The Clone Wars - S07E10 - The Phantom Apprentice
7.plot: The battle for Mandalore continues, and Ahsoka finds herself face to face with Maul.

7.title: FR - Star Wars : The Clone Wars - S07E11 - Shattered
7.plot: Maul is captured and the Siege of Mandalore is won. But evil lurks elsewhere, and the galaxy will never be the same.

7.title: FR - Star Wars : The Clone Wars - S07E12 - Victory and Death
7.plot: In the wake of Order 66, Ahsoka and Rex must work together to survive.

meta.plot: Yoda, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, Mace Windu and other Jedi Knights lead the Grand Army of the Republic against the droid army of the Separatists.

1.title: FR - L'Intrigante et le Roi - S01E01 -
FR - L'Intrigante et le Roi - S01E02 -

meta.plot: L'histoire d'amour cruelle entre le roi Lee In, menacé par des luttes de pouvoir intestines, et Kang Hee Soo, qui cherche à le séduire pour se venger, mais tombe dans son propre piège.

1.title: FR - Ancestral - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: At her unknown uncle’s funeral, Yoon Seo-ha meets Kim Young-ho, a man claiming to be her half brother. Meanwhile, detective Choi Sung-jun chases new leads.

1.title: FR - Ancestral - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Seo-ha suspects Young-ho may have a hand in a recent tragic murder. An age-old conflict between chief detective Park Sang-min and Sung-jun surfaces.

1.title: FR - Ancestral - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Confronted with the shocking truth about the burial ground, Seo-ha finds herself in peril — and she must devise a last-ditch effort to save herself.

meta.plot: La jeune, Yun Seo-ha, hérite des terres familiales à la mort soudaine de son oncle et qui se retrouve mêlée à des événements étranges...

1.title: FR - Le Garçon et l'Univers - S01E01 - Boy Smells Rat
1.plot: Eli starts the day with a turbulent driving lesson from Slim. School bullies confront Eli with a challenge, but a teacher catches them in the act.

1.title: FR - Le Garçon et l'Univers - S01E02 - Boy Gets Chop
1.plot: Lyle shows Eli and Gus around his workplace and introduces them to his boss, Tytus Broz. Later, a surprise visit to Eli's house leads to trouble.

1.title: FR - Le Garçon et l'Univers - S01E03 - Run Boy Run
1.plot: Frankie gets herself in trouble for protecting her sons. Eli searches for a way back home to look for his stepdad — and his missing stash.

1.title: FR - Le Garçon et l'Univers - S01E04 - Boy Loses Dad
1.plot: Caitlyn continues investigating Lyle's disappearance. Accompanied by police, the school's guidance counselor checks on the boys.

1.title: FR - Le Garçon et l'Univers - S01E05 - Boy Takes Flight
1.plot: Eli asks for a big favor from Slim's old acquaintance and comes across a major clue about Lyle's disappearance.

1.title: FR - Le Garçon et l'Univers - S01E06 - Boy Seeks Work
1.plot: Eli and Gus show Frankie what they've planned for their future. Later, Eli attempts to get a job as a journalist at the local paper.

1.title: FR - Le Garçon et l'Univers - S01E07 - Boy Meets End
1.plot: Eli finds an unlikely source for a story to submit to The Courier-Mail. New evidence leads Caitlyn to uncover the truth about the criminal underworld.

meta.plot: Dans les années 80, un jeune garçon d'une banlieue de Brisbane est confronté aux dures réalités de la vie, ainsi qu'aux dangers imminents qui menacent sa famille.

1.title: FR - Shaman King Flowers - S01E01 - Asakura vs. Secret Asakura
1.plot: 14 years after the Shaman Fight, Asakura Hana is attacked by Yohane and Luca who want to kill Hana and take his place as the true heirs of the Asakura Family.

1.title: FR - Shaman King Flowers - S01E02 - West Tokyo Sound Effect Festival
1.plot: After running across Tamamura Tamao, Asakura Hana hides that he was fighting again and rushes back to Funbari Onsen. Tamao decides to take Umemiya Ryunosuke's motorcycle so that she can investigate the secret Asakura Family. Back at the inn, Hana is caught by the Hana-Gumi Waitresses. By the time Hana returns with the first aid kit to the cemetery, Yohane is gone.

meta.plot: Asakura Hana finds that being the son of Asakura You & Anna isn't all it's cracked up to be, and his boredom has him itching for any kind of excitement. But when a fight comes straight to his doorstep, it's from a place he least expects—his own family? The battle for Asakura supremacy begins!

1.title: FR - La chorale - S01E01 - The Kids from Detroit
1.plot: After their success on "America's Got Talent" can the DYC continue growing to reach their potential?

1.title: FR - La chorale - S01E02 - Raising the Bar
1.plot: Top performers get ready for a big gig as Azaria fights to keep up at a playoff basketball game.

1.title: FR - La chorale - S01E03 - The Golden Ticket
1.plot: Pressure rises as Carnegie auditions are coming up, and no one knows who will make the cut

1.title: FR - La chorale - S01E04 - Lean on We
1.plot: With the auditions behind them, Carnegie Hall rehearsals shift into gear for the kids in the choir.

1.title: FR - La chorale - S01E05 - High Hopes
1.plot: The DYC is in NYC! Carnegie Hall just days away, wonderful surprises await the kids in the big city.

1.title: FR - La chorale - S01E06 - Primetime Ready
1.plot: After months of practice, preparation, and nerves, the DYC hits the stage at Carnegie Hall

meta.plot: Cheer on the kids from the Detroit Youth Choir as they prepare for the performance of a lifetime!

1.title: FR - Alexandre le Grand : Au rang des dieux - S01E01 - The Boy King
1.plot: After a violent murder, a young Alexander ascends the throne of Macedonia and takes up arms against the mighty Persian Empire, ruled by Darius III.

1.title: FR - Alexandre le Grand : Au rang des dieux - S01E02 - Death or Victory
1.plot: The tyrant inside Alexander starts to emerge as he leads his army to victory in western Persia, forcing Darius III to reassess his opponent.

1.title: FR - Alexandre le Grand : Au rang des dieux - S01E03 - Face to Face
1.plot: Alexander defies the odds again and defeats Darius III at the Battle of Issus. He then falls back to set his sights on an unexpected target: Egypt.

1.title: FR - Alexandre le Grand : Au rang des dieux - S01E04 - The Golden Empire
1.plot: Alexander finds new purpose in Egypt and embarks on a perilous journey to find an ancient oracle and learn his true identity.

1.title: FR - Alexandre le Grand : Au rang des dieux - S01E05 - The Living God
1.plot: Alexander embraces his destiny as his army plunges into the heart of Persia. With peace off the table, a final showdown against Darius III is inevitable.

1.title: FR - Alexandre le Grand : Au rang des dieux - S01E06 - A World Still to Conquer
1.plot: With the Persian Empire in his hands and Darius III at his feet, Alexander burns with renewed ambition as he seeks to conquer the entire world.

meta.plot: Expert interviews and gripping reenactments combine to reveal the extraordinary life of Alexander the Great and his burning desire to conquer the world.

1.title: FR - Baby Bandito - S01E01 - Opportunity Makes the Thief
1.plot: The Butchers' plan to pull off a millionaire heist falls into Kevin's hands. Génesis and Kevin meet at a skateboarding park — and sparks fly.

1.title: FR - Baby Bandito - S01E02 - It's Easier to Catch a Liar Than a Thief
1.plot: As Greyhound hunts Kevin, Panda and Kevin recruit Panther and Mística into the crew. Génesis makes an impulsive choice. The day of the heist arrives.

1.title: FR - Baby Bandito - S01E03 - It's No Crime to Steal From a Thief
1.plot: Kevin and the crew bury the money and make a pact not to spend it... yet. After Amador makes a gruesome discovery, the Russian sets out on a vengeful mission.

1.title: FR - Baby Bandito - S01E04 - Murphy's Law
1.plot: Génesis proposes a risky plan to Kevin, and he accepts. The police question one of the guards from the airport. The Russian follows a lead to find Kevin.

1.title: FR - Baby Bandito - S01E05 - No One Is a Prophet in Their Own Land
1.plot: While Kevin and Génesis live the high life in Rome — and post everything on social media — in Santiago, the rest of the crew starts falling apart.

1.title: FR - Baby Bandito - S01E06 - A Leopard Never Changes its Spots
1.plot: Nidia tricks Panda. Génesis and Kevin get into trouble with local criminals. Vulture continues her brutal interrogation — but Mística has a plan.

1.title: FR - Baby Bandito - S01E07 - Only the Good Die Young
1.plot: After being captured, Kevin learns a painful truth about Génesis. Later, she visits him in jail. Bozo follows the Russian, but he has a secret agenda.

1.title: FR - Baby Bandito - S01E08 - A Good Friend is Worth More Than Gold
1.plot: Kevin finds unexpected refuge with Panda. As he plots to flee with Génesis and their baby, the remaining Butchers —and the whole world— are after him.

2.title: FR - Baby Bandito - S02E01 - Straight From the Horse's Mouth
2.plot: Mística enlists Kevin to recover the loot. Génesis balances motherhood and music. Unsure of Natalia, Amador calls his son Áxel to lead their company.

2.title: FR - Baby Bandito - S02E02 - Like Water off a Duck's Back
2.plot: Russian and Panda have an explosive clash with the police. Rambo asks to accelerate the mission. Kevin and América end up at Génesis's musical debut.

2.title: FR - Baby Bandito - S02E03 - Birds of a Feather
2.plot: Russian agrees to work with Panda, for now. Mística plans a scheme to reach the secret vault. Kevin makes a truce with Panda, unaware of his true motives.

2.title: FR - Baby Bandito - S02E04 - Don't Count Your Chickens Before They Hatch
2.plot: The Bandits strike during a major horse race at the Hippodrome, but others are after the loot too—and not everything goes according to plan.

2.title: FR - Baby Bandito - S02E05 - Old Flames Die Hard
2.plot: A shocking accident following the heist triggers Ana to remember her criminal past — and her relationship with Panther. Áxel introduces Paloma to Amador.

2.title: FR - Baby Bandito - S02E06 - When the Going Gets Tough
2.plot: Thanks to América, Mística and Kevin set out to recover the money once again. A viral video directs police to the culprits of the "perfect" heist.

2.title: FR - Baby Bandito - S02E07 - Who Sows the Wind Reaps the Whirlwind
2.plot: The Bandits go on a mission with a new member. Meanwhile, Giovanni's kidnapping puts Kevin in an impossible position. Axel's revenge scheme is revealed.

2.title: FR - Baby Bandito - S02E08 - When the Chickens Come Home To Roost
2.plot: Bandits and Butchers agree to an exchange, but everyone has secret agendas, and no one can escape unscathed. This ends today — or does it?

meta.plot: After skater Kevin and his crew pull off Chile's biggest heist, reckless love –and social media– threatens everyone's fortunes. Inspired by true events.

1.title: FR - Six Nations : Au contact - S01E01 - Let Battle Commence
1.plot: Scotland warm up for their opening match at Twickenham, where they haven’t won against England in over a century. Is this the year they defy the odds?

1.title: FR - Six Nations : Au contact - S01E02 - Hard Knock Life
1.plot: Italy's under pressure to perform in the England game. With last year's injury at the front of his mind, Sebastian Negri faces up to the challenge.

1.title: FR - Six Nations : Au contact - S01E03 - On the Edge
1.plot: It's only round two but the stakes couldn't be higher as France, last year's reigning champions, face the world number one — Ireland.

1.title: FR - Six Nations : Au contact - S01E04 - The Second Coming
1.plot: With the Wales team in turmoil on and off the pitch, their old coach returns to shake things up. Will his gamble pay off in the match against England?

1.title: FR - Six Nations : Au contact - S01E05 - La Défense
1.plot: Following a rocky start, everything depends on the next game for last year’s champions, France. Will they find their form, or is the title gone for good?

1.title: FR - Six Nations : Au contact - S01E06 - Pressure Cooker
1.plot: With two teams in the championship on a losing streak, more than a wooden spoon is at stake as they prepare to face each other in the next round.

1.title: FR - Six Nations : Au contact - S01E07 - The Last Dance
1.plot: All of the Scottish team are keen to be picked for the next round. But their coach has a hard choice to make, as his best players are plagued by injury.

1.title: FR - Six Nations : Au contact - S01E08 - Agony or Ecstasy
1.plot: It's Super Saturday, the epic conclusion of rugby's biggest championship. As all six teams take to the pitch, there can only be one winner.

meta.plot: Journée après journée, match après match, les meilleures équipes européennes s'affrontent pour remporter le trophée du tournoi des Six Nations 2023.

1.plot: As Gülcan grieves their father's death, Gökhan faces the ultimate test from Kübra.

1.title: FR - Kübra - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: As Gökhan's supporters mourn a difficult loss, tensions boil over, causing rifts in his following that lead to clashes with law enforcement.

1.title: FR - Kübra - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Inspector Kara confronts Semavi over something personal. At Merve and Gökhan’s wedding, Gülcan learns a terrible secret.

1.title: FR - Kübra - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Gökhan discovers the unnerving truth behind the attempt on his life. Merve faces the fallout of her actions.

1.title: FR - Kübra - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Confronted with the astonishing truth behind Kübra, Gökhan must decide whether to give up on his followers or push forward.

2.title: FR - Kübra - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: Following a shocking feat, the government searches desperately for Gökhan and his followers. In Semavi's underground camp, cracks begin to form.

2.title: FR - Kübra - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: Merve learns a dangerous secret that puts everything in jeopardy. Meanwhile, Gökhan clashes with his allies about how to use their newfound influence.

2.title: FR - Kübra - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: Gülcan escapes with an old flame. Merve investigates a mystery of her own. Gökhan becomes increasingly isolated, even within his camp.

2.title: FR - Kübra - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: A raid at the camp leads to great losses. Gökhan swears revenge as he continues his search for Gülcan.

2.title: FR - Kübra - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: Pushed to the brink, Gökhan escalates his movement — with dangerous consequences — and a secret relationship is revealed.

2.title: FR - Kübra - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: An investigator goes rogue to get a hold of answers. Berk comes into contact with the people he helped indoctrinate.

2.title: FR - Kübra - S02E07 - Episode 7
2.plot: With just a few faithfuls left, Berk must make one last attempt to reach his goal. But before he will play along, Gökhan wants to see his sister.

2.title: FR - Kübra - S02E08 - Episode 8
2.plot: With the streets in crisis and the authorities closing in, will Gökhan finish what he started — or end it once and for all?

meta.plot: Lorsqu'un homme ordinaire reçoit des messages qui semblent prédire l'avenir, il attire non seulement des adeptes… mais aussi de puissants ennemis.

1.title: FR - Hazbin Hotel - S01E01 - Overture
1.plot: Charlie pitches Heaven her plan to save sinners by way of redeeming themselves through her Hotel. Vaggie enlists the staff to make a commercial to promote the hotel.

1.title: FR - Hazbin Hotel - S01E02 - Radio Killed the Video Star
1.plot: The Vee's: Vox, Velvette, and Valentino rule their corner of Hell unchallenged, but Alastor's return to the airwaves may shake things up. Meanwhile, a new Hotel guest tests Angel's patience.

1.plot: While the Hotel's guests and crew spend the day learning about trust, information revealed at a meeting of overlords leads to a respectless dispute.

1.title: FR - Hazbin Hotel - S01E06 - Welcome to Heaven

1.title: FR - Hazbin Hotel - S01E08 - The Show Must Go On

2.title: FR - Hazbin Hotel - S02E02 - Storyteller
2.plot: Sir Pentious' redemption creates a stir in Heaven, but not everyone is happy to see a sinner redeemed.

2.title: FR - Hazbin Hotel - S02E03 - Hazbin Hotel: Behind Closed Doors
2.plot: Charlie invites Voxtek to do a piece on the Hotel and Pentious' redemption. But she will need hard proof to convince her skeptical guests.

2.title: FR - Hazbin Hotel - S02E04 - It's a Deal
2.plot: Charlie tries to do damage control by going live on television! Meanwhile, Alastor reaches his final straw.

2.title: FR - Hazbin Hotel - S02E05 - Silenced
2.plot: Vox hosts a rally for his increasing supporters. Meanwhile, Charlie looks to Heaven for help.

2.title: FR - Hazbin Hotel - S02E06 - Scream Rain
2.plot: Vox leads the overlords toward war with Heaven. Tensions run high at the hotel and Husk returns to his old ways.

2.title: FR - Hazbin Hotel - S02E07 - Weapon of Mass Distraction
2.plot: Vox unveils his secret weapon, giving Heaven their final warning.

2.title: FR - Hazbin Hotel - S02E08 - Curtain Call
2.plot: Vox (and the Vees, I guess) is hosting a party so everyone can watch him take over Heaven - and you're all invited!

meta.plot: Charlie Morningstar, la Princesse de l'Enfer, lutte pour convaincre les démons et les anges que n'importe quelle âme peut être rachetée. Venez chanter devant cette comédie musicale animée pour adultes sur la rédemption.

1.plot: Abby returns to her hometown after hearing troubling news about the family inn facing foreclosure.
