1.plot: An enraged Beelzebub overwhelms the Insect Men as Rao infiltrates the Army's mega aircraft carrier.

1.title: FR - Sand Land: The Series - S01E07 - The Story of the Angel Hero EP1: On to a New Adventure
1.plot: The river flows once again in Sand Land, bringing with it new encounters and a new adventure.

1.title: FR - Sand Land: The Series - S01E08 - The Story of the Angel Hero EP2: Operation: Sneak into the Capital!
1.plot: Upon learning of King Jam's imminent execution, the trio and their new friend rush to stop it.

1.title: FR - Sand Land: The Series - S01E09 - The Story of the Angel Hero EP3: Fiend Power
1.plot: King Jam's execution is imminent once again when Supreme Commander Bred and Muniel corner Beelzebub.

1.title: FR - Sand Land: The Series - S01E10 - The Story of the Angel Hero EP4: Muniel's Urn
1.plot: A hint from Lango leads the four to Demon Village where King Lucifer and Muniel square off.

1.title: FR - Sand Land: The Series - S01E11 - The Story of the Angel Hero EP5: Flying Fortress Garam
1.plot: The long-awaited invasion of Sand Land's capital can now begin as Muniel uses the Aquanium to reactivate the Flying Fortress Garam. Determined to infiltrate and stop the flying fortress, the four seek help wherever they can get it.

1.title: FR - Sand Land: The Series - S01E12 - The Story of the Angel Hero EP6: The Final Battle!
1.plot: Beelzebub and Ann manage to get past Bred to stop Garam, only to come face-to-face with Muniel.

meta.plot: Sand Land is a mysterious world where demons and humans eke out an existence in a barren desert wasteland. In hopes of replenishing their water supply, Fiend Prince Beelzebub, a demon named Thief, and a human named Sheriff Rao team up and embark on a journey in search of the Legendary Spring.

1.title: FR - Franklin 2024 - S01E01 - Sauce for Prayers
1.plot: As the fight for independence teeters on the brink of defeat, Benjamin Franklin and his grandson plunge into a world of intrigue and deception.

1.title: FR - Franklin 2024 - S01E02 - Welcome, Mischief
1.plot: An arms operation is threatened by a ruthless opponent. The Paris police watch Franklin's every move. Temple makes a confession.

1.title: FR - Franklin 2024 - S01E03 - Pride and Gout
1.plot: Bad news arrives from America. Franklin finds himself ensnared in the traps of Versailles. Temple bows down before a star.

1.title: FR - Franklin 2024 - S01E04 - Small Revenge
1.plot: Franklin pays back an insult—and receives the favor of a king. A new lover catches his eye, and an old rival turns up to thwart him.

1.title: FR - Franklin 2024 - S01E05 - The Natural State of Man
1.plot: Tensions mount between Franklin and Adams. Madame Brillon asserts her power. Temple decides to fight his own war.

1.title: FR - Franklin 2024 - S01E06 - Beauty and Folly
1.plot: Franklin suspects traitors are everywhere. Vergennes makes a final offer. Jacques introduces Temple to the thrill of the hunt.

1.title: FR - Franklin 2024 - S01E07 - Begin by Creeping
1.plot: After victory at Yorktown, the Americans and the French plot against each other for the upper hand. Franklin is laid low at a crucial moment.

meta.plot: En décembre 1776, Benjamin Franklin est mondialement connu pour ses expériences sur l'électricité. Mais sa passion et son influence sont mises à rude épreuve lorsqu'il embarque pour une mission secrète en France tandis que le sort de l'indépendance des États-Unis est en jeu.

1.title: FR - UNDER NINJA - S01E01 - Throw a Rock, Hit a Ninja
1.plot: Kumogakure Kuro is a modern day ninja, but that doesn't mean his life is exciting. Bereft of any missions for a long time, he's an underachiever whiling away his days in obscurity, until he receives a special delivery.

1.title: FR - UNDER NINJA - S01E02 - I Want to Be a Ninja
1.plot: Kuro's been assigned a mission to infiltrate Kodan High School, but while waiting for his enrollment to finish, he's tasked with confronting a mysterious assailant with a very particular target.

1.title: FR - UNDER NINJA - S01E03 - Boobs: So Close, Yet So Far
1.plot: Kuro sets a trap and catches a high school boy named Eita. Upon returning home Eita encounters Junna who wants to borrow his drone. Eita agrees to let her if she can find the blond foreigner.

1.title: FR - UNDER NINJA - S01E04 - Do You Know What the Ninja Code Says?
1.plot: The confrontation between the Foreigner, Suzuki and Hibi continues. Junna's stepfather arrives at the location of the conflict and begins to yell at her for being outside. Then the Foreigner attacks him.

1.title: FR - UNDER NINJA - S01E05 - Kumogakure Is Within the Top 10 Common Family Names in Japan (Lying)
1.plot: Kuro goes to take his placement tests for school where he meets Noguchi who is there for extra lessons. After the tests Kuro and Noguchi walk home together and Kuro introduces her to Kawado.

1.title: FR - UNDER NINJA - S01E06 - The Lid on This Hellish Cauldron Has Come Off
1.plot: After coming to Eita's aid in a conflict with some school delinquents, Kuro makes his way to the school's boiler room where he confronts the director. Later on the defeated Noheji requests Kuro's aid in fighting some students from Yankii High.

1.title: FR - UNDER NINJA - S01E07 - Meow Meow, Meow Meow, Meow Meow Meow Meow Meow?
1.plot: After the lady at the convenience store is attacked by an invisible individual and killed, an Emergency Shinobi Notice is sent out and an investigation is launched in an effort to ascertain the identity of the culprit.

1.title: FR - UNDER NINJA - S01E08 - Every Last Ninja on the Surface Will Be Annihilated
1.plot: Kuro scares Noguchi after sneaking into her room to tell her not to go to school. Yoshida recounts his history of being a writer and how it was influenced by various ninja.

1.title: FR - UNDER NINJA - S01E09 - I'm Gonna Go Down in Shinobi History
1.plot: Ranran finishes her analysis of the UN's invisibility suit and sends her findings to Kato. Saruta begins his attack on the school and starts cutting down the students and faculty.

1.title: FR - UNDER NINJA - S01E10 - A Maiden's Chest Is a Precious Thing
FR - UNDER NINJA - S01E11 - Kuro Finally Took Up a Sword
1.plot: Hibi loses his fight to Yamada and now it's time for Kuro to step up to the plate. Noguchi encounters Sato and Suzuki while following orders from the Director and he leads them into a secret underground facility formerly run by the Japanese army.

1.title: FR - UNDER NINJA - S01E12 - Business as Usual, Wrapped Up Tidy
1.plot: The battles at the schools reach their climax. When all is said and done who will be left standing and what will be the outcome?

meta.plot: Within the shadows of Japan, a covert battle wages on. Around 200,000 ninjas still exist carrying out deadly missions as a secret organization, National Intelligence of NINJA, or NIN. But a challenger arises: UNDER NINJA. Known as UN, these ninjas oppose NIN at every turn. One such UN is Kuro, a high school loner sent to the front lines. What will be his fate and which faction will prevail?

meta.plot: Jack, commandant de bord pilotant aussi mal sa vie personnelle que son avion, et Charlie sa co-pilote, reléguée d’une compagnie prestigieuse à Flywingz, sont obligés de collaborer. Pour ce faire, ils seront épaulés par une équipe de PNC étonnante : la naïve Nelly, Nabil, le stewart le plus imprévisible que le ciel ait connu, Tristan l'arriviste, et Armelle, militante de tous les combats. Une visite d'inspection qui tourne au fiasco, un enfant qui prend les commandes de l’avion ou une formation de sécurité qui part en vrille : notre équipe de bras cassés (presque) toujours soudée tentera tant bien que mal de gérer ces situations absurdes. Et tant pis si les méthodes adoptées ne respectent pas toujours les procédures de sécurité. Bon vol !

1.title: FR - Knok - S01E01 - Episode 1
FR - Knok - S01E02 - Episode 2
FR - Knok - S01E03 - Episode 3
FR - Knok - S01E04 - Episode 4

meta.plot: Un petit employé de société fabriquant des urinoirs – complétement transparent, abandonné par sa femme et en préavis de licenciement – assiste par accident à l’exécution d’un meurtre commandité lors d’une inspection de routine des toilettes d’une station-service. Il devient par la force des choses l’apprenti d’un tueur à gages et entame une reconversion grâce à une application participative de type Uber…qui facilite le meurtre rémunéré…

1.title: FR - Apples Never Fall - S01E01 - The Delaneys
1.plot: Joy and Stan Delaney find that retirement isn’t what they hoped until a mysterious visitor arrives. When Joy later goes missing, her children wonder if foul play is involved.

1.title: FR - Apples Never Fall - S01E02 - Logan
1.plot: As the search for Joy grows more intense, her son, Logan, becomes hellbent on pointing the cops away from his own family.

1.title: FR - Apples Never Fall - S01E03 - Amy
1.plot: As the mystery surrounding Joy’s disappearance deepens, Amy gathers the community together in the hopes of bringing her mother home.

1.title: FR - Apples Never Fall - S01E04 - Brooke
1.plot: During a hurricane, Brooke faces her demons while the detectives pursue a surprising new lead in Joy’s disappearance.

1.title: FR - Apples Never Fall - S01E05 - Troy
1.plot: Troy makes a risky decision while evading the police, who know he has critical information about his mother’s disappearance.

1.title: FR - Apples Never Fall - S01E06 - Stan
1.plot: Stan’s erratic behavior fuels suspicion as a damning new piece of evidence in Joy’s disappearance arises.

meta.plot: Après cinquante ans de vie commune, Joy et Stan Delaney, parents de quatre enfants désormais adultes, vendent leur école de tennis très réputée, prêts à goûter à un repos mérité et vivre leurs plus belles années. Lorsque leur mère disparaît subitement, ses enfants sont forcés de réexaminer le mariage de leurs parents et leur histoire familiale avec un regard neuf.

1.title: FR - Lupin (Audio) - S01E01 - Chapter 1
1.plot: Years after a tragic injustice, Assane seeks to settle a score — and a debt — by stealing a diamond necklace, but the heist takes an unexpected turn.

1.title: FR - Lupin (Audio) - S01E02 - Chapter 2
1.plot: Assane hatches a plot to contact Comet, an inmate who steers him to a clue about Babakar's demise. Anne Pellegrini comes clean about the past.

1.title: FR - Lupin (Audio) - S01E03 - Chapter 3
1.plot: Assane confronts Commissioner Dumont and plants a decoy to divert the police. Hubert Pellegrini's connection to Babakar's fate comes to light.

1.title: FR - Lupin (Audio) - S01E04 - Chapter 4
1.plot: To retrieve incriminating evidence on Hubert, Assane enlists the help of a journalist. Officer Guédira connects the dots around the Louvre heist.

1.title: FR - Lupin (Audio) - S01E05 - Chapter 5
1.plot: En route to Étretat with Claire and Raoul, Assane encounters an unwelcome figure. In a bind, Assane sends a message to Capt. Laugier.

2.title: FR - Lupin (Audio) - S02E01 - Chapter 1
2.plot: To mend matters with Claire and Raoul, Assane devises a plan to get them out of France. But with high stakes come greater risks — and no room for error.

2.title: FR - Lupin (Audio) - S02E02 - Chapter 2
2.plot: An unfathomable loss rocks France, but Guédira and Raoul grapple with denial. A mysterious classified ad resurrects old ghosts and long-lost hopes.

2.title: FR - Lupin (Audio) - S02E03 - Chapter 3
2.plot: As Fleur and Guédira strike a deal, Belkacem visits Benjamin. Assane tries to outmaneuver a new enemy in the shadows while keeping tabs on his family.

2.title: FR - Lupin (Audio) - S02E04 - Chapter 4

1.plot: Hippie and small-time pot dealer Randy Lanier funds his passion for auto racing by taking his weed racket to new heights.

1.plot: Investigators detail shocking allegations that former Juventus director Luciano Moggi influenced referees in a scandal that rocked Italian football.

1.plot: A kitten named Precious is floating out to sea, and the PAW Patrol must rescue her, but that's not all. The PAW Patrol must also act fast to find her owner before the mischievous kitten gets into big trouble.

The PAW Patrol tries to fix the tracks, but how will they fix the tracks when Rubble sprains his paw and can't work? Can Chase save the day?

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E07 - Pups Save the Circus

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E11 - Pups Pit Crew

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E17 - Pups Get a Rubble
1.plot: This episode is a flashback story of how Rubble joined the PAW Patrol. Rubble must help Jake when he gets trapped in an Avalanche.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E24 - Pups Save a School Day
1.plot: It's Alex's first day of school, but he has lost his backpack! So the PAW Patrol agrees to help him find it.

1.plot: Ryder and the PAW Patrol need to rescue Alex on Jakes mountain.

FR - PAW Patrol - S01E35 - Pups Go All Monkey

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E46 - Pups Save the Camping Trip
1.plot: When Chickaletta falls in a cave in the ground it's up to the PAW Patrol to save her!

2.plot: The PAW Patrol must help a Baby Dolphin get back into the bay with her parents.

2.plot: Katie's bathtub float floats away when Alex puts too many balloons on it during Adventure Bay Day.

2.plot: The PAW Patrol uses Zuma's new submarine to help Cap'n Turbot.

4.plot: When a troubled popstar is suspected of killing her fiancé, the team's investigation uncovers the distorted loyalties formed when personal ties meet the trappings of fame.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E03 - Rex Marks the Spot
4.plot: After a journalist is killed searching for buried pirate treasure, Charlie and Rex dig deep into the competitive world of treasure-hunters to unearth the killer.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E04 - Leader of the Pack
4.plot: While Sarah embarks on a wilderness adventure, Charlie and Rex investigate the murder of a college professor.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E05 - Rex to Riches
4.plot: A stock market guru's fortune is stolen, setting Charlie and Rex on the trail of a very surprising thief.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E06 - Dead Man's Bridge
4.plot: After a truck transporting liquid explosive is hijacked by criminals, Charlie and Rex find themselves in a race against time to prevent the case from blowing sky high.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E07 - A Stab in the Dark Web
4.plot: As Major Crimes investigates a dark web marketplace, Charlie and Rex protect a witness in their home.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E08 - Sudden Death

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E09 - Impawster Syndrome
4.plot: The Major Crimes team is forced to turn against Jesse when he becomes the prime suspect in a bank robbery.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E10 - Blood & Diamonds

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E11 - Capital Punishment
4.plot: Charlie and Rex receive an award for heroism while Major Crimes investigates an extremist threat.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E12 - No Man Is an island
4.plot: Charlie, Rex and Sarah travel to an isolated island community caught up in a resettlement dispute. Donovan tries to stop a British police officer from derailing the investigation.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E13 - Roses of Signal Hill
4.plot: Rex's starring role in a television commercial is interrupted by the murder of one of the agency's ad executives.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E14 - Roll the Bones
4.plot: After the owner of a construction company is found dead, Charlie and Rex track the killer to an underground casino. Major Crimes goes undercover to solve the case.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E15 - Nightmare on Water St.
4.plot: While St. John's celebrates Mardi Gras, Charlie and Rex investigate a targeted killing spree.

4.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S04E16 - Dog Days Are Over
4.plot: When Officer Maya Power and her K9 partner Rebel are violently attacked responding to a call about a warehouse break-in, Major Crimes is at the ready.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E01 - Lost in the Barrens
5.plot: When a young woman goes missing in The Barrens, suspicion turns to the woman's boyfriend; it's up to the team to uncover the truth behind her disappearance.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E02 - Punch Drunk Glove
5.plot: When Charlie's estranged brother is accused of the death of his recent boxing opponent, Charlie and the team wrestle with the possibility of his guilt.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E03 - Run, Donovan, Run
5.plot: When Superintendent Donovan transports an inmate, who happens to be his former partner, he finds himself confronting the past and caught up in a daring and dangerous escape.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E04 - Hand of Cod
5.plot: After a severed hand is found in a box of frozen cod, the team must uncover the identity of both the victim and the killer behind the grisly crime.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E05 - The Good Shepherd
5.plot: When Rex is accused of attacking a decorated former police officer, Charlie enlists the help of an unorthodox ally to uncover the truth in the hopes of restoring Rex's position on the team.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E06 - Den of Snakes
5.plot: When the co-owner of a successful board game company is found dead of a snake bite, the team has to not only catch the hugger but also the deadly venomous snake still on the loose.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E07 - The Date Escape
5.plot: After two killers escape from St. John s Women s Penitentiary, the team is stymied in their attempts to capture the duo when their antics turn them into modern-day folk heroes.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E08 - Bury the Lead
5.plot: When Supt. Donovan's journalism student daughter investigates the story behind a murder on her university campus, the team races to find the killer before someone else becomes the next victim.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E09 - Rexpert Witness
5.plot: When an important trial is jeopardized after Sarah s testimony is challenged by a former rival in court, it s up to Charlie, Rex, and the rest of the Major Crimes team to uncover new evidence to save the case before time runs out.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E10 - One Wild Night
5.plot: When the maid-of-honor winds up dead after a bachelorette party, it s up to Charlie and Rex to untangle the events of the night.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E11 - Working for the Weekend
5.plot: When Rex finds a body with signs of foul play during Charlie and Sarah's romantic weekend getaway, they discover the idyllic community they're staying in may be more hostile than it looks.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E12 - Lost Lives Club
5.plot: After a popular physiotherapist is murdered, the team must investigate the victims of his alleged sexual assaults in order to track down the killer before they strike again.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E13 - The Miranda Act
5.plot: When Charlie's beloved Aunt Miranda and her friends are caught investigating an investment fraud scheme, it's up to Charlie and Rex to get to the source of the fraud.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E14 - Rexit, Stage Left
5.plot: When a famous starlet is killed onstage during a preview performance of abeloved Newfoundland play, Rex takes on a starring role while Charlie goesbehind the scenes.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E15 - Northern Rexposure
5.plot: When Jesse s sister contacts him for help, he, Sarah and Rex head to Northern Ontario and find themselves in the middle of a deadly situation.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E16 - Due North
5.plot: Rex seeks help from Detective Sidney Scott to save his stranded and injured friends.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E17 - Lost and Found
5.plot: Charlie gets a break in a long-unsolved kidnapping case that has haunted him, but runs into trouble when the abductee refuses his help.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E18 - Jail Break
5.plot: An imprisoned killer forces the station into lockdown by taking a hostage and attempting escape.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E19 - The Cook, the Chief, the Cop and His Lover
5.plot: Charlie and Rex sniff out the suspects when the Chief Superintendent of the St. John's Police Department dies at a popular restaurant and all signs point to poison.

5.title: FR - Hudson et Rex - S05E20 - One for the Road
5.plot: Charlie and Rex try to take down a car theft ring after one of the team is seriously injured trying to stop a theft in progress.

1.title: FR - Mademoiselle Holmes - S01E01 - We Open Her Chakras Episode 1
1.plot: Charlie, a discreet cop who was stationed at the complaints office, interfered with the investigation by his colleague Chris to find Anna, a six-year-old girl. Headed by Samy, the new trainee, she will discover exceptional investigator skills, inherited from her great-grandfather: Sherlock Holmes.

1.title: FR - Mademoiselle Holmes - S01E02 - SearchK-Lista Episode 2
1.plot: Charlie is the only one to take seriously the disappearance of K-Lista, an influence. Samy and she immerse themselves in the world of social media to understand what could have happened to her: easy money, jealousy, secret relationships, many could have wanted her to harm. Unless all of this is just a staging, meant to make the buzz?

1.title: FR - Mademoiselle Holmes - S01E03 - Off Course Episode 3
1.plot: Nicolas, a friend of Charlie's youth, calls him for help when he has just had a tragic car accident for Anthony, his brother-in-law, who was in the passenger seat. But then, real accident or sabotage? Immersed in the world of vintage cars, will Charlie have enough back to find out who could have done attack on his friend?

1.title: FR - Mademoiselle Holmes - S01E04 - Baker Street Episode 4
1.plot: Her personal history led her to London and Charlie was determined to meet her half-sister. Samy, of course, accompanies him on his journey. On the way to visiting Sherlock Holmes' house, they meet Tracy, a young psychotic girl, who begs them to help her: her sister's ghost would have come to warn her that she was in great danger. Will they be able to prevent Tracy from suffering the same tragic fate as her dead sister a few years ago?

1.title: FR - Mademoiselle Holmes - S01E05 - 20 Degrees Episode 5
1.plot: Jiyoung, a talented young icerman, is found dead, frozen, in the supergelator of the factory where she worked. If her professional requirement had not brought her only friends and might lead her to revenge, Charlie will discover that the young woman voluntarily returned to the freezer... but why?

1.title: FR - Mademoiselle Holmes - S01E06 - The Last Problem Episode 6
1.plot: George, Charlie's grandfather, is in a coma after an attempted murder. The police station mobilized to find the culprit, while Charlie was excluded from the investigation. But Charlie is determined to shed light on the case, in the back of the brigade, always with Samy's help. But she soon discovers that all incriminates her...

meta.plot: Shy cop Charlie, descendant of Sherlock Holmes, lives with grandfather until a car accident changes her. Her newfound energy and brilliance as a cop lets her embrace life and solve crimes with Watson-like partner Samy.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E01 - The Day I Became a Shinigami
1.plot: Fifteen-year-old Ichigo Kurosaki has the uncanny ability to see ghosts, but otherwise lives an ordinary life. However, once a Shinigami named Rukia Kuchiki appears before him, everything changes.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E02 - A Shinigami's Work
1.plot: After becoming a Shinigami, Ichigo Kurosaki refuses to help Rukia Kuchiki with her work as the local Shinigami of Karakura Town.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E03 - The Older Brother's Wish, the Younger Sister's Wish
1.plot: When a Hollowfied Sora Inoue attacks his younger sister, Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki set out to save her.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E04 - Cursed Parakeet
1.plot: When Yasutora Sado receives a parakeet that contains the Soul of a young boy, it is up to Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki to protect him from the Hollow that is after them.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E05 - Beat the Invisible Enemy!
1.plot: Rukia Kuchiki and Yasutora Sado team up to take on the Hollow Shrieker.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E06 - Fight to the Death! Ichigo vs. Ichigo
1.plot: At Rukia Kuchiki's behest, Ichigo Kurosaki puts an artificial soul in his body to take care of it and not arouse suspicion while he carries out his Substitute Shinigami duties, but the artificial soul has its own agenda.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E07 - Greetings from a Stuffed Lion
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki becomes friends with the Modified Soul, Kon, and puts him into a plushie.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E08 - June 17, Memories in the Rain
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki goes to his mother's grave with the rest of his family.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E09 - Unbeatable Enemy
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki battles against Grand Fisher.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E10 - Assault on Trip at Sacred Ground!
1.plot: While grudgingly attending Don Kanonji's show with the rest of his family, Ichigo Kurosaki is forced to fight a Hollow inadvertently created by Don Kanonji himself.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E11 - The Legendary Quincy
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki meet Uryū Ishida, a Quincy.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E12 - A Gentle Right Arm
1.plot: As Ichigo Kurosaki begins his duel with Uryū Ishida, Yasutora Sado gains a new power.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E13 - Flower and Hollow
1.plot: Orihime Inoue gains a new power in order to protect Tatsuki Arisawa.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E14 - Back to Back, a Fight to the Death!
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki and Uryū Ishida work together to defeat a Menos Grande.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E15 - Kon's Great Plan
1.plot: Kon decides to run away from the Kurosaki Clinic as Soul Society comes after Rukia Kuchiki.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E16 - The Encounter, Abarai Renji!
1.plot: Two Shinigami, 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai and Captain Byakuya Kuchiki, arrive in the Human World to take Rukia Kuchiki back to the Soul Society.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E17 - Ichigo Dies!
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki loses his Shinigami powers and Rukia Kuchiki is taken back to Soul Society.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E18 - Reclaim! The Power of the Shinigami!
1.plot: Ichigo Kurosaki begins his training with Kisuke Urahara to regain his Shinigami powers and save Rukia Kuchiki.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E19 - Ichigo Becomes a Hollow!
1.plot: Kisuke Urahara helps Ichigo Kurosaki regain his Shinigami powers.

1.title: FR - Bleach - S01E20 - Ichimaru Gin's Shadow
1.plot: After completing their training, Ichigo Kurosaki and his friends depart to Soul Society to rescue Rukia Kuchiki.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E01 - The Blood Warfare
2.plot: The Soul Society is observing a sudden surge in the number of Hollows being destroyed.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E02 - Foundation Stones
2.plot: Arrancars Nel Tu and Pesche Guatiche have come to seek Ichigo’s help explaining that Hueco Mundo is under attack by an unknown enemy. Unable to ignore the situation, Ichigo and his friends decide to set out for Hueco Mundo.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E03 - March of the Starcross
2.plot: Ichigo and his friends arrive in Hueco Mundo to confront Quilge Opie and learn that their latest enemy are Quincies.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E04 - Kill the Shadow
2.plot: The Wandenreich mobilizes its elite force, the Stern Ritter, to annihilate the Soul Society. Creating massive flaming pillars of Reishi as a distraction, the Stern Ritter easily enter the Soul Society to bring carnage to the Soul Reapers.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E05 - Wrath as a Lightning
2.plot: Quilge Opie uses his power to imprison Ichigo inside the Garganta. As he tries to break free, Ichigo begins to hear, through his Soul Phone, the screams of the Soul Reapers falling to the enemy's onslaught.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E06 - The Fire
2.plot: Shigekuni Genryusai Yamamoto confronts Yhwach for the first time in a thousand years. As Yhwach finally draws his sword against Genryusai, the Soul Reapers notice an abnormal change taking place across the Seireitei.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E07 - Born in the Dark
2.plot: Shigekuni Genryusai Yamamoto learns that the Yhwach he defeated was an impostor. The real Yhwach then reveals himself and easily kills Genryusai, sending a wave of shock and devastation across the Soul Reapers.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E08 - The Shooting Star Project [Zero Mix]
2.plot: Rescue efforts are being made across the Seireitei to find and help those who've survived the Stern Ritter attack. Meanwhile, Ichigo meets with Mayuri Kurotsuchi about fixing his broken Tensa Zangetsu.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E09 - The Drop
2.plot: Squad Zero brings Ichigo back to the Royal Palace to prepare for the coming battle. Meanwhile, Kyoraku is appointed as the new Head Captain to lead the Thirteen Court Guard Squads.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E10 - The Battle
2.plot: Kenpachi Zaraki removes his eye patch to fight Retsu Unohana, a.k.a. Yachiru Unohana, “The First Kenpachi.” Meanwhile, Ichigo and Renji head to Hoohden to meet Oh-Etsu Nimaiya, the man who is said to have created the Zanpakuto.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E11 - Everything but the Rain
2.plot: Ichigo is kicked out of the Royal Palace by Oh-etsu Nimaiya for failing his test. When Ichigo next opens his eyes, he finds himself standing in front of his house in the World of the Living.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E12 - Everything but the Rain: June Truth
2.plot: Squad 10 Captain Isshin Shiba of the Thirteen Court Guard Squads decides to not report his encounter with the Quincy named Masaki Kurosaki in the World of the Living to the Head Captain.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E13 - The Blade Is Me
2.plot: Ichigo learns that he is the child born of a Soul Reaper and a Quincy. Finally understanding the truth behind his heritage, Ichigo decides to return to Hoohden with a renewed resolve to finish what he has started.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E14 - The Last 9 Days
2.plot: Ichigo prepares to leave the Royal Palace to return to the Seireitei but is stopped by Hyosube, who claims that Ichigo cannot defeat Yhwach as he is now.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E15 - Peace From Shadows
2.plot: As the Seireitei is completely replaced by the Wandenreich, the Gotei 13 are confronted by the Sternritter.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E16 - The Fundamental Virulence
2.plot: Mayuri receives a call from Urahara, who had stayed behind in Hueco Mundo to search for a way to reclaim everyone’s stolen Bankai. Urahara claims that he was able to come up with a solution based on the data gained from his earlier battle with Quilge.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E17 - Heart of Wolf
2.plot: The tides of battle seemed to have turned after the captains reclaimed their stolen Bankai. However, the Stern Ritters release their Quincy Voll Stern Dich to drive the Soul Reapers deeper into a corner.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E18 - Rages at Ringside
2.plot: Kensei Muguruma joins the battle against Masculine, who has already defeated Shuhei Hisagi, Ikkaku Madarame, and Yumichika Ayasegawa. However, Kensei is taken aback by how weak his opponent is.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E19 - The White Haze
2.plot: A fearless Rukia swings her Sodenoshirayuki in battle as she takes on Äs Nödt.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E20 - I Am the Edge
2.plot: Isane and Yachiru are treating the wounded Kensei and Rojuro when they are attacked by Gwenael, a Quincy who not only possesses the ability to disappear physically but can also erase his existence from the memory of his opponents.

2.title: FR - Bleach - S02E21 - The Headless Star
2.plot: Kenpachi defeats Gremmy, but his moment of victory is cut short when he is suddenly struck by Candice’s thunderbolt attack. Meninas, Giselle, and Liltotto also join Candice to take down Kenpachi, who is considered to be a Special Threat.

meta.plot: For as long as he can remember, Ichigo Kurosaki has been able to see ghosts. But when he meets Rukia, a Soul Reaper who battles evil spirits known as Hollows, he finds his life is changed forever. Now, with a newfound wealth of spiritual energy, Ichigo discovers his true calling: to protect the living and the dead from evil.

1.title: FR - Resident Evil: Infinite Darkness - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Now at an NGO in Penamstan, Claire discovers signs reminiscent of Raccoon City. Leon makes his way to the White House, unaware that it's under attack.

1.title: FR - Resident Evil: Infinite Darkness - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Leon, along with agents Jason and Shen May, embarks on a covert mission to infiltrate a research facility in Shanghai aboard a nuclear submarine.

1.title: FR - Resident Evil: Infinite Darkness - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Claire discovers a grim scene at the home of one of the last surviving members of the Mad Dogs Unit. Shen May warns Leon about an ominous conspiracy.

1.title: FR - Resident Evil: Infinite Darkness - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Secretary Wilson threatens Claire's life, demanding that she drop her investigation. Leon and Shen May rush to the vast subterranean bioweapons lab.

meta.plot: Years after the horrors of Raccoon City, Leon and Claire find themselves consumed by a dark conspiracy when a viral attack ravages the White House.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E01 - The Infinity Thief
1.plot: To regain his detective status, Cole Ellis, a demoted by-the-book cop, is assigned to work with Max Mitchell, a spirited con artist whose charismatic street smarts could help catch an elusive thief.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E02 - Show Me the Murder
1.plot: A community outreach lecture on porch pirates turns into a murder investigation when Max and Ellis find an elite sports agent dead in his condo. Max’s dad George gives her advice – from his jail cell.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E03 - Howl to Get Away with Murder
1.plot: Things go from quaint to creepy when Max and Ellis look into the disappearance of a butcher in a small rural town. The duo gets a lesson in team building and Max quizzes Ellis on his personal life.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E04 - Strangers on a Wave
1.plot: When a surfer is mysteriously killed, Detectives Simmons and Yates are assigned the case. But it’s Ellis who grabs a board and goes undercover, taking a page out of Max’s book of disguise.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E05 - The Accountant of Monte Cristo
1.plot: When Ellis’s federal agent ex-girlfriend loses an accountant scheduled to testify against the mob, she enlists their help to find him before the accountant ends up sleeping with the fishes.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E06 - Dead of Night
1.plot: When the leads of THE most popular vampire show on TV become the target of a stalker, Max and Ellis enter the world of showbiz where the behind-the-scenes drama is even wilder than what’s on screen.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E07 - Con With the Wind
1.plot: George gets a 3-day pass from jail to spend with Max but the urge to pull one more con is real. Ellis helps a troubled youth charged with a B&E after he discovers it’s a teen his brother used to know.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E08 - Eternal Sunshine of the Therapized Mind
1.plot: When a celebrated therapist and best-selling author is murdered, a bickering Max and Ellis go undercover as a married couple at her wellness retreat and discover more than their chakras.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E09 - Inside (Con)Man
1.plot: Max visits the bank to access her safe deposit box but instead becomes a hostage in a dangerous robbery. Ellis defies Chief Li's orders to wait for the Tactical Response Team, knowing Max is inside.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E10 - Romancing the Egg
1.plot: Ellis is drawn into a case involving Max, her ex, and a world-famous Imperial egg, where a cat-and-mouse heist tests their friendship, their partnership, and their trust in each other.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E01 - Con in 60 Seconds
2.plot: Begrudgingly, Ellis comes to terms with Max's betrayal knowing she risked it all to share info about his brother's killer; now assigned to a new case, they dive into a high-speed street racing ring.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E02 - Once a Con a Time in the West
2.plot: Max and Ellis saddle up for a wild west adventure as they track down the attempted murderer of a ranch family's stud horse and uncover a dark family secret.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E03 - The Lorne Identity
2.plot: A paranoid biomedical engineer with a case of amnesia comes to Ellis for help leading the team down a trail of conspiracies, corruption and secret codes.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E04 - Dial 'A' for Alibi
2.plot: Stuck at home with a sprained ankle and a pair of binoculars, Max is convinced she has witnessed a murder while snooping on the condo across the street.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E05 - Catch Me if You Con
2.plot: Max's childhood bestie visits, pulling her into her old con ways. While Ellis investigates the murder of a former tennis pro, the BFFs go undercover to find the killer.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E06 - Seance and Sensibility
2.plot: Max and Ellis investigate a mysterious murder among an eccentric family where everyone is a suspect with riches on the line. Max adopts a psychic persona and holds a séance to summon the true killer.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E07 - The Big Bang Theory
2.plot: When Chief Li and Max are trapped in a hostage situation, Ellis tries to save them without letting his emotions cloud his judgement.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E08 - Death By Design
2.plot: When the head of a popular streetwear clothing brand is found dead, Max and Ellis find themselves investigating a murder within the world of haute couture, fashion models, and overworked assistants.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E09 - Barking Bad
2.plot: A murdered dog show judge leads Max and Ellis to a traveling dog competition to sniff out the killer. Ellis and his cat Marc move in temporarily with Max and Ricky while Ellis' boat is under repair.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E10 - Our Lip (Fillers) Are Sealed
2.plot: Max and Ellis go undercover, joining the cast and crew of a reality show to find out who murdered its star. In a world of scandal, deceit and lip-filler parties, every cast member is under suspicion.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E11 - Bride and Doom
2.plot: Max and Ellis are pulled into the undercover world of espionage and counterintelligence when a bride becomes the target of an unusual murder attempt on her wedding day.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E12 - Clouds In My Eyes
2.plot: Ellis gets new information that leads him to a jazz club and possibly the person responsible for Daniel's death. Max poses as a singer at the club to gather intel. George goes before the parole board.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E13 - Sunrise Sunset
2.plot: Ellis makes a shocking discovery about the criminal kingpin responsible for Daniel's death, and who is protecting him. Max, George and Ricky try to solve the cryptic clues hidden in Ashford's office.

1.title: FR - L'Affaire Asunta - S01E01 - September 21
1.plot: Rosario and Alfonso report their adopted daughter, Asunta, as missing. But what police assume is a kidnapping quickly spirals into something sinister.

1.title: FR - L'Affaire Asunta - S01E02 - September 24
1.plot: The investigation discloses unexpected details about Rosario's love life. A new testimony goes over Asunta's last months and points to alarming signs.

1.title: FR - L'Affaire Asunta - S01E03 - September 26
1.plot: As questions and evidence mount, public opinion turns against Rosario and Alfonso, whose relationship proves to be more turbulent than it looked.

1.title: FR - L'Affaire Asunta - S01E04 - September 28
1.plot: The defense attorney switches gears and reveals that Asunta had been targeted in the past. However, the new evidence seems off to Judge Malvar.

1.title: FR - L'Affaire Asunta - S01E05 - 24 Hours
1.plot: Detectives piece together theories about Asunta's death, her complicated relationship with her parents and Rosario and Alfonso's co-dependency.

1.title: FR - L'Affaire Asunta - S01E06 - The Trial
1.plot: Pressure builds on both sides as evidence and key testimonies are scrutinized in court. A new set of eyes on the case could sway the verdict.

meta.plot: Après avoir signalé la disparition de leur fille Asunta, âgée de 12 ans, des parents se retrouvent rapidement visés par l'enquête.

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E01 - Welcome to Chateau Rosabelle
1.plot: For months, Lisa Vanderpump has meticulously curated her latest business venture: a chateau in the South of France. But when the first guests check in for a luxury experience, will the new staff be able to provide the service that meets Lisa’s standards?

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E02 - No Room for Error
1.plot: Upon learning of a huge argument in front of the guests, Lisa sets her staff straight. With the marquee event less than 24 hours away, can the staff put aside their differences and come together to help the Guest of Honor pull off a secret proposal?

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E03 - From One Queen to Another
1.plot: The Chateau welcomes a close circle of friends who are celebrating a ‘Rebirth’ party. Eric attempts to navigate managing duties while receiving pushback from Stephen and Lisa. Two ladies in the staff develop romantic feelings for the same co-worker.

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E04 - A Naughty Night in Versailles
1.plot: One staff member’s antics reach a new high, causing a rift in the back of the house. But when a new group of guests arrive with their own set of issues, lines become blurred, and the drama spills over to the front of the house.

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E05 - Revenge of Les Dames
1.plot: When a group of eligible bachelors arrive for a stay in the Chateau, the ladies in the staff could not be more thrilled to make the male staff a little jealous. Marciano finds himself in hot water with just about everyone after a night of debauchery.

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E06 - An Unforgettable Night in Carcassonne
1.plot: While things heat up romantically between two staff members, another employee begins to isolate themselves. But when sparks fly at a festive dinner in town, ugly truths are revealed, making everyone question their relationships in the chateau.

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E07 - A Divorce Party
1.plot: After an explosive dinner in town, lines are crossed, and one staff member questions their future at the chateau. When a new group of guests shows up to celebrate their divorce, old memories resurface, sending another staff member into a downward spiral.

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E08 - Love, Death, and Beyond
1.plot: The Chateau welcomes a guest of honor who wants to celebrate her 30’s and say goodbye to her tumultuous 20’s by having a funeral service. Meanwhile, Hannah tries to navigate some of her own past insecurities with relationships, and Marciano.

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E09 - Reunited and It Feels So Good
1.plot: A recent staff member’s arrival continues to ruffle some feathers, while another employee sees an opportunity for the taking. When a seasoned group of guests shows up to the villa, they breathe new life into the Chateau.

meta.plot: Dans un château français, les membres du personnel tentent d'offrir aux invités des expériences luxueuses, conçues par Vanderpump, tout en gérant les rivalités, les romances et les mésaventures qui en découlent.

1.title: FR - Renegade Nell - S01E01 - Don't Call Me "Nelly"
1.plot: England, 1705: Nell Jackson's supernatural fighting skills stir up trouble on her return from war.

1.title: FR - Renegade Nell - S01E02 - Tracks Less Well Trod
1.plot: On the run from the law, Nell, Roxy and George turn to highway robbery to survive.

1.title: FR - Renegade Nell - S01E03 - A Private Joke with the Queen
1.plot: Poynton's dark magic catches up with Nell. One of her sisters is dangerously wounded in the escape.

1.title: FR - Renegade Nell - S01E04 - Devil's Dung
1.plot: Nell risks capture to find a doctor, and the gang receive help from some unlikely sources.

1.title: FR - Renegade Nell - S01E05 - Excuse Me, I'm a Doctor
1.plot: Nell goes to Newgate Prison to try and rescue Devereux, and Roxy and George meet their Uncle Jack.

1.title: FR - Renegade Nell - S01E06 - Snatched by Strollers
1.plot: Nell sets out to rescue George, and Rasselas finally confronts Sofia.

1.title: FR - Renegade Nell - S01E07 - Stop Printing This Muck
1.plot: The gang head to Fleet Street to stop the news sheets from printing lies about Nell.

1.title: FR - Renegade Nell - S01E08 - Not Some Cheap Trick
1.plot: Nell and the gang race against time to stop Poynton and save the Queen.

meta.plot: England, 1705: Framed for murder and on the run with her sisters, Nell Jackson turns her hand to highway robbery to survive. Aided by her superpowered sidekick, a plucky little sprite called Billy Blind, Nell realizes that fate has put her on the wrong side of the law for a reason. A reason much bigger than she could have ever imagined: to defeat a magical plot against the Queen of England.

1.title: FR - Fallen - S01E01 - The Time of the Redeemer
1.plot: One year after finding out that he is a Nephilim, Aaron Corbett continues on his mission to redeem the Fallen and send them back to Heaven. After Camael is injured in a fight with the Powers, Aaron and Camael visit fallen angel who can heal Camael. Meanwhile, Azazel, one of the Fallen who has been imprisoned for 5,000 years, is released to help the Redeemer fulfill his mission.

1.title: FR - Fallen - S01E02 - Mysterious Ways and All That
1.plot: After helping Vilma escape, Aaron and Vilma are rescued from the Powers by Azazel, who tells them he can take them to the Light Bringer, an oracle who can help Aaron on his mission. Aaron begins to doubt if he is doing the right thing by sending the Fallen back to Heaven. Meanwhile, Camael has been captured by the Powers who demand to know where Aaron is.

1.title: FR - Fallen - S01E03 - Someone Always Has to Die
1.plot: After escaping from the Powers, Aaron, Vilma and Azazel continue on their journey to the Light Bringer. Camael escapes from the Powers and makes his way to Ariel. Mazarin begins to have doubts about his mission.

1.title: FR - Fallen - S01E04 - Il Gran Rifiuto
1.plot: Aaron's powers are challenged in a stronger way than ever before.

1.title: FR - Fallen - S01E05 -
FR - Fallen - S01E06 -

meta.plot: The phenomenal journey of Aaron Corbett, an 18-year-old Nephilim (half-angel/half human), as he struggles to come to terms with his role as The Redeemer and is drawn into a world where angels walk among us.

1.title: FR - Citoyens clandestins - S01E01 - Episode 1
FR - Citoyens clandestins - S01E02 - Episode 2
FR - Citoyens clandestins - S01E03 - Episode 3
FR - Citoyens clandestins - S01E04 - Episode 4
FR - Iron Reign - S01E01 - The Law of the Port
1.plot: For 30 years, Joaquín Manchado has ruled Barcelona's port with an iron grip — until an unexpected foe threatens his thriving cocaine smuggling business.

1.title: FR - Iron Reign - S01E02 - Long Live the King
1.plot: Joaquín's urgency to bring in a new shipment to port grows by the day along with his number of enemies. Román discovers a devastating truth.

1.title: FR - Iron Reign - S01E03 - Throne of Blood
1.plot: The Manchados face an uncertain future as the struggle for power begins. Víctor solidifies his position and a double cross sparks discord among factions.

1.title: FR - Iron Reign - S01E04 - Double or Nothing
1.plot: With their enemies circling in, the Manchados' search for the missing shipping containers heats up just as their dynasty fractures from within.

1.title: FR - Iron Reign - S01E05 - An Eye for an Eye, a Tooth for a Tooth
1.plot: As Román keeps looking for Ricardo, old family feuds resurface. Víctor receives news that could change the investigation.

1.title: FR - Iron Reign - S01E06 - A Bad Omen
1.plot: Following a lead, Víctor runs into close contact with Miki, who is hot on his trail. Ariel tempts fate. Pressure mounts on money laundering.

1.title: FR - Iron Reign - S01E07 - Crossroads
1.plot: After a double shock, Rocío assumes control of the family business. The stakes rise in Víctor's investigation.

1.title: FR - Iron Reign - S01E08 - A Matter of Blood
1.plot: A funeral turns into mayhem as Víctor, Néstor and Rocío race to find the missing delivery. A con leaves a life hanging in the balance.

meta.plot: Joaquín Manchado rules his drug empire from Barcelona's seaport with an iron fist — until a new shipment sends business and family spiraling.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E01 - The Boy in the Iceberg
1.plot: Two teenage siblings (Sokka and Katara) living in the South Pole discover a very strange boy (Aang), along with his pet flying bison Appa, in an iceberg. But can they trust him when he accidentally draws the war to their village's doorstep?

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E02 - The Avatar Returns
1.plot: Katara and Sokka discover that Aang is the long-lost Avatar and must rescue him when a Firebending prince named Zuko kidnaps him.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E03 - The Southern Air Temple
1.plot: Aang is excited about going home for the first time in one hundred years, but he is shocked to find out that the temple is deserted. Aang tells Sokka and Katara about his childhood as they explore the temple, but they soon discover something that Aang never expected. Meanwhile, Zuko must make repairs to his ship and the only way he can do it is to dock his ship at his rival's naval base.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E04 - The Warriors of Kyoshi
1.plot: The gang arrives at Kyoshi Island and are captured by some Kyoshi warriors. When Aang reveals that he is the avatar, news quickly spreads out, eventually reaching Zuko, who then goes to Kyoshi Island to capture him.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E05 - The King of Omashu
1.plot: Aang's abilities as an airbender are challenged by a king.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E06 - Imprisoned
1.plot: In a nearby Earth Village, the gang meets a teenage earthbender named Haru. This village lives in fear of the Fire Nation, for soldiers there capture any earthbenders they can find.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E07 - The Spirit World: Winter Solstice (1)
1.plot: Aang and friends visit a village being terrorized by an angry spirit. Iroh is captured by Earth Kingdom soldiers.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E08 - Avatar Roku: Winter Solstice (2)
1.plot: To contact the spirit of the previous Avatar, Aang must reach a temple in the Fire Nation before the sun sets on the following day. There he will learn what he must do to restore balance to the world. Zuko must defy his banishment to follow Aang.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E09 - The Waterbending Scroll
1.plot: After Katara attempts to teach Aang waterbending, but realizes that he is learning it much faster than she is, she is desperate to improve her abilities.  When Katara inadvertently stumbles across a waterbending scroll that can help improve her abilities at a pirate’s store, she decides to steal it, realizing that she couldn’t hope to afford it.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E10 - Jet
1.plot: While traveling towards the North Pole, the group almost gets captured by the Fire Nation.  However, when a charismatic young man and his band of rebels attack the Fire Nation camp and rescue them, they learn that they are trying to resist the Fire Nation’s motives to expand their territory.  Katara and Aang really enjoy their time with the band of rebels, but Sokka soon discovers that they aren’t as noble as meets the eye.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E11 - The Great Divide
1.plot: While on their way to the North Pole, Aang and his friends arrive at a giant canyon where two groups of refugees are bickering over who should get to go across.  Aang decides to walk across with the two groups to ensure they don’t fight one another.  However, he soon learns that the two tribes have been feuding for one hundred years and they both believe their actions are justified.  But when the predators inside the canyon start to come out, Aang is stuck trying to defend both tribes from each other and the vicious wildlife.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E12 - The Storm
1.plot: Aang, Katara and Sokka have run out of money.  Katara suggests Sokka get a job, and coincidentally, they meet a fisherman who is looking for someone to help him out with his fishing. But when the fisherman recognizes Aang as the Avatar, he blames Aang's absence for all of the troubles of the last 100 years, and Aang runs away on his glider. Katara follows on Appa, and when she finds him, Aang begins to reveal his life before he was frozen in the iceberg. Meanwhile, Zuko and Lieutenant Jee get into a fight, but Iroh breaks it up. Soon thereafter, the Lieutenant and the rest of the crew gain a newfound respect for their leader after learning of his past.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E13 - The Blue Spirit
1.plot: While Aang, Katara and Sokka are traveling, Sokka gets a fever. Katara and Aang try to help Sokka, when Katara also catches the fever. It's up to Aang to go up on his own to save his two friends. But before he can get the medicine he is captured by the newly promoted Admiral Zhao and put in Zhao's fortress.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E14 - The Fortuneteller
1.plot: When the group tries to help a man who is being attacked by a platypus-bear, they discover that the local town has a fortuneteller named Aunt Wu in it, who has been forecasting the town's fate for years. But when Sokka and Aang discover one of the fortuneteller's most vital predictions is dead wrong, they have to develop a plan to convince the stubborn townspeople that their beloved Aunt Wu was wrong.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E15 - Bato of the Water Tribe
1.plot: Aang feels neglected as Katara and Sokka reunite with Bato, an old friend of their father’s from the South Pole. They begin to reminisce on their times in the past while they wait for a message to arrive from their father. Aang believes Katara and Sokka will abandon him and go out to find their father should the message arrive. However, when the messenger gives Aang the message to give to Bato, Aang betrays his friends in a way Katara or Sokka could never imagine. However, when Zuko recruits a bounty hunter named June to track Aang down, his friendship is put to the test as he must deal with the fact that he betrayed his friends while defending himself from yet another fight.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E16 - The Deserter
1.plot: Aang and his friends go to a Fire Nation town so that Aang can witness some firebending, but their plan soon goes awry when it’s discovered that he is the Avatar. Fortunately, he's rescued by an individual who serves a firebending master named Jeong Jeong who has abandoned the Fire Nation, so Aang decides to use this time to attempt to learn firebending. The firebending master, however, seems reluctant to teach Aang.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E17 - The Northern Air Temple
1.plot: When Aang and his friends hear rumors about surviving airbenders, they decide to stop by the Northern Air Temple on their way to the North Pole to see for themselves. What they find is a bunch of people who are not airbenders, but have mastered the art of gliding; though this upsets Aang because they have been defacing the temple. However, there was one part of the temple where nobody has been able to enter, and what Aang and his friends discover inside spells oncoming conflict.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E18 - The Waterbending Master
1.plot: When Aang tries to find the north pole, he is found by the north pole instead. As they are taken there, Aang and Katara are eager to find a waterbending master, only to discover that girls are not allowed to learn waterbending.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E19 - The Siege of the North (1)
1.plot: Zhao begins to launch his attack against the Northern Water Tribe. As the walls of the prestiged city begin to fall, the Avatar taps into the spirit world and seeks the help of one of the oldest spirits, in hopes of saving one of the most prominent areas of the world.

1.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S01E20 - The Siege of the North (2)
1.plot: Aang returns from the spirit world to a big surprise. Meanwhile, Zhao and his forces continue to press deeper into the Northern Water Tribe. Iroh makes a powerful stand and Zuko struggles to keep his plan intact.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E01 - The Avatar State
2.plot: Plagued with nightmares featuring the devastating power of his Avatar State, Aang and the gang meet an Earth Kingdom general who has big plans for defeating the Fire Nation. Meanwhile, Zuko and Iroh, having survived the failed attack on the North Water Tribe, have a surprise visit from Zuko's sister with seemingly good news.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E02 - The Cave of Two Lovers
2.plot: On their way to Omashu, Aang, Katara, and Sokka meet a group of nomads who show them a shortcut through the "Cave of Two Lovers". But when the group becomes trapped in the cave, it's up to Aang and Katara to save the group by trusting in love, possibly questioning their relationship. Meanwhile, Iroh gets a lethal rash so Zuko and Iroh head to a small Earth Kingdom town for help, hoping their real identities will not be discovered.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E03 - Return to Omashu
2.plot: Despite the shocking news the gang have just discovered, Aang insists on trying to find King Bumi within Omashu's borders, even with the dangers that will await him and his friends if his real identity is discovered.  Meanwhile Azula goes in search of old friends to help her with her mission.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E04 - The Swamp
2.plot: A mysterious tornado pulls the kids into a supernatural swamp where Katara, Sokka and Aang have mysterious visions. Meanwhile, Momo and Appa are chased by rogue swamp dwellers and only Aang and the gang can save them.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E05 - Avatar Day
2.plot: Aang and the gang discover an Earth town that celebrates something called "Avatar Day." But when they get there and learn the festival is of "anti-Avatar" sentiment and Aang is put on trial for a crime a past incarnation allegedly committed. Looking to clear the Avatar's good name, Katara and Sokka venture back to a familiar  place to gather evidence and discover the truth.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E06 - The Blind Bandit
2.plot: In search for an Earthbending teacher for Aang, the kids go to an underground Earthbending tournament called Earth Rumble 6, where they encounter Toph, a blind but powerful Earthbending girl. After seeing her unique style of Earthbending, Aang wants Toph to become his teacher, but there are complications with Toph's family.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E07 - Zuko Alone
2.plot: Zuko travels by himself to an Earth Kingdom town were he meets a local boy. The two almost become friends, while Zuko suffers from flashbacks of his past.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E08 - The Chase
2.plot: Tired from trying to escape a machine that shows up every time they try to sleep, Aang and the gang have to escape Azula and her team, but their exhaustion leads to a tight situation. Meanwhile, Zuko must deal with something personal, and Iroh bonds with an unlikely individual.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E09 - Bitter Work
2.plot: Toph's instructing abilities come into question when Aang cannot seem to overcome a block that keeps him from earthbending. Sokka gets himself in a jam, while befriending what was, moments before, his next meal, and Iroh and Zuko begin training utilizing new philosophies and methods that originate from the other elements.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E10 - The Library
2.plot: When Aang and his friends find a professor who knows of a library that contains information about the world, Sokka decides to go there to hopefully find some information to use against the Fire Nation. The library is guarded by the knowledge spirit, Wan Shi Tong, who doesn't welcome humans into his library, because he believes they only seek information for evil purposes. When Wan Shi Tong discovers Sokka wasn't being truthful with him, he begins to sink the library, bringing the kids down with it.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E11 - The Desert
2.plot: Aang searches for Appa while Katara struggles to keep everyone together to survive in the vast desert. Meanwhile, Iroh and Zuko seek help from an ancient secret society.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E12 - The Serpent's Pass
2.plot: When Aang and the gang meet up with a group of refugees, they tell the gang where they can get on a ferry to Ba Sing Se. But after a series of events they have to take a deadly route called the serpent's pass with the help of an old friend, Suki. Meanwhile Zuko and Iroh meet up with a boy named Jet and his freedom fighters.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E13 - The Drill
2.plot: Having made it to the outer wall of Ba Sing Se, the kids confront a Fire Nation army that is driving a massive Fire Nation drill, which poses an imminent threat to the last Earth Kingdom stronghold. Meanwhile, Zuko and Iroh make crucial mistakes which begin to attract Jet's suspicions.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E14 - City of Walls and Secrets
2.plot: Having finally made it into Ba Sing Se, the kids are given a house in the upper ring. The kids are anxious to tell the Earth King their plan but there are complications. Meanwhile, still convinced that Iroh and Zuko may be Fire Nation, Jet decides to take matters into his own hands and do whatever it takes to get the refugees to reveal their true nature.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E15 - The Tales of Ba Sing Se
2.plot: A series of short stories, highlighting different characters and their individual adventures in the city. Tales of Katara and Toph, Iroh, Sokka, Aang, Zuko, and Momo.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E16 - Appa's Lost Days
2.plot: Appa's journey from being abducted in the desert to the present is explored.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E17 - Lake Laogai
2.plot: Aang and his friends continue to search for Appa and, unbeknownst to them, they aren't the only ones looking for him. During their search, the kids meet up with Jet, whom they are understandably reluctant to trust. The kids soon realize that the Dai Li are doing their best to thwart the kids' efforts to find Appa. Meanwhile, Iroh is offered his own tea shop in the upper ring, and Zuko discovers the avatar is in the city.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E18 - The Earth King
2.plot: The kids battle Long Feng and the Dai Li when they attempt to show the Earth King the vast conspiracy taking place in his city. Zuko becomes seriously ill and has feverish dreams as he faces a spiritual crisis.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E19 - The Guru
2.plot: Aang travels to the Eastern Air temple to receive guidance from Guru Pathik while Sokka is reunited with his long-lost father. Meanwhile, Azula has something diabolical in store for her enemies in the Earth Kingdom, including Zuko and Iroh.

2.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S02E20 - The Crossroads of Destiny
2.plot: Everyone races against time to stop Azula's sinister plan. Zuko finds companionship in an unlikely source. Aang's destiny hangs in the balance—and so does Zuko's, as Iroh tells him it's time to make a choice.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E01 - The Awakening
3.plot: Aang awakens to find himself aboard a captured Fire Nation ship with a full head of hair and sustaining serious injuries from the previous battle for Ba Sing Se. At his side are Katara, Sokka, and their father Hakoda who recount the events that led the four to the ship and contemplate their next move. Aang struggles to fight his own desire to face the Fire Lord before he is ready. Meanwhile, Zuko deals with his own issues as he makes his long-awaited journey home, with the fear of his father's rejection hanging over his head.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E02 - The Headband
3.plot: To better blend in as Fire Nation citizens, Aang enrolls in a Fire Nation school, giving himself an opportunity to learn more about the Nation and to enjoy life as a normal kid for the first time since he discovered he was the Avatar. Meanwhile Zuko, growing more and more paranoid about the Avatar's false demise, brings himself to confront the imprisoned Iroh.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E03 - The Painted Lady
3.plot: When the gang arrives at a suffering fishing village, a mysterious spirit appears to help the villagers.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E04 - Sokka's Master
3.plot: Feeling as though he isn't contributing enough to the group, Sokka seeks out an elusive swordsmaster from whom he can learn the ways of the blade.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E05 - The Beach
3.plot: Zuko, Azula, Mai and Ty Lee take a vacation to Ember Island. In the process, they come to learn more about themselves and each other as well as their desires for the future. Elsewhere, Aang and the others face off against a new adversary.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E06 - The Avatar and the Firelord
3.plot: The tale of Avatar Roku and Fire Lord Sozin is revealed to Aang and Zuko by different sources.  Both learn about themselves and are shown the origins of the war.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E07 - The Runaway
3.plot: When Katara expresses her disapproval of Toph's new way to make quick cash, the group finds her too motherly and tension grows between Katara and Toph. When Katara finally decides to participate in this scam to disprove Toph's accusations, they are left vulnerable and are forced to face the dire consequences.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E08 - The Puppetmaster
3.plot: The gang investigates the bizarre disappearances taking place within an eerie town.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E09 - Nightmares and Daydreams
3.plot: Four days prior the invasion, Aang becomes nervous over his soon-to-come confrontation with the Fire Lord. His anxiety gets the better of him as he begins to suffer from outrageous nightmares and hallucinations. Meanwhile, Zuko becomes upset to learn that he was not informed about a war meeting.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E10 - The Day of Black Sun: The Invasion (1)
3.plot: The day of the eclipse has arrived, and the invasion force gathers together to make last preparations. They infiltrate the island and the battle begins. Meanwhile, Aang searches for the Fire Lord.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E11 - The Day of Black Sun: The Eclipse (2)
3.plot: As the invasion force fights their way to the Fire Nation capital, the kids help Aang find the Fire Lord in time for the eclipse. Zuko confronts his father with shocking news.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E12 - The Western Air Temple
3.plot: Aang and the group arrive at the Western Air Temple, with Zuko in pursuit. Zuko wishes to help the Avatar end the war by teaching him firebending.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E13 - The Firebending Masters
3.plot: While teaching Aang firebending, Zuko realizes that he has lost all his firebending skills. To regain his powers, Zuko and Aang must seek the original source of firebending within the ruins of a lost civilization.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E14 - The Boiling Rock (1)
3.plot: Sokka wants to break his father out of jail and asks Zuko for information on Fire Nation prisons. Sokka and Zuko head for the Boiling Rock, a prison located in the middle of a volcano, to rescue Sokka's father.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E15 - The Boiling Rock (2)
3.plot: Zuko and Sokka make new plans to break out of the prison with Suki, Sokka's father and some others while a shocking twist leaves Azula none too happy with her two closest friends.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E16 - The Southern Raiders
3.plot: Katara decides to confront the Fire Nation soldier responsible for her mother's death. Aang tries to talk her out of it, but she doesn't listen.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E17 - The Ember Island Players
3.plot: A play recounting the gang's adventures does not sit well with Aang and his friends, except for Toph who enjoys it very much. Meanwhile, Aang confesses his love to Katara, but the response is ambiguous.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E18 - Sozin's Comet: The Phoenix King (1)
3.plot: Aang struggles to decide whether or not he has to kill the Fire Lord and, during the night, is drawn toward an island which disappears before morning. Zuko leads the rest of the group to the Earth Kingdom to meet a tracker whom they hope can find Aang. The Fire Lord crowns himself Phoenix King and Aang awakens on the island not knowing where he is.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E19 - Sozin's Comet: The Old Masters (2)
3.plot: While on the island, Aang seeks guidance from his past lives, but is not pleased with what he is told. The island, in fact, turns out to be a lion turtle from which Aang is given the guidance he had been seeking. After the tracker is unable to track Aang, the rest of the group decide they must find Iroh. Meanwhile, while tracking down Iroh, the group meets up with The Order of the White Lotus, a group that transcends the division of the four nations.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E20 - Sozin's Comet: Into the Inferno (3)
3.plot: Sokka, Suki, and Toph try to stop the Fire Nation's air fleet. Meanwhile, Zuko and Azula duel in an Agni Kai and Aang confronts the Fire Lord. On the verge of losing, Aang gets hit in the back of his scar which sends him into the Avatar State.

3.title: FR - Avatar: Le dernier maître de l'air - S03E21 - Sozin's Comet: Avatar Aang (4)
3.plot: Aang defeats the Fire Lord by bending the elements within the Fire Lord and removing his firebending abilities. After Zuko is taken down protecting Katara from Azula, Katara joins the fight and manages to restrain Azula. Afterwards, Zuko is crowned Fire Lord and promises a better future for the world, while Aang takes his place as the next Avatar. Katara finally shows her love for Aang as they kiss under the setting sun.

meta.plot: Ang est un jeune Maître de l'Air, mais c'est surtout l'Avatar, un être unique qui maîtrise tous les éléments - Feu, Air, Eau et Terre. Lors d'un terrible orage, il sombre dans la mer et hiberne grâce à ses pouvoirs d'Avatar, pour se réveiller un siècle plus tard dans un monde tyrannisé par la puissante Nation du Feu et où il est le dernier représentant de son peuple. Aidé de ses deux amis de la Tribu de l'Eau, Ang va devoir réveiller l'Avatar en lui, apprendre à contrôler tous les éléments et se battre contre la menace que les Maîtres du Feu font peser sur le monde.

FR - Vermin - S01E03 - The Flashback
