meta.plot: It’s the story of a praying mantis who goes off the city to become a policeman and is going to suffer a lot. It’s a bit like Zootopia but without being tolerant.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E01 - Great Power
1.plot: One year after becoming Spider-Man, a teenage Peter Parker is approached by Nick Fury to train with S.H.I.E.L.D. Spidey turns Fury down, but soon finds that villainous forces may require him to join the big leagues after all.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E02 - Great Responsibility
1.plot: Spider-Man accepts Nick Fury’s offer to become the Ultimate Spider-Man and meets his new allies of young heroes consisting of Nova, White Tiger, Power Man and Iron Fist. Meanwhile, Norman Osborn orders Doctor Octopus to send the Frightful Four to target Spider-Man. Spider-Man ends up having to get help from his new allies to fight off the Frightful Four.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E03 - Doomed
1.plot: After a childish argument between Spider-Man and Nova gets their entire team grounded, the super-youths go through S.H.I.E.L.D.'s database of the most wanted supervillains to see who they can defeat and apprehend in order to impress Nick Fury. When the choices Batroc the Leaper, Blizzard, Melter, MODOK, Toad, Whirlwind, and Lady Porcupine prove unpopular, Spider-Man and his team go to Latveria to track down Doctor Doom. The young heroes fairly easily capture Doom, but things take a turn for the worst when Doctor Doom tricks the team into taking one of his Doombots aboard the Helicarrier.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E04 - Venom
1.plot:
Under the supervision of Osborn, Doctor Octavius obtains a sample of Spider-Man's blood in order to create a creature that rivals the powers of the wall crawler.

 

Meanwhile, Peter attempts to balance his friendship with Harry with his time with his SHIELD teammates.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E05 - Flight of the Iron Spider
1.plot: When Spider-Man meets his idol Iron Man, he receives a specialized gift: the Iron Spider suit. However, Spider-Man experiences difficulty learning how to use the suit and begins to neglect his teammates. Meanwhile, the heroes battle the Living Laser, who takes advantage of Spider-Man's lack of experience using the new suit.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E06 - Why I Hate Gym
1.plot: Taskmaster goes undercover and infiltrates Peter's school to seek out Spider-Man. Spider-Man and White Tiger must put their differences aside and find a way to defeat an opponent who can mimic all of their physical abilities.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E07 - Exclusive
1.plot: Spider-Man agrees to a video interview with budding news reporter Mary Jane Watson, who gets a more exclusive scoop than she could ever have anticipated when Spider-Man and The Incredible Hulk engage in an all-out battle against Zzzax throughout Manhattan.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E08 - Back in Black
1.plot: It is bad enough Spider-Man catches a cold, but things drop from bad to worse when a new Spider-Man dressed in black attempts to replace him. Are his friends right and is his jealousy is getting the best of him, or is the new Spider-Man Venom's latest victim?

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E09 - Field Trip
1.plot: While on a field trip, Spider-Man and his superhero friends encounter the mighty Thor, who is transformed into a frog by his mischievous half-brother Loki. Now, the heroes must venture to the magical world of Asgard in order to save the nine realms from Loki's wrath.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E10 - Freaky
1.plot: Spider-Man and Wolverine must overcome clashing personalities and styles in order to defeat Mesmero and Sabretooth.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E11 - Venomous
1.plot: Venom resurfaces, using Harry as his host, yet again, and this time Harry's neglecting father becomes his main target. While Norman Osborn does not want his potential secret weapon damaged, Spider-Man is confronted with the dilemma of either trying to help Harry on his own or putting his trust in his teammates, who have orders from Fury to finish Venom off.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E12 - Me Time
1.plot: After a fight with Whirlwind, Spider-Man insists on a weekend off from Nick Fury and S.H.I.E.L.D.. Unfortunately, Doctor Octopus chooses this very time to attack Spider-Man when his job is threatened by Norman Osborn.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E13 - Strange
1.plot: When New York is plunged into a mystical sleep, Iron Fist and Spider-Man (who is at first highly sceptical of magic) seek the help of Doctor Strange. In order to break the spell, the three heroes must face their own worst fears in the face of the spell's initiator, the extradimensional entity known as Nightmare.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E14 - Awesome
1.plot: Peter Parker scrambles to focus his attention between completing his science fair project with Luke Cage and combatting Juggernaut. In his desperation concerning the first case, he decides to "borrow" one of Dr. Connor's inventions ... which (literally) becomes an even bigger threat to the city.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E15 - For Your Eye Only
1.plot: After being late for training, Spider-Man is faced against an evil super army called Zodiac and their leader, Scorpio, who took over the S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier and set it on self-destruct. Spider-Man and Fury must put their differences aside and fight the new menace as a team.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E16 - Beetle Mania
1.plot: Spider-Man and his team are put on S.H.I.E.L.D. security detail to protect the all-too-critical-for-his-own-health J. Jonah Jameson from the Beetle, a prospect Spider-Man does not enjoy. Things do get personal when Spider-Man must also protect a highly determined Mary Jane, who is on her way to the Bugle for a job interview, from the high-tech villain.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E17 - Snow Day
1.plot: When Phil Coulson wants the heroes to report to the S.H.I.E.L.D. ice base for winter survival training, Spider-Man and his team sneak off for a vacation on a deserted tropical island that Nova finds under "classy." However, they soon realize something is not right with the island and the Sandman will make sure they never leave.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E18 - Damage
1.plot: When Spider-Man and his fellow teenage super heroes cause too much damage in a super villain fight, Nick Fury assigns them to work with the super clean-up company Damage Control. While working with Damage Control, Spider-Man uncovers a villainous mystery.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E19 - Home Sick Hulk
1.plot: Hulk smashes back into Spider-Man’s life where he is sick with an alien infection caused by the Phalanx. Spider-Man has no choice but to take Hulk home and keep him hidden from Aunt May while protecting him from the Phalanx.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E20 - Run Pig Run
1.plot: Loki exacts revenge on Spider-Man by turning him into a pig, just in time for the Asgardian Boar Hunt across New York City. Now, Thor, who knows all too well how it feels to be transformed into a helpless animal, must help Spider-Ham survive.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E21 - I Am Spider-Man
1.plot: Flash Thompson stars as Spider-Man in a Midtown High musical production, and gets a taste of what Spider-Man's life is really like when the Trapster mistakes the football jock for the real web-slinger.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E22 - The Iron Octopus
1.plot: When Doctor Octopus takes over Iron Man's armors, Spider-Man and team work to stop his attacks on Oscorp and S.H.I.E.L.D.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E23 - Not a Toy
1.plot: Spider-Man loses Captain America's shield and must retrieve it from Doctor Doom.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E24 - The Attack of the Beetle
1.plot: Aunt May goes on a date with Phil Coulson, Peter's principal and S.H.I.E.L.D. supervisor, and the Beetle returns to continue his evil deeds.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E25 - Revealed
1.plot: The Green Goblin is created.

1.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S01E26 - The Rise of the Goblin
1.plot: Spider-Man tries to protect Harry Osborn from the Green Goblin and Venom.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E01 - The Lizard
2.plot: Spider-Man returns to stop the nefarious plot of Doctor Octopus. But not everything goes according to plan when Spidey’s friend, Dr. Curt Connors, transforms into The Lizard.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E02 - Electro
2.plot: Spider-Man's old enemy Electro takes control of the city's electricity.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E03 - The Rhino
2.plot: Spider-Man must stop Rhino’s personal vendetta against Spidey’s least favourite Midtown High classmate: Flash Thompson.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E04 - Kraven the Hunter
2.plot: White Tiger comes to terms with her powers and origin, while she is hunted by a villain from her past.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E05 - Hawkeye
2.plot: Spider-Man and Hawkeye join forces when the Beetle returns to New York City.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E06 - The Sinister Six
2.plot: Spider-Man gets trapped with six of his most dangerous foes, including Rhino; Kraven the Hunter; Lizard; Electro; Beetle; and a secret sixth member.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E07 - Spidah-Man!
2.plot: Spider-Man accepts an invitation from Boston to become the city's official hero.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E08 - Carnage
2.plot: The Green Goblin returns and tries to make Spider-Man into his perfect weapon, but Carnage has other ideas for the duo.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E09 - House Arrest
2.plot: The security system at Aunt May's home becomes dangerous.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E10 - The Man-Wolf
2.plot: Spider-Man travels to the moon to rescue J. Jonah Jameson's son, but a bizarre threat awaits him on the lunar surface.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E11 - Swarm
2.plot: A disgruntled Stark Industries scientist named Michael Tan develops and envelops himself in a swarm of self-replicating nanobots. Now Spider-Man must work with Iron Man to contain Swarm.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E12 - Itsy Bitsy Spider-Man
2.plot: Using a Norn Stone, Loki shrinks Spider-Man's team while looking for Thor. Nick Fury has Spider-Man's team placed in the Helicarrier's D.A.Y.C.A.R.E. area while S.H.I.E.L.D. continues to look for Thor. With Thor also having been shrunk, Spider-Man's team must find a way to help Thor fight Loki and the Destroyer Armor and return to normal size.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E13 - Journey of the Iron Fist
2.plot: Spider-Man travels to the mystical city of K’un L’un to help Iron Fist fulfill his destiny. But The Scorpion plans to destroy them both.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E14 - The Incredible Spider-Hulk
2.plot: Spider-Man and The Hulk switch minds, leading to lots of craziness and a clobberin’ from The Thing of The Fantastic Four.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E15 - Stan By Me
2.plot: Spider-Man, Mary Jane, Harry and Stan the Janitor have to descend into the sewer tunnels beneath Midtown High to track down the Lizard.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E16 - Ultimate Deadpool
2.plot: Spider-Man spends a day in Deadpool's madcap world.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E17 - Venom Bomb
2.plot: Spider-Man must work with his nemesis, Doctor Octopus, when The Green Goblin unleashes Venom on the Tricarrier.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E18 - Guardians of the Galaxy
2.plot: Spider-Man and Nova team up with The Guardians of the Galaxy on a deep-space adventure to save Earth from destruction.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E19 - The Parent Trap
2.plot: Spider-Man and Power Man infiltrate Zodiac's secret volcano base only to discover what really happened to Power Man's long-lost parents.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E20 - Game Over
2.plot: Spider-Man teams up with The Avengers' Captain America and the X-Men's Wolverine to stop a new threat to S.H.I.E.L.D.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E21 - Blade
2.plot: It's Halloween for Marvel's Ultimate Spider-Man, but there's no time for Spider-Man and his friends to trick-or-treat when they find themselves attacked by evil vampires led by Dracula himself.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E22 - The Howling Commandos
2.plot: Spidey's only hope of stopping a world takeover is to team up with Nick Fury's secret team of super-powered monsters, The Howling Commandos. Led by Jack Russell, aka Werewolf by Night, The Howling Commandos include vampire hunter Blade, The Living Mummy, Frankenstein's Monster and Man-Thing.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E23 - Second Chance Hero
2.plot: Spider-Man forms an unlikely partnership with a cured Norman Osborn. But is Norman really a hero as the Iron Patriot?

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E24 - Sandman Returns
2.plot: Sandman proves he might not be the biggest bad after all. He's given the chance to start all over and Spidey must mentor his former foe as he struggles against his old instincts. What side will Sandman ultimately choose, hero or villain?

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E25 - Return of the Sinister Six
2.plot: Doc Ock launches a surprise attack on Spider-Man and the heroes. They soon find themselves in one of the most challenging battles of the season when they're up against the newly reformed Sinister Six. Norman Osborn also returns as Iron Patriot despite Ock's alternate plans for him.

2.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S02E26 - Ultimate
2.plot: Doc Ock launches a surprise attack on Spider-Man and the heroes. They soon find themselves in one of the most challenging battles of the season when they're up against the newly reformed Sinister Six. Norman Osborn also returns as Iron Patriot despite Ock's alternate plans for him.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E01 - The Return of the Guardians of the Galaxy
3.plot: The Guardians of the Galaxy land on Earth to repair their ship at the same time ex-Nova Corps member Titus leads the Chitauri into targeting Nova's helmet. Now Spider-Man and Nova must work with the Guardians of the Galaxy to defeat Titus and the Chitauri.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E02 - The Avenging Spider-Man
3.plot: Spider-Man's dream of joining the Avengers becomes a nightmare when Loki switches bodies with the web-slinger, turning his new teammates against him. Spider-Man and his friends team up with the Avengers to stop Loki and Doctor Octopus from destroying New York City with an army of Venomized monsters.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E03 - Agent Venom
3.plot: While trying to become a crime fighter, Flash Thompson gets permanently bonded with Venom. It's up to Spider-Man to rescue his one-time school bully from the attentions of Venom, Beetle and Taskmaster. In the end, Nick Fury decides to give Spider-Man his list of teenaged superheroes.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E04 - Cloak & Dagger
3.plot: Spider-Man wants to recruit Cloak and Dagger as new warriors for his S.H.I.E.L.D. team. Complicating the matter, however, are Dormammu taking control of Cloak and Dr. Strange in an attempt to invade Earth, and Cloak and Dagger's own trust issues.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E05 - The Next Iron Spider
3.plot: Science genius Amadeus Cho proves perfect to operate the Iron Spider armor. The only trouble is he's Peter Parker's class rival.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E06 - The Vulture
3.plot: A mysterious thief known as The Vulture has been causing trouble. Spider-Man decides to track him down, and discovers he's a young man who has trouble remembering his past.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E07 - The Savage Spider-Man
3.plot: Spider-Man accompanies Wolverine to the Savage Land to recruit Ka-Zar and his pet smilodon Zabu. During this time, they discover a plot by Taskmaster and Kraven the Hunter to abduct Zabu as part of Kraven the Hunter's ritual that would render him immortal.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E08 - Halloween Night at the Museum
3.plot: The cast of "Jessie" gets animated in this special crossover episode that finds the Manhattan nanny in possession of a medieval sword coveted by the infamous Morgan Le Fey. Jessie and Spider-Man team up to save Halloween and the world from Le Fay's evil plans.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E09 - New Warriors
3.plot: Now that the other young heroes have been assembled, Spider-Man must lead them into defending the Tri-Carrier from the Thunderbolts (consisting of Taskmaster, Vulture, and Cloak and Dagger) where they managed to spring Green Goblin, Doctor Octopus, Beetle, and Scorpion from their cells.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E10 - Nightmare on Christmas
3.plot: Spider-Man sees what the world would be like without him when Nightmare takes the web-slinger on a journey through his past, present, and future.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E11 - The Spider-Verse (1)
3.plot: Spider-Man learns that the Green Goblin is planning to travel across the Multiverse using the Siege Perilous he stole from S.H.I.E.L.D. and the energy of Electro to collect the DNA of other Spider-Men. Spider-Man follows his enemy to the futuristic world of Marvel 2099 (which is drawn in CGI) and helps boost the confidence of Spider-Man 2099. Then he travels to a gender-swapped universe and teams up with Spider-Girl to defeat their world's versions of the Green Goblin.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E12 - The Spider-Verse (2)
3.plot: While chasing Green Goblin across the Multiverse, Spider-Man arrives in the Marvel Noir universe where he helps Spider-Man Noir renew his friendship with Marry Jane. Then Spider-Man heads to a cartoonish world inhabited by anthropomorphic animals where he helps Peter Porker find the will to be Spider-Ham again.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E13 - The Spider-Verse (3)
3.plot: As Spider-Man continues chasing Green Goblin across the Multiverse, he lands in a medieval-based world where he helps Spyder-Knight take down the Alchemist (the medieval version of Doctor Octopus) and his Kraken creation to save York. Then, his last stop before heading back home is an alternate version of the Ultimate Universe where he helps Miles Morales overcome the guilt of being unable to save his world's Peter Parker from death and fight the Ultimate Green Goblin.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E14 - The Spider-Verse (4)
3.plot: After Spider-Man finally ends up back in his own universe, he finds Green Goblin has injected himself with the Spider-Men DNA from all the universes to become the Spider-Goblin. With Electro's help from the Siege Perilous, he summons all the Spider-Men dubbed Web-Warriors to battle the Spider-Goblin and save New York even when Electro plans to destroy it.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E15 - S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy
3.plot: The S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy has been opened up at the Triskelion by Nick Fury as Spider-Man's group gets their education from Mr. Frank and guest instructors like Captain America and Hawkeye. Halfway into their education, Spider-Man and Iron Spider unknowingly reactivate an old World War II villain named Arnim Zola.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E16 - The Rampaging Rhino
3.plot: When Rhino learns that his archenemy Flash has become a hero, he starts a bitter rampage through New York. Spider-Man and Agent Venom are the last line of defense with help from Hulk. However, Hulk and Rhino face in battle and only Spider-Man and Agent Venom should stop now so to not cause destruction.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E17 - Ant-Man
3.plot: Nick Fury has been infected by nanite versions of Doctor Octopus' Octo-Bots. While the others face off against Doctor Octopus, Spider-Man and Power Man work with Ant-Man to enter Nick Fury's body and get the Octo-Bots out of him.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E18 - Burrito Run
3.plot: Craving Mexican food following an entire day training with Hawkeye, Spider-Man, Power Man, and Squirrel Girl sneak out of the Triskelion after hours for late-night burritos. Along the way, they must contend with Mesmero's plot to use the cellular network to brainwash everyone like he did with Batroc the Leaper, Boomerang, Grizzly, and Shocker.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E19 - Inhumanity
3.plot: Following Spider-Man's fight with Molten Man, the Inhumans have declared war on Manhattan as Nick Fury blames the exchange student Triton. Spider-Man and Triton discover that Maximus has brainwashed the rest of the Inhuman Royal Family (consisting of Black Bolt, Medusa, Gorgon, Lockjaw and Karnak) and plans to crash Attilan into Manhattan.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E20 - Attack of the Synthezoids
3.plot: Arnim Zola resurfaces and starts replacing Spider-Man's fellow students with synthezoid versions of themselves.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E21 - The Revenge of Arnim Zola
3.plot: With most of his fellow students replaced with synthezoids, Spider-Man must work with Agent Venom and Rhino to rescue their classmates and defeat Arnim Zola.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E22 - Contest of Champions (1)
3.plot: The Collector and the Grandmaster capture Spider-Man, along with every hero, villain and citizen of New York to play a game that will decide the fate of the entire planet.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E23 - Contest of Champions (2)
3.plot: The Collector and the Grandmaster's game continues as Spider-Man teams up with members from the Avengers and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. to play for the fate of the planet.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E24 - Contest of Champions (3)
3.plot: Spider-Man has to change the rules of The Grandmaster's game to save the citizens of New York and prevent the villains from taking over Earth.

3.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S03E25 - Contest of Champions (4)
3.plot: Spider-Man fights side-by-side with The Collector in an attempt to free all of Earth's heroes and villains from the Grandmaster and set everything right again.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E01 - Hydra Attacks (1)
4.plot: Peter Parker learns Doctor Octopus has teamed up with Arnim Zola and Hydra to attack the Tri-Carrier, leaving S.H.I.E.L.D. caught off-guard and Spider-Man left to single-handedly stop the assault. He assembles a new team, including an apprehensive Scarlet Spider, in order to stop the villains from taking over New York.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E02 - Hydra Attacks (2)
4.plot: After being saved by Scarlet Spider following Arnim Zola's takeover of the S.H.I.E.L.D. Tri-Carrier, Spider-Man must work with him to liberate Manhattan and his fellow students from HYDRA's clutches. Even when they save Agent Venom and Iron Spider, they must also undo transformations of the HYDRA Goblins, avoid Doctor Octopus and Kraven the Hunter, and defeat Arnim Zola.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E03 - Miles from Home
4.plot: After learning that Norman Osborn injected himself with an Anti-Goblin serum to prevent further transformations into Green Goblin following the last encounter, Doctor Octopus teams up with Baron Mordo and uses the Siege Perilous to pull the Ultimate Green Goblin from Miles Morales' universe into theirs so that HYDRA can be his master. Now Spider-Man and Miles have to work together with Doctor Strange to keep the demonic Goblin from using the Siege Perilous to destroy reality.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E04 - Iron Vulture
4.plot: With the Siege Perilous destroyed in the aftermath of the fight with the Ultimate Green Goblin, Miles Morales is forced to stay in Spider-Man's reality until S.H.I.E.L.D. can find a way to get him and his world's Goblin back to their home. Now dubbed Kid Arachnid, he and Spider-Man must help Norman Osborn when he is targeted by Doctor Octopus and Vulture.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E05 - Lizards
4.plot: Dr. Curt Connors has been turned into Lizard again. This time, he has a bite that turns anyone who is bitten into Lizards. The Triskelion goes under lockdown when Spider-Man's team and the S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy personnel get infected and attack Spider-Man. With help from an item in Nick Fury's office and with the help of Iron Spider, Leo Fitz, and Jemma Simmons, Spider-Man must work on an antidote in order to restore everyone to normal. Meanwhile, Agent Venom and Rhino guard Doctor Octopus' cell during the outbreak just in case he plans any escapes from his cell. Once everyone is cured, Spider-Man witnesses Doctor Octopus and Rhino making off with Agent Venom.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E06 - Double Agent Venom
4.plot: After Doctor Octopus and Rhino have escaped the Triskelion with Agent Venom in their clutches, Spider-Man and Scarlet Spider track them to the recently-returned HYDRA Island as Doctor Octopus and Arnim Zola work to separate the Venom symbiote from Flash Thompson. In order to get to Flash, Spider-Man and Scarlet Spider have to fight their way past Kraven the Hunter and the HYDRA Agents. Ock Manages to succeed in separating the symbiote from Flash, giving to Kraven, who becomes a lion-like Venom. However, Flash is able to coerce the symbiote back to him as they understand each other. As a result of the re-fusion, Agent Venom gains a new look.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E07 - Beached
4.plot: Spider-Man, Iron Spider, Agent Venom, Kid Arachnid, and Scarlet Spider have been looking for signs on where Doctor Octopus is hiding out. Upon Spider-Man and Iron Spider being ambushed by Vulture, they follow him to a nearby island where they are attacked by clones of Sandman. As Spider-Man fights the Sandman clones, Iron Spider stumbles upon a secret laboratory where Doctor Octopus has captured Sandman and cloned him so that he can find the "Ultimate Sandman" that will join the Sinister Six. After Sandman is rescued and Doctor Octopus escapes, Spider-Man allows Sandman to spread out around the Triskelion.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E08 - Anti-Venom
4.plot: Spider-Man and Agent Venom have been busting villains like Beetle, Grizzly, Shocker, and Shriek where they suspect that they might be candidates for Doctor Octopus' Sinister Six. Arnim Zola recruits Michael Morbius to work on a new symbiote. When Spider-Man, Agent Venom, and Harry Osborn in the Patrioteer armor track them down, they are caught off-guard when they release the Anti-Venom symbiote which possesses Harry and does not have any of the symbiote weaknesses. The resulting battle leaves Agent Venom injured and Harry in a coma.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E09 - Force of Nature
4.plot: During a drought, Spider-Man, Iron Spider, Kid Arachnid, and Scarlet Spider answer a distress signal that takes them to an abandoned mall in Queens. They find an empty air-tight room containing Hydro-Man who has a past with Nick Fury. While transporting him to the Triskelion, Iron Spider find that Hydro-Man is not a good guy where the fight with him causes an emergency landing near Aunt May's house. While Spider-Man, Iron Spider, and Kid Arachnid fight Hydro-Man, Scarlet Spider works to protect Aunt May who ends up naming him Ben. Once Hydro-Man is defeated where the resulting battle watered Aunt May's lawn, Spider-Man gets word that the Quinjet carrying Hydro-Man back to his cell was intercepted causing Spider-Man to speculate that Doctor Octopus has gotten Hydro-Man on his side.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E10 - The New Sinister Six (1)
4.plot: Spider-Man faces the culmination of all Doc Ock's evil machinations when the new Sinister Six assaults the Web Warriors and S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy at the Triskelion.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E11 - The New Sinister Six (2)
4.plot: When Doc Ock learns that the key to a device that will retrieve Hydra Island is at Aunt May's house, Spider-Man must fight to protect his family.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E12 - Agent Web
4.plot: When a battered Nova asks for help finding Nick Fury, Spider-Man tracks him to the dangerous ruins of an ancient city.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E13 - The Symbiote Saga (1)
4.plot: Spider-Man and Agent Venom discovered Hydra and Morbius' plan to create a new and improved Venom Bomb.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E14 - The Symbiote Saga (2)
4.plot: Spider-Man, Captain America and S.H.I.E.L.D Academy must band together to save New York.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E15 - The Symbiote Saga (3)
4.plot: Spider-Man and his fellow heroes have to Morbius and his plan to use the Carnage Queen as a weapon.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E16 - Return to the Spider-Verse (1)
4.plot: Spider-Man and Kid Arachnid travel to alternate dimensions to gather the shards from the broken Siege Perilous.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E17 - Return to the Spider-Verse (2)
4.plot: Spider-Man and Miles, tracking the missing pieces of the Siege Perilous, travel to a tropical Pirate dimension where they meet Web Beard, the Spider-Pirate, and encourage him and his old team to work together to save themselves from the dreaded Kraken.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E18 - Return to the Spider-Verse (3)
4.plot: Spider-Man and Kid Arachnid arrive in the Noir Universe where they have to prevent Mr. Negative from using the Siege Perilous to drain all the life and color out of the world.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E19 - Return to the Spider-Verse (4)
4.plot: Spider-Man, having collected all of the shards of the Siege Perilous, returns to Miles Morales' universe and confronts Wolf Spider.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E20 - Strange Little Halloween
4.plot: Trick-or-treaters start turning into monsters and Spider-Man, Dr. Strange and Ant-Man must team up to stop Baron Mordo.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E21 - The Spider Slayers (1)
4.plot: Spider-Man must team with the former traitor, Scarlet Spider, to stop Doc Ock from reawakening a secret program designed to create evil duplicates of Spider-Man.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E22 - The Spider Slayers (2)
4.plot: Spider-Man and Scarlet Spider have to infiltrate the sunken Hydra Island so Scarlet can destroy the lab that created him.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E23 - The Spider Slayers (3)
4.plot: Spider-Man puts the Triskelion on lockdown when a mysterious villain begins to take out the heroes one at a time.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E24 - The Moon Knight Before Christmas
4.plot: Spider-Man house sits on Christmas Eve and is forced to team up with Moon Knight to defend the home from the new Mysterio.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E25 - Graduation Day (1)
4.plot: Spidey must track down Ock before he harms Aunt May.

4.title: FR - Ultimate Spider-Man - S04E26 - Graduation Day (2)
4.plot: Peter Parker must find a way to stop Doctor Octopus and the Superior Sinister Six from destroying all of the heroes in New York and taking over the world.

meta.plot: While being trained by S.H.I.E.L.D., Spider-Man battles evil with a new team of teen colleagues.

1.title: FR - Trailer Park Boys: The Animated Series - S01E01 - Long Story Short... A Bear Ripped My Cock Off and Ate It
1.plot: Back in jail, tripping on mushrooms and transformed into cartoons, the boys test the limits of their new reality with both fear and excitement.

1.title: FR - Trailer Park Boys: The Animated Series - S01E02 - The Pepperoni Cobra
1.plot: A tapeworm is taking the grub right out of Ricky's mouth, but when the parasite swipes his weed, that's the last straw. Bubbles connects at the club.

1.title: FR - Trailer Park Boys: The Animated Series - S01E03 - The Stanley Bong
1.plot: Bubbles convinces Julian and Ricky to join him as he stalks Wayne Gretzky. Now they must beat the Moncton Mudslides to win back the Stanley Bong.

1.title: FR - Trailer Park Boys: The Animated Series - S01E04 - The Penis Milker
1.plot: The boys go on a mission to save a mountain lion friend, but they don't count on the mosquitoes, bear traps or sperm-harvesting backwoods locals.

1.title: FR - Trailer Park Boys: The Animated Series - S01E05 - Big Ho's Carwash
1.plot: Business booms -- and chaos reigns -- as Julian revs up a sexy car wash, Ricky opens a trailer pool, and Bubbles goes it alone to build his dream shed.

1.title: FR - Trailer Park Boys: The Animated Series - S01E06 - The Three Mustardteers
1.plot: Old-school hash brings back memories of grade school, when young Julian, Ricky and Bubbles met, smoked and retaliated against a bully with a pellet gun.

1.title: FR - Trailer Park Boys: The Animated Series - S01E07 - Satan's Bastards
1.plot: Trinity and Jacob want to move, so the boys deliver hash to raise cash. But Ricky gets greedy and incurs the wrath of a rampaging biker gang.

1.title: FR - Trailer Park Boys: The Animated Series - S01E08 - Space Weed
1.plot: When Ricky's grow operations are exposed, an entrepreneur approaches him to cultivate dope in space. Beyond pumped, Bubbles demands to join the team.

1.title: FR - Trailer Park Boys: The Animated Series - S01E09 - Hurricane Ricky
1.plot: To get off the grid, Ricky liberates hundreds of car batteries. Julian concocts a scheme to ride out a big storm, but Mother Nature has other plans.

1.title: FR - Trailer Park Boys: The Animated Series - S01E10 - Trailerstock
1.plot: The boys throw a benefit concert featuring Helix to save Sunnyvale. But how can their event compete with the nearby Queens of the Stone Age show?

2.title: FR - Trailer Park Boys: The Animated Series - S02E01 - Duber
2.plot: Ride-sharing hits a new high when Ricky attempts to go legit with a dope-smoking twist on Uber: Duber. But can the gang handle success — and Randy?

2.title: FR - Trailer Park Boys: The Animated Series - S02E02 - Viral Video
2.plot: The viral video cash-in is on. Ricky kidnaps a rank clown for Mo’s birthday party. But when the bozo bails, Cory and Randy step up as party starters.

2.title: FR - Trailer Park Boys: The Animated Series - S02E03 - The Tax Man F**ked Me
2.plot: Sunnyvale’s sketchiest get scammed by grifters posing as tax agents. A trap is set, then lethal farts lead the boys to a familiar face.

2.title: FR - Trailer Park Boys: The Animated Series - S02E04 - Scamazon
2.plot: Bubbles pours his life savings into Kitty Shakes while Julian and Ricky drive off to steal packages. Later, a reality competition comes calling.

2.title: FR - Trailer Park Boys: The Animated Series - S02E05 - Clint Eatswood
2.plot: The gang must rustle up dough to cure Bubbles’s kitten of hookworms, even if that means becoming movie stars. But are the boys ready to play dirty?

2.title: FR - Trailer Park Boys: The Animated Series - S02E06 - The First Time We Smoked Weed
2.plot: The fellas take a shady trip down memory lane back to 1979: the first time they smoked Panama Red — and launched a life of petty crime.

2.title: FR - Trailer Park Boys: The Animated Series - S02E07 - Bubbles for Mayor
2.plot: The city rounds up Bubbles’s free-range kitties, and when the mayor kicks him to the curb, he decides to run for office. One paradigm shift coming up.

2.title: FR - Trailer Park Boys: The Animated Series - S02E08 - The Bagshank Redemption
2.plot: After going to jail for peeing on the cops, Ricky claims he’s turning over a new leaf. That means ditching his pals to go on a Costco treasure hunt.

2.title: FR - Trailer Park Boys: The Animated Series - S02E09 - The F**ket List
2.plot: Bubbles drags Julian to the fair to cheer him up. After a fortuneteller delivers the bad news, the guys end up in a cult. Time to start drinking.

meta.plot: Nova Scotia’s favorite miscreants have always been super sketchy. Now, carrying on from the Season 12 finale, the boys have become complete cartoons.

1.title: FR - 101, rue des Dalmatiens - S01E01 - Dog's Best Friend
1.plot: When Dylan sees Clarissa Corgi's human waiting on her hand and paw he wonders whether he should get one to help with household chores. But he soon realizes a 'pet' is a big responsibility

1.title: FR - 101, rue des Dalmatiens - S01E02 - Boom Night
1.plot: On the scariest night of the Dog Calendar, Dad locks the house and tells Dylan to keep everyone safe in the house, but Dolly manages to sneak out anyway. When Dylan realizes that Dorothy has followed her, he has to overcome his fear of the Bummer Night in search of her

1.title: FR - 101, rue des Dalmatiens - S01E03 - Power to the Puppies
1.plot: Dolly & Dylan clash over puppy-sitting styles, so they call a snap election to decide who shall be Top Dog, only for Diesel, the most unsuitable leader, to win

1.title: FR - 101, rue des Dalmatiens - S01E04 - Who The Dog Do You Think You Are?
1.plot: Dylan finds out he has royal ancestors. Trouble erupts, however, when he embraces his royal role and the other pups are forced to wait on him hand and paw!

1.title: FR - 101, rue des Dalmatiens - S01E05 - Walkies on the Wild Side
1.plot: After Dolly teases Dylan for being too domestic, Dylan is determined to show her he can be wild and enlists Fergus the Fox to bring out his inner wolf

meta.plot: La série est centrée sur une grande famille de 99 dalmatiens dont le nom commence par la lettre "D" et leurs parents, Doug et Dalila, dont le dernier est un descendant de Pongo et Perdita. Ils laissent souvent les frères et sœurs aînés, Dylan et Dolly, en charge alors qu'ils sont occupés au travail. Ils vivent seuls au 101, rue des Dalamtiens, situé à Camden Town, à Londres au XXIe siècle, sans surveillance humaine, leur propriétaire, Dodie Smith, une milliardaire excentrique, leur a laissé sa maison pour aller vivre sur une île.

1.title: FR - Archer - S01E01 - Mole Hunt
1.plot: Archer is in trouble with his Mother and the Comptroller because his expense account is way out of proportion to his actual expenses. So he creates the idea that a Mole has breached ISIS and he needs to get into the mainframe to hunt him down (so he can cover his tracks!). All this leads to a surprising ending.

1.title: FR - Archer - S01E02 - Training Day
1.plot: Lana's residual lust for Archer prompts Malory to promote Cyril to field agent. Archer then trains his new competition as only he can, whilst Malory frets over her own past and her son's future.

1.title: FR - Archer - S01E03 - Diversity Hire
1.plot: Owing to a rash of agent deaths (the result of Sterling's carelessness), ISIS can't meet government diversity standards. Enter the gruffly elegant Conway Stern, an "onyx" agent who wears a Star of David around his neck. Conway is "a diversity double whammy," gushes Malory, but that and his secret-agent skills aren't the only reasons she hired him.

1.title: FR - Archer - S01E04 - Killing Utne
1.plot: Malory hosts a dinner party for the UN intelligence chairman, Torvald Utne, in an effort to get a new weapons contract for ISIS. Unfortunately, a group of rival assassins have targeted Mr. Utne for elimination.

1.title: FR - Archer - S01E05 - Honeypot
1.plot: Malory's career is threatened when a sensitive videotape falls into the hands of a rogue (and roguish) Cuban agent, so she calls on Archer’s expertise in seduction to turn the tables on her blackmailer.

1.title: FR - Archer - S01E06 - Skorpio
1.plot: Archer must rescue Lana from the clutches of Skorpio, the infamous arms dealer. Meanwhile, Cyril fears not only for his girlfriend's life, but her succumbing to the seductive nature of Archer's heroics.

1.title: FR - Archer - S01E07 - Skytanic
1.plot: When a bomb threat jeopardizes the maiden voyage of the luxury airship Excelsior, Archer and the ISIS crew must battle the clock (and each other) to avert disaster.

1.title: FR - Archer - S01E08 - The Rock
1.plot: After ISIS loses yet another lucrative contract to rival agency ODIN, Malory assigns Archer and Lana to embarrass ODIN by stealing a priceless diamond from their biggest client.

1.title: FR - Archer - S01E09 - Job Offer
1.plot: When Archer takes a higher-paying job at rival agency ODIN, Malory will stop at nothing to get him back.

1.title: FR - Archer - S01E10 - Dial M for Mother
1.plot: Questions about the identity of Archer's real father lead him into a perilous trap... and an explosive confrontation with Malory.

2.title: FR - Archer - S02E01 - Swiss Miss
2.plot: In yet another attempt to secure funding for ISIS, Malory drags her agents to the luxury winter resort town of Gstaad to protect a Swiss billionaire's daughter from a kidnapping threat. But Archer soon finds out the real threat is his protectee: an underage nymphomaniac who will stop at nothing to bed the world’s greatest spy.

2.title: FR - Archer - S02E02 - A Going Concern
2.plot: After Malory is wiped out in a Ponzi scheme, she hatches a scheme of her own: selling ISIS - lock, stock and snack machines - to archrival spy agency ODIN. Archer and the rest of the ISIS employees, rightfully fearing for their jobs, must use every trick in the book (ISIS Field Manual, 3rd Edition) to try to stop the sale.

2.title: FR - Archer - S02E03 - Blood Test
2.plot: When Archer's favorite call girl suddenly arrives for a visit, Archer is shocked to learn that she claims her new baby boy was fathered by him.  She obtains a court order that forces him to take a paternity test in hopes of proving her claim.

2.title: FR - Archer - S02E04 - Pipeline Fever
2.plot: Archer and Lana head to Louisiana to stop an ecoterrorist from blowing up a natural-gas pipeline. (Archer’s also looking forward to a Big Easy vacation.) Back at ISIS headquarters, Mallory orders the staff to go green to get “freebie socialist tax credits.” A flashback recalls Lana’s introduction to ISIS.

2.title: FR - Archer - S02E05 - The Double Deuce
2.plot: When members of Woodhouse's famed WWI Royal Flying Corps squadron start dying mysteriously, Archer tries to track down the killer.

2.title: FR - Archer - S02E06 - Tragical History
2.plot: Cyril agrees to help George Spelvin inject a virus into the ISIS mainframe so Cyril can defeat the virus and be seen as a hero.

2.title: FR - Archer - S02E07 - Movie Star
2.plot: On Malory's orders, Lana helps Hollywood star Rona Thorne (voice of Rachael Harris) research her role in a spy thriller while Malory writes a role for herself in the movie (with Cyril's reluctant assistance). Meanwhile, Pam steals Rona's diary.

2.title: FR - Archer - S02E08 - Stage Two
2.plot: Breast cancer strikes the Archer family---Sterling has it. "I'm trying to stay positive," he says. "I can beat this." But before surgery, he wants to bond with young Seamus (even though he isn't actually the baby's father) and take a Las Vegas vacation.

2.title: FR - Archer - S02E09 - Placebo Effect
2.plot: When Archer discovers that the chemotherapy drugs he has been taking are phony, he goes on a rampage against the Irish gangsters behind the scheme. He also makes friends with a fellow marijuana-toking cancer patient (voice of Joan Van Ark). Meanwhile, Cyril learns why Krieger is fluent in Portuguese.

2.title: FR - Archer - S02E10 - El Secuestro
2.plot: Pam is abducted by kidnappers who mistake her for Cheryl. It seems that Cheryl wasn’t completely forthcoming about her background when she applied for her job at ISIS.

2.title: FR - Archer - S02E11 - Jeu Monegasque
2.plot: When a mysterious stranger summons Malory and her intrepid ISIS agents to Monaco, all bets are off! Well, actually all bets are on. Because Monaco is basically one giant casino, and Archer has $4 million in untraceable bearer bonds. Also, it's Gran Prix week, so you can just forget getting a hotel room

2.title: FR - Archer - S02E12 - White Nights
2.plot: Archer's search for his father's identity leads him into hot water.  Agent Barry Dylan is sent to rescue Archer.

2.title: FR - Archer - S02E13 - Double Trouble
2.plot: Krieger works to finish a top-secret project, and Archer brings a mysterious former KGB agent named Katya Kazanova home to meet Malory.

3.title: FR - Archer - S03E01 - The Man from Jupiter
3.plot: Archer is shocked to learn that his mother is dating Archer's idol/hero/man-crush, Burt Reynolds.

3.title: FR - Archer - S03E02 - El Contador
3.plot: Cyril is promoted to field agent, while Malory institutes a strict drug-testing policy. Neither of which sit well with the staff of ISIS.

3.title: FR - Archer - S03E03 - The Limited
3.plot: The Royal Canadian Mounted Police enlist the help of ISIS to transport a captured Canadian terrorist. On a train.

3.title: FR - Archer - S03E04 - Drift Problem
3.plot: Archer's surprise birthday present - a high-tech, souped-up spy car - leads to all sorts of other surprises. None of which are good.

3.title: FR - Archer - S03E05 - Lo Scandalo
3.plot: Malory turns to Archer and Lana for help when she finds herself in a compromising situation with the Italian prime minister.

3.title: FR - Archer - S03E06 - Bloody Ferlin
3.plot: Archer must help Gillette save his younger brother from a crooked sheriff in the backwoods of West Virginia.

3.title: FR - Archer - S03E07 - Crossing Over
3.plot: Archer's sex life compromises his effectiveness as an agent. But more seriously than the countless other times.

3.title: FR - Archer - S03E08 - Skin Game
3.plot: Archer is faced with a dilemma when his murdered fiance, Katya, miraculously reappears. In Krieger's lab.

3.title: FR - Archer - S03E09 - Space Race (1)
3.plot: Archer and his colleagues at ISIS voyage to the final frontier in an effort to prevent a catastrophe on the International Space Station.

3.title: FR - Archer - S03E10 - Space Race (2)
3.plot: Archer and the rest of ISIS are held captive by mutineers on the International Space Station.

4.title: FR - Archer - S04E01 - Fugue and Riffs
4.plot: Archer has amnesia and decides the only cure is a spa weekend.

4.title: FR - Archer - S04E02 - The Wind Cries Mary
4.plot: Archer and his former best friend are holed up in the Vermont wilderness, fighting hard to come out on top.

4.title: FR - Archer - S04E03 - Legs
4.plot: Archer's fear of cyborgs hits home when Krieger offers to make robotic legs for Gillette.

4.title: FR - Archer - S04E04 - Midnight Ron
4.plot: The beginning of beautiful hatred between Archer and his new stepfather plays out as the two are chased by gangsters.

4.title: FR - Archer - S04E05 - Viscous Coupling
4.plot: Archer's former fiancée calls on him to rescue her cyborg boyfriend from outer space, but he has other things on his mind.

4.title: FR - Archer - S04E06 - Once Bitten
4.plot: Archer is bitten by a snake in a "special place".

4.title: FR - Archer - S04E07 - Live and Let Dine
4.plot: Archer, Lana, and Cyril go undercover in celebrity chef Lance Casteau's hellish kitchen.

4.title: FR - Archer - S04E08 - Coyote Lovely
4.plot: Archer heads to the Mexican border to capture a notorious coyote, which is Spanish for coyote.

4.title: FR - Archer - S04E09 - The Honeymooners
4.plot: Archer and Lana pose as newlyweds to stop a sale of enriched uranium.

4.title: FR - Archer - S04E10 - Un Chien Tangerine
4.plot: Archer and Lana extract an agent from Morocco only to find out his bark is worse than his bite.

4.title: FR - Archer - S04E11 - The Papal Chase
4.plot: Archer must rescue the Pope from an assassination plot using Woodhouse as a decoy. Operation Bad Habit is a go.

4.title: FR - Archer - S04E12 - Sea Tunt (1)
4.plot: Cheryl's brother Cecil Tunt and his girlfriend Tiffy drive her crazier than usual as they travel into the Bermuda Triangle. Where mysteries abound!.

4.title: FR - Archer - S04E13 - Sea Tunt (2)
4.plot: Archer and the ISIS crew go to an underwater SEA LABoratory to stop the deranged Captain Murphy.

5.title: FR - Archer - S05E01 - White Elephant
5.plot: ISIS is raided and disbanded by the U.S. government when it transpires that the agency was never sanctioned by them. Its former staff discover a hidden vault containing one-ton of cocaine, and form a drug cartel to sell the drugs to fund their retirements.

5.title: FR - Archer - S05E02 - A Kiss While Dying
5.plot: Archer, Pam and Lana travel to Miami to visit some old friends. It's a fondue party!

5.title: FR - Archer - S05E03 - A Debt of Honor
5.plot: Pam makes a deal that puts everyone in danger; Archer dons his slightly darker black suit.

5.title: FR - Archer - S05E04 - House Call
5.plot: Archer has to stage an intervention for Pam that gets derailed by an unwanted guest.

5.title: FR - Archer - S05E05 - Southbound and Down
5.plot: Malory buys a bus and takes everyone on a road trip. Put that hammer down and give it hell.

5.title: FR - Archer - S05E06 - Baby Shower
5.plot: Archer decides to give Lana the perfect baby shower gift by forcing Kenny Loggins to sing a duet with Cherlene. Something something Danja Zown!

5.title: FR - Archer - S05E07 - Smugglers' Blues
5.plot: Archer travels to Columbia on a secret mission that becomes not so secret after he gets drunk.

5.title: FR - Archer - S05E08 - The Rules of Extraction
5.plot: Archer, Ray, and Cyril raft down a crocodile-filled river while Lana and Pam plan a spa day for Malory.

5.title: FR - Archer - S05E09 - On the Carpet
5.plot: Archer avoids crash landing in a dangerous swamp only to come face-to-face with a shady arms dealer.

5.title: FR - Archer - S05E10 - Palace Intrigue (1)
5.plot: Archer and the rest of the ISIS gang are the guests of Gustavo Calderon and his wife Juliana. Calderon is a big fan of Cherlene but Juliana is a bigger fan of Archer.

5.title: FR - Archer - S05E11 - Palace Intrigue (2)
5.plot: Archer tries to keep his fling with the dictator's wife a secret while Krieger bonds with his clone-brothers.

5.title: FR - Archer - S05E12 - Filibuster
5.plot: Cyril becomes the new president of San Marcos, Cherlene becomes the first lady of country music, and Archer becomes a resistance fighter.

5.title: FR - Archer - S05E13 - Arrival/Departure
5.plot: Archer helps Lana with the delivery of her baby, while Krieger tries to prevent the delivery of a deadly weapon.

6.title: FR - Archer - S06E01 - The Holdout
6.plot: Archer must salvage a crashed plane in a jungle filled with relics from World War II.

6.title: FR - Archer - S06E02 - Three to Tango
6.plot: An agent from the past has a hand in creating tension between Archer and Lana.

6.title: FR - Archer - S06E03 - The Archer Sanction
6.plot: Archer, Lana, and Ray climb their way to the top of an assassin’s hit list.

6.title: FR - Archer - S06E04 - Edie's Wedding
6.plot: Pam takes Archer to her sister's wedding but gets side-tracked with technical difficulties.

6.title: FR - Archer - S06E05 - Vision Quest
6.plot: The gang gets to work early so they can spend some quality time together.

6.title: FR - Archer - S06E06 - Sitting
6.plot: Archer’s first weekend alone with baby AJ is soiled by a Pakistani intelligence officer.

6.title: FR - Archer - S06E07 - Nellis

meta.plot: Sterling Archer is the world's most daunting spy. He works for ISIS, a spy agency run by his mother. In between dealing with his boss and his co-workers - one of whom is his ex-girlfriend - Archer manages to annoy or seduce everyone that crosses his path. His antics are only excusable because at the end of the day, he still somehow always manages to thwart whatever crises was threatening mankind.

Earth's Mightiest Heroes are forced to face the fact they're big fish in a small pond -- and this new villain wants to conquer the entire ocean! Will the mightiest superheroes on Earth be able to stop the super-villain of the galaxy... before he succeeds in becoming all-powerful?

4.plot: After Loki becomes the Sorcerer Supreme, the Avengers are the only thing standing between him and the domination of the universe.

5.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S05E02 - Shadow of Atlantis (2)

5.plot: Black Panther discovers a relic of ancient Wakanda that helps him continue his quest for answers.

5.plot: Black Panther explores a secret enemy facility with a nefarious past.

5.plot: All of Black Panther's efforts to protect Wakanda are thrown into jeopardy by a new foe.

meta.plot: Marvel’s Avengers Assemble est une série animée racontant des histoires directement en lien avec le film The Avengers. Iron Man est le leader de cette équipe réunissant les plus puissants des superhéros: Hulk, Captain America, Thor, Hawkeye, Black Widow et un nouveau venu, Falcon. Ils allieront leurs forces face à des menaces qu'un seul ne peut pas vaincre. Quand les Avengers se réunissent, le mal n'a aucune chance de l'emporter.

1.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S01E01 - Blaze of Glory
1.plot: Blaze steps up when a cheating truck uses dirty tricks to try and win the championship race

1.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S01E02 - Blaze of Glory - Part 2
1.plot: Blaze steps up when a cheating truck uses dirty tricks to try and win the championship race.

1.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S01E03 - The Driving Force
1.plot: When Starla loses one of her pistons, Blaze and AJ try to get it back before Crusher can take it.

1.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S01E04 - Tool Duel
1.plot: Crusher steals all of Gabby's tools, and Blaze must help her retrieve them so she can repair the Monster Machines.

1.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S01E05 - Bouncy Tires
FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S01E06 - Stuntmania!
1.plot: The Monster Machines are eager to see Darington's stunt track, but Crusher tricks Darington, sending him far away.

1.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S01E07 - Epic Sail
1.plot: Crusher and Pickle challenge Blaze and the others to a sailboat race, but Crusher's attempt at cheating shipwrecks both teams.

1.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S01E08 - The Team Truck Challenge
1.plot: On the day of the Team Truck Challenge, Crusher chooses someone other than Pickle as his partner, which disappoints Pickle.

1.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S01E09 - The Jungle Horn
1.plot: When Crusher steals Stripes' jungle horn, Blaze and Stripes speed after him in a chase to get it back.

1.plot: When Crusher challenges Blaze to a game of truckball, Blaze must scour Axle City to put together a team before the big game.

1.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S01E11 - Cake-tastrophe!
1.plot: When Crusher accidentally turns the baker truck's baker bots to messy mode, they sprout wheels and drive away.

1.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S01E12 - The Mystery Bandit
1.plot: When a mysterious bandit makes off with Blaze's metallic trophy, he must track down the culprit.

1.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S01E13 - Gasquatch
1.plot: Blaze and AJ discover a mud-loving monster truck in the woods and set out on an adventure to bring their new friend to Mud Fest.

1.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S01E14 - Truck Rangers
1.plot: Blaze and his friends join the Truck Rangers, a scouting club where trucks earn badges for their accomplishments.

1.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S01E15 - Trouble at the Truck Wash
1.plot: Blaze and AJ must track down the missing pieces of Gabby's Truck Wash and rebuild it so their friends can get clean.

1.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S01E16 - Zeg and the Egg
1.plot: Zeg, Blaze and AJ find a tiny dinosaur egg and try to return it to its mother.

1.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S01E17 - Runaway Rocket
1.plot: When Crusher tries to cheat at a carnival game, he accidentally strands himself and Pickle on a giant rocket.

1.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S01E18 - Cattle Drive
1.plot: When Blaze and Starla encounter a herd of cows wandering in the desert, they embark on a wild west adventure to bring the cows back to Starla's barn.

1.plot: When Crusher cheats during a tropical island race with Blaze, AJ manages to rescue his best friend while overcoming obstacles.

1.plot: Blaze's friends each have the sneezles (except for Pickle, Blaze, AJ, and Gabby) , so Gabby, Blaze, and AJ must bring them medicine oil to help them feel better.

2.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S02E01 - Fired Up!
2.plot: In the second-season opener, Blaze smells smoke and gets his pals to safety, prompting a fire chief to encourage Blaze to become a firefighter.

2.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S02E02 - Dino Dash
2.plot: Zeg lands in a mud pit located far away, so Blaze and AJ try to rescue him by using a new engineering design inspired by their dinosaur-truck pals.

2.plot: It's Halloween in Axle City, and Blaze, AJ, and all of their friends are excited to "Truck or Treat." But when Crusher tries to steal all of their candy, his plan goes awry, and he sends their treats far away from Axle City.

2.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S02E04 - Race to the Top of the World, part 1
2.plot: Blaze and his friends compete in the most epic race in history. They meet pirates and the Sphinx on a whirlwind world-tour. But when Crusher throws them off course, Blaze and pals must persevere to make it to the finish line.

2.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S02E05 - Race to the Top of the World, part 2
2.plot: Blaze and his friends compete in the most epic race in history. They meet pirates and the Sphinx on a whirlwind world-tour. But when Crusher throws them off course, Blaze and pals must persevere to make it to the finish line.

2.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S02E06 - Monster Machine Christmas
2.plot: It's Christmas Eve, and Blaze and AJ are helping Santa load his magic bag of presents to deliver all over the world. But Crusher accidently knocks over the bag and sends the presents flying.

2.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S02E07 - Knight Riders

2.plot: Today Darington will attempt his biggest stunt yet: rocketing to the moon! But there's just one problem. His battery-powered rocket is out of energy. To get to the moon Blaze must help Darington recharge his battery.

2.plot: It's the day of the Piggy 500, and Starla is teaming up with her prize pig, Zippy, to race. But when her competitor Crusher and his rude pig, Slop, cheat and send Zippy far away, it's up to Blaze, AJ, and Starla to find him and get back to the race in time.

2.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S02E10 - Spark Bug
2.plot: Blaze, Stripes, and AJ are racing through the jungle when Stripes discovers a lost little fire beetle named Sparky. Blaze and his friends set off across the jungle to help Sparky get back home to the top of a red hot volcano.

2.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S02E11 - Five Alarm Blaze
2.plot: There's a fire on the bridge, and it's too much for the Fire Chief and his team to handle. They need Firefighting Blaze to help. With time running out, Blaze hurries across town. But can he get to the bridge in time?

2.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S02E12 - Axle City Grand Prix
2.plot: Axle City Grand Prix: Gabby has the perfect tool to get Blaze ready to race: a special remote that can control any machine. But when Crusher takes her remote, he activates machines all over town to slow Blaze down.

2.plot: Blaze, AJ, and Gabby join Pegwheel the Pirate-Truck for an island treasure hunt! Following their treasure map, the friends search jungle beaches and mountains to find where X marks the spot.

2.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S02E14 - Rocket Ski Rescue
2.plot: Crusher's Grammy is in town to watch Crusher and Blaze race at the Monster Dome. But when Crusher tries to cheat using rocket skis, his plan backfires, blasting him off the racetrack and across Axle City. Now Blaze must team up with Grammy to rescue Crusher.

2.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S02E15 - Dinosaur Parade
2.plot: Blaze, AJ, and lots of spectators have gathered to watch herds of dinosaurs march through Axle City! But when Crusher pushes his way into the parade, he scatters dinos everywhere, and it's up to Blaze, AJ, and Zeg to find and rescue them.

2.title: FR - Blaze et les Monster Machines - S02E16 - Race Car Superstar
2.plot: While visiting another town, a snooty car traps all of the racers, and Blaze must become a racecar to free his new friends.

2.plot: Blaze, AJ, and Stripes are searching for the Wishing Wheel: a magical treasure that will grant a wish for one lucky race car. But with chomping, stomping, and slithering dangers at every turn, can Blaze and his friends stay on track?

meta.plot: AJ est un mécano de 8 ans qui conduit son gros camion qu'il appelle « Blaze », le bolide le plus rapide d'Axle City. Les deux partent à l'aventure et trouvent sur leur chemin des problèmes de sciences et de maths. Ces problèmes, auxquels ils sont confrontés, sont causés par le rival de Blaze, Crusher, une semi-remorque qui fera tout pour vaincre ses rivaux jusqu'à la ligne d'arrivée.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E01 - Brothers of the Universe
1.plot: Koji Kaboto tries his OVT that he made with pieces of mecano. When flying, he is attacked by the UFOs of Vega. Fortunately Duke Fleed arrives on time to save the day (but not too quickly nonetheless). Koji does not actually know that Duke Fleed is the prince of Fleed.

1.plot: Koji discovers the identity of the Duke Fleed, but has no time to ask questions because Vega attacks. Duke Fleed and Koji unite their power and push back the enemy.

1.plot: Dampee Makeeba organizes a party at the ranch and invites Koji and Duke Fleed. The latter has no time to eat anything because Vega attacks. Will he have the time to make it to Grendizer before the earth is ravaged? All bets are open...

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E04 - The Island of Fear
1.plot: Gandal wants to discover the hiding place of Grendizer. So he launches a massive attack. Koji tries to confront the enemies alone, but he only succeeds to crush himself on a deserted island. Finally Duke Fleed makes it there and saves the day.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E05 - The Pitfall of Death
1.plot: Koji, Hikaro, Goro and Bunta are taken in hostage. Actarus interrupts his siesta to free them.

1.plot: Hikaro leaves for Perlepolis with Bunta. Their bus is attacked by a monster of Vega. Koji distracts the monster the time that Duke Fleed arrives (Grendizer has trouble to start up in winter).

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E07 - The Feast of the Wolves
1.plot: Janus, from the fearsome Ruins' Division, attacks Grendizer that is powerless in front of the brutality and the agility of his enemy.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E08 - The Radars are Off
1.plot: Blaki sets a trap to Grendizer by hiding mines in a cloud of spatial dust. Koji falls in the trap. Fortunately Duke Fleed helps him and destroys the Golgoth 8.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E09 - The Black Moon Camp
1.plot: Koji is captured with his UFO by the Vegans. Grendizer attacks the camp of the black Moon to save him.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E10 - Vega's Spy
1.plot: An inhabitant of the planet Rubi is contacted by Vega to explode the UFO carrier of Grendizer. The mission fails because of Duke Fleed and the Vegans try to kill the Rubinian. But Duke Fleed flies to his help.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E11 - The Day when the Sun will Stop
1.plot: The Vegans plan is to bring Grendizer to the shadow of the moon during the eclipse because Grendizer's systems will shut down temporarily under it and then destroy it.

1.plot: Daisuke and Kogi are sent to investigate an avalanche and to find survivors. They find a girl named Mirana who lost her memory. Back at Space Science Centre she begins to remember how a saucer destroyed her home.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E13 - By Iron and by Fire
1.plot: A new Vegan mecha comes to destroy Earth. It sucks power from the sun and burns everything in its path. Grendizer is damaged by it and has to withdraw. As the mecha attacks again Grendizer has to go to battle weaponless.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E14 - The Day of the Rising Sun
1.plot: Boss, Nuké, and Mocha are in this episode. They are visiting their old friend Koji Kabuto. The Vegans keep their eye on a mysterious orange robot that is found skiing near-by. Commander Blacki orders the Minifo to follow it and investigate.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E15 - Red Akerae
1.plot: Commander Yara is forced to create a mecha that creates earthquakes and use it on the city Kanto.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E16 - The Fiancé of Death
1.plot: A Vegan pilot lands near the Space Science Centre and makes Mr. Hayashi's fiancé, Kaori, a spy for him. She takes Dr. Umon as a hostage.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E17 - The Infernal Ride
1.plot: The Vegans begin building a base for their operations on Earth. The saucer "Giba Giba" begins to attack but Grendizer comes to save the day by saving a town and a mountain.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E18 - The New Time of the Caves
1.plot: Dr. Umon made a project so that Grendizer is able to launch without revealing his whereabouts to the enemy. Kabuto is control by the Vegans and fights Duke.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E19 - The Crushed Town
1.plot: A huge meteor is headed straight gives order to fire on the meteor and change its course to head for the planet Earth. The meteors are detected and Grendizer launches to intercept them before they hit land.

1.plot: Daisuke gets the suspicion that the Vegans may be planning to pull the moon down to Earth. Duke Freed launches Grendizer and follows Koji who already went to explore the area of Mount Kirofoki.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E21 - The Submerged Continents
1.plot: The Vegans plan to melt ice in the North Pole. This will cause the sea level to rise with catastrophic results to the shores on Earth.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E22 - The Slayers of the Sky
1.plot: The Vegans are planning to steal Dr. Chibana's new device so that they can use it to silence Duke Freed and his Grendizer.

1.plot: The Vegans continue their attempts to discover Grendizer's secret hideout as they are sure that the Space Science Centre has something to do with it. Hikaru finds out who Daisuke really is.

1.plot: Commander Witer successfully sneaks into Earth as Dr. Space who is a well-known acquaintance of Dr. Umon and a reliable person so he can find Duke Fleed and kill him.

1.plot: uke Freed's childhood friends Nayda, brainwashed by the Vegans, attempts to put a bomb on Grendizer but Duke stops her. Nayda accuses Duke of being a traitor. Koji attempts to pilot Grendizer but is almost killed.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E27 - Win or Perish
1.plot: Grendizer's delicate weapon systems malfunction and he finds himself struggling against the enemy. The Vegans arrive and descend upon the Center. Hikaru and Daisuke must fix Grendizer and save the Center.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E28 - The New Masters of Darkness
1.plot: General Zuril is a brilliant scientist who will try to find different ways of taking down Grendizer. Daisuke, Hikaru, and Goro are attacked by Vegans and Danbi puts on his gear and begins fighting them too.

1.plot: Vegans shrink the cells of the living body to make Harook become a young boy for a time so he can spy Space Science Centre. Harrok and Goro become friends but later the effects of the shrinking begin to wear off so Harook captures Goro.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E30 - The Lightning Rock
1.plot: A strange rock full of radiation energy lands on Earth and Dr. Umon can't make much of this new phenomenon. At the same time, the Vegans discover this strong source of energy and put it to use in their next saucer beast.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E31 - A Dreamer from Outer-Space
1.plot: The Boss, Koji, and Bunta go to the Boss Borot to begin their counterattack of the Vegan attack on them but will face some technical difficulties. Grendizer gets into some trouble while trying to help them but the Boss Borot will help Grendizer in the funniest way but will lose his Boss Spazer.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E32 - The Ghost Queen
1.plot: The Vegans send a woman by the name of Marian who looks identical to Duke Freed's mother who passed away on planet Freed.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E33 - The Wings of Death

meta.plot: Vega, Grand Stratéguerre de la planète Stykadès, s'empare d'Euphor, une planète pacifique qu'il va ravager avec sa flotte de soucoupes et de robots géants. Durant l'attaque qui mènera à la destruction finale d'Euphor, la famille royale est exterminée. Actarus, fils du roi et prince, parvient à s'échapper après s'être emparé de Goldorak, le plus perfectionné des robots mis au point par les scientifiques de la planète, et s'enfuit vers la Terre. Il est recueilli par la professeur Procyon qui dirige le Centre de recherches spatiales. Poursuivant sa conquête de nouvelles planètes, Vega établit une base sur la face cachée de la Lune, à partir de laquelle il compte lancer l'offensive sur la planète bleue. Actarus se voit alors dans l'obligation d'utiliser Goldorak afin d'éviter que la Terre subisse le même sort que sa planète natale.

meta.plot: Anna, a young and naive woman, moves to Knutby to become part of the free church congregation as a nanny, which to her seems like a warm and pious community. But soon the idyll that never existed crackles, and manipulation, power games, social exclusion, group pressure, brainwashing, fanaticism and both more and less religiously sanctioned left-wing chatter end in murder and grief.
