1.title: FR - Genius - S01E03 - Chapter Three
1.plot: Einstein struggles to support his pregnant wife and land an academic post in a rigid world of tradition and protocol.

1.title: FR - Genius - S01E04 - Chapter Four
1.plot: Albert Einstein and Mileva juggle raising a kids with his attempts to catch the eye of the scientific establishment.

1.title: FR - Genius - S01E05 - Chapter Five
1.plot: Einstein begins to experience the academic life he coveted, but he falters in his familial responsibilities. He is reintroduced to his cousin Elsa.

1.title: FR - Genius - S01E06 - Chapter Six
1.plot: Einstein moves his family for work, and to be closer to his new love, Elsa. He sets out to prove his theory as his marriage reaches a breaking point.

1.title: FR - Genius - S01E07 - Chapter Seven
1.plot: In the wake of the war, patriotism corrupts one of Albert Einstein’s closest friends, Fritz Haber, pitting them against each other.

1.title: FR - Genius - S01E08 - Chapter Eight
1.plot: Einstein and his wife Elsa attempt to flee Germany after the rise of the Nazis, but they face unexpected roadblocks.

1.title: FR - Genius - S01E09 - Chapter Nine
1.plot: Albert Einstein settles into life in America, but dangers abroad continue to be a threat to both him and his former colleagues.

1.title: FR - Genius - S01E10 - Chapter Ten
1.plot: After the atomic bomb is dropped and World War II draws to a close, Einstein assumes the role of world citizen in his twilight years.

2.title: FR - Genius - S02E01 - Chapter One
2.plot: Pablo Picasso confronts the threat of fascism in Spain, and Young Pablo rejects traditional painting to search for his own voice.

2.title: FR - Genius - S02E02 - Chapter Two
2.plot: Picasso's relationship with Dora Maar is strained by war. Young Pablo succeeds by imitating the masters, but struggles to be original.

2.title: FR - Genius - S02E03 - Chapter Three
2.plot: Picasso meets his great love Franoise Gilot. Young Pablo begins his Blue Period after the suicide of his friend.

2.title: FR - Genius - S02E04 - Chapter Four
2.plot: As older Picasso juggles two love affairs, Young Pablo strives to create a masterpiece that will signal his arrival as a great artist.

2.title: FR - Genius - S02E05 - Chapter Five
2.plot: Picasso tries to convince Françoise to move in with him, while Young Pablo is challenged by the radical genius of Matisse.

2.title: FR - Genius - S02E06 - Chapter Six
2.plot: Picasso takes Françoise Gilot on vacation. Young Pablo starts cubism with Georges Braque, but is accused of stealing the Mona Lisa.

2.title: FR - Genius - S02E07 - Chapter Seven
2.plot: After WWII, Picasso joins the Communist Party but struggles to align his artwork with his own political beliefs. Affected by a tragic love affair from his past, Picasso falters in his responsibilities to Françoise.

2.title: FR - Genius - S02E08 - Chapter Eight
2.plot: Pablo meets his first wife, a ballerina, while designing a ballet. Older Picasso struggles to manage his complex family.

2.title: FR - Genius - S02E09 - Chapter Nine
2.plot: Younger Picasso finds respite from his strained marriage with Olga in the arms of his newest muse: Marie-Thérèse Walter. However, their romance is short-lived, cause soon he crosses paths with Dora Maar. Meanwhile, Françoise Gilot defies Older Picasso and pursues her artistic goals.

2.title: FR - Genius - S02E10 - Chapter Ten
2.plot: After Françoise Gilot leaves him, Pablo finds companionship with a new woman. In near seclusion, Pablo obsesses over creating the perfect painting. Meanwhile, Françoise struggles to escape Picasso's shadow even after remarrying and moving to the US.

3.title: FR - Genius - S03E01 - Respect
3.plot: Desperate for a hit, Aretha travels to Muscle Shoals in 1967 to record her first album with Atlantic Records. After suffering the loss of her surrogate mother, Little Re braves her first solo in 1953, in her father’s, C.L. Franklin, church.

3.title: FR - Genius - S03E02 - Until the Real Thing Comes Along
3.plot: Struggling to find her sound, Aretha catches the attention of Jerry Wexler at Atlantic Records in 1966. Meanwhile, Little Re has her first touring experience on the Gospel Circuit in 1954 with C.L. Franklin and meets her idol, Clara Ward.

3.title: FR - Genius - S03E03 - Do Right Woman
3.plot: Aretha juggles her music career and her commitment to the civil rights movement, led by Martin Luther King Jr., in 1967 and 1968. Meanwhile, Little Re leaves behind her newborn child to return to the Gospel Circuit in 1955, meeting with music legends James Cleveland and Little Sammie Bryant.

3.title: FR - Genius - S03E04 - Unforgettable
3.plot: Aretha is featured on the cover of Time Magazine in 1968, but she’s devastated when the article focuses on the scandalous details of her personal life. Barbara Franklin and Young C.L. Franklin struggle to establish themselves in Memphis in 1941, before Little Re is born.

3.title: FR - Genius - S03E05 - Young, Gifted and Black
3.plot: Aretha, inspired by Angela Davis and the Soledad Brothers, records her protest album “Young, Gifted and Black” in 1970. Despite Jerry Wexler’s uncertainty, the album is a success. Barbara Franklin makes a decision that has a devastating effect on Little Re in 1951.

3.title: FR - Genius - S03E06 - Amazing Grace
3.plot: Aretha records her best-selling live Gospel album “Amazing Grace” in 1972 at New Temple Missionary Baptist Church, ignoring her sibling’s pleas to record instead at New Bethel with their father, C.L. Franklin.

3.title: FR - Genius - S03E07 - Chain of Fools
3.plot: As the Queen of Soul enters the age of disco, Aretha will do anything to remain relevant—including stealing an opportunity from her sister Carolyn. She receives a GRAMMY nomination but is ultimately snubbed from winning the award.

3.title: FR - Genius - S03E08 - No One Sleeps
3.plot: Despite significant emotional losses, including a second divorce and the death of her father in 1984, Aretha pushes herself artistically and triumphs.

4.title: FR - Genius - S04E01 - Graduation
4.plot: An intense focus on the formative years of Martin Luther King, Jr. and Malcolm X and their experiences and relationships as young children and teens that shape and influence the iconic figures they would become. Malcolm’s release from prison and King’s graduation from Boston University begin their respective journeys that will one day change the nation, but also begin a budding rivalry.

4.title: FR - Genius - S04E02 - Who We Are
4.plot: Malcolm is introduced to the Honorable Elijah Muhammad, who takes him under his wing after recognizing his potential with the NOI, but temptations from an old flame and the bonds of family test his strength. Martin introduces and brings Coretta into the King family. Martin finds his voice within the church and is faced with a career decision that will alter his relationship with Daddy King.

4.title: FR - Genius - S04E03 - Protect Us
4.plot: Malcolm builds space for Muslims in the Harlem community, meeting new member Betty Saunders. As romance builds between the two, a confrontation with the police puts Malcolm in the spotlight. As the Montgomery bus boycott intensifies, Martin and his new family are faced with concerns about their safety. In the end, both find themselves ascending to heights they could have never imagined.

4.title: FR - Genius - S04E04 - Watch the Throne
4.plot: After an attack leaves Martin grappling with his mortality, he must confront whether his fear is affecting his ability to lead. Malcolm sees an opportunity to grow the profile of the Nation in the form of a documentary about the NOI. However the consequences of his actions begin to bubble to the surface. All the while, Malcolm juggles a growing family as Betty finds herself feeling isolated.

4.title: FR - Genius - S04E05 - Matriarchs
4.plot: With Martin unjustly jailed, Coretta must call upon all her strength to keep pushing forward. When an opportunity to help Martin comes up, she takes it, despite pushback from Daddy King. With Malcolm refusing to listen to her needs, Betty takes drastic action to try to save her marriage. A reminder of her past, and a vision for her future, show her the way through.

4.title: FR - Genius - S04E06 - The American Promise
4.plot: In an effort to force the passage of the Civil Rights Act, Martin and his allies attempt their biggest undertaking yet – the March on Washington. As it draws near, Martin finds himself struggling to find the right words to unite the country. When Malcolm finds himself nearly suspended from the Nation, he evaluates his relationship with Elijah, especially in light of a dramatic revelation.

4.title: FR - Genius - S04E07 - The Sword and the Shield
4.plot: After his break from the NOI, the pain of betrayal from Elijah takes a toll on Malcolm mentally, physically and emotionally. When further betrayals within the Nation come to both him and Betty, he decides to speak out. The FBI targets Martin and Coretta, causing stress and paranoia, but the passage of the Civil Rights Act gives both Martin and Malcolm hope - and the opportunity to meet each other.

4.title: FR - Genius - S04E08 - Can You Imagine
4.plot: Malcolm, knowing his death is likely imminent, works hard to care for his family, reconcile with his siblings, and speak truth to power about the Nation and the best way forward, up until his final moments. In the aftermath of Malcom’s death, Martin, feeling his own mortality, decides that he can no longer remain silent on the Vietnam War. A horrifying day in Memphis shocks the world.

meta.plot: The life stories of history's greatest minds. From their days as young adults to their final years we see their discoveries, loves, relationships, causes, flaws and genius.

1.title: FR - Mauvais joueurs - S01E01 - Welcome to Hell
1.plot: Thirteen confused contestants arrive at the camp. Rules are explained, clans are formed and a captain is elected ahead of a brutal battle of the boxes.

1.title: FR - Mauvais joueurs - S01E02 - Clan vs. Clan
1.plot: After a tense beach standoff, the chosen ones make their way to the villa and plan for their first assembly. Jordan takes his destiny into his own hands.

1.title: FR - Mauvais joueurs - S01E03 - The Duel Is On
1.plot: A contender is chosen and the duel begins. In a bid to avoid elimination and win a spot at the villa, two players face off in a test of mettle and nerve.

1.title: FR - Mauvais joueurs - S01E04 - New Players, New Headaches
1.plot: The camp members greet a surprise arrival with suspicion and fatigue. Faced with a high-stakes decision, an emotional Emia is at odds with her friends.

1.title: FR - Mauvais joueurs - S01E05 - A Promise Is a Promise
1.plot: The previous night's decision causes upset in the camp. As a new relationship blossoms in the villa, a confident camp member promotes his perfect plan.

1.title: FR - Mauvais joueurs - S01E06 - Clean Sweep
1.plot: Two players go head-to-head in a daring duel with double the stakes. A wily contestant attempts to break up the core group. The boxes of destiny return.

1.title: FR - Mauvais joueurs - S01E07 - Every Man for Himself...
1.plot: Promises are broken on the beach. A member of the villa is given special powers ahead of the third duel. Hugo and Thibault try to sway the same player.

1.title: FR - Mauvais joueurs - S01E08 - ...And God for All
1.plot: At the assembly, the fate of one player rebounds dramatically. With only two opportunities left to rise to the villa, camp members prepare for battle.

1.title: FR - Mauvais joueurs - S01E09 - The Grand Finale
1.plot: Backstabbing and blocking decide the fate of some. In the final, members of the camp play a decisive role. Can trust triumph or will greed win the game?

meta.plot: Starting from nothing, 13 players compete for a spot in a luxury villa and a shot at 150,000 euros in this unpredictable game of strategy and survival.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E01 - The Cat and the Claw (1)
1.plot: When Catwoman infiltrates the underground headquarters of the terrorists, both she and Batman are captured and left to die as victims of a viral plague.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E02 - On Leather Wings
1.plot: When a vicious bat creature known as Man-Bat, starts terrorizing Gotham City, everyone mistakenly thinks that Batman is the culprit. Batman must find out who the mysterious Man-Bat is and clear his own name.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E03 - Heart of Ice
1.plot: Brilliant cryogenics expert Dr. Victor Fries is transformed into Mr. Freeze, a vengeful creature who can only survive in subzero temperatures.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E04 - Feat of Clay (1)
1.plot: A popular actor renowned for his ability to play any part has a terrible secret--he's addicted to a strange chemical formula that enables him to alter his facial features without makeup.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E05 - Feat of Clay (2)
1.plot: Clayface learns that the man responsible for his disfigurement is to appear on TV, promoting a skin conditioner containing the same chemical that deformed him.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E06 - It's Never Too Late
1.plot: An aging Mob boss learns his drug dealings have contributed to his son's drug addiction.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E07 - Joker's Favor
1.plot: When a timid accountant accidentally runs afoul of the Joker, he promises the Joker anything if the villain will only let him go.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E08 - The Cat and the Claw (2)
1.plot: When Catwoman infiltrates the underground headquarters of the terrorists, both she and Batman are captured and left to die as victims of a viral plague.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E09 - Pretty Poison
1.plot: When District Attorney Harvey Dent is poisoned after a dinner date, Batman makes the horrifying discovery that his date was Poison Ivy, a plant-obsessed villainess.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E10 - Nothing to Fear
1.plot: A horrifying villain named Scarecrow spreads fear gas and wreaks havoc at Gotham State University.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E11 - Be a Clown
1.plot: The Joker infiltrates the birthday party of Mayor Hill's son in order to plant a bomb.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E12 - Appointment in Crime Alley
1.plot: Batman's friend, Dr. Leslie Thompkins, is taken prisoner by a ruthless land developer after she uncovers his devious plans.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E13 - P.O.V.
1.plot: Bullock's account of a botched sting operation is so at odds with the other officers' testimony that the police investigator suspends everyone involved.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E14 - The Clock King
1.plot: When a maniacally punctilious man faces financial ruin because of attorney Hamilton Hill, he transforms into the devious Clock King and swears revenge on Hill, now the mayor of Gotham.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E15 - The Last Laugh
1.plot: The Joker employs a lethal mind-altering laughing gas to transform the citizens of Gotham into total fools.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E16 - Eternal Youth
1.plot: Alfred and his friend, Maggie Paige, visit a health spa that is actually run by the nefarious Poison Ivy.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E17 - Two-Face (1)
1.plot: District Attorney Harvey Dent hides a deep dark secret--he has a second personality, Big Bad Harv, a tough gangster.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E18 - Two-Face (2)
1.plot: Two-Face, the former Harvey Dent, begins an aggressive campaign against his hated rival, Rupert Thorne.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E19 - Fear of Victory
1.plot: The Scarecrow uses a fear chemical triggered by adrenaline on Gotham's greatest athletes, then bets against them to reap the winnings.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E20 - I've Got Batman in My Basement
1.plot: After the Penguin sprays Batman with nerve gas, a 12-year-old boy rescues the unconscious hero and hides him in his basement.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E21 - Vendetta
1.plot: Batman suspects that an imprisoned Detective Bullock may be innocent after he is arrested for murder. The real murderer turns out to be Killer Croc, who framed Bullock to get revenge.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E22 - Prophecy of Doom
1.plot: Bruce begins to worry when all of his wealthy friends join the same Brotherhood group run by Nostromos, a so-called psychic.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E23 - The Forgotten
1.plot: When men begin disappearing at a bowery, Bruce Wayne decides to go undercover as a worker. He loses his memory after he is attacked, kidnapped and forced to work in a mining camp.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E24 - Mad as a Hatter
1.plot: The Mad Hatter puts the city of Gotham under his control in an attempt to impress a woman, Alice, with whom he is in love.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E25 - The Cape and Cowl Conspiracy
1.plot: Batman investigates a theft of bearer bonds intended for the starving people of a poor country.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E26 - Perchance to Dream
1.plot: Bruce Wayne wakes up to find that his parents are not dead, he is not Batman, and he's engaged to Selina Kyle!

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E28 - Night of the Ninja
1.plot: When Wayne Enterprises is robbed by a mysterious figure known as the Ninja, Batman and Robin discover that the Ninja is an old nemesis of Bruce Wayne.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E29 - The Strange Secret of Bruce Wayne
1.plot: Dr. Hugo Strange's invention, a machine that reads people's thoughts, leads him to discover that Bruce is Batman.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E30 - Tyger, Tyger
1.plot: When a genetic engineer produces a man-cat hybrid, he kidnaps Selina Kyle to provide his creation with a mate.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E31 - Dreams in Darkness
1.plot: Batman must thwart the Scarecrow's plan to poison Gotham's water supply with a chemical that induces hallucinations.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E32 - Beware the Gray Ghost
1.plot: Batman connects recent bombings in Gotham to an episode of an old television series featuring his favorite boyhood hero, the 'Gray Ghost.'

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E33 - Cat Scratch Fever
1.plot: Selina Kyle uncovers a plot to infect stray animals with a deadly disease that will be transmitted to the human population.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E34 - I Am the Night
1.plot: On the anniversary of the death of Bruce's parents, Batman expresses doubts about whether or not he should continue his one-man war against crime.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E35 - Almost Got 'Im
1.plot: While hiding from the police, Batman's deadliest enemies exchange stories about their mutual nemesis--Batman.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E36 - Moon of the Wolf
1.plot: Professor Milo tries to use an old friend of Bruce Wayne's, Anthony Romulus, to destroy him after Milo injects Romulus with a serum that changes him into a wolf.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E37 - Terror in the Sky
1.plot: When a man-sized bat ransacks Gotham harbor, Batman suspects that Dr. Kirk Langstrom is drinking his Man-Bat formula again.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E38 - Christmas with the Joker
1.plot: The Joker kidnaps three prominent citizens during Christmas and challenges Batman to find him before midnight.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E39 - Heart of Steel (1)
1.plot: Karl Rossum, owner of Cyberton Labs has been replacing important authority figures with robot look-alikes. Batman invites a young woman to dinner, not knowing that she is a robot as well.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E40 - Heart of Steel (2)
1.plot: Batman escapes from being attacked by his own Batcomputer, which was sabatoged by HARDAC. He now seeks to get back Gordon, Hill and Bullock, who have all been replaced with robots.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E41 - If You're So Smart, Why Aren't You Rich?
1.plot: When Edward Nygma's greedy boss unjustly fires genius him, Nygma seeks revenge in a new guise--as the Riddler!

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E42 - Joker's Wild
1.plot: When a billionaire builds a casino called the Joker's Wild, the Joker breaks out of Arkham Asylum to destroy it.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E43 - His Silicon Soul
1.plot: A confused robot that believes he is Batman causes problems for the real Dark Knight.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E44 - Off Balance
1.plot: Batman investigates a notorious global crime cartel, The Society of Shadows, which has begun to operate in Gotham City.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E45 - What Is Reality?
1.plot: To prove that he has a superior mind, the Riddler lures Batman into a contest inside a virtual reality computer game.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E46 - The Laughing Fish
1.plot: The Joker becomes enraged when the Gotham copyright office rejects his demand for a copyright for his grinning Joker fish.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E47 - Harley and Ivy
1.plot: Harley Quinn has broken off with the Joker and teams up with Poison Ivy. Together they wreck havoc on Gotham and now Joker wants a piece of the action.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E48 - The Mechanic
1.plot: While engaged in a high-speed chase, the Penguin's gang escapes and the Batmobile is virtually demolished.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E49 - The Man Who Killed Batman
1.plot: Sidney Debris, a small-time mobster, earns the hatred of all of Batman's enemies when he claims to have accidentally killed Batman during a brawl.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E50 - Zatanna
1.plot: When glamorous female magician Zatanna is framed for a robbery during her act, Batman comes to her defense.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E51 - Robin's Reckoning (1)
1.plot: After learning the name of an extortion ringleader, Batman mysteriously refuses to let Robin continue the investigation with him.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E52 - Birds of a Feather
1.plot: Veronica Vreeland, a socialite desperate to create a novel party, makes the mistake of inviting the Penguin as her guest of honor.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E53 - Robin's Reckoning (2)
1.plot: Despite Batman's orders not to, Robin pursues Tony Zucco, the criminal who was responsible for the death of Robin's parents.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E54 - Blind as a Bat
1.plot: Bruce Wayne is temporarily blinded when the Penguin steals a new police helicopter with weaponry developed by WayneTech.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E55 - Day of the Samurai
1.plot: Bruce Wayne and Alfred travel to Japan to help Bruce's old martial arts teacher, Sensei Yoru.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E56 - See No Evil
1.plot: After a fortune disappears from a gem exposition, Batman investigates. He discovers that the crime may have been committed by an invisible man, an ex-con named Lloyd Ventris.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E57 - The Demon's Quest (1)
1.plot: When Robin is mysteriously abducted, Batman's search leads him to meet Ra's Al Ghul, leader of The Society of Shadows, whose daughter, Talia, has also been kidnapped.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E58 - The Demon's Quest (2)
1.plot: Batman discovers Ra's Al Ghul's plan to flood Earth with chemicals and return it to a lush, green planet--which will destroy all life that now exists!

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E59 - Read My Lips
1.plot: Batman investigates a series of baffling crimes and discovers that the crime czar is a wooden dummy, manipulated by a mild-mannered man called the Ventriloquist.

1.title: FR - Batman: The Animated Series - S01E60 - Fire from Olympus
1.plot: Believing he's the reincarnation of Zeus, a mad shipping magnate mounts a stolen electron cannon atop his penthouse to shoot 'lightning bolts' at the 'wicked mortals' below.

seasonsMeta.name: Season 3: The Adventures of Batman & Robin

meta.plot: Vowing to avenge the murder of his parents, Bruce Wayne devotes his life to wiping out crime in Gotham City as the masked vigilante "Batman".

1.title: FR - Palm Royale - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Maxine is ready to start a new life in Palm Beach. While trying to join an elite club, she discovers several secrets—while hiding her own.

1.title: FR - Palm Royale - S01E02 - Maxine Saves a Cat
1.plot: To gain membership sponsors, Maxine must make an impressive splash at a charity auction—but bad checks and a suspicious bartender hound her.

1.title: FR - Palm Royale - S01E03 - Maxine's Like a Dellacorte
1.plot: When Maxine's auction antics land her in the Shiny Sheet, the ladies of Palm Beach become interested in knowing more about her.

1.title: FR - Palm Royale - S01E04 - Maxine Rolls the Dice
1.plot: With Norma's estate going to charity, Maxine's last shot at the Dellacorte fortune is a conservatorship that puts her at legal odds with Robert.

1.title: FR - Palm Royale - S01E05 - Maxine Shakes the Tree
1.plot: Maxine tries to unearth information that could upend her marriage. Linda and the Women's Circle grapple with threats to Palm Beach social order.

1.title: FR - Palm Royale - S01E06 - Maxine Takes a Step
1.plot: With both the Beach Ball and a real estate deal set to take off, Maxine and Douglas need to secure the favor of a visiting prince.

1.title: FR - Palm Royale - S01E07 - Maxine Bags a Prince
1.plot: Douglas faces a looming threat. Robert navigates his increasingly serious relationship with the prince. Linda and Evelyn receive shocking news.

1.title: FR - Palm Royale - S01E08 - Maxine Saves the Whale
1.plot: A beached whale appears on the Beach Ball site, throwing the event into doubt with days to spare. Linda and Evelyn adjust to their new normals.

1.title: FR - Palm Royale - S01E09 - Maxine Makes a Splash
1.plot: Evelyn must hide at Eddie's place. Doug makes a pitch for the Dellacorte. Maxine and Robert make shocking discoveries.

1.title: FR - Palm Royale - S01E10 - Maxine Throws a Party
1.plot: Tensions boil over at the Beach Ball.

2.title: FR - Palm Royale - S02E01 - Maxine Drinks Martinis Now
2.plot: In the aftermath of the Beach Ball fiasco, Maxine navigates her new reality and contends with Douglas' betrayal.

2.title: FR - Palm Royale - S02E02 - Maxine Serves a Swerve
2.plot: As Linda's case makes it to national television, Maxine botches her own plan and must help her friend before the (wo)manhunt begins.

2.title: FR - Palm Royale - S02E03 - Maxine's Like a Dellacorte
2.plot: When Maxine's auction antics land her in the Shiny Sheet, the ladies of Palm Beach become interested in knowing more about her.

2.title: FR - Palm Royale - S02E04 - Maxine Unwrecks a Home

2.title: FR - Palm Royale - S02E05 - Maxine Is Ready to Single Mingle

2.title: FR - Palm Royale - S02E06 - Maxine Finds Herself
2.plot: Virginia enlists Maxine and Douglas to help find the Russian mole. The arrival of a new family member complicates the matter.

2.title: FR - Palm Royale - S02E07 - Maxine Plays Dead
2.plot: Robert is torn between his best friend and his oldest friend. Dinah uncovers the source of her death threats.

2.title: FR - Palm Royale - S02E08 - Maxine Hits the Slopes
2.plot: Palm Beach society arrives in Switzerland with sights set on the Dellacorte generation-skipping trust.

2.title: FR - Palm Royale - S02E09 - Maxine Hears a Confession
2.plot: Amid a raging snowstorm in the Alps, Norma orchestrates plans to secure the fortune for herself and Robert. Maxine races to expose her.

2.title: FR - Palm Royale - S02E10 - Maxine Does Something Good

meta.plot: En 1969, une femme ambitieuse aspire à franchir la frontière entre les modestes et les nantis pour se faire une place à la table la plus huppée, la plus sélect, et la plus impitoyable des Etats-Unis : la haute société de Palm Beach.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E01 - The small world of Tom Sawyer
1.plot: Tom Sawyer doesn't like school much. Escaping from the schoolhouse, he's off to the woods to catch a wild pig with his friend Huck. Their attempts to sell the pig at the harbor end with a wild disturbance on the steamboat.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E02 - Hand games, evil games
1.plot: Tom is dismayed when Aunt Polly tells him he must spend his Saturday whitewashing the fence. Too long to paint in one day, Tom convinces his friends of the joys of the job, and soon has all the help he needs.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E03 - A great love
1.plot: Tom goes to the harbor to meet his cousin Mary, and sees Becky Thacher for the first time. Her family moves into St. Petersburg, and Tom falls in love.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E04 - The magic spell
1.plot: Tom tries to arouse Becky's interest at Sunday School, but is ignored. That night Old Sam shows him a special charm to make wishes come true.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E05 - Becky
1.plot: Tom arrives at school late and finds that Becky is in his class. He finally manages to become friends with her, and promises to visit - forgetting another promise he has made to Huck.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E06 - Huck's house
1.plot: Huck is offended that Tom forgot his promise. The next few days Tom works with Huck, telling Becky he is busy helping his sick aunt. Becky discovers his lie but her anger is replaced with surprise when she sees Huck's newly built tree house.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E07 - Competition
1.plot: Tom just can't get along with his new classmate Alfred, and challenges him to a fighting match. On the way home, the boat they are aboard sinks and Tom rescues Alfred, who can't swim at all - winning Becky's praise.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E08 - Panic at board
1.plot: A large steamship comes to St Petersburg. Tom and Huck steal aboard for a trip. Next day, Tom boasts about their adventure, fascinating his classmates.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E09 - The children of aunt Polly
1.plot: Aunt Polly falls sick and is struck with an idea. She calls Tom to her bedside, pretending to be dying. Aunt Polly tells Tom she cannot go to heaven unless he promises to be a good boy but Tom refuses to promise, because he doesn't want his aunt to die.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E10 - The treasure
1.plot: The villagers do not like drunken Muff and Indian Joe. Tom and Huck rescue Muff and he, in return, tells them about a treasure buried near St Petersburg. The boys decide they will find the treasure, and Indian Joe joins Muff in his search.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E11 - Pirates
1.plot: Mr. Dobbins, the schoolteacher, doesn't trust Tom, but all Tom's classmates like him. Younger brother Sid saves Tom from punishment at school. Later, Tom and Huck decide to conduct their treasure hunt at night, to avoid Indian Joe.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E12 - The professor
1.plot: Tom gives Becky an engagement kiss. But with a slip of the tongue, he tells her that he had once been engaged to Amy. Becky is furious, and Tom becomes so discouraged he ends his treasure hunt.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E13 - I want to be a pirate
1.plot: After Becky ignores Tom for five days, he decides to run away from home to be a pirate. During the night he sails to Jackson Island on a raft, along with Huck and Ben.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E14 - Pirates don't go to school
1.plot: Tom, Huck and Ben enjoy their adventure on the island while everyone in the village worries about their disappearance. A rainstorm washes away their raft, and it is found by a villager broken to pieces.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E15 - Ah! the adventure...
1.plot: The villagers believe the boys have drowned in the river. Though they play all day on the island, Ben misses his home. Tom returns secretly for news of the village and sees Aunt Polly praying for his safety.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E16 - The pirates crush black
1.plot: Ben and Huck miss the village, so Tom proposes that they return on the very day of their funeral. No other village children, Tom decides, have ever become the center of so much attention.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E17 - Good old days
1.plot: After the funeral Tom is a hero at school, and everyone wants to hear his story. Charlie inks Tom's schoolbook out of jealousy, and Tom is punished. Becky saw what happened and feels guilty that she did not tell the truth.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E18 - Reconciliation
1.plot: Becky accidentally tears a page of Mr. Dobbins' precious book on medical science, and Tom takes the blame. Becky makes up with him.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E19 - The frog contest
1.plot: Frog leaping matches are popular with the school students, and Tom trains his frog to be a great leaper. Charlie doesn't want to hand over his championship, so he stuffs Tom's frog with pebbles.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E20 - The secrecy of mr. Dobbins
1.plot: Tom and Huck discover that Mr. Dobbins wears a wig. On the last day of school, when the teacher whips every student, even girls, for sleeping during class, Tom hits on a capital idea for revenge.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E21 - The holidays begin
1.plot: Sid comes down with the mumps just as summer vacation starts. Tom doesn't want to get sick and spoil his holiday. Just then two men come to town with Water of Life, guaranteed to cure every disease.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E22 - The charlatan
1.plot: Tom distributes handbills in return for the medicine. It sells like hotcakes, then the two men disappear. The medicine turns out to be a sham. Tom doesn't get the mumps, but he makes many trips to the outhouse.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E23 - Fishing party
1.plot: Tom goes fishing with Huck and Becky. They catch a big one, but only after Becky jumps in to lend a hand.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E24 - Huck carries a tie
1.plot: Becky's great aunt has no children of her own, and decides to adopt Huck. Tom makes him take a bath, dresses him up, and takes him to Becky's house. Huck doesn't like anything that binds, including a tie, and declines the offer.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E25 - A stubborn boy
1.plot: Alfred hones his swimming skills in order to show up Tom. At his birthday party he challenges Tom to a swimming race and wins. Tom then challenges Alfred to a contest to see who can stay under the water the longest.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E26 - Lisette
1.plot: The village children are bored; nothing exciting ever happens there. Then a theatrical troupe arrives and announces a play for the children. Among them is a young actress Lissette, and Huck falls in love.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E27 - The rising of the curtain
1.plot: Tom promises to take Huck to the play. To earn the money he works for his aunt, moving furniture to a friend's ranch quite a distance away. When a wheel comes off the cart, Tom is almost defeated - but manages to run home just in time for the play.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E28 - Helping Lisette
1.plot: Lizette is treated severely in the tragedy. Huck, unaware that it's a drama, jumps onto the stage to save her. Tom stirs up the other children to help Huck and Lizette, and the play becomes a fiasco. Lizette rather likes Huck, and promises to visit.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E29 - Goodbye Lisette
1.plot: Huck prepares a delicious meal for Lizette's next visit. Suddenly two of the troupers desert, and the group must leave, unable to continue the show. Lizette tells Tom she will be back someday to see Huck.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E30 - Huck's father
1.plot: Tom discovers a dead body up the river - it appears to be Huck's father! After the funeral, Huck's father appears alive; come to take his son. Huck doesn't want to go, and hides.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E31 - The candlestick
1.plot: On the anniversary of Huck's mother's death, he wants to light a candle in her memory. Though he knows Aunt Polly won't allow it, Tom promises to bring Huck her silver candlestick. Then, with the help of Mary and Sid, he tricks his Aunt.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E32 - Gold, gold!
1.plot: When Tom and Huck find a small gold lump in the river, the news spreads quickly and all the villagers rush to the river to search for gold. Even Aunt Polly tries to join them, but Mary calls a halt.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E33 - The escape to freedom
1.plot: Morris, Jim's friend, runs away from his master. He wants to go north where slaves can be free. Tom makes a raft and helps him leave the village.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E34 - The man who came from the cold
1.plot: Mary begins working for Dr. Mitchell, training to be a nurse. A balloon descends in the village, and the people panic, thinking it is a monster. Tom, who knows what it is, lends a hand to Arthur the pilot.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E35 - Tom wants to fly in the sky
1.plot: Arthur meets Mary at Dr. Mitchell's office, and she invites him to dinner. Tom is fascinated by his stories of balloon flight and is determined to have a ride.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E36 - To fly or not to fly?
1.plot: Arthur and Mary fall in love. He decides to fly the balloon with the children's help before the army comes to recover it. But the sheriff suspects he is a devil and intervenes. The children are disappointed, but Tom won't give up his dream of flight.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E37 - Goodbye, Arthur!
1.plot: Tom attempts an early morning balloon flight with Huck. Arthur jumps on just as the balloon takes off, and they enjoy the view from the sky. Soon the army arrives and Arthur leaves the village, with a promise to return to Mary.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E38 - The drama
1.plot: On their way to a haunted house in the middle of the night, Tom and Huck witness a murder. Indian Joe kills Dr. Robinson, then lays the blame on Muff Potter. Tom and Huck exchange a promise to keep their secret, because they fear Indian Joe.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E39 - A question of confidence
1.plot: Muff is arrested for the murder, just as Indian Joe planned. Tom and Huck sympathize with Muff and send in food and cigarettes, but keep their silence. Tom is plagued by nightmares.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E40 - The lawsuit
1.plot: Tom and Huck suffer from their guilty consciences and decide to tell the truth. Indian Joe comes to the trial with confidence, but his plan is foiled by Tom's testimony. Joe takes flight and Muff is declared not guilty. Tom is again the children's hero.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E41 - The undesirable
1.plot: The sheriff calls in a detective from St. Louis to find Indian Joe, but to everyone's disappointment he is unsuccessful. He is sure, however, that Joe will seek revenge. The detective follows Tom continually, hoping eventually to arrest Indian Joe.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E42 - A happy journey
1.plot: Aunt Polly asks Tom to visit Aunt Sally in Arkansas and deliver important papers. Glad to go as Becky is also traveling to St. Louis, and the trip will keep him away from Indian Joe. To the surprise of Tom and Becky, Huck steals aboard the steamship.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E43 - The white horse
1.plot: Tom and Huck reach Aunt Sally's ranch safely and hand over the papers. Tom introduces Huck as his brother Sid. While out riding, they spy a white horse.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E44 - The capture
1.plot: Tom and Huck have a grand time on the ranch. When the ranch hands decide to catch the white horse named Lightning, the boys go along. The horse is finally captured, but Tom feels they have injured Lightning's pride.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E45 - Freedom
1.plot: Bennie discovers that Huck is not Tom's brother, but offers to keep their secret in return for help. The ranchers try to tame Lightning, but the Indians say they should release the horse. Out of love for Lightning, Bennie releases it with Tom and Huck.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E46 - The haunted house
1.plot: Tom sneaks out to go to the haunted house with Huck. There they learn that Indian Joe has come back to the village in disguise. By chance, Joe and his friend find a box of gold coins. Tom informs the sheriff, but is not believed.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E47 - The sighs cave
1.plot: All the children go on a picnic except Sid, who has a cold, and Huck. Tom and Becky get lost while exploring a cave. Trying to find the way out, Tom sees Indian Joe coming in. Huck discovers Joe's friend, killed.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E48 - End of Joe the Indian
1.plot: A search party forms to find Tom and Becky. Indian Joe comes upon Tom and scares him, but does no harm. Pursued by the sheriff, Joe falls into a gorge and meets his end. Tom, to his surprise, feels sorry for Joe. Later, Tom and Huck find gold coins.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Tom Sawyer - S01E49 - All is well
1.plot: The judge divides the gold between Tom and Huck. Mrs. Douglas is chosen as Huck's guardian, and he begins a new life under strict discipline. A new school year begins, and Huck attends with Tom. On day one, the two are in trouble with the new teacher.

meta.plot: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer is a Japanese anime series, directed by Hiroshi Saitô which was aired in 1980. It is based on the well-known and popular novel The Adventures of Tom Sawyer by Mark Twain. The series was broadcast on the World Masterpiece Theater, an animation staple on Fuji TV that showcased each year an animated version of a different classical book or story of Western literature, and was originally titled "Tom Sawyer no Bōken". It was the second installment of the series, after 1977's Rascal the Raccoon, to feature the work of an American author. This series was also dubbed to English by Saban International and aired on HBO circa 1988 under the title "The Adventures of Tom Sawyer." It aired during the 7:30AM time slot and alternated with the later WMT version of "Little Women." Celebrity Home Entertainment released videos in the United States under the title "All New Adventures of Tom Sawyer". As of January 2011, the anime is airing in the United States on the NHK's cable channel TV Japan.

1.title: FR - Unicorn Academy - S01E08 - Ravenzella's Revenge
1.plot: As the academy teachers gear up to battle a powerful foe, they forbid their students from leaving the dorms. But one rider doesn't follow the rules.

1.title: FR - Unicorn Academy - S01E09 - Mended Hearts

1.title: FR - BASTARD‼ -Heavy Metal, Dark Fantasy- - S01E02 - Rampage
1.plot: Left with no other option, Yoko revives Dark Schneider once again when a terrifying multiheaded monster attacks the Kingdom of Meta-llicana.

1.title: FR - BASTARD‼ -Heavy Metal, Dark Fantasy- - S01E03 - Abduction
1.plot: The first of four seals that contain the God of Destruction breaks. As a crisis looms in sight, Yoko grapples with conflicting emotions.

1.plot: Sheila and Dark Schneider set out to free Yoko, whose captor threatens to torment her unless she discloses how she unseals the powerful wizard.

1.title: FR - BASTARD‼ -Heavy Metal, Dark Fantasy- - S01E05 - Showdown
1.plot: The demon god Efreet unleashes deadly flames, and Dark Schneider must find a way out in order to save Yoko.

1.title: FR - BASTARD‼ -Heavy Metal, Dark Fantasy- - S01E06 - Destiny

1.title: FR - BASTARD‼ -Heavy Metal, Dark Fantasy- - S01E07 - The Demon Beast
1.plot: Arshes Nei sends sorcerer Kai Harn to defeat Dark Schneider, who uses High Ancient Magic to try to turn him into a stone statue.

1.title: FR - BASTARD‼ -Heavy Metal, Dark Fantasy- - S01E08 - The Progenitor

1.title: FR - BASTARD‼ -Heavy Metal, Dark Fantasy- - S01E09 - Blue Nail
1.plot: While Dark Schneider struggles to break free from captivity, Yoko, Kai Harn and Sean Ari fend for themselves against Di-amon.

1.title: FR - BASTARD‼ -Heavy Metal, Dark Fantasy- - S01E10 - The Goddess of Thunder
1.plot: The remaining members of the Divine Kings gather and vow to eliminate Dark Schneider. Abigail tests Arshes Nei's loyalty to their mission.

1.title: FR - BASTARD‼ -Heavy Metal, Dark Fantasy- - S01E11 - Prophecy
1.plot: Dark Schneider and Arshes Nei reunite for the first time since his reincarnation. Baba, an old woman with prophetic powers, has an alarming vision.

1.title: FR - BASTARD‼ -Heavy Metal, Dark Fantasy- - S01E12 - Life or Death
1.plot: Arshes Nei unleashes a surprise attack on the castle, getting the upper hand in her battle against a disarmed adversary.

1.title: FR - BASTARD‼ -Heavy Metal, Dark Fantasy- - S01E13 - Wavering
1.plot: Nearly equal in strength, two opponents ratchet up the rapidly escalating fight. Meanwhile, the warriors struggle with their emotions.

1.title: FR - Ergo Proxy - S01E01 - Awakening
1.plot: When a series of mysterious attacks involving Cogito infected AutoReivs occur, Re-l is assigned to investigate, and encounters a humanoid monster. Later, she is attacked by two of these monsters at her home.

1.title: FR - Ergo Proxy - S01E02 - Confession
1.plot: Re-l struggles to convince her peers of her encounters with the monsters, which she learns are called Proxy. She is removed from the investigation and finds that Iggy has had his memories of recent events erased. Meanwhile, Vincent finds himself on the run from a proxy and then the city’s authorities.

1.title: FR - Ergo Proxy - S01E03 - Mazecity
1.plot: Romdo is no longer a safe haven for Vincent. He is trying to avoid capture by the authorities. As he flees he comes across the infected AutoReiv Pino. Pino then shows him the way to escape from Romdo to the outside world. Re-l struggles to contact Vincent and uncover the true nature of his involvement with the Proxy.

1.title: FR - Ergo Proxy - S01E04 - Futu-risk
1.plot: Vincent and Pino are taken in by a small commune, the inhabitants of which make a living off the refuse dumped from the Dome. Meanwhile, Raul plans his move to locate and capture Vincent.

1.title: FR - Ergo Proxy - S01E05 - Tasogare
1.plot: Re-l braves the outside world in order to bring Vincent back to Romdo. While there, Raul commences his plan to capture Vincent by attacking the Commune with patrol drones. Re-l’s environmental suit is damaged and Vincent is injured in the attack. Re-l suspicions are confirmed that there is a link between Vincent and the Proxies.

1.title: FR - Ergo Proxy - S01E06 - Domecoming
1.plot: Re-l’s life becomes endangered when she falls ill after exposure to the harsh environment. Hoody hatches a cunning plan to trick Raul and return to Romdo. Quinn leads a group on an escape from the Commune using the Rabbit.

1.title: FR - Ergo Proxy - S01E07 - Re-L124C41+
1.plot: Re-l recovers from her illness. Daedalus shows her the disturbing mechanisms responsible for the Dome’s continued survival. Vincent makes his way home, slowly losing his companions along the way, ending up alone with Pino. A group of infected AutoReivs is unleashed on Re-l, Iggy, and Daedalus. The episode ends with Daedalus filling out Re-l’s death certificate.

1.title: FR - Ergo Proxy - S01E08 - Shining Sign
1.plot: Vincent and Pino stumbles onto war-torn Halos, where they are caught in a war between the dome’s human inhabitants and its autonomous AutoReivs.

1.title: FR - Ergo Proxy - S01E09 - Angel’s Share
1.plot: Vincent is introduced to a man named Hauer, and learns some truths about Halos and Proxies, discovering a horrific revelation.

1.title: FR - Ergo Proxy - S01E10 - Cytotropism
1.plot: Disturbed by recent events, Raul questions the future of Romdo. Meanwhile, Re-l and Iggy explore a strange antiquated dome inhabited only by primitive AutoReivs.

1.title: FR - Ergo Proxy - S01E11 - Anamnesis
1.plot: Vincent finds a strange book store and an even stranger old man, where he discovers more about his true nature. Re-l and Iggy catch up on the Centzon (the Rabbit, the flying ship that Vincent travels by).

1.title: FR - Ergo Proxy - S01E12 - Hideout
1.plot: The group is confronted by a vagrant Proxy and its companion AutoReiv, and Re-l puts her new weapon to use.

1.title: FR - Ergo Proxy - S01E13 - Wrong Way Home
1.plot: An infected Iggy becomes enraged and kidnaps Re-l, setting out to kill Vincent. Re-l is again confronted by the homeless AutoReiv.

1.title: FR - Ergo Proxy - S01E15 - Who Wants to be in Jeopardy!

1.plot: Pino explores the mysterious Smile Land with the NaKaMa, and confronts the Creator of the city.

1.title: FR - Ergo Proxy - S01E20 - Goodbye Vincent
1.plot: Vincent finds himself trapped within Re-l’s consciousness, and observes powerlessly as events unfold.

1.plot: A Cogito outbreak spreads through Romdo and the city falls into chaos. Vincent incites the people to revolt, pushing them to hunt down and kill all AutoReivs.

1.title: FR - Ergo Proxy - S01E22 - Bilbul
1.plot: As the city continues to crumble, Vincent and Re-l encounter Proxy One. Raul is overcome with regret and despair, and sets out to find Pino.

1.title: FR - Ergo Proxy - S01E23 - Deus Ex Machina

meta.plot: In a futuristic world almost barren of life, mankind is confined to mechanized domed cities where A.I.’s control all aspects of life. In this world, humans are no longer born, they are manufactured in a production line; and alongside them live androids known as autoreivs. Within one of these domed sanctuaries named Romdeau lives Re-l Mayer, one of a few citizens who aren’t entirely prevented from thinking. Her grandfather's prominent position and the affection of the scientist Daedalus have left her more free will than is normally allowed, but Re-l has started to question the sanctity of the city and the citizens' perfect way of life. With mysterious beings known as proxies causing havoc and a man named Vincent causing great influence on her life, Re-l must travel outside of the city to find the answers she seeks and discover the mystery behind "the awakening".

1.plot: Oncle Tom doit faire face à la justice suite à un recours collectif formé de plusieurs clients insatisfaits par ses nombreux produits.

1.plot: À leur camp scout, Gabriel, Samuel et leurs amis partent en forêt à la recherche d’une mine perdue dans le but d’y trouver la plus grosse pépite d’or du monde.

1.plot: Après une dispute, Monique quitte Lucien et rencontre un nouvel homme qui lui fera vivre de nouvelles aventures. Pour le meilleur ou pour le pire.

1.plot: Le soir de l’Halloween, deux scientifiques provoquent une invasion de zombies à travers tout le Québec.

À chaque épisode, une aventure originale met en vedette les personnages les plus populaires des Têtes à claques auxquels viennent se greffer de nouveaux protagonistes créés spécialement pour l'occasion!

On the Caribbean island of Martinique, in the middle of the tropics, several mysterious murders occur. Now it is up to the two investigators Mélissa Sainte-Rose and Gaëlle Crivelli to solve the case - even if the two women have very different views of law.

1.title: FR - Eureka - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: An accident leads a U.S. Marshal and a teenage girl (who later is revealed to be his daughter) to a peculiar town populated by scientists and their families where 10-year-old boys are in 11th grade, the local diner doesn't believe in menus, and E=MC² was just the beginning. Just as the Marshal starts to get settled into the swing of things, a local scientist develops a bomb that seems to appear anywhere and eats all the matter around it.

1.title: FR - Eureka - S01E02 - Many Happy Returns
1.plot: The citizens of Eureka attend the funeral of Susan Perkins, only to find out that she is in fact alive. Meanwhile the Sheriff moves into an underground bunker that is actually a 'smart house' controlled by a computer dubbed 'S.A.R.A.H., and begins to investigate a 'ghost' that has been appearing in town.

1.title: FR - Eureka - S01E03 - Before I Forget
1.plot: Something starts to steal the townspeople's memory...

1.title: FR - Eureka - S01E04 - Alienated
1.plot: After hosting a movie party, Spencer is found the next day in the middle of a crop circle, claiming he was abducted by aliens; and then other people who attended the party start to go missing as well. Elsewhere, the legislator responsible for Eureka's funding visits the town, and gets dragged into a Sector 5 experiment...

1.title: FR - Eureka - S01E05 - Invincible
1.plot: An unpredictable researcher accidentally unleashes a dangerous artifact which was previously hidden by Nathan Stark.

1.title: FR - Eureka - S01E06 - Dr. Nobel
1.plot: A sleeping weapons system is accidentally awakened by Fargo and Spencer. Henry tries to avert the pending catastrophe with the help of a retired, nonsensical scientist.

1.title: FR - Eureka - S01E07 - Blink
1.plot: Carter investigates an unusual car accident. Meanwhile, Stark, under the stress of completing a project on time, pressures two research teams to produce results.

1.title: FR - Eureka - S01E08 - Right as Raynes
1.plot: A former resident returns to Eureka and creates mayhem which threatens Global Dynamics, prompting Stark to take action.

1.title: FR - Eureka - S01E09 - Primal
1.plot: Taggart achieves a medical breakthrough while Fargo invents a device that bridges the divide between computers and human brains.

1.title: FR - Eureka - S01E10 - Purple Haze
1.plot: Strange behavior exhibited by the townspeople is investigated by Carter,who has to solve the mystery before Stark makes a decision that could affect the world.

1.title: FR - Eureka - S01E11 - H.O.U.S.E. Rules
1.plot: A bad day in the lab forces Carter to rethink his decision to live in Eureka, prompting an intervention from S.A.R.A.H. (the self Activated Residential Automated Habitat.

1.title: FR - Eureka - S01E12 - Once in a Lifetime
1.plot: Ambition trumps common sense when Stark is given a chance to try out the Top-secret artifact. Once it's tested, Eureka warps into the future and ends up in 2010, where the town is different.

2.title: FR - Eureka - S02E01 - Phoenix Rising
2.plot: Taggart's theory is that solar flares caused by the eclipse, or the 'Phoenix Effect', are to blame when people start to spontaneously combust.  When Carter discovers that a blast of radiation from the artifact had penetrated the wall of the chamber and is actually to blame for the spontaneous combustion, it becomes a race against time to save the other two people exposed - Nathan and Kevin!

2.title: FR - Eureka - S02E02 - Try, Try Again
2.plot: Fargo accidentally triggers a prototype for a personal force field, which goes out of control, forcing Carter to enlist Stark's help.

2.title: FR - Eureka - S02E03 - Unpredictable
2.plot: Dr. Whiticus creates an incredible "weather machine" intended to reverse the effects of global warming which instead stirs unexpected results.

2.title: FR - Eureka - S02E04 - Games People Play
2.plot: Carter suffers a blow to the head, and after arguing with Zoe, he suddenly finds himself in a parallel Eureka, where the residents seem to be mysteriously vanishing.

2.title: FR - Eureka - S02E05 - Duck, Duck Goose
2.plot: Falling space debris threatens Eureka residents and Carter turns to high school science fair participants to solve the problem. Specifically, he taps a student science project created to harness the sun's energy. Also, Zoe gets an eco-friendly automobile.

2.title: FR - Eureka - S02E06 - Noche de Sueños
2.plot: One of the Global Dynamics tanker trucks spills, potentially causing a change in everyone's sleep habits... In the course of the episode, we come to learn that Global Dynamics has developed a technology that enables them to distill six months of the town waste and by-products into one truck, an amount that would normally fill Lake Erie.

2.title: FR - Eureka - S02E07 - Family Reunion
2.plot: Fargo's grandfather awakens after 50 years in cryogenic suspension and accuses his rival of putting him there and stealing his work.

2.title: FR - Eureka - S02E08 - E=MC...?
2.plot: As an experiment that will recreate the first moment of the origins of the universe, the Big Bang, goes terribly awry, the town’s geniuses turn into morons, leaving the fate of Eureka in the hand of Jack Carter and an antisocial young ubergenius.

2.title: FR - Eureka - S02E09 - Sight Unseen
2.plot: An abandoned research project on invisibility returns to haunt Eureka. Carter and Zoé become tangled in a web of strange occurrences that lead to Carter’s disappearance and the possibility that he might never reappear.

2.title: FR - Eureka - S02E10 - God is in the Details
2.plot: Sudden muteness, human bioluminescence and faucets running blood cause many of Eureka’s citizens to believe that they are the victims of a biblical plague.

2.title: FR - Eureka - S02E11 - Maneater
2.plot: Sheriff Jack Carter becomes absolutely irresistible to every woman in Eureka. But if he doesn't get his mojo under control, they might just eat him alive.

2.title: FR - Eureka - S02E12 - All That Glitters
2.plot: Beverly Barlow returns to town just as a parasitic bacterium threatens to destroy Eureka, by turning everything to gold and then into rust --- people included.

2.title: FR - Eureka - S02E13 - A Night at Global Dynamics
2.plot: Nathan Stark and Jack Carter must put aside their rivalry to stop a deadly bacteria from destroying the town and killing Allison’s son. But can Carter ignore Stark’s crimes, as well?

3.title: FR - Eureka - S03E01 - Bad to the Drone
3.plot: The search is one for an escaped drone as Eva Thorne arrives to assist the clean up of damages which Global Dynamics has caused.

3.title: FR - Eureka - S03E02 - What About Bob?
3.plot: Carter and Allison investigate when a scientist mysteriously disappears from a sealed biosphere. Meanwhile, the "Fixer" tries to make Eureka's efforts more profitable.

3.title: FR - Eureka - S03E03 - Best in Faux
3.plot: Eureka's annual dog show is underway and is like none other. Meanwhile, Sheriff Carter experiences an earthquake; Zoe debates quitting the accelerated physics program; and Allison starts the process of fitting her wedding dress.

3.title: FR - Eureka - S03E04 - I Do Over
3.plot: It's Allison and Stark's wedding day and Carter finds himself reliving it over and over. Meanwhile, Carter's sister, Lexi, visits the town.

3.title: FR - Eureka - S03E05 - Show Me the Mummy
3.plot: A search for a mummy ensues after a famed archaeologist opens the tomb of an Egyptian queen at Global Dynamics.

3.title: FR - Eureka - S03E06 - Phased and Confused
3.plot: Carter's job is made more difficult when a super hero emerges. Meanwhile, Zoe and her friends are imperiled when Thorne makes a subterranean search beneath Eureka.

3.title: FR - Eureka - S03E07 - Here Come the Suns
3.plot: The Eureka mayoral race is overshadowed by the sudden arrival of a second sun, forcing Carter, Allison and Zane to investigate it more closely.

3.title: FR - Eureka - S03E08 - From Fear to Eternity
3.plot: Trust issues are produced by a scientific find, along with sinister results. Zoe's life is in jeopardy, and Eva Thorne knows what has caused the predicament.

3.title: FR - Eureka - S03E09 - Welcome Back Carter
3.plot: Carter interviews for a job with the Department of Homeland Security, after being terminated as the sheriff. Deputy Lupo decides to resign after discovering that a very personable robot is the new sheriff.

3.title: FR - Eureka - S03E10 - Your Face Or Mine
3.plot: Jo displays atypical behavior after a DNA scan malfunctions, unfortunately it's while she's interim sheriff because Carter is undergoing a 48-hour DOD recertification test.

3.title: FR - Eureka - S03E11 - Insane In The P-Brane
3.plot: Dr. Tess Fontana reopens Section 5, causing objects to become ambulatory , possibly due to poltergeists.

3.title: FR - Eureka - S03E12 - It's Not Easy Being Green
3.plot: Carter finds himself chasing down creation of blob-ical like proportions when a series of escalating pranks turn deadly. Elsewhere, long-term rivals from Area 51 come to Eureka for a bowling tournament.

3.title: FR - Eureka - S03E13 - If You Build It...
3.plot: Eureka's teenagers who appear to have been manipulated while asleep, gathered in a field where they assembled a strange structure comprised of scrap metal and electronics.

3.title: FR - Eureka - S03E14 - Ship Happens
3.plot: Henry's ship returns causing Carter to fear it maybe linked to the town's deadly electrical anomalies.

3.title: FR - Eureka - S03E15 - Shower the People
3.plot: Allison's baby shower fetches her a load of eco-friendly gifts and the discovery of a drowned scientist in a location where drowning is impossible.

3.title: FR - Eureka - S03E16 - You Don't Know Jack
3.plot: Global Dynamics sonic cleaning coincides with a phenomenon in which the citizens of Eureka develop a form of amnesia. Meanwhile, Allison goes into labor.

3.title: FR - Eureka - S03E17 - Have an Ice Day
3.plot: The first day on the job as temporary head of Global Dynamics proves daunting for Tess when a new Ice Age comes to Eureka; and a familiar face returns in the process.

3.title: FR - Eureka - S03E18 - What Goes Around Comes Around
3.plot: Tess has a job offer from Australia, Zoe is prepared to leave for Harvard and Carter has a magnetic disturbance above Eureka to contend with, in the third season finale.

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E01 - Founder's Day
4.plot: It's Founder's Day in Eureka and everyone is in the spirit of the celebration until Jack, Allison, Henry, Jo and Fargo are transported back to 1947 where they meet some familiar faces along the way. Will they be able to get back to 2010 or will they be stuck forever in 1947 where Eureka is not a town, but an Army base.

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E02 - A New World
4.plot: When the 5 get back to their time, things are changed everywhere. As the Henry tries to fix the machine that transported them in the first place, Dr. Grant is making himself comfortable as he can. Jack is still trying to wrap his mind at the fact that he asked Tess something that she says yes to and the fact that the group's positions changed. As one thing leads to another, a twist happens and things get a little dicey.

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E03 - All the Rage
4.plot: When a prototype sets everyone into bad temper mode, the issue escalates and gets worse beyond the control of what Jack can handle. As Jack and Allison and Tess are the only sane people at Global Dynamics they have to devise a plan that will make everything calm and happy again. Meanwhile, Henry is helping Dr. Grant re-build the bridge that got them back to the new world except everything they touch disappears.

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E04 - The Story of O2
4.plot: It's space week in Eureka, and everyone is gearing up for the rocket race - except for Carter. General Mansfield is in town for the big Race to the Moon, and is debriefed on a new oxygen-generating fluid designed, called TAP, for colonizing Mars. When the question about someone using TAP to fuel their rocket, the whole town of Eureka is in danger and it is up to Kevin to save the day this time. Will he do it, or will Jack come back to see charred remains of his friends?

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E05 - Crossing Over
4.plot: Claudia Donovan visits Eureka to see if Fargo's promises of wondrous devices are true, but she finds herself in the middle of a mystery suitable for Warehouse 13 when objects begin to appear randomly around the town and GD, and it must be solved before there are deadly consequences.

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E06 - Momstrosity
4.plot: When Sara gives Andy a (as Zane calls it ) an EMO download to give him emotion, she inadvertently affects all Level 6 AIs. Including Tiny. She escapes while being transported to NASA and  is on the loose. Meanwhile, Jack takes Kevin camping with Fargo and Grant and Jack is not happy that Grant is there. They argue on who is with Allison and who is not and they are interrupted by Tiny who has an attachment to a certain object of Kevin's.

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E07 - Stoned
4.plot: Love is in the air as Carter gets fed up with Grant's pursuit of Allison, Zoe conceals her love and Henry courts Grace. But all the emotions may have to be put on simmer when people in town start turning to stone.

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E08 - The Ex-Files
4.plot: Eureka's citizens face the return of people from the past; Global Dynamics tests a new device.

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E09 - I'll Be Seeing You
4.plot: When Grant and Carter become stranded, they must race back in time to save Eureka.

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E10 - O Little Town
4.plot: Carter can't get into the Christmas spirit especially with the town surrounded by a force-field. Fargo organizes the GD holiday party, and Allison is full of holiday cheer.

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E11 - Lift Off
4.plot: Zane pesters Jo for details she does not want to reveal. Carter problem-solves at Andy and S.A.R.A.H.'s wedding. Elsewhere, Zane's actions make him and Fargo unexpectedly airborne.

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E12 - Reprise
4.plot: Carter's duties expand to babysitting when Allison attends a medical conference, and Fargo finds his groove when a certain song is played. Meanwhile, a rocket scientist appears at Café Diem.

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E13 - Glimpse
4.plot: Jo receives a technical boost to her crime-fighting ability with lenses that predict security breaches. Allison's headaches won't go away so Carter plans a vacation. Fargo, meanwhile, deals with an onslaught of volunteers when he announces a space mission with room for civilians.

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E14 - Up in the Air
4.plot: Jack deals with a bank robbery which may relate to the sudden gravity issues besetting the citizens of Eureka. Meanwhile, Fargo's rivalry with Isaac Parrish is boosted when he learns Holly and Parrish went on a date.

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E15 - Omega Girls
4.plot:
When Zoe comes home for a visit, Jo faces an angry woman who doesn't accept her fumbling explanations about Zane. This all fades to background noise, however, when they find everyone in Eureka unconscious and must find a way to work together so they can revive the town and beat Beverly before she gets hold of valuable data.

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E16 - Of Mites and Men
4.plot: When mites threaten to take down Global Dynamics, Jack is called into action since Jo is in the middle of training. Allison is struggling with the fact that everyone things that her brain doesn't work and she is determined to prove that she is back in action again.

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E17 - Clash of the Titans
4.plot: The Eureka atmosphere becomes toxic when Department of Defense auditor comes to assess the team's relationships.

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E18 - This One Time at Space Camp...
4.plot: The Astraeus candidates go through their final interviews while Carter and Allison appeal their relationship audit.

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E19 - One Small Step...
4.plot: When an explosion in the Astraeus lab accidentally sends Andy to Titan the team must devise a plan to save him before it's too late! Eureka

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E20 - One Giant Leap...
4.plot: In the season finale - It's chaos in Eureka when an energy beam rips through main street but the Astraeus launch must go on...with or without Eureka intact.

4.title: FR - Eureka - S04E21 - Do You See What I See
4.plot: The quaint town of geniuses is transformed into animated versions of themselves. Sheriff Carter and Allison Blake are secretly planning the perfect holiday surprise for their kids. But a mysterious kaleidoscopic wave of color crashes over Eureka, leaving the entire town and its inhabitants animated.

5.title: FR - Eureka - S05E01 - Lost
5.plot: The Astraeus crew returns to Eureka four years later and must adapt to a myriad of changes, including a more oppressive version of Deputy Andy.

5.title: FR - Eureka - S05E02 - The Real Thing
5.plot: The town huddles in a last attempt to locate the vanished Astraeus before it's too late!

5.title: FR - Eureka - S05E03 - Force Quit
5.plot: Beverly Barlowe resurfaces in Eureka seeking Carter's help to free the Astraeus crew, and the rescue plan lands Carter in the crew's virtual world.

5.title: FR - Eureka - S05E04 - Friendly Fire
5.plot: When a smart fire experiment gets out of control, Carter and team discover that the Astraeus victims may be the cause.

5.title: FR - Eureka - S05E05 - Jack of All Trades
5.plot: The crew moves forward after an ordeal and Warren's visit adds to the pressure.

5.title: FR - Eureka - S05E06 - Worst Case Scenario
5.plot: Henry conducts a preparedness drill that winds up a disaster and Fargo faces a hard reality.

5.title: FR - Eureka - S05E07 - Ex Machina
5.plot: Fargo is convinced that Holly is still inside of the Matrix computer, but the DOD is determined to wipe its hard drive clean -- losing Dr. Marten forever.

5.title: FR - Eureka - S05E08 - In Too Deep
5.plot: Carter's romantic surprise for Allison turns deadly when they're trapped in a sinking marine lab with time and oxygen quickly running out.

5.title: FR - Eureka - S05E09 - Smarter Carter
5.plot: When Allison's genius older brother comes to meet her new husband, Carter feels the pressure of not being smart enough to measure up.

5.title: FR - Eureka - S05E10 - The Honeymooners
5.plot: Jack and Allison's perfect honeymoon is interrupted when sabotage is discovered in Eureka. Elsewhere, Holly faces another hurdle to remain intact.

5.title: FR - Eureka - S05E11 - Mirror, Mirror
5.plot: Eureka is cut off from the world by a malfunctioning experiment that threatens to eradicate the town's populace.

5.title: FR - Eureka - S05E12 - Double Take
5.plot: The people of Eureka are being kidnapped and replaced by body-doubles one by one unless Allison, Fargo and Zane can figure out how to avoid capture and save their town.

5.title: FR - Eureka - S05E13 - Just Another Day...
5.plot: Wormholes randomly materialize around Eureka as the Department of Defense is set to shut the town.

meta.plot: The sleepy Pacific Northwest town of Eureka is hiding a mysterious secret. The government has been relocating the world's geniuses and their families to this rustic town for years where innovation and chaos have lived hand in hand. U.S. Marshal Jack Carter stumbles upon this odd town after wrecking his car and becoming stranded there. When the denizens of the town unleash an unknown scientific creation, Carter jumps in to try to restore order and consequently learns of one of the country's best kept secrets.

1.title: FR - Post mortem : Personne ne meurt à Skarnes - S01E01 - Post Mortem
1.plot: It's just another average day in this small Norwegian town until a young woman is found dead in a field. But things are not as they seem.

1.title: FR - Post mortem : Personne ne meurt à Skarnes - S01E02 - Condolences
1.plot: As the police investigate another death, Live struggles to adjust to her own second chance at life as the pressure starts getting to Odd.

1.title: FR - Post mortem : Personne ne meurt à Skarnes - S01E03 - On Behalf of the Family
1.plot: With nowhere to run, Live hides under the bed. Reinert's blind date with Judith's niece takes an unexpected turn. Odd's business picks up.

1.title: FR - Post mortem : Personne ne meurt à Skarnes - S01E04 - A Wake
1.plot: As Odd puts his sales skills to the test, Live hunts for a way to dispose of evidence. Meanwhile, Judith searches for Reinert, who's gone missing.

1.title: FR - Post mortem : Personne ne meurt à Skarnes - S01E05 - Baptism by Fire
1.plot: Dr. Hansen offers Live an explanation of sorts. Odd gets some new business, but there's a catch. Judith begins to act on her suspicions.

1.title: FR - Post mortem : Personne ne meurt à Skarnes - S01E06 - Rigor Mortis
1.plot: Live and Reinert try to do a little good amid a whole lot of bad. Odd wrestles with a moral dilemma. Judith cranks up the heat.

meta.plot: Une femme, déclarée morte, se réveille avec une soif de sang incontrôlable. Cela redonne espoir à l’entreprise de pompes funèbres de sa famille, sur le déclin.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E01 - Stormy Weather
1.plot: The loser of a kids-channel contest gets akumatized by Hawk Moth. Now Stormy Weather, she takes revenge on those who did not vote for her.  Dark skies await for our superheroes!

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E02 - The Bubbler
1.plot: Adrien's best friend, Nino, is akumatized into the Bubbler, a villain who traps adults in bubbles and sends them floating away into the atmosphere.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E03 - The Pharaoh
1.plot: When a villain with the power of the ancient Egyptian gods wants to sacrifice Alya, Ladybug and Cat Noir must fight an army of mummies to rescue her.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E04 - Lady Wifi
1.plot: Mistakenly believing that Chloé is Ladybug, Alya gets expelled from school for her nosiness and becomes akumatized into the villain Lady Wifi.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E05 - Timebreaker
1.plot: When anger over a broken watch turns Alix into a time-traveling villain, it's up to Ladybug to return to the past and thwart her plans.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E06 - Mr. Pigeon
1.plot: The akuma fighters try to apprehend Mr. Pigeon, a bird lover who has kidnapped all the park keepers in Paris, but Cat Noir's allergies interfere.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E07 - The Evillustrator
1.plot: A fellow student with a crush on Marinette is akumatized into the Evillustrator, a villain that Cat Noir must face without Ladybug.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E08 - Rogercop
1.plot: When he's fired by the mayor, police officer Roger becomes Rogercop, a villain who thinks he's enforcing the law by ruling Paris as a dictator.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E09 - Copycat
1.plot: A jealous sculptor in love with Ladybug akumatizes into Copycat, a duplicate of Cat Noir who tries to take his rival's place by Ladybug's side.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E10 - Dark Cupid
1.plot: Marinette considers declaring her feelings to Adrien for Valentine's Day, but first they must stop Dark Cupid, a villain bent on eradicating love.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E11 - Horrificator
1.plot: During the filming of a short horror movie for Marinette's class, scared star Mylène is akumatized into a slimy monster that feeds on others' fears.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E12 - Darkblade
1.plot: While Marinette tries to retrieve her diary from Chloé, Adrien's fencing teacher is akumatized into Darkblade, a villain who storms city hall.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E13 - The Mime
1.plot: When Mylène's father loses a part in a play to his scheming understudy, he akumatizes into the Mime, a villain whose pantomimes become real.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E14 - Kung Food
1.plot: When his dish at a competition is sabotaged, Marinette's great-uncle chef Wang Cheng becomes Kung Food, who recruits henchmen with his cooking.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E15 - Gamer
1.plot: Marinette beats Adrien's video game tournament partner, Max, so she can replace him and spend time with her crush, but Max akumatizes into a villain.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E16 - Animan
1.plot: A humiliated zookeeper is akumatized into a villainous shapeshifting animal on a day when Marinette, Adrien and friends are visiting the zoo in Paris.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E17 - Antibug
1.plot: Crestfallen when her hero Ladybug refuses to heed her advice, Chloé akumatizes into Antibug, an evil twin of Ladybug with identical powers.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E18 - The Puppeteer
1.plot: Marinette babysits little Manon, who becomes akumatized into the Puppeteer while playing with dolls of Ladybug, Cat Noir and some infamous villains.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E19 - Reflekta
1.plot: Excluded from a class photo, dejected Juleka akumatizes into the villain Reflekta, who turns everyone, including Cat Noir, into copies of herself.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E20 - Guitar Villain
1.plot: Rock star Jagged Stone is akumatized into a supervillain who tries to transform all Parisians into fans and undermine his musical rival, Mr. XY.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E21 - Pixelator
1.plot: Rejected by a rock star, an angry fan becomes Pixelator, who traps Parisians in his camera's memory until Cat Noir and Ladybug halt his photo spree.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E22 - Princess Fragrance
1.plot: Marinette can't transform into Ladybug when classmate Rose is akumatized into a villain whose perfume lets her control Cat Noir and a visiting prince.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E23 - Simon Says
1.plot: A hypnotist akumatizes into Simon Says, a villain who can make anyone obey him with his deck of cards, and seeks revenge on Adrien's father.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E24 - Volpina
1.plot: Humiliated in front of Adrien by Marinette, Lila -- a rival who pretends to be Ladybug's friend -- akumatizes into Volpina, a villain of illusions.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E25 - Ladybug & Cat Noir - Origins, Part 1
1.plot: In a flashback, Ladybug and Cat Noir's origins are revealed, as Marinette befriends Alya and meets Adrien, a famous model with an overprotective dad.

1.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S01E26 - Stoneheart - Origins, Part 2
1.plot: In a continuing flashback to Ladybug and Cat Noir's origins, Marinette mistakes Adrien for a bully and hesitates to embrace her Ladybug persona.

2.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S02E01 - The Collector
2.plot: Master Fu and Marinette believe that the owner of the Miraculous book is Hawk Moth, but that suspicion leads to either Adrien or his father, Gabriel.

2.title: FR - Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir - S02E02 - Despair Bear
