2.plot: Stardate: 42402.7. The Enterprise is placed in a compromising situation when the captain of a disabled starship places the crew in the middle of a love triangle.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E05 - Loud as a Whisper
2.plot: Stardate: 42477.2. A deaf-mute mediator meets with disaster while being escorted by the Enterprise.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E06 - The Schizoid Man
2.plot: Stardate: 42437.5. Data is possessed by the consciousness of a brilliant scientist. However, it has a disturbing impact on Data's personality.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E07 - Unnatural Selection
2.plot: Stardate: 42494.8. A mysterious hyper-ageing sickness kills the crew of a Federation cargo ship, and Dr. Pulaski must race against time to find a cure.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E08 - A Matter of Honor
2.plot: Commander Riker participates in an officer's exchange program which lands him an assignment on a Klingon Bird-of-Prey.  Meanwhile, a Bezite ensign has trouble assimilating to the routines of the Enterprise.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E09 - The Measure of a Man
2.plot: Stardate: 42523.7. When Data's rights as a sentient individual are placed under trial, Starfleet forces Riker into a position where he must prove that Data is only an Android.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E10 - The Dauphin
2.plot: Stardate: 42568.8. Wesley falls in love with a passenger the Enterprise is escorting, who has the secret ability to shape-shift.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E11 - Contagion
2.plot: Stardate: 42609.1. A strange power source disables the Enterprise's computer systems, damages Data's programming and leaves the ship and crew vulnerable to a Romulan attack.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E12 - The Royale
2.plot: Stardate: 42625.4. An away team is trapped in an alien environment based around a novel entitled 'The Hotel Royale.'

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E13 - Time Squared
2.plot: Stardate: 42679.2. Picard encounters his double from six hours in the future, whose Enterprise had been destroyed.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E14 - The Icarus Factor
2.plot: Stardate: 42686.4. Riker is promoted to Captain of another Federation ship. Worf must confront his past and his Klingon heritage.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E15 - Pen Pals
2.plot: Stardate: 42695.3. Wesley must investigate the causes of strange tectonic activity on the planet where Data's pen pal lives.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E16 - Q Who
2.plot: Stardate: 42761.3. Q hurls the Enterprise into the Delta Quadrant and introduces the Federation to a powerful new enemy that may destroy the Alpha Quadrant: The Borg.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E17 - Samaritan Snare
2.plot: Stardate: 42779.1. A race known as the Pakleds kidnap Geordi La Forge. Picard must face surgery when he is left in a near-dead state.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E18 - Up the Long Ladder
2.plot: Stardate: 42823.2. Picard must convince two dying civilizations that they must co-exist on the same planet to survive, however, they have other plans to ensure their survival: in the form of clones of the Enterprise crew.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E19 - Manhunt
2.plot: Stardate: 42859.2. While being escorted to a Federation conference by the Enterprise, Lwaxana hunts for a man to satisfy her needs when her sex-drive is quadrupled during a natural mid-life cycle.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E20 - The Emissary
2.plot: Stardate: 42901.3. Worf is re-united with his former lover, K'Ehleyr, while the Enterprise is ordered to intercept a Klingon ship whose crew has been in stasis for a century.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E21 - Peak Performance
2.plot: Stardate: 42923.4. Trouble begins when a Ferengi warship stumbles over a war simulation between Riker and Picard, each on different ships, and begins attacking them.

2.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S02E22 - Shades of Gray
2.plot: Stardate: 42976.1. Riker is infected with an alien organism that takes over his mind. Dr. Pulaski must force Riker's mind back to a state where it can access primitive survival skills.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E01 - Evolution
3.plot: Stardate: 43125.8. A system-wide computer malfunction places the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise in grave danger while they are escorting a scientist to a star in the process of exploding.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E02 - The Ensigns of Command
3.plot: Stardate: 43133.3. A human colony is forced to evacuate a planet when the original inhabitants return and threaten the colonists with annihilation if they do not leave within four days.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E03 - The Survivors
3.plot: Stardate: 43152.4. The Enterprise discovers a planet that has had all life eradicated, except for two mysterious residents and their home, which has been left in perfect condition.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E04 - Who Watches the Watchers
3.plot: Stardate: 43173.5. An away team inadvertently breaks the Prime Directive and reveal themselves to a primitive culture on Mintaka III, causing the inhabitants believe that Captain Picard is a God.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E05 - The Bonding
3.plot: Worf and Wesley must help a 12 year old boy cope with the death of his mother; an archaeologist killed during an away mission to a deserted planet.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E06 - Booby Trap
3.plot: Stardate: 43205.6. While investigating an ancient ship left adrift in space, the Enterprise accidentally trips the ancient booby trap that disabled the old vessel over 1000 years ago.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E07 - The Enemy
3.plot: Stardate:43349.2. A blind Geordie is trapped on a hazardous planet with a paranoid and severely injured Romulan. In orbit, a Romulan Warbird is preventing the Enterprise from attempting a rescue mission.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E08 - The Price
3.plot: Stardate: 43385.6. The Enterprise hosts the negotiations for the rights to a newly discovered, stable wormhole to the Delta Quadrant. One of the negotiators, Devinoni Ral, becomes attracted to Deanna Troi, but he holds a dubious secret.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E09 - The Vengeance Factor
3.plot: Stardate: 43421.9. The Enterprise crew tries to mend the relationship between a race known as the Acamarians and a faction known as the Gatherers.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E10 - The Defector
3.plot: Stardate: 43462.5. A defecting Romulan warns the Federation about an impending attack by the Romulans, who are secretly establishing bases within the Neutral Zone.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E11 - The Hunted
3.plot: Stardate: 43489.2. A potentially new member of the Federation enlists the help of the Enterprise to track down a wanted criminal who has a reputation for his excessive violence. However, the fugitive's actions may not be of his own will.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E12 - The High Ground
3.plot: Stardate: 43510.7. Dr. Crusher is abducted by a group of terrorists while delivering crucial medical supplies to a planet ravaged by civil war.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E13 - Déjà Q
3.plot: Stardate: 43539.1. A Calamarian starts attacking the Enterprise while seeking revenge on a powerless Q.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E14 - A Matter of Perspective
3.plot: Stardate: 43610.4. Riker is accused of murder when a scientist is killed in an explosion. Picard must recreate the recent events in the holodeck to prove his commander's innocence.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E15 - Yesterday's Enterprise
3.plot: Stardate: 43625.2. A rift in the space/time continuum brings the U.S.S. Enterprise - C forward into the 24th Century, and alters the timeline. In this future, the Federation is at war with the Klingons, Tasha Yar is on the bridge, Worf did not join the Federation, and only Guinan's unique perception of reality may restore the timeline.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E16 - The Offspring
3.plot: Stardate: 43657.0. Data becomes a father when he creates a Soong-type android in the form of a daughter named Lal. Issues are complicated when Lal starts showing signs of a more evolved consciousness, including the ability to feel emotions, which attracts the attention of Starfleet scientists who want to take her away from Data and examine her advanced systems.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E17 - Sins of the Father
3.plot: Stardate: 43685.2. Worf is reunited with his long-lost brother when their father is charged with treason for helping the Romulans. Together they make an appeal to the Klingon High Council to challenge the charges, and have them revoked.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E18 - Allegiance
3.plot: Stardate: 43714.1. Picard is secretly abducted and switched with an alien double. The crews' suspicions are raised when he starts exhibiting unusual behaviour, and is relieved of command.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E19 - Captain's Holiday
3.plot: Stardate: 43745.2. While on vacation on Risa, Captain Picard encounters two Vorgons from the 27th Century who claim they are searching for a powerful weapon hidden somewhere on the planet.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E20 - Tin Man
3.plot: Stardate: 43779.3. The Enterprise encounters a 'living' ship in the Neutral Zone, and risks breaking the Romulan Federation alliance in order to bring it into contact with a Betazoid emissary.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E21 - Hollow Pursuits
3.plot: Stardate: 43807.4. A nervous and insecure officer, Lt. Reginald Barclay, places the Enterprise in great danger when he neglects his duties in Engineering, and instead spends his time acting out his fantasies on the holodeck.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E22 - The Most Toys
3.plot: Stardate: 43872.2. The crew are shattered by the apparent death of Data in a shuttle explosion, and are prevented from carrying out a detailed investigation when Starfleet gives them orders for a new mission elsewhere. However, the crew don't realize that he was actually abducted and placed on display as part of a collection of rare and valuable items held by a disreputable character.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E23 - Sarek
3.plot: Stardate: 43917.4. Spock's Vulcan father, Sarek, boards the Enterprise to negotiate political relations with the Legaran. However, Sarek has contract Bendii syndrome, which causes a Vulcan to gradually lose control, and become overpowered with emotions.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E24 - Ménage à Troi
3.plot: Stardate: 43930.7. Riker and Deanna, both on shoreleave, are unexpectedly joined by Deanna's mother, Lwaxana, on Betazed. Shortly, all three are kidnapped by the Ferengi who want to study Lwaxana's telepathic abilities.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E25 - Transfigurations
3.plot: Stardate: 43957.2. Dr. Crusher becomes attracted to an injured alien with mysterious powers, who is being tracked down by his government like a wanted criminal.

3.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S03E26 - The Best of Both Worlds (1)
3.plot: Stardate: 43989.1  An Starfleet expert on the Borg, Lt. Cmdr. Shelby, is assigned to the Enterprise to investigate the disappearance of a Federation colony. Picard is abducted by the Borg and assimilated into the Collective, which forces Riker to attempt a rescue mission.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E01 - The Best of Both Worlds (2)
4.plot: Stardate: 44001.4. Riker must pull out all the stops in order to save Earth from a Borg invasion being lead by none other than Locutus - otherwise known as Captain Jean-Luc Picard.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E02 - Family
4.plot: Stardate 44012.3. Picard meets with his older brother in France, and contemplates resigning his Starfleet commission after his ordeal with the Borg. Worf's adoptive parents spend time with their son on the Enterprise, and succeed in embarrassing him in front of his crewmates.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E04 - Suddenly Human
4.plot: Stardate: 44143.7. A custody battle between Picard and a child's adoptive father arises when a boy showing evidence of abuse is discovered.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E05 - Remember Me
4.plot: Stardate: 44161.2. Dr. Crusher begins to question her sanity when members of the crew start disappearing one by one, and all evidence of their existence is erased.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E06 - Legacy
4.plot: Stardate: 44215.2. The Enterprise is caught in the middle of a civil war when they encounter Tasha Yar's long-lost younger sister, Ishara.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E07 - Reunion
4.plot: Stardate: 44246.3. Picard is asked to choose between two candidates to succeed the current Chancellor of the Klingon High Council as the new ruler of the Empire. Worf is disturbed by unexpected news when he is paid a visit by his former lover.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E08 - Future Imperfect
4.plot: Stardate: 44286.5. Riker awakens one morning to discover he is suddenly 16 years in the future as the captain of the Enterprise, and negotiating a peace treaty with the Romulans with no recollection of how he arrived at that point in time, or of any recent events.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E09 - Final Mission
4.plot: Stardate: 44307.3. Wesley must keep Captain Picard alive on the eve of his entrance exam to Starfleet Academy when their shuttle crashes on a barren moon.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E10 - The Loss
4.plot: Stardate: 44356.9. Troi loses her empathic abilities when the Enterprise is caught in the gravitational pull of a black hole.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E11 - Data's Day
4.plot: Stardate: 44356.9. A Vulcan Ambassador being escorted by the Enterprise starts exhibiting suspicious behavior. Miles O'Brien marries his fiancée, Keiko Ishikawa in Ten-Forward.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E12 - The Wounded
4.plot: Stardate: 44429.6. When the Cardassians start re-arming themselves, a Federation Captain takes it upon himself to remove a potential threat before it escalated. Now, Picard must fight for the Cardassians and stop the renegade from slaughtering innocents.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E13 - Devil's Due
4.plot: Stardate: 44474.5. The crew of the Enterprise must defend the planet Ventax from a mythological Devil who re-appears when a 1000 year long era of peace comes to an end.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E14 - Clues
4.plot: Stardate: 44502.7. Picard orders a secret investigation when the crew suspects Data of lying about the discovery of a wormhole.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E15 - First Contact
4.plot: Riker is abducted by a xenophobic race of aliens during a first contact mission. They believe the Enterprise is a scout for an invasion.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E16 - Galaxy's Child
4.plot: Stardate: 44614.6. Geordi must work with the real Leah Brahms when she arrives on the Enterprise when a space-borne alien life form thinks the ship is its mother. Tensions rise when she learns that Geordi created a holographic version of her several months before in order to save the ship from danger.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E17 - Night Terrors
4.plot: Stardate: 44631.2. Troi faces a recurring nightmare when the Enterprise is caught in a rift in space. Soon, the crew begins to slip into insanity through dream deprivation.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E18 - Identity Crisis
4.plot: Stardate: 44664.5. Geordi and a former crew mate begin evolving into bizarre creatures when they return to a planet both of them were on during an Away Mission five years earlier.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E19 - The Nth Degree
4.plot: Stardate: 44704.2. An alien probe transforms Barclay from a shy, awkward character into an arrogant super-genius who is able to interface with the Enterprise's computer through the holodeck.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E20 - Qpid
4.plot: Stardate:44741.9. Q places Vash and the senior Enterprise crew in a recreation of Robin Hood and his merry men.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E21 - The Drumhead
4.plot: Stardate: 44769.2. Picard is accused of treason when an explosion aboard the Enterprise is investigated by a ruthless and paranoid Starfleet Admiral.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E22 - Half a Life
4.plot: Stardate: 44805.3. Lwaxana Troi falls in love with a man who must return home to commit suicide, as is customary for their race when they reach a certain age.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E23 - The Host
4.plot: Startdate: 44821.3. Dr. Crusher falls in love with a Trill Ambassador, until she discovers the Trill's symbiotic relationship.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E24 - The Mind's Eye
4.plot: Stardate: 44885.5. While en route to Risa for shore leave, Geordi is abducted by the Romulans and brainwashed into becoming an assassin.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E25 - In Theory
4.plot: Stardate: 44932.3. Data experiences the complexities of love when a fellow crewmate becomes attracted to him.

4.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S04E26 - Redemption (1)
4.plot: Stardate: 44995.3. Worf must choose between his people and the Federation when a civil war threatens to destroy the Klingon Empire.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E01 - Redemption (2)
5.plot: Stardate: 45020.4. Picard suspects a Romulan influence in the recent Klingon civil war, and must force the Federation to intervene before the Empire collapses.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E02 - Darmok
5.plot: Stardate: 45047.2. Picard must find a way to communicate with the newly discovered Tamarians, who speak entirely in metaphors, when a Tamarian Captain is brutally killed.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E03 - Ensign Ro
5.plot: Stardate: 45076.3. Picard exposes a planned genocidal attack on the Bajorans with the help of a new officer, Ensign Ro Laren.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E04 - Silicon Avatar
5.plot: Stardate: 45122.3. Picard attempts communications with the Crystalline Entity - a life form responsible for hundreds of deaths throughout the Alpha Quadrant. However, a scientist on board the Enterprise has plans of revenge over the death of her only son at the hands of the Entity.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E05 - Disaster
5.plot: Stardate: 45156.1. A natural disaster leaves Troi in command of the Enterprise, Picard stuck in a turbo lift with three small children and Keiko O'Brien stuck in Ten-Forward giving birth with an anxious Worf.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E06 - The Game
5.plot: Stardate: 45208.2. An addictive game is distributed among the crew of the Enterprise, however, it appears that this game interferes with a person's logic and reason, which leaves the crew open to manipulation. Only a young Ensign and a vacationing Wesley Crusher are able to think for themselves, and must find a way to reverse the damage before the ship falls into the wrong hands.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E07 - Unification (1)
5.plot: Stardate: 45233.1. Ambassador Spock has disappeared and intelligence finds him on Romulus.  Captain Picard is sent to Romulus to find Spock.  Meanwhile Riker and the rest of the crew investigate the fragments of a Vulcan ship discovered in the wreck of a Ferengi vessel.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E08 - Unification (2)
5.plot: Stardate: 45245.8. Picard and Data find Spock and discover the reason behind the secret meetings. However, a darker scheme planned by the Romulans is also uncovered in the process.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E09 - A Matter of Time
5.plot: Stardate: 45349.1. While on a mission to help a planet recently struck by an asteroid, the Enterprise is payed a visit by a man who claims to be from the future.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E10 - New Ground
5.plot: Stardate: 45376.3. Worf's son, Alexander, unexpectedly arrives on the Enterprise to stay with his father. However, Alexander wants to stay permanently.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E11 - Hero Worship
5.plot: Stardate: 45397.3. The Enterprise investigates the cause of an explosion which destroyed a small ship and its entire crew, except for a small boy.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E12 - Violations
5.plot: Stardate: 45429.3. While escorting a group of telepaths, crew members on board the Enterprise suddenly start to slip into comas.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E13 - The Masterpiece Society
5.plot: Stardate: 45470.1. A natural disaster in the core of a system's sun threatens to destroy a colony of genetically engineered people on an otherwise desolate planet. However, the crew's intervention may cause more harm than good.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E14 - Conundrum
5.plot: Stardate: 45494.2. The Enterprise crew unknowingly receives a new first officer who claims that the Federation is at war with another species.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E15 - Power Play
5.plot: Stardate: 45571.2. While en route to the source of a subspace distress signal coming from a desolate moon, Data, Troi and O'Brien take over the bridge and force the ship to change course.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E16 - Ethics
5.plot: Stardate: 45587.3. When Worf is paralysed in an accident he must undergo drastic back surgery. However, this experimental technique may cost him his life.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E17 - The Outcast
5.plot: Stardate: 45614.6. While investigating the disappearance of a J'naii shuttlecraft, the crew finds reason to believe the missing ship is stranded in an abnormal pocket called "null space." Riker and Soren, a member of the J'naii race, begin preparing to rescue the craft, and the two strike up a friendship. Their relationship develops quickly as the pair question each other about mating habits, since the J'naii are androgynous and do not identify themselves as either male or female. Despite this difference, sparks begin to fly between them.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E18 - Cause and Effect
5.plot: Stardate: 45652.1. While exploring the Typhon Expanse, the Enterprise is caught in a time warp in which they are repeatedly destroyed while colliding with another starship.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E19 - The First Duty
5.plot: Stardate: 45703.9. Wesley is involved in a cover-up at Starfleet Academy when a cadet is killed and five shuttles are destroyed during a forbidden maneuver performed by Starfleet Academy's best cadets.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E20 - Cost of Living
5.plot: Stardate: 45733.6. Deanna's mother pays a surprise visit to the Enterprise with even more surprising news: she plans to marry a man she has never met. After destroying an asteroid, the ship becomes infected with parasites that eat away at the ship's hull.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E21 - The Perfect Mate
5.plot: Stardate: 45761.3. The Ferengi try to abduct an empathic Metamorph who could bring peace between two warring worlds.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E22 - Imaginary Friend
5.plot: Stardate: 45832.1. While exploring a strange form of energy in a region of space, a little girl's imaginary friend becomes real and places the Enterprise in great danger.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E23 - I, Borg
5.plot: Stardate: 45854.2. An injured Borg is discovered and brought back to the Enterprise where he is 'repaired' by Dr. Crusher and befriended by Geordi, who names him 'Hugh.' Soon, Hugh starts showing signs of individuality while Picard must choose between destroying him or returning him to the collective.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E24 - The Next Phase
5.plot: Stardate: 45092.4. While the Enterprise helps a Romulan science vessel, an accident occurs which forces Geordi LaForge and Ro Laren slightly out of 'phase', causing them to become undetectable to everyone but each other. As a result, the crew thinks they are dead and make arrangements for their funerals, even though they are closer than the crew realise.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E25 - The Inner Light
5.plot: Stardate: 45944.1. Picard awakes to find himself living in a small village where he is a well-known member of the community who is suffering from a delusion of being a starship captain.

5.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S05E26 - Time's Arrow (1)
5.plot: Stardate: 45959.1. Data's head is uncovered in an archaeological dig on Earth, where evidence is also found that aliens may have been on Earth as early as the 19th Century. Using modified technology, an away team follows Data into the late 1890s to investigate.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E01 - Time's Arrow (2)
6.plot: Stardate: 46001.3. The away team's investigations are hampered by a nosy Samuel Clemens. Picard discovers that he originally met Guinan in the 1890s on Earth.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E02 - Realm of Fear
6.plot: Stardate: 46041.1. Lt. Barclay's fear of using transporters is eerily justified when he sees bizarre aliens within the transporter beam.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E03 - Man of the People
6.plot: Stardate: 46071.6. Deanna becomes attracted to an alien ambassador. Shortly thereafter, she starts ageing rapidly and starts becoming violent.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E04 - Relics
6.plot: Stardate: 46125.3. Montgomery 'Scotty' Scott is discovered suspended in a transporter beam 75 years after he disappeared. After the Enterprise crew re-materialise him, he has a hard time adjusting to the new society.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E05 - Schisms
6.plot: Stardate: 46154.2. Members of the crew are secretly abducted from the Enterprise to be used in bizarre experiments where they are dismembered and re-assembled without anyone's knowledge - including their own. The only signs that anything is wrong is a strange form of tiredness and no recollection of having slept well the night before.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E06 - True Q
6.plot: Stardate: 46192.3. A young intern visiting the Enterprise captures the interest of Q when she starts displaying Q-like powers.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E07 - Rascals
6.plot: Stardate: 46235.7. A transporter accident transforms Picard, Ro Laren, Guinan and Keiko O'Brien into small children who appear to be about 12 years old. Matters are complicated when the Ferengi seize the Enterprise.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E08 - A Fistful of Datas
6.plot: Stardate: 46271.5. Worf and his son, Alexander, become trapped in the holodeck when their Wild West program malfunctions. However, they must find a way to defeat the holographic bandits who have Data's appearance and abilities.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E09 - The Quality of Life
6.plot: Stardate: 46315.2. Data discovers that the maintenance robots built by Dr. Farallon may have become sentient.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E10 - Chain of Command (1)
6.plot: Stardate: 46357.4. Picard resigns as Captain of the Enterprise to lead a top-secret espionage mission into Cardassia with Worf and Dr. Crusher.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E11 - Chain of Command (2)
6.plot: Stardate: 46360.8. Picard is captured and tortured by the Cardassians, while Riker tries to prevent a Federation attack on Cardassia.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E12 - Ship in a Bottle
6.plot: Stardate: 46424.1. While performing holodeck maintenance, Barclay accesses the stored hologram of Professor Moriarty, who wreaks havoc on board the Enterprise.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E13 - Aquiel
6.plot: Stardate: 46461.3. Geordie falls in love with a lieutenant who is the prime suspect in a murder case.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E14 - Face of the Enemy
6.plot: Stardate: 46519.1. Troi is abducted and surgically altered by the Romulans as part of a ploy to smuggle intelligence operatives into the Federation.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E15 - Tapestry
6.plot: Stardate: Unknown. A mortally wounded Picard is forced into re-living a time of his life when he was back in Starfleet Academy, with the intervention of Q.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E16 - Birthright (1)
6.plot: Stardate: 46578.4. While visiting Deep Space Nine, Worf learns that his father is still alive and being held captive in a secret Romulan prison camp.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E17 - Birthright (2)
6.plot: Stardate: 46759.2. Worf is captured by the Romulans where he learns why the other captives did not attempt an escape years before.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E18 - Starship Mine
6.plot: Stardate: 46682.4. The crew evacuates the Enterprise when the ship needs to be cleaned of particles that have built up over the ship's hull. However, Picard accidentally stumbles over a terrorist group who plan on destroying the ship. He only has a short time to stop their attempts before the ship is swept by a beam of radiation to remove the particles that is lethal to all forms of life.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E19 - Lessons
6.plot: Stardate: 46693.1. Picard must choose between love and command when he must make a decision that could place the woman he loves in a potentially deadly and high-risk mission.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E20 - The Chase
6.plot: Stardate: 46731.5. Picard's old archaeology professor is found murdered, the crew try to complete his research. Soon, the crew must compete with Romulans and Klingons and Cardassians to uncover the truth behind his discoveries.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E21 - Frame of Mind
6.plot: Stardate: 46778.1. Riker questions his sanity when his reality seems to shift between an alien psychiatric hospital and a play he is performing with other members of the crew.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E22 - Suspicions
6.plot: Stardate: 46830.1. Dr. Crusher puts her career on the line when she tries to clear the name of a murdered scientist whose invention could allow starships to pass through a sun's corona.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E23 - Rightful Heir
6.plot: Stardate: 46852.2. While on a quest to summon a vision of Kahless, Worf questions his faith when the real Kahless rises from the dead to lead the Empire.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E24 - Second Chances
6.plot: Stardate: 46915.2. Riker discovers that eight years ago, an exact clone of him was created when he beamed through a planet's surface while returning to his starship. This clone, named Thomas Riker, has secretly remained on the planet for the past eight years, and still has romantic feelings for Troi.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E25 - Timescape
6.plot: Stardate: 46944.2. Picard, Geordi, Troi and Data return from a Federation conference to find the Enterprise frozen in time and under attack from a frozen Romulan Warbird.

6.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S06E26 - Descent (1)
6.plot: Stardate: 46982.1. The Borg return to threaten the Federation under the new leadership of Lore. Data experiences a disturbing facet of human emotions - he feels pleasure after killing a Borg drone.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E01 - Descent (2)
7.plot: Stardate: 47025.4. Data abducts Picard, Troi and Geordi and holds them prisoners of the Borg, while he derives pleasure from being evil. Dr. Crusher is left in command of the Enterprise as it comes under attack from a Borg vessel.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E02 - Liaisons
7.plot: Stardate: Unknown. During an exchange program, Picard's shuttle crashes on an unknown planet where he is rescued by the sole survivor of another crash.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E03 - Interface
7.plot: Stardate: 47215.5. Geordi defies direct orders from Captain Picard in an attempt to rescue his mother who had recently been reported as missing.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E04 - Gambit (1)
7.plot: Stardate: 47135.2. An away team investigates the apparent death of Jean-Luc Picard who was supposedly killed in a bar fight. When Riker is abducted by a band of criminals who loot archaeological digs, he is shocked to find Picard alive and well, and undercover as a renegade archaeologist.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E05 - Gambit (2)
7.plot: Stardate: 47160.1. Picard and Riker covertly work together in an attempt to find out why the criminals are looting archaeological digs.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E06 - Phantasms
7.plot: Stardate: 47225.7. Data's new dream subroutine causes him to experience nightmares which provide a unique insight into strange events that are occurring on board the Enterprise.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E07 - Dark Page
7.plot: Stardate: 47254.1. Lwaxana Troi collapses with a repressed memory related illness. Her only chance for survival is if Deanna can probe her subconscious and find out what is killing her. However, the secret Lwaxana holds is deeper than Deanna imagined.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E08 - Attached
7.plot: Stardate: 47304.2. While on a a diplomatic mission, Dr. Crusher and Picard are captured and imprisoned. As a result, they are linked together via a telepathic device.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E09 - Force of Nature
7.plot: Stardate: 47310.2. The Enterprise is drawn to a region of space where many starships have been mysteriously disabled. They soon learn that a brother and sister team has been working together to bring attention to the fact that frequent high-warp travel is damaging the very fabric of space/time.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E10 - Inheritance
7.plot: Stardate: 47410.2. Data is disturbed by the claims of a woman who says she is Noonien Soong's ex-wife.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E11 - Parallels
7.plot: Stardate: 47391.2. Worf returns from a Klingon competition to find that he is shifting through different realities.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E12 - The Pegasus
7.plot: Stardate: 47457.1. Riker is placed on a covert mission to find the missing starship he was once a member aboard, but the mission holds a secret that could destroy the peace treaty between the Federation and the Romulans.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E13 - Homeward
7.plot: Stardate: 47423.9. Worf's adoptive brother violates the Prime Directive to save an alien society whose planet is dying.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E14 - Sub Rosa
7.plot: Stardate: Unknown. Dr. Crusher attends her grandmother's funeral, to find that she had been in romantic encounters with a mysterious man who had been haunting the Howard family women for generations.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E15 - Lower Decks
7.plot: Stardate: 47566.7. Four young ensigns compete for a promotion that only one of them will receive. However, they are soon placed on a top secret mission that places some of their lives in danger.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E16 - Thine Own Self
7.plot: Stardate: 47611.2. Data find himself mysteriously stranded on a planet with no recollection of who he is or how he arrived there. Soon he is accused of spreading a plague among the inhabitants. Troi takes the bridge officer's test in an attempt to gain the rank of Commander.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E17 - Masks
7.plot: Stardate: 47615.2. The Enterprise is slowly transformed into an ancient alien temple when Data discovers an alien archive full of information about an ancient culture. Shortly after opening the archive, Data becomes possessed with several different personalities.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E18 - Eye of the Beholder
7.plot: Stardate: 47622.1. While investigating the mysterious suicide of a crew member, Troi and Worf begin to show romantic feeling towards one another.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E19 - Genesis
7.plot: Stardate: 47653.2. Upon returning from an away mission, Picard and Data find the ship drifting in space, and the crew de-evolving into their animal ancestors.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E20 - Journey's End
7.plot: Stardate: 47751.2. Under the terms of the new Federation/Cardassian alliance, Picard is ordered to evacuate a colony of native Americans, but protests from Wesley hamper the process. Wesley's destiny is finally revealed to him when the Traveler returns.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E21 - Firstborn
7.plot: Stardate: 47779.4. A disinterested Alexander must face his first Right of Ascension passage, but a mysterious warrior by the name of K'Mtar brings with him a disturbing request.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E22 - Bloodlines
7.plot: Stardate: 47829.1. Picard tries to save his newly-discovered son from the retaliation of a vengeful Ferengi whose only son was killed by Picard buring the Battle of Maxia many years before.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E23 - Emergence
7.plot: Stardate: 47869.2. The Enterprise's computer systems starts having repeated malfunctions, leading the crew to believe that it may be evolving into a new life form.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E24 - Preemptive Strike
7.plot: Stardate: 47941.7. Fresh from Starfleet's Advanced Tactical Training course, Ro Laren is assigned to infiltrate the Maquis. However, over time she begins to sympathize with them, which forces her to choose between her loyalty to the Federation, and her new friends in the Maquis.

7.title: FR - Star Trek : La nouvelle génération - S07E25 - All Good Things...
7.plot:
Stardate: 47988.0. Shortly after Picard is diagnosed with a long-term, potentially debilitating brain disorder, he starts experiencing bizarre shifts into three main time periods: 25 years into the future, a few days before the Enterprise-D is sent on its mission to Farpoint station, and the present. Picard realizes that Q is behind these shifts through time.

Stardate:  47988.1. After his encounter with Q, Picard assembles the senior staff, and wonders if Q is actually giving him a chance to save humanity by showing him that the spatial anomaly also exists in the past. As they talk, the ship reaches the Neutral Zone, then Picard returns to the future, where Beverly's ship is also on the edge of the Neutral Zone. He convinces a reluctant Worf to accompany the group into Klingon territory, and then travels to the past, where he orders the crew into the Devron system.

meta.plot: Cette série raconte les aventures, au XXIVe siècle, du vaisseau USS Enterprise (NCC-1701-D), commandé par un capitaine d'origine française, Jean-Luc Picard, et de son équipage.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E01 - DeeDeemensional
1.plot: In "Deedeemensional", Dee Dee time-travels to save Dexter from a monster. In "Magmanamus", Monkey goes up against a lava being that dislikes human-caused noise. In "Maternal Combat", when his mother falls, Dexter creates a robot mom to substitute for her.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E02 - Dial M for Monkey: Magmanamus
1.plot: Monkey must defend the city from a giant underground lava monster, Magmanamus, who cannot sleep because of the noise created by its residents.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E03 - Maternal Combat
1.plot: When his mother falls ill, Dexter creates a robot to do her chores. Dee Dee gets hold of its remote control and wreaks havoc, forcing Dexter to create a second robot to counter Dee Dee's.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E04 - Dexter Dodgeball
1.plot: Dexter is forced to play dodgeball by his P. E. teacher. Constantly failing, Dexter builds a robotic exoskeleton to defend himself.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E05 - Dial M for Monkey: Rasslor
1.plot: Intergalactic wrestling champion Rasslor challenges Earth's superheroes, including Monkey, with the planet's fate at stake.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E06 - Dexter's Assistant
1.plot: In need of an assistant to operate his latest invention, Dexter performs a brain transplant on Dee Dee to make her smart enough to fulfill the role. With her new brain, Dee Dee proves to be more intelligent than Dexter.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E07 - Dexter's Rival
1.plot: Mandark Astronomanov, a new student at Dexter's school, seems to be superior to Dexter academically. Mandark forces Dexter to shut down his lab so that Mandark's lab can gain more power. However, with the help of Dee Dee, Dexter manages to destroy Mandark's lab.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E08 - Dial M for Monkey: Simion
1.plot: Monkey encounters Simion, an intelligent anthropomorphic chimpanzee who seeks vengeance on humans for turning him into his current state.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E09 - Old Man Dexter
1.plot: Banned from watching a late-night movie due to his young age, Dexter uses his technology to artificially grow into adulthood, but Dee Dee tampers with his machine, causing Dexter to turn into an old man.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E10 - Double Trouble
1.plot: Dee Dee and her friends, Lee Lee and Mee Mee, enter Dexter's lab and wreak havoc. Dexter clones himself to stop them, but the girls too make clones of themselves.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E11 - Dial M for Monkey: Barbequor
1.plot: Monkey's birthday party is interrupted by Barbequor an intergalactic villain who plans to eat the planets, and his sidekick, the Silver Spooner.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E12 - Changes
1.plot: Rerun of "Dexter's Laboratory", the first "What a Cartoon!" pilot.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E13 - Jurassic Pooch
1.plot: To clone a dinosaur with an incomplete DNA sequence, Dexter uses his dog's genetic code to fill in the gaps.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E14 - Dial M For Monkey: Orgon Grindor
1.plot: While on a date with Agent Honeydew, Monkey gets hypnotized by the music of the Organ Grindor who commands him to rob Fort Knox.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E15 - Dimwit Dexter
1.plot: Due to overworking his brain, Dexter's mind shuts down, making him act idiotic.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E16 - Dee Dee's Room
1.plot: After Dee Dee steals his critical invention, Dexter ventures into her room to find it.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E17 - Dial M For Monkey: Huntor
1.plot: Monkey encounters an alien hunter named Huntor and must fight him to save Agent Honeydew and Commander Chief.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E18 - The Big Sister
1.plot: Rerun of the second "What a Cartoon!" pilot.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E19 - Star Spangled Sidekicks
1.plot: Dexter and Dee Dee enter tryouts to become Major Glory's sidekick. When Dee Dee wins, Dexter realizes that fancy costumes are not the only criterion to become a superhero.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E20 - The Justice Friends: TV Super Pals
1.plot: With only one television in their apartment, Major Glory, Krunk, and Valhallen disagree on what to watch: Major Glory's televised capture of the Disgruntled Postman, TV Puppet Pals, or the monster truck pull.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E21 - Game Over
1.plot: Dexter and Dee Dee's father buys a video game for them to play, but the game sucks Dexter inside when he plugs in the cartridge, and it is up to Dee Dee to bring him out.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E22 - Babysitter Blues
1.plot: Dexter has a crush on his teenage babysitter Lisa. When he finds out that she has a boyfriend, he sabotages their relationship and accelerates his age by ten years in an attempt to win her heart.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E23 - The Justice Friends: Valhallen's Room
1.plot: Valhallen loses his magic ax and starts turning into a nerd, forcing Major Glory and Krunk to enter his room to find it.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E24 - Dream Machine
1.plot: When Dexter's nightmares become frequent and problematic, he invents a machine that allows him to have nice dreams, as long as Dee Dee can operate it properly while she is awake.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E25 - Dollhouse Drama
1.plot: Suspicious that Dee Dee has not entered his lab even once on a particular day, Dexter shrinks himself and enters her room to spy on her. He soon becomes an unwilling character in Dee Dee's doll story, but he believes the story to be real.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E26 - The Justice Friends: Krunk's Date
1.plot: While fighting Comrade Red and his gang, Krunk falls in love with his equivalent in their gang, She-Thing.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E27 - The Big Cheese
1.plot: Dexter's new device allows him to study for the next day's French test while sleeping. It malfunctions, causing a single phrase -omelette du fromage- to repeat throughout the night, causing Dexter to wake up the next morning speaking nothing else except "omelette du fromage".

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E28 - Way of the Dee Dee
1.plot: Dee Dee teaches Dexter how to live life her way instead of being lonely and purely focused on science.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E29 - The Justice Friends: Say Uncle Sam
1.plot: Major Glory forces Krunk and Valhallen to tidy up their apartment for his Uncle Sam, who is coming over for a visit.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E30 - Tribe Called Girl
1.plot: To learn more about girls, Dexter camouflages himself and enters Dee Dee's room, where she is having a sleepover with her friends Lee Lee and Mee Mee. He gets caught by the girls, who force him to take part in their activities.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E31 - Spacecase
1.plot: To prevent himself from being taken away by aliens for experimentation, Dexter tricks Dee Dee into going instead, but he regrets his decision after realizing how much he cares for her.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E32 - The Justice Friends: Ratman
1.plot: To fix their apartment's plumbing, Krunk and Valhallen go to the basement, where they meet Ratman, a diminutive vigilante raised by rats (a parody of Batman).

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E33 - Dexter's Debt
1.plot: Dexter's lab is threatened with repossession unless he can repay his debt to NASA. When Dee Dee wins the same amount in a lottery, he decides to steal her money out of desperation.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E34 - The Justice Friends: Bee Where?
1.plot: Major Glory, Krunk, and Valhallen try to rid their apartment of a bee.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E35 - Mandarker
1.plot: Following the destruction of his lab by Dexter and Dee Dee (in the episode Dexter's Rival), Mandark turns to magic to beat Dexter at the science fair.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E36 - Inflata Dee Dee
1.plot: Dee Dee inflates Dexter's hydro-plasmatic suit and constantly floats in the air, prompting Dexter to bring her down.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E37 - The Justice Friends: Can't Nap
1.plot: After fellow Justice Friend White Tiger helps Valhallen stop a super-villain, the latter invites him to spend the night in his apartment, forgetting that Major Glory is allergic to cats.

1.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S01E38 - Monstory
1.plot: Not interested in hearing Dee Dee's long-winded story, Dexter gives her a silencing formula to keep her quiet, but it instead turns her into a giant monster still bent on telling her story. When he realizes that nothing can make her quiet, he becomes a giant monster himself.

2.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S02E01 - Beard To Be Feared
2.plot: After a fright from Dee Dee, Dexter lays down in the beard growing machine and tries to grow a beard like his hero, Action Hank. Unfortunately, everyone thinks he's a hero.

2.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S02E02 - Quackor The Fowl
2.plot: Mandark doesn't know that his pet duck is really Quackor the Fowl, Monkey's rival. Quackor overhears Mandark talking in his sleep about destroying Dexter's lab and tries to do it, unaware that Monkey is Dexter's pet.

2.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S02E03 - Ant Pants
2.plot: Dexter prevents Dee Dee from destroying some ants. In order to teach her about ants, Dexter and Dee enter Dexter's ant farm. The ants think Dexter is a criminal and has him fight to the death with a stronger ant.

2.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S02E04 - Mom and Jerry
2.plot: Dexter switches his brain with a mouse, and must avoid his mother when she decides to exterminate him. A Parody of Tom and Jerry.

2.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S02E05 - Chubby Cheese
2.plot: At the Chubby Cheese pizza restaurant, Dexter wears a Chubby Cheese hat and tries to slow down the Whack The Weasel machine to win a stuffed Monkey doll before Dee Dee does.

2.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S02E06 - That Crazy Robot
2.plot: One of Dexter's robots becomes Dee Dee's servant when she removes a wrench that froze him up, but the robot is willing to destroy anyone who is mean to her or scolds her, including Dexter.

2.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S02E06 - That Crazy Robot
2.plot: One of Dexter's robots becomes Dee Dee's servant when she removes a wrench that froze him up, but the robot is willing to destroy anyone who is mean to her or scolds her, including Dexter.

2.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S02E07 - D & DD
2.plot: When Dexter's friends tire of the complicated traps he sets up as Dungeon Master (he has their character's killed every time), they put Dee Dee in charge for a change of pace.

2.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S02E08 - Hamhocks and Armlocks
2.plot: Dexter's father gets challenged to an arm wrestling match against a local champion at a truck stop, when he causes the champion to lose for the first time, but refuses to do so even when he trashes the family car. He finally accepts the challenge when he slams the door in Mom's face. Dee Dee knows he'll get creamed, so Dexter builds him a robotic arm to help him win the match.

2.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S02E09 - Hunger Strikes
2.plot: Dexter uses radiation therapy so he can like vegetables, it actually causes him to only eat vegetables, also, the therapy has consequences if Dexter goes too long without them. He turns into a Parody of The Incredible Hulk without vegetables.

2.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S02E11 - Morning Stretch
2.plot: Dexter oversleeps and still has to finish his homework along with getting ready for school and eating breakfast, so he creates a helmet that expands thirty seconds into thirty minutes, but realizes that slowing down time is more detrimental than helpful. When he gets everything done, the helmet shuts off. But Dee Dee blocks his door causing him to miss the bus. When Dexter asks Dee Dee why, she replies "Snow Day, school's canceled!". Dexter realizes he did all that rushing around for nothing!

2.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S02E12 - Dee Dee Locks and the Ness Monster
2.plot: Dee Dee Locks and the Ness Monster—Dexter's mother forces Dexter to read to Dee Dee when she's sick, but she makes up her own story after being bored by Dexter's story (which was actually a science article). The story is completely mixed up and makes no sense. Dexter ends up catching Dee Dee's illness.

2.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S02E13 - Backfire
2.plot: Dexter fuses Dee Dee with the family car by accident, causing mayhem. A Parody of Herbie the Love Bug.

2.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S02E14 - Book 'Em
2.plot: Dexter accidentally takes a library book without checking it out, so he and Dee Dee try to put it back without being caught.

2.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S02E15 - Sister's Got a Brand New Bag
2.plot: Dee Dee's new dance annoys Dexter to no end.

2.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S02E16 - Shoo, Shoe Gnomes
2.plot: Dexter calls upon the "shoe gnomes" to repair his boots, but can't rid himself of them afterwards. The only way to get rid of them, according to Dee Dee, is to kick them in the butt. Dexter gets rid of the last one with his boot, but it's damaged again.

2.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S02E17 - Lab of The Lost
2.plot: Dexter ends up in the "old part of the lab" where his earliest inventions, long since forgotten, are not too happy to see him. They are mad at him for saying they were his greatest inventions, then moved on to another great invention.

2.title: FR - Dexter's Laboratory - S02E18 - Labels
2.plot: Dexter and Dee Dee label everything in the house. When their parents get home, they mistake Dexter for Dee Dee (he had a Dee Dee label on his forehead), but he already blamed Dee Dee for the chaos.

meta.plot: Dexter, a boy-genius with a secret laboratory, constantly battles his sister Dee Dee, who always gains access despite his best efforts to keep her out, as well as his arch-rival and neighbor, Mandark.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E01 - Candy's Birthday
1.plot: At Pony's Home, an old church and orphanage run by Miss Pony and Sister Mary, young Tom discovers that something is amiss outside. When Miss Pony and Sister Mary go outside to investigate, they find two abandoned babies, Annie and Candy White. Over the next decade, the girls become best friends who try to sabotage visits from possible future parents in order not to be adopted.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E02 - Candy and Annie's Picnic
1.plot: Annie thinks more and more about having parents. To console her, Candy takes her on a picnic without telling the Pony House where they are going. Candy just leaves a letter explaining that they will return before nightfall. During their journey, they are swept away by the current of a river but brought back safely to the Brighton house.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E03 - Goodbye Annie
1.plot: The Brightons pretend to have a barbecue at the orphanage to ask to adopt Candy, but she wants to stay with Annie so she forces them to change their mind, which makes them fall back on Annie who agrees to be adopted.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E04 - A Letter from Annie
1.plot: Candy's life is punctuated by the passage of the letter carrier, Mr. Mathieu: she harasses him to get letters from Annie. But one day, Annie, under the pressure of her adoptive parents, writes her a farewell letter. In her sadness, she wanders to the hill where she meets a young man in a Scottish outfit who encourages her and whom she calls her "prince of the hill".

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E05 - From Today, I'll be a princess?
1.plot: Candy departs for Lakeweood together with her raccoon Klint. She hitches a ride with Tom and his father Mr. Steave on their wagon. Mr. Steave expresses his doubts about the Leagans and advises Candy to be strong and never cry. From the very moment of her arrival, Candy is the victim of the nasty pranks by the Leagan children, Neil and Eliza.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E06 - The Prince of the Hill
1.plot: Candy wins the sympathy of the servants, but Daniel and Elisa continue to play nasty tricks on her. She hides Klint in the stable after trying to abandon him, but Daniel and Elisa take advantage of this to blackmail her. She runs away and meets a handsome boy at a flowery gate who reminds her of her prince from the hill, which encourages her to stay with the Legrands.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E07 - Am I Elegant?
1.plot: Candy attracts the wrath of the Legrands again and they punish her. So she decides to make an effort and become a real lady, but the Legrands want to make her a servant, so she runs away again and meets Archibald who is gallant.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E08 - Invitation of Happiness
1.plot: Elisa takes Candy to the city, but only to be a carrier. Elisa abandons her there, but Candy meets Alistair who helps her to come back home very quickly despite some adventures. Candy is invited to the party that welcomes Aunt Elroy who is going to live here (and at which she hopes to find her prince), but only because of her new friends.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E09 - The Dance Where I Met Him
1.plot: At the party, Elisa makes fun of Candy's outfit, but her friends put on casual clothes to support her. During Aunt Elroy's speech, Archibald makes Candy laugh, which brings shame on her. Archibald and Alistair make her a dress, and she gets a dance with Anthony at Elisa's expense.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E09 - The Dance Where I Met Him
1.plot: At the party, Elisa makes fun of Candy's outfit, but her friends put on casual clothes to support her. During Aunt Elroy's speech, Archibald makes Candy laugh, which brings shame on her. Archibald and Alistair make her a dress, and she gets a dance with Anthony at Elisa's expense.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E10 - The Barn Princess
1.plot: Unhappy with Candy's performance, the Legrands move her to the barn, but Sister Maria and John come to visit her, so she must keep up appearances, despite Elisa's protests. But the visitors discover the truth and Sister Maria gives her recommendations. Anthony, in compensation for Candy's difficult life, promises her a special rose for her birthday.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E11 - The Small Ribbon
1.plot: The Brightons visit the Legrands, but Annie must not show that she knows Candy. She is offered a horseback ride, but a trick by Daniel and Elisa wraps up the horse, and Candy must go to Annie's rescue, who shows her friendship by giving her a ribbon.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E12 - A Rose-Scented Birthday
1.plot: Candy discovers roses in the barn, but ends up understanding that it is Daniel who wanted to anger Anthony by making her look like a thief. She implicates him, but he says that the cat scratched her hands and accuses Candy of having stolen the ribbon, which discredits her. She flees to the river where she is saved by Albert, a vagrant, to be brought back by her three friends who have discovered the truth. Anthony gives her a new variety of rose, tender Candy.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E13 - The Lonesome Three
1.plot: Neil attempts to poison the horses, however, a shadow rushes into the barn and punches him, before running out again just as Candy arrives. Eliza blames Candy for Neil's black eye at the first opportunity, and torn between his pride, Eliza's wishes and his mother's insistence, Neil elects to blame Candy. Candy realizes it must have been Albert.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E14 - The Old Tree in Spring
1.plot: Mr. Leagan returns home from a long absence to find Candy downgraded to a servant, and decides Candy deserves a holiday at Pony's Home. Once there, Candy learns their neighbor, Mr. Cartwright, sold Father Tree to the eccentric Mr. Flannigan from Washington. He wants the tree all to himself, because he believes it would surrender the best business ideas. Candy leads the orphans and farm animals into an insurgency against the workers preparing the cutting and transportation of the tree.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E15 - The Decision Which Took Away My Happiness
1.plot: At the Leagans, Candy learns that Dorothy will be sent off to Mexico as an extra hand for the Ardley property. Mr. Leagan is absent again and cannot intervene. Anthony helps Candy to retrieve the horses Eliza and Neil chased out of the barn and compliments her on her lasso throwing skills. The Leagan children chased off the horses as a distraction, so they can frame Candy for thievery. As a result, Mrs. Leagan decides Candy will be sent to Mexico in Dorothy's place.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E16 - Departure to an Unknown Country
1.plot: The day before leaving for Mexico, Candy wishes to say farewell to Anthony, but instead witnesses how Anthony denounces his great-aunt when she orders her cousins never to play with the "thief" Candy. It does Candy's heart much good that all three believe in her, but she does not want Anthony to lose his family over her. She will go to Mexico and write him each day.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E17 - In the Arid, Wild West
1.plot: Candy discovers that Garcia, her pilot, has a bad temper. She discovers in the cart a poor family who is also leaving for Mexico. She leaves once to find milk for the baby, then she "borrows" the cart to have him treated in the nearest town. To pay the doctor, she has to sell her rosebush, then the family leaves.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E18 - The Cross of Happiness
1.plot: Candy saves Garcia from a snake bite and gives him her medallion, but he delivers her to bandits to save himself. Remorseful, he frees her, but she is kidnapped by a motorist.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E19 - At the End of the Difficult Journey
1.plot: Candy thinks she will be sold in Europe, but she manages to escape while her friends search for her. She arrives at the Rose Gate to discover that it is George who has kidnapped her, as Great Uncle William has decided to adopt her; the Legrands and Aunt Elroy can do nothing about it, as Uncle William is the absolute master of the Ardley family.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E20 - Happy Like in a Dream
1.plot: Candy now lives at the Ardley estate, together with the Cornwell brothers and Anthony and a closet full of dresses given by great-aunt Elroy. Neil and Eliza still try to persist in their lies and accusations, embarrassing great-aunt and provoking Anthony and the Cornwell brothers to remind them that Candy is a member of the family. When they make Neil beg on his knees for forgiveness, Candy stops them: without their deception, she would not have been sent to Mexico and Grandfather William would not have adopted her to save her.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E21 - A Pigeon That Carried Friendship
1.plot: To get back at Candy, Elisa takes Anthony into the woods and causes an accident with Tom who is carrying milk. Anthony brings Elisa, injured, back home, then fights with Tom who called him a coward. For this, Anthony is punished and confined in a castle in the woods with a ban on contacting Candy, who would have a bad influence on him.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E22 - Don't Give Up, Anthony!
1.plot: Despite the ban, Anthony and Candy correspond, first by carrier pigeon, then by a balloon designed by Alistair, which arrives at Elisa's house. Aunt Elroy discovers that Anthony wants to participate in a rodeo and tries to dissuade him, but a clever campaign convinces her to let him participate. And Anthony wins the rodeo.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E23 - The First Date
1.plot: An incident reveals that the prize of the rodeo was a calf. Unable to keep it, Anthony leaves with Candy to find a way to get rid of it before managing to sell it to Tom's father. So they decide to spend their money on small pleasures, and visit the fortune teller who seems to see a bad omen for Anthony.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E24 - My Anthony
1.plot: The bad omens are piling up but do not dampen Anthony's good mood. A fox hunt is organized to officially welcome Candy to the Ardley family. Candy and Anthony isolate themselves from the group, and as Anthony prepares to reveal the identity of Candy's prince, his horse catches his leg in a trap and throws his rider off, breaking his neck.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E25 - Overcoming the Pain
1.plot: The whole family is in mourning, and Anthony is buried in the cemetery, Candy being relegated to the church. Aunt Elroy sees Candy as a bird of misfortune and Elisa accuses her of being responsible for Anthony's death. Finally, Candy decides to go back to Pony's house.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E26 - Father-tree Knows
1.plot: Candy spends her time moping at Pony's house, so Jimmy, a newbie, doubts her status as a leader and is unpleasant with her. Then he challenges her to running and climbing, ignoring that Candy excels in these disciplines. She wins, earning his esteem.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E27 - A Present of Angels
1.plot: Christmas Eve promises to be gloomy for Miss Pony and Sister Maria, because Mr. Cartwright, their landlord, wants to enlarge his ranch by taking the house. Candy and Jimmy decide to persuade him not to do so. After a first approach which proves to be a failure, they take all the orphans, dressed as angels, to present their wishes to the men of the ranch. The orphanage is saved!

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E28 - Scar on the Healed Soul
1.plot: Mr. Cartwright has become a friend of Pony's house. He lends his cart so that everyone can visit Tom. He proposes to Candy to adopt him. Candy goes for a walk with Archibald and Alistair who tell her that they are leaving for England soon.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E29 - A Departure Full of Hope
1.plot: Candy declines Mr. Cartwright's offer. She feels the vocation of becoming a teacher, but George comes to seek her. She runs away in the rain with Jimmy, who is already sick and whose condition is getting worse. She is finally not mature enough to be a teacher, but watches over Jimmy until he recovers, then leaves with George.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E30 - Love Transcends Raging Waves
1.plot: Candy shows her altruism on the boat that takes her to England: she treats a seagull and then supports the captain who wants to deviate from his course to save shipwrecked people while the influential passengers are opposed to it. But her stubbornness and her good heart make them change their minds, so a party is organized for the captain who risked his place. On the rail, she sees a young man who looks like Anthony.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E31 - A New Day in the Old Capital
1.plot: This young man goes from tears to laughter as Candy approaches him and makes fun of her. Archibald and Alistair come to pick her up and want to take Klint to the zoo because he will not be allowed to go to college. He runs away and is almost killed by a hunter. She goes to the hotel where she thinks she will meet Uncle William, but she finds this young man, Terrence, from a big family.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E32 - Another Pony Hill
1.plot: Candy gets Klint into St. Paul's College, but he gets her into trouble. The rules are very strict. She meets Patricia, but Elisa starts to bully her again and plays new tricks on her using Patricia who doesn't dare to oppose her. Finally, Terrence makes a scandal during the service of the mass. She discovers a hill which reminds her of her own.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E33 - A Strange Student
1.plot: Candy is quarantined by Elisa, but Patricia's grandmother steps up and pushes her granddaughter to bond with Candy, all the while wanting to experience life as a middle schooler in a strange way.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E34 - The Returned Envelope
1.plot: A bad trick of Elisa's turns against her, as she was making fun of Candy's letter. So, she sends Daniel and his cronies to take revenge on her, but Terrence intervenes. Alistair and Archibald invite Candy and tell her that Archibald had a fight with Terrence and that Annie will come to the school.

1.title: FR - Candy Candy - S01E35 - A Wonderful Sunday
1.plot: The Ardley's got permission to go out this Sunday and see Aunt Elroy, but Candy didn't request it, so she has to stay. So she joins Terrence at the hill. Then Mr. Brighton takes her to see the horse races and tells her that Annie is coming.
