31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E20 - Warrin' Priests (2)
31.plot: While Bode has won over most of Springfield, he finds one churchgoer he can't sway in Ned Flanders. Meanwhile in Michigan, Reverend Lovejoy finds the ammunition he needs to get rid of his replacement.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E21 - The Hateful Eight-Year-Olds
31.plot: After severing her sibling ties with Bart, Lisa attends a sleepover at her new friend Addy's house, only to discover that Addy's clique are a group of cruel snobby rich girls that taunt her. Meanwhile, Homer takes Marge on a sunset cruise for the evening and finds himself at odds with the boat's cover band.

31.title: FR - Les Simpson - S31E22 - The Way of the Dog
31.plot: Santa's Little Helper nips at Marge, causing the family to reflect on the difficult life that the dog led prior to being adopted by the family. They end up reuniting him with his mother to avoid having to euthanize him.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E01 - Undercover Burns
32.plot: Mr. Burns goes undercover as "Fred" at the nuclear power plant and becomes friends with Homer and the gang. Burns implements all sorts of amenities to improve his employees' lives, but a jealous Smithers plots to bring the old, bitter Burns back and destroy Fred.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E02 - I, Carumbus
32.plot: At a museum exhibit of Ancient Rome, Marge and Homer get into an argument about Homer's lack of ambition. They then imagine a Roman version of what would happen if Homer was more career-driven.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E03 - Now Museum, Now You Don't
32.plot: Lisa stays home from school to explore the wonders of Western art. She appears as Lisanardo, while Bart takes the shape of a French impressionist, Homer and Marge as Diego Rivera and Frida Kahlo, and Maggie as a warrior Cupid.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E04 - Treehouse of Horror XXXI
32.plot: The 31st annual Simpsons Halloween special includes a frightening look at the 2020 election, parodies of Toy Story and Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse and a 9th birthday Lisa just can't get over.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E05 - The 7 Beer Itch
32.plot: Homer is tempted by a British femme fatale while Marge and the kids are on a seaside vacation.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E06 - Podcast News
32.plot: Grampa Simpson is accused of a crime; Kent Brockman questions his career.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E07 - Three Dreams Denied
32.plot: Bart becomes a voice-over actor; Comic Book Guy is humiliated at Comic-Con; Lisa is set up for a fall.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E08 - The Road to Cincinnati
32.plot: Odd couple Skinner and Chalmers embark on an 800-mile car ride to Cincinnati to attend an administrator's convention - but can they reach their destination without killing each other first?

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E09 - Sorry Not Sorry
32.plot: Lisa calls her teacher, Ms. Hoover, a hack and refuses to apologize. Then, she learns Ms. Hoover's private pain.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E10 - A Springfield Summer Christmas for Christmas
32.plot: A cable channel films a Christmas movie in Springfield and Skinner falls in love.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E11 - The Dad Feelings Limited
32.plot: Comic Book Guy and his wife Kumiko debate about having a baby and we learn about his awesome origin story.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E12 - Diary Queen
32.plot: Bart finds his old teacher's diary and learns a surprising secret. Then, Lisa discovers an even bigger surprise.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E13 - Wad Goals
32.plot: Bart becomes a successful caddy, but Marge worries it is ruining his character.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E14 - Yokel Hero
32.plot: Cletus becomes a singing sensation, while Homer becomes a new man. Then, Cletus turns on his fans, ruining everything.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E15 - Do Pizza Bots Dream of Electric Guitars
32.plot: Homer tries to reunite a mechanical band from his youth, but film and TV creator J.J. Abrams gets ahold of them first.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E16 - Manger Things
32.plot: A secret of Flanders' Past and a never-before-seen room of the Simpson house are shown off.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E17 - Uncut Femmes
32.plot: It is discovered that Chief Wiggum's wife is more than she seems. Meanwhile, Marge takes part in a jewel heist.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E18 - Burger Kings
32.plot: Mr. Burns gets into the plant-based burger business. Lisa refuses to believe he's up to no good.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E19 - Panic on the Streets of Springfield
32.plot: Lisa gets a new imaginary friend - a depressed British singer from the 1980s. Meanwhile, Homer becomes a truck guy.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E20 - Mother and Child Reunion
32.plot: Lisa makes a shocking college decision, wounding Marge. It leads to a very surprising place.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E21 - The Man from G.R.A.M.P.A.
32.plot: A British secret agent comes to Springfield in search of a Russian spy.

32.title: FR - Les Simpson - S32E22 - The Last Barfighter
32.plot: After Moe breaks their most sacred rule, a secret society of bartenders seeks ultimate vengeance on Homer and his friends.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E01 - The Star of the Backstage
33.plot: A musical comes to life in Springfield as Marge stages a revival of her beloved high school show - but her wonderful memories are threatened by the return of a rival from the past.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E02 - Bart's in Jail
33.plot: When Grampa falls victim to a phone scammer, the Simpsons set out on a mission of vengeance to get his money back.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E03 - Treehouse of Horror XXXII
33.plot: The 32nd annual Simpsons Halloween special includes a spoof of "Parasite" and a segment where Bambi gets his revenge.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E04 - The Wayz We Were
33.plot: Evergreen Terrace is overrun with traffic and Moe has a fateful choice to make.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E05 - Lisa's Belly
33.plot: Marge puts a hurtful word in Lisa's brain and Bart gets swole.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E06 - A Serious Flanders (1)
33.plot: When a ruthless debt collector come to Springfield, Homer and Ned's lives are sucked into the artificial world of prestige TV.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E07 - A Serious Flanders (2)
33.plot: Things for Ned and Homer go from bad to gosh-darn worse in the stunning conclusion of this 'Simpflix' prestige crime thriller.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E08 - Portrait of a Lackey on Fire
33.plot: Smithers finds true love with a famous fashion designer, but will his new relationship destroy Springfield?

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E09 - Mothers and Other Strangers
33.plot: In a flashback, Homer goes on a road trip with his father to find his mother.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E10 - A Made Maggie
33.plot: Fat Tony becomes Godfather to Maggie Simpson.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E11 - The Longest Marge
33.plot: Marge and Mr. Burns fight for the soul of a brash young football prodigy.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E12 - Pixelated and Afraid
33.plot: When Homer and Marge are lost in an icy wilderness, they must push themselves to their limits to survive.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E13 - Boyz N the Highlands
33.plot: Bart, Martin and the bullies run for their lives when a weekend in the wilderness takes a dark turn.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E14 - You Won't Believe What This Episode Is About -- Act Three Will Shock You!
33.plot: Homer becomes a pariah when footage of him allegedly leaving Santa's Little Helper in a hot car goes viral.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E15 - Bart the Cool Kid
33.plot: When Bart befriends a famous kid influencer who owns an ultra-cool skate wear brand, Homer leads a rebellion of loser dads against them.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E16 - Pretty Whittle Liar
33.plot: Cletus discovers that his wife Brandine has been hiding a secret love ... of learning.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E17 - The Sound of Bleeding Gums
33.plot: Lisa meets the son of the late musician Bleeding Gums Murphy - and attempts to improve his life.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E18 - My Octopus and a Teacher
33.plot: Bart can't control his feelings when he gets a new teacher. Meanwhile, Lisa befriends an octopus.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E19 - Girls Just Shauna Have Fun
33.plot: When Lisa joins the high school marching band, she finds an unlikely mentor in Shauna Chalmers. Meanwhile, Homer becomes a craft beer brewer.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E20 - Marge the Meanie
33.plot: A surprise from Marge's past has her bonding with Bart and terrifying Homer.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E21 - Meat Is Murder
33.plot: Grampa finds himself in a pickle when his hidden hamburger past comes back to "ketchup" with him.

33.title: FR - Les Simpson - S33E22 - Poorhouse Rock
33.plot: After Bart humiliates him at church, Homer finally teaches his son to admire his dad - until a visit from a magical, singing janitor changes everything they thought they knew.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E01 - Habeas Tortoise
34.plot: After Homer humiliates himself in a town meeting, he looks for acceptance in an internet group hunting for a missing tortoise but finds something much more sinister.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E02 - One Angry Lisa
34.plot: Lisa gets called for jury duty while Marge becomes obsessed with her exercise bike.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E03 - Lisa the Boy Scout
34.plot: When the Boy Explorers become co-ed, Bart and Lisa vow to "out scout" each other at the annual jamboree.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E04 - The King of Nice
34.plot: Marge is hired as a segment producer on Krusty's new daytime talk show. But her initial excitement about the job fades when she discovers what an endless nightmare it is!

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E05 - Not It
34.plot: Homer and his teenaged friends are pursued by a killer clown in a spoof of Stephen King's novel "It".

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E06 - Treehouse of Horror XXXIII
34.plot: In a book-themed trilogy, Marge's resentment takes monstrous form, Lisa tries to save the planet through murder and Homer learns he's not the man he thought he was.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E07 - From Beer to Paternity
34.plot: When Homer becomes Duffman's girl-dad hero, they go on a road trip with Lisa that threatens to expose Homer's terrible parenting.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E08 - Step Brother from the Same Planet
34.plot: Homer is stunned by his feelings of rage and resentment when Grampa becomes a doting stepfather to his girlfriend's quirky young son. Lisa and Bart throw the ultimate slumber party.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E09 - When Nelson Met Lisa
34.plot: A future tale of the will-they-won't-they-I-guess-they-won't-maybe-they-will of Springfield's most unlikely couple.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E10 - Game Done Changed
34.plot: When Bart discovers a profitable glitch in an online game, he ropes Principal Skinner into his lucrative criminal enterprise. Marge and Maggie discover paradise.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E11 - Top Goon
34.plot: Coach Moe recruits the world's greatest brawlers to teach Nelson the art of hockey goonery.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E12 - My Life as a Vlog
34.plot: Through a series of YouTube recommended videos, the story of the rise and fall of The Simpson Family Vlog is revealed.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E13 - The Many Saints of Springfield
34.plot: When Ned Flanders falls on hard times, Fat Tony makes him an offer he can't refuse.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E14 - Carl Carlson Rides Again
34.plot: When Carl is smitten by a beautiful woman, he looks into the roots of his own identity by discovering the origins of a mysterious rodeo buckle.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E15 - Bartless
34.plot: When Bart's latest prank leads to chaos at Springfield Elementary, Marge and Homer dream of a world in which their rambunctious son was never a Simpson.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E16 - Hostile Kirk Place
34.plot: When Milhouse's Dad, Kirk, takes exception to a school history lesson that paints one of his ancestors in a bad light, Kirk goes on a crusade to censor and control the school curriculum -- a crusade that Homer co-opts for fun and profit.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E17 - Pin Gal
34.plot: A mysterious figure from Marge's past returns to coach her for a bowling tournament.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E18 - Fan-ily Feud
34.plot: Homer publicly disparages a pop singer and faces the ire of her vindictive and highly organized fan army.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E19 - Write Off This Episode
34.plot: When Marge and Lisa start a charity together, Marge is seduced by the money and prestige of Big Charity fundraising.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E20 - The Very Hungry Caterpillars
34.plot: When a plague of insects shuts down Springfield, the Simpsons face their greatest challenge yet… spending time in lockdown with each other.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E21 - Clown v. Board of Education
34.plot: Krusty opens a school for clowning, and it becomes the most successful thing he's ever done.

34.title: FR - Les Simpson - S34E22 - Homer's Adventures Through the Windshield Glass
34.plot: Time stands still after Homer crashes his car and flies through the windshield. As his life flashes before his eyes, a magical friend helps Homer learn the secret truth about his marriage.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E01 - Homer's Crossing
35.plot: Feeling worthless at work, Homer volunteers to be a school crossing guard. But when his safety squad receives too much funding, the crossing guards become a force to be feared.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E02 - A Mid-Childhood Night's Dream
35.plot: Marge feels an overwhelming dread of the empty nest.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E03 - McMansion & Wife
35.plot: When a new neighbor showers him with kindness, Homer thinks he's being tricked into buying a sports car at the dealership where the neighbor works - but the truth turns out to be even more sinister; Lisa neutralizes Nelson after he goes on a bullying spree.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E04 - Thirst Trap: A Corporate Love Story
35.plot: In a parody documentary, a young college-dropout CEO embraces the Silicon Valley "fake it until you make it" philosophy and bewitches Mr. Burns into funding her highly dubious dream project.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E05 - Treehouse of Horror XXXIV
35.plot: After Bart is turned into an NFT, Marge fights though the blockchain to rescue her son. To track down a gruesome serial killer, Lisa turns to a murderer from her past. An outbreak transforms Springfielders into a plague of lazy, beer-loving oafs.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E06 - Iron Marge
35.plot: When Marge's heart is broken by a bad birthday present, Bart and Lisa must dig into their mom's past to show that they really know her. Homer becomes a neighborhood fear-monger.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E07 - It's a Blunderful Life
35.plot: Lisa recounts the story of how Homer was scapegoated for a power outage that plunged Springfield into darkness days before Thanksgiving.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E08 - AE Bonny Romance
35.plot: When Groundskeeper Willie is kidnapped to Scotland, Bart and the Simpsons follow - only to discover that what awaits is Homer's worst nightmare.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E09 - Murder, She Boat
35.plot: Lisa must solve a closed-boat mystery when Comic Book Guy's million-dollar action figure is "murdered" on a pop culture cruise.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E10 - Do the Wrong Thing
35.plot: Homer and Bart become kings of the blue-collar sports circuit, but Marge suspects something dishonest at the core of their father-son bond.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E11 - Frinkenstein's Monster
35.plot: Professor Frink secretly helps Homer, through a zoom interview, land a high-level position at a state-of-the-art nuclear plant in Shelbyville. But since Homer lacks the skills to actually perform the job, Frink must monitor Homer's work situation remotely and dictate his every word... causing Frink to fear he's created a monster.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E12 - Lisa Gets an F1
35.plot: Lisa feels a need for speed as well a need for control of her anxiety when she becomes a pro kid go-cart racer.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E13 - Clan of the Cave Mom
35.plot: A parenting disagreement between Marge and Luann Van Houten escalates into a life-or-death struggle for survival.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E14 - Night of the Living Wage
35.plot: Marge gets a job in a high-pressure ghost kitchen, but when she tries to start a union, she gets more than she (collectively) bargained for.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E15 - Cremains of the Day
35.plot: When someone in Homer's life passes away, he and guys from Moe's go on a road trip to scatter the ashes... but will their friendship die as well?

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E16 - The Tell-Tale Pants
35.plot: Marge comes upon a surprising windfall and, angry with Homer, spends it secretly on herself.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E17 - The Tipping Point
35.plot: Homer loses his mind over tipping culture run amok.

35.title: FR - Les Simpson - S35E18 - Bart's Brain

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E01 - Bart's Birthday
36.plot: Bart celebrates the most shocking birthday party of his entire life — one that might just change everyone in Springfield forever.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E02 - The Yellow Lotus
36.plot: The Simpsons encounter death on vacation at a high-end resort.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E03 - Desperately Seeking Lisa
36.plot: Lisa has a blazing misadventure in the dark world of Capital City's downtown art scene.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E04 - Shoddy Heat
36.plot: An unearthed corpse opens up a cold case from Springfield in the 1980s… as well as a steamy relationship between young Grampa and Agnes Skinner.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E05 - Treehouse of Horror XXXV
36.plot: Giant monsters created by political rage threaten to tear the town apart, a Victorian Mr. Burns is jump-scared on Thanksgiving by the ghosts of his abused workers, and Homer bonds with a pair of extra-terrestrial jeans in an unforgettable stop-motion adventure that can only be called… Denim.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E06 - Women in Shorts
36.plot: Girls just want to have funny.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E07 - Treehouse of Horror Presents: Simpsons Wicked This Way Comes
36.plot: A tattooed man at a mysterious night circus transports Lisa into three strange stories from the innocent 1950s, the chilling retro-present, and a brutalist future where prestige TV rules the world.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E08 - Convenience Airways
36.plot: The Simpsons are trapped on a flight with the most unruly passengers in America.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E09 - Homer and Her Sisters
36.plot: After a fight in an escape room, Krusty's truth-telling Aunt fixes Homer's relationship with Patty and Selma.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E10 - The Man Who Flew Too Much
36.plot: The new and improved Pin Pals travel to Capital City for their first ever state bowling championship.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E11 - Bottle Episode
36.plot: Marge and Smithers team up to become wine-forging Robin Hoods.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E12 - The Flandshees of Innersimpson
36.plot: Bart dips his toe into the world of celebrity DJ-ing, and Homer finally pushes Flanders too far.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E13 - The Last Man Expanding
36.plot: Springfield becomes hooked on a miracle weight loss drug... all except Homer.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E14 - P.S. I Hate You
36.plot: Marge's "nice-lady" reputation is on the line when an unknown blackmailer threatens to expose the angry woman she is inside.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E15 - Abe League of Their Moe
36.plot: After Grampa and Moe recruit a Macedonian slugger to play in Springfield, it strains their friendship and the very integrity of baseball.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E16 - Stew Lies
36.plot: Homer reinvigorates a celebrity chef's lost passion for food... with some help from the mob.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E17 - Full Heart, Empty Pool
36.plot: Homer and Grampa team up to create a new sport that rivals pickleball, until Homer kicks Grampa off the team.

36.title: FR - Les Simpson - S36E18 - Estranger Things
36.plot: When Bart & Lisa stop watching Itchy & Scratchy together, Marge fears that they'll start to drift apart... but she has no idea how bad things are about to get!

37.title: FR - Les Simpson - S37E01 - Thrifty Ways to Thieve Your Mother
37.plot: When Lisa starts wearing Marge's "vintage" clothes from the 90's, she's welcomed into the school's super-elite fashion club. But as they run out of retro looks, the funky fashionistas become obsessed with getting more... by hook or by crook.

37.title: FR - Les Simpson - S37E02 - Keep Chalm and Gary On
37.plot: Homer gets Superintendent Chalmers a job at the power plant. There, Chalmers discovers huge mutated snails that produce valuable slime launching his new career as a man-o-sphere guru.

37.title: FR - Les Simpson - S37E03 - Treehouse of Horror XXXVI
37.plot: Springfield is threatened by a mysterious killer monster emerging from the sewers, Krusty welcomes a demonic guest to his Halloween special, and the action moves a thousand years into the future in a post-apocalyptic, plastic version of the city.

37.title: FR - Les Simpson - S37E04 - Men Behaving Manly
FR - Les Simpson - S37E05 - Bad Boys... for Life?
37.plot: Is Bart Simpson truly a bad seed? Homer and Marge must find out once and for good.

37.title: FR - Les Simpson - S37E06 - Bart 'N' Frink
37.plot: When Bart becomes Professor Frink's lab assistant, the Simpsons are thrown into a world of tech billionaires determined to live forever, with the future of the internet at stake.

37.title: FR - Les Simpson - S37E07 - Sashes to Sashes
37.plot: Bart runs against Mayor Quimby's son for student council president, while Lisa learns troubling secrets about the Quimby clan... and about the Simpsons.

meta.plot: Située à Springfield, ville américaine moyenne, la série se concentre sur les singeries et les aventures quotidiennes de la famille Simpson : Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa et Maggie, ainsi que des milliers d'autres personnages.

1.title: FR - Comme deux frères - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: The night before a crucial football match, Pini and Nisso are out to make sure the opposition don't get any sleep. Sparks fly when the plan backfires.

1.title: FR - Comme deux frères - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Still in shock from the doctor's announcement, the pair contemplate their futures. Nisso makes a hard decision — before hearing more bad news.

1.title: FR - Comme deux frères - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Still reeling from his diagnosis, Nisso continues acting recklessly. Pini steps in to help, and together they look for new ways to save the bar.

1.title: FR - Comme deux frères - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Pini has his suspicions about the incident next door and decides his partying days are over. Nisso visits Rotem, leaving her even more confused.

1.title: FR - Comme deux frères - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: On a trip away together, Pini looks for a way to explain his decision to his friend. But before he can do so, Nisso gets into even more trouble.

1.title: FR - Comme deux frères - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: A night out proves eventful for the Beitar fans. Searching for a quiet spot, Nisso and Pini end up in a metal bar — and meet some unfriendly regulars.

1.title: FR - Comme deux frères - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: News from last night spreads fast and worries Alma. In Krakow, Nisso avoids Pini and befriends a mysterious stranger.

1.title: FR - Comme deux frères - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Rescued by Pini yet again, Nisso finally tells him the truth. With both their futures depending on the outcome, the long-awaited match kicks off.

meta.plot: Après avoir reçu de troublantes nouvelles, deux meilleurs amis voyagent de Jérusalem à Cracovie pour assister à un match de football dans l'espoir d'oublier leurs soucis.

meta.plot: Le téléroman raconte la vie des locataires d'une résidence étudiante. Avec les jeunes qu'elle accueillait en pension dans sa maison, Louise a certainement joué tous les rôles et les professions possibles: mère, infirmière, confidente, psychologue, agente de probation, etc. Tous ces jeunes étudiants l'aimaient bien et ce n'est pas pour rien que la plupart revenaient à chaque année. Certains finissaient par voler de leurs propres ailes, mais Louise restait toujours disponible pour eux. Malgré tous leurs sentiments pour elle, ils réussissaient à lui en faire voir de toutes les couleurs; guerres entre pensionnaires, amour (souvent surpris en pleine action!), maladie (on introduit le sida par le personnage de Caroline), tours et gaffes, etc. Et ce cher Pete réalisait plus que sa part de frasques et de renversements! Les sept années du téléroman passées à l'antenne ont permis aux téléspectateurs de rire et de pleurer au gré des émissions. Il est à noter que l'engouement qu'a rapidement créé la série (2,5 millions de téléspectateurs), a fait en sorte que TVA a demandé à l'auteur de faire passer de 30 minutes à 60 minutes la durée des épisodes entre la 1re et la 2e saison.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E01 - The Story of Daigo
1.plot: In Japan's Warring States period, Lord Daigo Kagemitsu makes a pact with 12 demons, offering them his unborn son in exchange for the prosperity of his lands. Years later, young thief Dororo is attacked by a ghoul but rescued by a mysterious boy, whose body parts turn out to be almost entirely prosthetic.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E02 - The Story of Bandai
1.plot: Dororo and Hyakkimaru happen upon a village and are brought before its chief, Lady Bandai. However, Hyakkimaru inexplicably draws his sword in her presence, resulting in both him and Dororo being locked in a storehouse by the villagers. It turns out they are not the only ones confined there...

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E02 - The Story of Bandai
1.plot: Dororo and Hyakkimaru happen upon a village and are brought before its chief, Lady Bandai. However, Hyakkimaru inexplicably draws his sword in her presence, resulting in both him and Dororo being locked in a storehouse by the villagers. It turns out they are not the only ones confined there...

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E03 - The Story of Jukai
1.plot: Jukai is a doctor who travels the land fitting prosthetic arms and legs to those who have lost their limbs in war. One day, on the riverbank he finds a baby missing most of its body parts. He decides to raise the child, who he names “Hyakkimaru”. Jukai provides the child with prostheses, but the time comes when Hyakkimaru sets out on a journey to recover his own body parts.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E04 - The Story of the Cursed Sword
1.plot: Dororo Onikimaru confronts Tanosuke, a manly slaughter. The sword he wields was a cursed decoy where the devil lives. Although barely dismissing Tanosuke, the military sword has passed over to the hands of the hands and the horsemans are manipulated by the weapon.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E05 - The Story of the Moriko Song, Part 1
1.plot: Struggling to adapt to an unfamiliar world of "sound", Hyakkimaru is injured in a fight with a ghoul. He is taken in and nursed by a girl named Mio, who looks after children orphaned by war. However, after becoming aware of a demon nearby, Hyakkimaru heads out to fight it before he is fully recovered.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E06 - The Story of the Moriko Song, Part 2
1.plot: Hyakkimaru has regained his voice from the devil god, but one leg was stolen from him. After returning to the deserted temple and having his wounds taken care of, he again goes into battle with the demon. Meanwhile, in the abandoned temple where Mio and the children are waiting ...

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E07 - The Story of the Jorogumo Silk Spider
1.plot: The spider-like ghoul Jorogumo is wounded by Hyakkimaru. To heal itself, it transforms into a woman and takes advantage of the hospitality of a young man named Yajiro. Having let Jorogumo slip through their fingers, Dororo and Hyakkimaru stop at a village where they hear rumors of a kidnapper at large.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E08 - The Story of Saru
1.plot: At a certain village, young girls are offered up as ritual sacrifices to appease a giant centipede demon that appears shrouded in black clouds. Hyakkimaru and Dororo team up with Saru, a boy whose older sister has been offered as a sacrifice, and together they confront the demon.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E09 - The Story of Mercilessness
1.plot: Dororo comes down with a high fever. While woozy from its effects, the youngster catches a glimpse of some red spider lilies, which stirs up memories of past days spent with parents Hibukuro and Ojiya.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E10 - The Story of Tahomaru
1.plot: A village within Daigo's domain is being terrorized by a ghoul that dwells in a nearby lake. Tahomaru, accompanied by his aides Hyogo and Mutsu, volunteers to exterminate the ghoul.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E11 - The Story of Banmon, Part 1
1.plot: After entering Lord Daigo's domain, Dororo and Hyakkimaru hear tales of Banmon, the huge wall that is the last remnant of a fort that once stood on the border. Hyakkimaru squares off against the fox demon that haunts the wall.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E12 - The Story of Banmon, Part 2
1.plot: Kagemitsu, who offered up his own son to the demons. Hyakkimaru, who is trying to get back the body parts that were taken from him. As if drawn together by fate, they face each other.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E13 - The Story of the Blank-faced Buddha
1.plot: Having left Daigo's domain, Dororo finds a statue of Fudo, one of the wisdom gods. But the statue is actually a demon that is harvesting humans' faces in an attempt to find one for itself.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E14 - The Story of Sabame
1.plot: Dororo and Hyakkimaru come across an abandoned, burnt-out temple, where they meet a man named Sabame who rules the surrounding area. Sabame invites the two of them to his residence and tells them the story behind the burnt-out temple and the ghoul that haunts it. However, Dororo and Hyakkimaru suspect that he might not be telling the truth.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E15 - The Story of the Scene from Hell
1.plot: Sabame has been feeding people to the demons to protect the village over which he rules. As Hyakkimaru once again confronts the demon moths, Dororo gets trapped in a storehouse.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E16 - The Story of Shiranui
1.plot: Dororo has been captured by Itachi and is being taken to the cape where Hibukuro supposedly hid the money. As Itachi and his men look for boats to get across to the cape, they are approached by a one-armed boy named Shiranui.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E17 - The Story of Questions and Answers
1.plot: Jukai is reunited with a bloodied Hyakkimaru at the site of a recent battle, and finds out the truth of how Hyakkimaru and the demons are connected. Hyakkimaru asks Jukai for a new prosthetic leg, but...

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E18 - The Story of the Cape of Impermanence
1.plot: The shark demon lets out a roar and attacks Dororo, who is tied up and unable to move. Meanwhile, a troop of soldiers commanded by Tahomaru is also approaching the cape.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E19 - The Story of the Amanojaku
1.plot: To fix Hyakkimaru's broken sword, he and Dororo travel to a village where a master swordmaker named Munetsuna lives. Upon arriving at Munetsuna's house, they are met by his daughter Okowa.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E20 - The Story of Nue
1.plot: While traveling along a mountain path in search of a demon, Dororo and Hyakkimaru encounter a young man named Dice-spot Saburota. The man says that he too is hunting the demon, and they set off to exterminate it together.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E21 - The Story of Breaking the Cycle of Suffering
1.plot: Daigo Kagemitsu continues to prepare for war with the neighboring land of Asakura. Upon receiving word that Hyakkimaru is approaching his domain, Kagemitsu sends Tahomaru to dispose of him.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E23 - The Story of the Demons
1.plot: Hyakkimaru comes face to face with Tahomaru, Mutsu and Hyogo, who have been possessed by the power of demons. Dororo, Lady Nui and Biwamaru hurry to the scene, where they witness a ferocious battle that will determine the future of the land of Daigo.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E24 - Dororo and Hyakkimaru
1.plot: Daigo's castle is engulfed in flames. Within, two brothers by blood are at the mercy of fate. Dororo, Jukai and Lady Nui also head for the castle, each with their own thoughts weighing down upon their hearts. For a life that began with a silenced cry, where will the path of destiny lead?

meta.plot: A samurai lord has bartered away his newborn son's organs to forty-eight demons in exchange for dominance on the battlefield. Yet, the abandoned infant survives thanks to a medicine man who equips him with primitive prosthetics—lethal ones with which the wronged son will use to hunt down the multitude of demons to reclaim his body one piece at a time, before confronting his father. On his journeys the young hero encounters an orphan who claims to be the greatest thief in Japan.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E01 - Are You Happy in Your Life?
1.plot: Physics professor and family man Jason Dessen is abducted from everything he loves.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E02 - Trip of a Lifetime
1.plot: Jason wakes to a life that makes no sense—he doesn't have a family and he's created something extraordinary.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E03 - The Box
1.plot: Leighton and Amanda show Jason his groundbreaking invention. Daniela and Jason2 throw a dinner party.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E04 - The Corridor
1.plot: Jason and Amanda fight to stay alive in the dangerous Corridor. Jason2 makes some life changes and visits an old friend.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E05 - Worldless
1.plot: As they learn more about the Box, Jason and Amanda see alternate versions of their lives. Jason2 begins training a potential investor.

meta.plot: Un physicien, professeur et père de famille qui, alors qu’il rentre chez lui un soir à pied dans les rues de Chicago, est projeté dans une version alternative de sa propre vie. L’émerveillement se transforme rapidement en cauchemar quand il essaie de retourner à sa réalité perdue dans le paysage hallucinant des vies qu’il aurait pu vivre. Dans ce labyrinthe de réalités, il s’embarque dans un voyage éprouvant pour retrouver sa véritable famille et la sauver de l’ennemi le plus terrifiant et invincible : lui-même.

5.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S05E12 - Dora Saves the Three Lil' Piggies
5.plot: Swiper swipes the Three Little Piggies' bricks... now the story can't end right! It's up to Dora, Boots and Swiper to save the story!

5.plot: When the Super Babies have a nap, Dora and Boots travel to the Dream Castle.

5.plot: Dora and Boots need to get back home before Dora's birthday party starts.

6.plot: Dora and her friends must find all the constellations after a meteor shower scares them away.

6.plot: Dora and Boots rescue a special wishing wand for the Birthday Wizzle.

6.plot: As Dora is preparing for a dance recital, the Delivery Duck brings her scuba flippers instead of ballet slippers. Now, Dora and Boots must find the slippers before the recital begins. 6.plot: It's a big day of firsts when Boots gets his first bike from the bike shop.

6.plot: Dora and Boots must help Little Monster find a costume so he can march in the Halloween parade.

When he tries to turn him back into a monkey, he lets out a big sneeze that propels the magic wand into Magic Land. Dora and friends set off on a magic-filled journey in order to get the wand fixed so Boots can become a monkey again.

6.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S06E16 - Swiper's Favorite Things
6.plot: Swiper is packing all of his favorite things for a sleepover at his Grandma’s House — his pajama trunk, his favorite puppy book, and his very special funny bunny. Just as he is about to leave, a big wind gust comes in and blows everything away! Dora and Swiper journey to Crocodile Lake, through the Jumbled Trees, and race to Strawberry Hill to get Swiper’s favorite things back

6.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S06E17 - A Ribbon for Pinto
6.plot: Dora, Boots and Pinto are heading to the big horse show, but the train breaks down on the way.

6.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S06E18 - Dora's Knighthood Adventure
6.plot: Boots loves to hear stories about knights who go on heroic adventures and Don Quixote (Andy Garcia) tells Dora and Boots that anyone can be a knight as long as they help others. Boots would love to be a knight and so would his friends Rocinante the horse and Dapple the donkey, but they need someone to rescue. Dora takes out her spotting scope and they discover a princess calling out for help from the Royal Garden. Dora, Boots, Rocinante and Dapple set out through the Puppet Stage, past Tico’s Carousel to get to the Royal Garden and save the princess.

7.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S07E01 - Dora's Rescue in Mermaid Kingdom
7.plot: Dora and Boots turn into sea creatures to help a lost mermaid return to her mother.

7.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S07E02 - Dora's Easter Adventure
7.plot: Swiper’s up to no good again and Dora, Boots and their new friend the Hip-Hop Bunny must stop him.

7.plot: Dora and her friends explore Troll Land, a secret place where the Grumpy Old Troll lives. In this kind of dimension, everything rhymes.

7.plot: Dora makes a kite for her Papi on Father's Day, and must retrieve it when it gets blown away.

7.plot: Dora and Boots are practicing for the Fantastic Gymnastics Show when Dora gets a special delivery: a beautiful rainbow ribbon. But Swiper came and swiped the ribbon so the duo must get it back in time for the show.

7.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S07E06 - School Science Fair
7.plot: Dora and Emma are bringing a project volcano to the Green Power Science Fair with new friends.

7.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S07E07 - Dora's Moonlight Adventure
7.plot: Dora takes care of some kittens for Abuela, but they go missing.

7.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S07E08 - Perrito's Big Surprise
7.plot: There's a surprise waiting for Perrito, but Swiper wants to swipe the present! Will Dora be able to prevent Swiper from doing so at Surprise Hill?

7.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S07E09 - Dora and Diego's Amazing Animal Circus
7.plot: Boots and Baby Jaguar are having an animal circus, and Dora and Diego rush to get there.

7.plot: Benny gets stranded on the crazy, deserted Coconut Island, and it's up to Dora and Boots to save him.

7.plot: Dora and Boots take Baby Bongo on a musical adventure as they race to the Big Music Show in time for Baby Bongo's first performance.

7.plot: Dora and Boots rush to get Dora's float back for the Thanksgiving Day parade when the Pirate Piggies cause it to fly away.

7.plot: Dora and Boots visit the library, where they jump into books, meet characters of books, and help them find their lost items.

7.plot: Dora is at the doctor's office for her yearly check up. There, she meets a few animals who are sick and learns that getting a shot isn't as bad as it looks.

7.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S07E16 - Little Map
7.plot: Map shows his nephew, Little Map, how to draw pictures and make a treasure map. Soon, Dora and Boots go on a treasure hunt of their own.

7.title: FR - Dora the Explorer - S07E17 - Vamos a Pintar! (Let's Paint!)
7.plot: Dora and Boots have to bring their special paintbrush to help their painter friend at the art studio.

7.plot: Dora and Boots have to get to Benny's barn so they can use Dora's microphone to invite their friends over for a sing-along party.

7.plot: Dora and Boots must help their butterfly friend, Mariposa, attend the Butterfly Ball, where everyone gets their special set of wings.

8.plot: Dora and her pals accompany a bunch of puppies to rescue a young dog named Little Boots.

8.plot: Dora and Boots make a train out of shapes in Boots' sticker book, and they jump in to retrieve the forgotten steering wheel before the train heads for the final turn on the tracks.

8.plot: Dora reads "The Three Little Kittens" to Abuela's new cat, Lucky, and jumps into the book of nursery rhymes to help the kittens find their mittens.

8.plot: Dora, Boots, and Verde the Clean-Up Truck must clear up a flood at Party Park in time for Verde's birthday party.

8.plot: Dora helps Sparky the Horse feel better, and then takes him for a ride before returning him to the barn.

8.plot: Dora and Boots put on their roller skates and take off on a skating adventure to open Skate Park for everyone.

8.plot: Dora and Diego travel back to prehistoric times and go on a dinosaur adventure.

1.plot: Simon’s apparent courtship of Daphne angers her brother Anthony and threatens to ruin the arrangements he made. Marina opens up to a curious Penelope.

1.plot: After Daphne catches the eye of a royal suitor, she turns to Simon for relationship advice. Lady Featherington tries to browbeat Marina into marriage.

1.plot: Daphne receives a stunning gift from Prince Friedrich but soon courts scandal at a ball. Eloise searches for clues to Lady Whistledown's identity.

1.plot: On her honeymoon, Daphne discovers just how uninformed she is about the physical aspects of the marital bed. Colin comes to a decision about Marina.

1.title: FR - Bridgerton - S01E07 - Oceans Apart
1.plot: Amid accusations of lies and betrayal, a rift forms between the newlyweds, while a deception of another kind could besmirch the Bridgerton family name.

1.plot: The duke and duchess's season-ending ball signals a turning point for their marriage — and ushers in changes of fortune and fate to those around them.

2.plot: Anthony begins his search for a wife, Eloise braves her society debut, and Lady Danbury helps the queen choose a diamond among the season's debutantes.

2.title: FR - Bridgerton - S02E02 - Off to the Races
2.plot: Facing heated competition and a prickly foe, Anthony steps up his courtship game. Eloise makes a Lady Whistledown discovery as a family member returns.

2.title: FR - Bridgerton - S02E03 - A Bee in Your Bonnet
2.plot: The Sharmas arrive at the Bridgerton's country estate, where Anthony seeks to win Kate's good opinion amid bad memories and a ruthless game of pall-mall.

2.title: FR - Bridgerton - S02E04 - Victory
2.plot: As guests gather for the Bridgerton's ball, Anthony and Kate clash during a hunting party, Colin revisits the past, and Lady Featherington sets a trap.

2.plot: Rattled by Anthony's hasty nuptial plans, Kate receives advice from Lady Danbury. Eloise spars with a new ally. Emotions run high during a dinner party.

2.title: FR - Bridgerton - S02E06 - The Choice
2.plot: Anthony's duty to his family wars with his desire for Kate. Edwina ponders her future — and impresses the queen. Eloise's rendezvous stirs suspicion.

2.title: FR - Bridgerton - S02E07 - Harmony
2.plot: Scandalous rumors swirl around the Bridgertons and the Sharmas. The queen’s ire over Lady Whistledown lands Eloise and Penelope in a quandary.

2.title: FR - Bridgerton - S02E08 - The Viscount Who Loved Me
2.plot: Anthony lashes out as he awaits news of Kate, while Eloise turns to Theo for help in her Lady Whistledown hunt and Lady Featherington plans a grand ball.

3.title: FR - Bridgerton - S03E01 - Out of the Shadows
3.plot: The debutantes enter the marriage mart as Francesca navigates her first season out. A well-traveled bachelor returns, and Penelope unveils a new look.

3.title: FR - Bridgerton - S03E02 - How Bright the Moon
3.plot: Penelope begins her private lessons in charming suitors, but the arrangement quickly grows complicated. A dazzling debutante seizes the queen's attention.

3.title: FR - Bridgerton - S03E03 - Forces of Nature
3.plot: Penelope catches the eye of nature-loving Lord Debling, to the dismay of other admirers. A near-catastrophe on a windy day makes a hero out of Colin.

3.title: FR - Bridgerton - S03E06 - Romancing Mister Bridgerton

3.title: FR - Bridgerton - S03E08 - Into the Light
3.plot: With a rival threatening to divulge her secret for money, Penelope chooses the best path forward as her relationships and livelihood hang in the balance.

FR - Bridgerton - S04E04 - An Offer from a Gentleman
FR - Bridgerton - S04E05 - Yes or No

4.title: FR - Bridgerton - S04E07 - The Beyond
4.plot: The Bridgerton family unites in the wake of a tragedy. Sophie's plans hit a snag. Benedict faces a heartwrenching choice.

4.title: FR - Bridgerton - S04E08 - Dance in the Country
4.plot: With Sophie in peril and the entire family's reputation at stake, the Bridgertons must rely on the ton's most powerful currency: scandal.

1.title: FR - The Big Cigar - S01E01 - Panther / Producer
1.plot: On the heels of his overturned conviction, Huey P. Newton reignites a revolution and meets an unexpected donor.

1.title: FR - The Big Cigar - S01E02 - The Cuban
1.plot: Huey and Bert's bold plan falls into place. Huey attempts to move the Black Panther Party away from armed confrontation.

1.title: FR - The Big Cigar - S01E03 - Guns & Matzah
1.plot: Huey and Eldridge stand divided. Bert and Steve clash over Huey. The road to Cuba becomes increasingly treacherous.

meta.plot: Black Panther Party co-founder Huey P. Newton enlists an unlikely ally—Hollywood producer Bert Schneider—to elude an FBI manhunt and escape to Cuba.

1.title: FR - Baccano! - S01E01 - The Vice President Doesn't Say Anything about the Possibility of Him Being the Main Character
1.plot: It's 1931 and Carol, the assistant of the Daily Days vice president Gustav St-Germain, is researching a bunch of astonishing events that have been occurring for the past several years. She struggles to determine the lead character of it all and in the midst of this, delves into the story that begins with the turf war between the Runorata family and the Gandor family. Gustavo of the Runorata family is said to have killed Luck and Firo, so to cover up his mess he needs to take care of Dallas. Meanwhile an incident has occurred on the Flying Pussyfoot and Ludd and Lua are found as survivors, but not without sustaining injuries.

1.title: FR - Baccano! - S01E02 - Setting the Old Woman's Qualms Aside, the Flying Pussyfoot Departs
1.plot: In the late 1930 of California, Isaac and Miria are in a mine digging for gold and months pass without any success. They receive a letter from Ennis in New York, who ask for them to return but they don't have any money. So after stealing some cash from the mafia they board the Flying Pussyfoot to New York, where they happen to spot a lot of suspicious characters. Whilst Isaac and Miria are getting acquainted with Jacuzzi and Nice something to do with the "Lemurs" is about to begin.

1.title: FR - Baccano! - S01E03 - Randy and Pecho Are Busy Getting Ready for the Party
1.plot: In 1932, Eve is watching the Hudson River in New York being dug up. The story then moves to 1931, when Runorata men come to the Daily Days for information on Dallas. Meanwhile in New York two idiots end up accidentally setting a storehouse on fire, where old man Barnes has been able to obtain the Immortality Elixir. Barnes manages to escape with 2 bottles but ends up getting into some trouble shortly afterwards. Back in the Flying Pussyfoot, everything is about to go down.

1.title: FR - Baccano! - S01E04 - Ladd Russo Enjoys Talking a Lot and Slaughtering a Lot
1.plot: 10 hours before the Flying Pussyfoot departs, in California, Russo learns that his cash was stolen by a couple and one of his underlings was killed. Then Ladd barges in and shows Russo just how much of a homicidal maniac his before heading to the Flying Pussyfoot with his subordinates. Back to the Flying Pussyfoot, Vicky has been killed by the "Lemurs" and yet again Ladd shows how much of a maniac he is. In New York Isaac and Miria happily enter the hat shop and after their purchase they are hit by the car Ennis is driving. She happens to be chauffeuring Szilard to the secret society of old geezers.

1.title: FR - Baccano! - S01E05 - Jacuzzi Splot Cries, Gets Scared and Musters Reckless Valor
1.plot: It's 1931 the day before the Flying Pussyfoot departs and Jacuzzi is about to be killed by some of Russo's men. Back to the Flying Pussyfoot, Jacuzzi discovers the dead bodies of the conductor, and Nice and Donny arrive at the conductor's cabin as well. In New York in 1930, Mr. Barnes wakes to discover he's in the location of the secret social society and Szilard wants to find out exactly what happened. Back to 1931, Gustavo is annoyed that his subordinates couldn't get any info on Dallas' location so he personally goes there himself to find out. Meanwhile Firo is inaugurated into the Camorras after a swear-in ceremony and a knife-fight with Maiza.

1.title: FR - Baccano! - S01E06 - The Rail Tracer Covertly, Repeatedly Slaughters Inside the Coaches
1.plot: 1931 on board the Flying Pussyfoot, the "Rail Tracer" appears to be killing of members of the "Lumeres" for reasons yet unknown. In New York in 1930, Dallas and his gang go to Luck for some help after running into some trouble but they get thrown out and end up leaving the crate he took from Mr Barnes. Back on the Flying Pussyfoot, Czeslaw leaves Mary in a broom closet in order to search for some Immortals. Meanwhile Nice, Jacuzzi and Donny rescue Nick who was tied up. Back to New York Isaac and Miria are busy reminiscing when all of a sudden they run into Dallas who is in a really bad mood. While they are beating up Isaac, Ennis knocks them out but only because she was ordered to take them back. Later that day Gustavo plans to kidnap Eve and use her to lure out Dallas.

1.title: FR - Baccano! - S01E07 - Everything Starts Aboard the Advenna Avis
1.plot: It's 1711 aboard the Advena Avis ship and a group of alchemists lead by Maiza is about to attempt summoning a demon to grant them the Immortal elixir. The summoning was proven to be a success and the demon granted them all the elixir, with 3 rules to go along with the elixir. Because they all follow Maiza's decision not to share the knowledge with those outside the group, it isn't long before someone gets greedy for the knowledge and that person is Szilard.

1.title: FR - Baccano! - S01E08 - Isaac and Miria Unintentionally Spread Happiness Around Them
1.plot: In 1931 onboard the Flying Pussyfoot, Issac and Miria realize that they forgot to get Ennis a souvenir and Jacuzzi, Nice, Donny and Nick decide to search for the Rail Tracer. In New York in 1930, whilst Eve is crying over her missing brother she overhears Isaac and Miria's supposedly "quiet" conversation and goes out to investigate. After a while Eve begins to enjoy their company and even tells them about her brother Dallas, so in their way of helping Isaac and Miria decide to rob the Genoard family assets. On the Flying Pussyfoot, Jacuzzi and co. discover that their friends are missing so he instructions them to split up into 2 groups to search for them.

1.title: FR - Baccano! - S01E09 - Claire Stanfield Faithfully Carries Out the Mission
1.plot: 1931 on board the Flying Pussyfoot, Ladd flips out after discovering the bodies in the conductor's cabin, with one of them being a fat conductor and Dune. It then reveals exactly what occurred in the conductor's cabin and how the Rail Tracer is in fact an elusive assassin Claire Stanfield/Vino. 1932 in New York, Rachel finally arrives back at the Daily Days to reveal to Nicholas and the president of DD all the information she gathered, based on her own experience. Back to 1930, Dallas and his gang wake up after being injected by Mr Barnes' Immortal Elixir and after eating on of them Szilard decides to use them against the Gandors.

1.title: FR - Baccano! - S01E10 - Czeslaw Meyer is Forced to Rework His Tremble-Before-the-Specter-of-Immortals Strategy
1.plot: Newfoundland 1931, Senator Beriam goes to see Huey Laforet in prison, to inform him of the situation that is happening on board the Flying Pussyfoot but Huey seems to understand the situation seeing how his daughter Chane is there. Meanwhile Czeslaw is trying to make a deal with Ladd, in order for him to find an Immortal but Ladd declines. 1932 in New York, Eve escapes from Gustavo's clutches and is picked up by Elean from the Daily Days. She then tells him to go to the Gandor headquarters in order to get some info on her brother Dallas. In 1930, Isaac and Miria are plotting their next robbery when they see Dallas carrying the box of elixir and steal it from him. After discovering the contents of the crate and thinking it is just alcohol, they head to the Martillo's office.

1.title: FR - Baccano! - S01E11 - Chane Laforet Remains Silent in the Face of Two Mysterious People
1.plot: 1931 on top of the Flying Pussyfoot, Chane is fighting Ladd but is forced to run away. After discovering this Goose orders his men to kill Chane if necessary and Ladd is able find out about this, after squeezing one of their men for information. Meanwhile Czeslaw is plotting his next move when all of a sudden Claire appears before him and enacts his one form of torture. After taking care of him, Claire goes on top of the Flying Pussyfoot to greet Ladd and Chane. New York in 1930, Maiza goes to the restaurant where he discovers Szilard who is waiting for him. Szilard reveals to Maiza what he's been getting up to and what he hopes to achieve, with the Immortal Elixir. In 1932, following all the commotion; Runorata enters the Gandor's office, desiring to know Dallas's whereabouts.

1.title: FR - Baccano! - S01E12 - Firo and the Three Gandor Brothers Are Felled by Assassins' Bullets
1.plot: 1932 in the Daily Days news office, Rachel continues to give her account on what she did that led up to her leg injury. After rescuing the Mary and Natalie, she moves on to the next cart to risk her life by saving Nice and Nick. 1930 in New York, Firo and Ennis are held at gun point by Dallas when all of a sudden the Gandors arrive to return Dallas the favour. During all the commotion Maiza finds an opportunity to escape and when Szilard tries to pursue him he gets hit by a car that Isaac is driving. 1931 on board the Flying Pussyfoot, Claire forces Ladd to risk his life to save Lua, whilst Jacuzzi is trying save everyone on the train but gets caught in a fire-fight with Goose.

1.title: FR - Baccano! - S01E13 - Both the Immortals and Those Who Aren't Sing the Praises of Life Equally
1.plot: 1931 on top of the Flying Pussyfoot, Claire is thinking whether he should kill or not kill Chane but instead comes out and proposes to her. Meanwhile Jacuzzi is having a stand off with Goose when he finally gets an opportunity to use the gift Nice gave him early. Isaac and Miria are also on the train roof when they see something coming towards Czeslaw and try to protect him thinking it's the Rail Tracer. New York in 1930, Ennis betrays Szilard and just when he is about to finish Ennis off all the guys who were shot early, including Firo, suddenly emerge. It is time for Szilard to receive his retribution. New York in 2001, Isaac and Miria are up to their usual mishaps.

1.title: FR - Baccano! - S01E14 -
FR - Baccano! - S01E15 -
FR - Baccano! - S01E16 -

meta.plot: During the early 1930s in Chicago, the transcontinental train, Flying Pussyfoot, is starting its legendary journey that will leave a trail of blood all over the country. At the same time in New York, the ambitious scientist Szilard and his unwilling aide Ennis are looking for missing bottles of the immortality elixir. In addition, a war between the mafia groups is getting worse. On board the Advena Avis, in 1711, alchemists are about to learn the price of immortality. Takes place in the same universe as Durarara (2010).

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E01 - Can't Catch Koko
1.plot: When Harrison breaks down, Koko volunteers to replace him on the night shift, but Vee insists that Wilson and Brewster go too. Koko protests that Brewster will slow them down and races off, but when Koko is stranded on her own, due to a power cut, Wilson and Brewster must find a way to rescue her.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E02 - Wilson and the Elephant
1.plot: Brewster, Koko and Wilson are taking the animals from the old Zoo to the new Zoo. Wilson is determined to get his animal transportation badge by taking Ebo the elephant safely to his new home. The naughty elephant has other ideas, however.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E03 - Clunky Wilson
1.plot: Brewster delivers some feed to the Safari Park and hurries back to practise picking up mail sacks, unaware that he has a naughty monkey stowaway on board!

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E04 - Koko and the Tunnel
1.plot: The trainees are heading for a lesson with Dunbar in the training yard when an underground tunnel catches Koko's eye. She wants to explore it but Vee says she isn't ready yet. When no one is looking, Koko decides she's going to see where that tunnel goes, but ends up coming off the tracks.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E05 - Braking Brewster
1.plot: Wilson and Koko are having lots of fun racing each other until Wilson damages his bogie spring. He's scared of going to the repair shed to get it fixed, so he tries to put on a brave face and ignore the problem while delivering milk to the farmers' fair.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E06 - Hodge and the Magnet
1.plot: The trainees must learn how to do difficult emergency stops with mud, leaves and water on the rails. Wilson loves getting dirty but he'll do anything he can to avoid going through the automatic Chugwash!

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E07 - Koko and the Squirrels
1.plot: Koko has her first big solo job, delivering timber to the paper mill, but she ignores Old Puffer Pete's advice to take it slow and ends up coming off the track and spilling her load!

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E08 - Wilson Gets A Wash
1.plot: Mtambo is training Wilson and Brewster to help out as guides at the safari park. He tells them to pay close attention to what he tells them about the animals but, as usual, Wilson is impatient and slips away to take some children on a tour.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E09 - Brewster Goes Bananas
1.plot: The chuggers learn how to carry passengers comfortably using dummies specially made to wobble if the ride isn't smooth. When poor Wilson struggles to drive smoothly, Eddie has an idea that just might help him.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E10 - Bang Clang Wilson
1.plot: Part of the track is out and there is chaos in Chuggington! Vee needs Eddie to repair the track but he is late for work again. As Hodge prepares the magnetic crane, Wilson persuades him to do the repairs by himself.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E11 - Old Puffer Pete's Tour
1.plot: Eddie lives so far away from Chuggington that he just can't seem to get into work on time. After getting into trouble with Morgan yet again, Hodge and the trainees set out to find a new home for Eddie in Chuggington.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E12 - Late Again Eddie
1.plot: Brewster is in a hurry to get back from a job at the mountain quarry, and he doesn't believe Dunbar's lessons about braking. When his heavy load sends him downhill too fast, quick-thinking Wilson has to help his friend get stopped in time.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E13 - Wilson's Smooth Moves
1.plot: It is time for the annual Chugger Championship Race, and Koko is sure she can win. She spends hours practising and ends up arguing with Wilson. When Wilson breaks down during the race, Koko must choose whether to help him, or keep going and win.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E14 - Cool Wilson
1.plot: Koko is yearning for adventure and she just might get it, as today the chuggers are making deliveries out of town. Vee asks old Puffer Pete to join them and, during their travels, they come across a mysterious old track that leads to Old Chuggington, which is now a ghost town.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E15 - The Chugger Championships
1.plot: The trainees are learning how to use ice cream cars today, and the great Frostini is going to test them on their skills. When Wilson's car breaks down, Puffer Pete comes to the rescue, pulling out his old steam driven ice cream wagon.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E16 - Action Brewster
1.plot: Brewster is so excited about seeing the new Action Chugger movie, but Irving sends him to the foundry and Brewster worries he won't be back in time for the film unless he can be as speedy as his Super chugger hero.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E17 - Koko's Puppy Training
1.plot: Koko finds a lost puppy and wants to keep it. She is convinced she can look after him and practice the new task delivering newspapers, but Koko soon runs into trouble.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E18 - Zephie's Zoomaround
1.plot: Everyone loves Frostini, the cool Italian ice cream chugger. Wilson wants to be just like him, so he's especially excited to learn that Frostini needs a helper for the school holidays.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E19 - Koko on Call
1.plot: When Zephie gets lost on the way to the farm, she shouts for help but no one hears her. Morgan fits her with a siren for emergencies but Zephie can't resist setting it off at every opportunity!

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E20 - Outward Bound Olwin
1.plot: Twiga the giraffe is having a baby. An excited Koko is given the important job of keeping watch overnight and fetching Doctor Gosling, the vet.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E21 - Brewster and The Dragon
1.plot: Olwin takes Brewster, Wilson and Koko on an outward bound training course, but when she treats them like babies, they hide in the Old Town. It's all fun and games until a heavy fog rolls in and the trainees realise they are trapped.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E22 - Wake Up Wilson
1.plot: A storm has left the safari park in a bit of chaos and some of the animals have escaped. Emery teases Brewster, saying one of the escapees is a dragon. The chuggers don't believe him, but when they hear a mighty roar coming from one of the tunnels, they start to think he might be right.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E23 - Brewster Knows Best
1.plot: Koko challenges Wilson to see if they can stay awake all night. When morning comes, Wilson declares himself the winner, but then he struggles to keep his eyes open whilst doing his work.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E24 - Koko Pulls It Off
1.plot: The trainees are doing a sign reading exercise and they're promised a wonderful surprise at the end. Koko and Wilson think Brewster is too slow, but Brewster's patience pays off when he meets his hero 'Action Chugger' at the ride in movie theatre.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E25 - Wilson and the Ice Cream
1.plot: Wilson is asked to take refrigerated cars to the ice cream fair, but when his hero Frostini offers him a tour of the ice cream factory, he forgets all about the important job he's supposed to be doing.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E26 - Wilson's Wacky Tour
1.plot: The trainees are taking their passenger test and Mr Simkins, from the Ministry of Chuggers, arrives to examine them. When a faulty machine startles Koko, she fails her test and is broken hearted.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E27 - Hodge's Secret
1.plot: Hodge longs to prove to Eddie that he can carry out his duties on his own. But when his attempts create all manner of confusion in the training yard, Hodge must set aside his pride and own up to his mistake.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E28 - Frostini's Fruit Fandango
1.plot: Wilson is sent to help Frostini at the ice cream factory, so that he can earn a 'helpers' badge. When he is left alone with the machinery he risks jeopardising Frostini's latest experiment.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E29 - Zephie Ace Reporter
1.plot: Zephie meets a newspaper reporter who is interviewing Morgan. She ends up with his press pass, and meets Super Chugger at his new film premiere. He has to fly off to save Old Puffer Pete and Zephie hitches a lift.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E30 - Famous Emery
1.plot: A television crew have come to make a documentary about Chuggington, and Emery is chosen to show them around the yard. He is desperate for a role in the film, but when the chance arises his cheeky sense of humour threatens to alienate him from his friends.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E31 - Watch Out Wilson
1.plot: Brewster, Koko and Wilson are training going backwards, and Wilson chooses the Fire truck. Wilson has trouble completing the task, and Harrison says to go slow. However, Wilson thinks it was the opposite and falls off the track. Morgan then fits Wilson with Wing Mirrors, and is thought off as being cool by Brewster and Koko.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E32 - Brewster's Hobby
1.plot: Brewster has a new hobby, watching people to see what strange things they do. Vee tells Brewster, Koko and Wilson to take a delivery out to the building yard, but Brewster and Wilson are arguing about who is the best at their new hobby, and forget to make the delivery.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E33 - Zephie's Monkey Business
1.plot: Vee asks for a spare engine, and Zephie arrives first. She is to take Dr Gosling on an inspection of all the animals in the Zoo. When Emery passes by, Zephie tells him what she is doing, and Emery scares her by saying the monkeys are mischievous and will steal her wipers. Zephie is upset by this and tries to stay away from the monkeys, but then wanders into the monkey enclosure and realises that the monkeys aren't as bad as Emery says. The trainees also practise using the crane cars.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E34 - Poor Old Puffer Pete
1.plot: Old Puffer Pete takes his wagon, called Terry, to Morgan to be repaired, but Zephie overhears Morgan talking to Lori and mishears him, and believes he will send Old Puffer Pete to the scrap yard. Brewster and Zephie then are busy all day doing his jobs and keeping him occupied. It is then found out that it's Terry that is going for scrap and Zephie and Brewster are relieved.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E35 - Inspector Emery
1.plot: Chuggington is getting ready for an inspection, and it's also Emery's day off; he has trouble finding things to do, so he tries helping out, but causes more problems, causing Irving to spill his load of rubbish, Dunbar to constantly re-organize the rolling stock yard, and Eddie to spill paint. Emery hides on the elevated rail station, and finds a passenger waiting, and takes her on a tour of Chuggington. She later reveals she is the inspector, thanks Emery for his honesty and passes Chuggington with flying colours.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E36 - Nurse Wilson
1.plot: The trainees are training to use the Ambulance Car, and are being taught by Nurse David. However, Dubar has been shouting to Caley previously over noise from machinery, and when he yells 'Quiet' at the trainees, he loses his voice! Wilson then decides to make Dunbar feel better.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E37 - Mtambo's Amazing Adventure
1.plot: Children's animation in which the trains talk, think and don't need drivers. Mtambo longs for adventure in his life so that he has new stories to tell.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E38 - Rock-a-Bye Chatsworth
1.plot: Chatsworth is tired after working hard, and goes to the depot to sleep. Olwen, meanwhile, is loading up at the quarry, and some rocks fall, and she runs off as she doesn't want to scratch her paintwork. She goes back to Chuggington and asks Vee for another chugger to do it instead. Vee asks Chatsworth to do it, but Harrison (followed by Wilson) has already taken a hopper to do the job, and Chatsworth does another job after Vee tells it to him. At the Quarry, Harrison bakes 'with style' and lodges rocks in his fuel filter. That night, nobody gets much sleep because of Harrison snoring. When Morgan fixes him, Vee said to Harrison that he would do their jobs while they slept.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E39 - Helpful Hodge
1.plot: Hodge and Koko challenge each other to do as many jobs as possible, with the chugger doing the most winning; however, Hodge only seems to be finding things that need fixing by Eddie that technically don't need fixing. At the end of the day, it's a draw; but Hodge magnetised Eddie's guitar, and now it's in tune; so Hodge wins!

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E40 - Brewster to the Rescue
1.plot: Calley is training the Trainees for their Rescue Badge. Brewster and Zephie are practising using the crane car, and Zephie falls over, pretending to be hurt, but Brewster doesn't control the crane properly, and goes back to the depot sad. Chatsworth is on the mainline and his hopper brakes seize on a hill, and Brewster is the only one who can help - and rushes to Chatsworth's rescue with the water car.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E41 - Wilson & the Paint Wagon
1.plot: Dunbar is training the trainees to use the new Painting wagons, and Wilson can't paint properly, and accidentally paints a moustache on Dunbar! Old Puffer Pete takes him to Old Chuggington to practise. Wilson tries to find the others, but can't, so paints his shed door instead, painting a butterfly that landed on the roof. Chatsworth comes by, and says that he can't paint it. However, Chatsworth finds him something to paint - Dunbar, Koko, Wilson and Brewster on the depot wall!

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E42 - Eddie Finds Time
1.plot: The Depot Clock is broken and there is chaos in Chuggington. The Chug Scan is also broken, and Hodge is taking it to be repaired, while Eddie finds the spare cog in Old Chuggington's clock.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E43 - Mtambo's Royal Tour
1.plot: The King of Buffertonia has come to take a tour of the Safari Park; however, when the king is delayed, M'tumbo takes him on a night-time tour of the Safari Park.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E44 - Wilson & the Wild Wind
1.plot: Dunbar has a new weather training simulator, but Wilson messes with the controls and causes a massive storm which causes problems all over Chuggington.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E45 - Old Puffer Pete's Firebox
1.plot: Puffer Pete's firebox is completely worn out and he can't move without it.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E46 - Jet Pack Wilson
1.plot: The Trainees are spending the day with Action Chugger training to be rescue chuggers. He has them endurance training, cat rescuing, and lots more besides. Action Chugger is called away, and Wilson finds the jet wings which the trainees are going to practise on...

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E47 - Brewster's Little Helper
1.plot: Zephie admires the big chuggers, and wants to pull freight just like them. When she overhears Brewster being given his jobs for the day, she decides to do some of them for him, but wreaks havoc, and can't handle a van full of tiles, and crashes.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E48 - Bubbly Olwin
1.plot: A magazine photographer is coming to Chuggington to do a feature on steam trains, and Olwin is determined to look her best for her picture. But she doesn't notice when a bottle of soap for Ebo the elephant accidentally lands in her water tank.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E49 - Koko Takes Charge
1.plot: When Irving leaves Koko in charge of the recycling yard, she is keen to show how responsible she is, but she doesn't listen properly to his instructions.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E50 - Wilson's Paper Trail
1.plot: Wilson is sent to pick up a roll of special paper for the printers, but when he finds a broken pipe gushing water, he decides to play in it.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E51 - Puffer Pete's Big Show
1.plot: Old Puffer Pete has been working in Chuggington for 150 years, and the Mayor wants to commemorate his anniversary with a special show.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E52 - Training Time Harrison
1.plot: Vee needs someone to pull the royal carriage for the Prince of Buffertonia and all the Chuggers race to get the job, but Harrison is first - thanks to cutting corners and going through a few red lights.

meta.plot: Koko, Brewster and Wilson are three young, adventurous trainee "chuggers", learning about working on the railway in the town of Chuggington, with the help of the railway controller, Vee, the older engines, and their human friends.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E01 - Tourist Trapped
1.plot: Twins Dipper and Mabel Pines visit their eccentric great-uncle for a summer in Gravity Falls, Oregon, where he operates the world's most bizarre museum. As soon as the twins arrive in Gravity Falls, they discover something amiss in the remote town.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E02 - The Legend of the Gobblewonker
1.plot: When Dipper and Mabel hear rumors of a sea monster that lives at the bottom of the local lake, they enlist Soos to take them on a boating expedition to prove it really does exist.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E03 - Headhunters
1.plot: When someone tampers with Mabel's life-size wax statue of Grunkle Stan, she and Dipper set out to find the culprit. Meanwhile, Grunkle Stan mourns over the loss of his wax doppelganger.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E04 - The Hand That Rocks the Mabel
1.plot: Dipper and Mabel discover that their seemingly cherubic new neighbor, Lil' Gideon, happens to be the town's adored psychic. But when Lil' Gideon guilts her into dating him, she and Dipper soon learn that his cuteness can fade all too quickly.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E05 - The Inconveniencing
1.plot: Dipper is invited by Wendy and her teen friends on a trek that leads to an abandoned convenience store that may be haunted.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E06 - Dipper vs. Manliness
1.plot: In a quest to attain manliness, Dipper ventures into the forest to battle the notorious Multi-Bear. Meanwhile, Mabel tries to teach Grunkle Stan how to be attractive to women, particularly the waitress in the local diner, Lazy Susan.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E07 - Double Dipper
1.plot: Stan throws a big weekend party to promote the Mystery Shack. Dipper makes clones of himself to impress Wendy. Mabel fights for the Party Queen title in honor of her two friends.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E08 - Irrational Treasure
1.plot: When Dipper and Mabel discover evidence that the reported town founder is a hoax, they set out to expose the historical cover-up and prove that Mabel's silliness is not a bad thing.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E09 - The Time Traveler's Pig
1.plot: Dipper wants to correct a mistake he made in the past with assistance from a time machine. Mabel is overjoyed when she wins a pet pig at a fair.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E10 - Fight Fighters
1.plot: After being challenged to a video game battle by Robbie, Dipper is shocked when his favorite playable fighter, Rumble McSkirmish, comes to life to defend him. But Dipper soon loses control over Rumble McSkirmish and has to find a way to stop him.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E11 - Little Dipper
1.plot: Dipper is self-conscious that Mabel is taller than him and seeks a magic solution. Meanwhile Lil' Gideon takes advantage of Dipper's and Mabel's height discrepancy.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E12 - Summerween
1.plot: Dipper and Mabel go trick-or-treating in the summer and encounter a candy-loving monster who threatens to devour them if they don't bring him sweet things to eat.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E13 - Boss Mabel
1.plot: Stan leaves Mabel in charge of the Mystery Shack while he is gone and the power goes to her head.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E14 - Bottomless Pit!
1.plot: While Stan, Dipper, Mabel and Soos are falling in a bottomless pit, they tell stories to pass the time.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E15 - The Deep End
1.plot: When Mabel befriends a cute merman trapped in the public pool, she's determined to help him out. Meanwhile, Dipper decides to volunteer as a lifeguard to see Wendy.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E16 - Carpet Diem
1.plot: The twins discover a hidden room inside the Mystery Shack and compete over who should have it.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E17 - Boyz Crazy
1.plot: When Mabel discovers that her favorite boy band is actually a bunch of imprisoned clones, she sets them free, only to decide on keeping them for herself. Meanwhile, Dipper is convinced that Robbie plans to brainwash Wendy with a secret message hidden inside one of his songs.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E18 - Land Before Swine
1.plot: When Waddles is snatched by a prehistoric beast, Dipper, Mabel, Stan, Soos, and Old Man McGucket must journey to a mysterious land trapped in time to rescue him.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E19 - Dreamscaperers (1)
1.plot: Dipper, Mabel, and Soos must travel through Grunkle Stan's mind to defeat a tricky dream demon summoned by Lil Gideon.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E20 - Gideon Rises (2)
1.plot: Li'l Gideon swindles the Mystery Shack away, forcing Grunkle Stan and the kids to move in with Soos. While Stan weighs how he can still care for his grandniece and nephew, they decide to take on Gideon.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E01 - Scary-oke
2.plot: The Pines family is starting to get everything back to normal after the Lil' Gideon incident. They throw a “Mystery Shack Is Back” party, but some unwelcome guests intend to crash it.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E02 - Into the Bunker
2.plot: Dipper’s secret journal pages lead him and the gang to the author’s hidden bunker where they find themselves face-to-face with a mysterious figure from Gravity Falls’ lore.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E03 - The Golf War
2.plot: After being belittled by Pacifica one too many times, Mabel challenges her to a miniature golf-off which gets a tad out of control when some local residents offer their help.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E04 - Sock Opera
2.plot: Mabel decides to put on a sock puppet rock opera to impress a local puppeteer, but her show goes awry when Dipper's drive to uncover more of the journal's secrets leads to a supernatural disaster.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E05 - Soos and the Real Girl
2.plot: Soos needs a date for his cousin Reggie's engagement party and looks to a dating simulator game to help him talk to girls.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E06 - Little Gift Shop of Horrors
2.plot: In three separate mysterious tales, Stan is cursed by a Witch, Waddles accidentally eats a bowl of brain-enhancing jelly and builds a machine that allows him to speak, and Mabel faces her fear of claymation.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E07 - Society of the Blind Eye
2.plot: The kids, along with Old Man McGucket's help, discover there is a secret society in Gravity Falls.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E08 - Blendin's Game
2.plot: Blendin returns to face off with Dipper and Mabel in a futuristic battle that could trap them forever in time jail.
