A horrified Yuki is declared winner of the survival game by his world's Murmur and spirited away through a vortex. 10,000 years on, Yuki is still grieving Yuno's death in his now empty universe, refusing to create anything. At the end of the episode, the final entry in his diary changes from "Yuno died" to "Yuno came to see me", and her voice is heard calling his name.

meta.plot: Yuki est un adolescent solitaire et renfermé qui préfère la compagnie de ses amis imaginaires à celle de ses camarades de classe. Son seul passe temps : un journal intime qu'il rédige sur son mobile. Mais voilà que Deus, l'une se ses créations, lui octroie le pouvoir de connaître l'avenir. Et Yuki se voit entraîné dans un jeu mortel dans lequel les participants doivent s'éliminer pour devenir le futur dieu du Temps et de l'Espace…

1.title: FR - The Fable - S01E04 - Chatting About Life

1.title: FR - The Fable - S01E05 - You Listening to Me?!

1.title: FR - The Fable - S01E06 - Prison Release Jamboree
1.plot: Kojima becomes increasingly resentful at changes to the Maguro Group while he was in prison.

1.title: FR - The Fable - S01E07 - Realist
1.plot: With growing frustration, Kojima takes advantage of Ebihara's absence to make his move.

1.title: FR - The Fable - S01E09 - You Mean a Hitman...?
1.plot: As Kojima's rampage escalates, Ebihara tries to get Akira to keep an eye on him.

1.title: FR - The Fable - S01E10 - The Phantom of the Balcony
1.plot: When Akira finds out that Misaki is in trouble, he goes into action to get her out of it.

1.plot: When Akira finds out that Misaki is in trouble, he goes into action to get her out of it.

1.plot: Akira, Yoko, Kojima, and Sunagawa all prepare for what will be an explosive encounter.

1.title: FR - Chilling Adventures of Sabrina - S01E01 - Chapter One: October Country
1.plot: While Greendale readies for a Halloween eclipse, Sabrina faces a crucial decision and Harvey makes and unexpected declaration.

1.title: FR - Chilling Adventures of Sabrina - S01E02 - Chapter Two: The Dark Baptism
1.plot: A legendary guest visits Spellman Mortuary. Ambrose explores a grim revelation, and Sabrina stuns the coven with a shocking announcement.

1.title: FR - Chilling Adventures of Sabrina - S01E03 - Chapter Three: The Trial of Sabrina Spellman
1.plot: As Sabrina confronts a long line of family secrets, Harvey faces turmoil at home - and shares a secret of his own.

1.title: FR - Chilling Adventures of Sabrina - S01E04 - Chapter Four: Witch Academy
1.plot: Sabrina takes a weekend trip. Father Blackwood poses a pivotal question. Roz and Susie stage an impromptu -- and unnerving -- sleepover.

1.title: FR - Chilling Adventures of Sabrina - S01E05 - Chapter Five: Dreams in a Witch House
1.plot: A mysterious demon wreaks havoc on Spellman Mortuary. Sabrina goes rogue and puts her powers to the test.

1.title: FR - Chilling Adventures of Sabrina - S01E06 - Chapter Six: An Exorcism in Greendale
1.plot: Harvey, Roz and Susie explore a mysterious force of evil. Sabrina digs deeper into Ms. Wardwell's intentions. Hilda pursues a new beginning.

1.title: FR - Chilling Adventures of Sabrina - S01E07 - Chapter Seven: Feast of Feasts
1.plot: The coven prepares for an annual ritual as Harvey takes part in a Kinkle family tradition. Sabrina grows suspicious of Lady Blackwood.

1.title: FR - Chilling Adventures of Sabrina - S01E08 - Chapter Eight: The Burial
1.plot: A disaster rattles the Greendale community. Desperate to help, Sabrina attempts a new kind of dark magic -- with the assistance of an unusual ally.

1.title: FR - Chilling Adventures of Sabrina - S01E09 - Chapter Nine: The Returned Man
1.plot: Sabrina recruits Roz for a crucial mission. Susie reconnects with her past. Lord Blackwood challenges Aunt Zela's authority.

1.title: FR - Chilling Adventures of Sabrina - S01E10 - Chapter Ten: The Witching Hour
1.plot: A revolutionary attack divides the witches and mortals of Greendale, and Sabrina braces for a life-changing choice.

2.title: FR - Chilling Adventures of Sabrina - S02E01 - Chapter Twenty-One: The Hellbound Heart
2.plot: Sabrina recruits Roz, Harvey and Theo for an emotional mission. Prudence and Ambrose travel to New Orleans. Ms. Wardwell returns to Baxter High.

2.title: FR - Chilling Adventures of Sabrina - S02E02 - Chapter Twenty-Two: Drag Me to Hell
2.plot: In Greendale, Sabrina explores a new hobby ... and a disturbing duty. Elsewhere, Prudence and Ambrose continue their search for Father Blackwood.

2.title: FR - Chilling Adventures of Sabrina - S02E03 - Chapter Twenty-Three: Heavy Is the Crown
2.plot: Sabrina visits a mysterious (and familiar) town. Zelda aims to restore order at the academy. A carnival creates buzz in Greendale. Theo takes a chance.

2.title: FR - Chilling Adventures of Sabrina - S02E04 - Chapter Twenty-Four: The Hare Moon
2.plot: The coven celebrates a festive tradition -- and crosses paths with unexpected guests. Nick struggles to strike a balance between pleasure and pain.

2.title: FR - Chilling Adventures of Sabrina - S02E05 - Chapter Twenty-Five: The Devil Within
2.plot: Ambrose treats Nick's affliction while Harvey and Theo tend to Roz. Meanwhile, Sabrina and Caliban continue in their unholy regalia challenge.

2.title: FR - Chilling Adventures of Sabrina - S02E06 - Chapter Twenty-Six: All of Them Witches
2.plot: Zelda attempts to forge a supernatural alliance, Sabrina and the gang work with Caliban, and Hilda's transformation takes a terrifying turn.

2.title: FR - Chilling Adventures of Sabrina - S02E07 - Chapter Twenty-Seven: The Judas Kiss
2.plot: On the heels of tragedy, the Spellmans receive a grim omen. Blackwood seeks vengeance. Sabrina prepares for her final challenge against Caliban.

2.title: FR - Chilling Adventures of Sabrina - S02E08 - Chapter Twenty-Eight: Sabrina Is Legend
2.plot: The lines between past, present and future blur as Sabrina stages an act of heroic restoration. But will her powers prove to be enough?

2.title: FR - Chilling Adventures of Sabrina - S02E09 - Chapter Twenty-Nine: The Eldritch Dark
2.plot: As an all-consuming darkness trickles into town, Sabrina grapples with feeling like the odd witch out — and makes a risky plan for a whirlwind trip.

1.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S01E01 - Camelot
1.plot: When the army pillages ​Sinaloa, ​an ambitious pot farmer pitches a plan to build a drug empire in Guadalajara. A young DEA agent transfers to Mexico.

1.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S01E02 - The Plaza System
1.plot: Félix tries to unite all of the plazas while Rafa searches for water for his seedless weed. Police corruption and the DEA’s complacency frustrate Kiki.

1.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S01E03 - El Padrino
1.plot: Kiki flies solo on a risky undercover operation. Félix turns to his mentor for advice as conflict between the cops and the traffickers escalates.

1.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S01E04 - Rafa, Rafa, Rafa!
1.plot: After months of frustration, Kiki seizes an opportunity. Rafa runs afoul of powerful government officials, putting Félix in a difficult position.

1.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S01E05 - The Colombian Connection
1.plot: A threat leaves Mika shaken. Félix envisions a different kind of future for the Guadalajara cartel.

1.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S01E06 - La Última Frontera
1.plot: A violent power struggle erupts between Falcón and Rafa. As Félix finds a footing in the cocaine business, the DEA tries to lure him into the U.S.

1.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S01E07 - Jefe de Jefes
1.plot: María implores Félix to move back to Sinaloa. Kiki gathers evidence of the Guadalajara cartel’s pot fields. Neto mourns.

1.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S01E08 - Just Say No
1.plot: After the DEA closes in on Rafa's enormous pot field, Félix tries to stop his associates from retaliating. Kiki and Jaime meet with investigators.

1.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S01E09 - 881 Lope de Vega
1.plot: A desperate Jaime is stymied by bureaucratic paperwork. Mika worries about her husband. Félix urges Rafa to disappear.

1.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S01E10 - Leyenda
1.plot: As pressure mounts, Félix returns to Sinaloa. An enraged Jaime and Mika seek justice and answers.

2.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S02E01 - Salva El Tigre
2.plot: While celebrating his 40th birthday, Félix worries about his associates' loyalty and confronts Pacho. Walt and his team plan retaliatory kidnappings.

2.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S02E02 - Alea lacta Est
2.plot: Verdin taunts the DEA agents torturing him. Félix offers opium dealer Guerra a partnership deal. Benjamín's sister Enedina poses a new business idea.

2.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S02E03 - Ruben Zuno Arce
2.plot: Multiple advisers counsel Félix to go into hiding as the Americans close in on the men involved in Kiki's murder. Amado helps Acosta resolve a feud.

2.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S02E04 - The Big Dig
2.plot: Zuno testifies in front of a grand jury. Isabella tries to broker a deal with Enedina. Félix makes a daring offer to a U.S. contact.

2.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S02E05 - AFO
2.plot: Calderoni briefs Walt on the tension between the plazas as Chapo continues construction of his tunnel. Félix's meeting with Pacho takes a turn.

2.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S02E06 - El Dedazo
2.plot: Félix meets with a political leader. Benjamín takes a stand when the Sinaloa and Tijuana rivalry intensifies. Walt's team turns its attention to planes.

2.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S02E07 - Truth and Reconciliation
2.plot: Félix proposes a new plan to help the PRI win the election and defeat Cárdenas. Promised intel on Félix, Walt takes an unexpected meeting in Ojinaga.

2.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S02E08 - Se Cayó El Sistema
2.plot: Mexican authorities, the FBI and Félix all seek out Acosta after a newspaper publishes an interview with him. The presidential election begins.

2.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S02E09 - Growth, Prosperity, and Liberation
2.plot: Félix stakes the future of his entire cartel on the delivery of 70 tons of cocaine as Walt and the DEA plan to topple the kingpin's empire.

2.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S02E10 - Free Trade
2.plot: After meeting with Pacho, Félix presents the plaza bosses with a new business plan. Walt receives a surprising invitation.

3.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S03E01 - 12 Steps
3.plot: Walt's undercover mission takes a turn. Amado is released following three months in prison. Juárez police officer Victor looks for a missing girl.

3.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S03E02 - Como La Flor
3.plot: Tijuana journalist Andréa takes an interest in the teen guests at the wedding between Enedina Arellano and a prominent attorney. Walt considers a move.

3.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S03E03 - Los Juniors
3.plot: After a disappointing conversation with the Arellanos about purchasing land, the Sinaloa cartel reacts. Andréa continues investigating the narcojuniors.

3.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S03E04 - GDL
3.plot: With the Tijuana and Sinaloa cartels at war, everyone wonders where Juárez stands, but Amado has other plans in Cuba. Ramón seeks revenge against Chapo.

3.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S03E05 - Boots on the Ground
3.plot: Walt joins a Mexican task force led by Gen. Rebollo aimed at catching those responsible for the Guadalajara massacre and Cardinal Posada's death.

3.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S03E06 - La Jefa
3.plot: Victor is shaken by a murder and takes action. Violence escalates in Tijuana. New boss Enedina develops a plan to challenge her cartel's rivals.

3.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S03E07 - La Voz
3.plot: La Voz is targeted following its reporting on Colosio's assassins. Mayo and Chapo form an alliance against the Tijuana cartel. Victor asks questions.

3.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S03E08 - Last Dance
3.plot: When torturing Alex doesn't work, Walt switches tactics. Andrea sifts through financial records tied to Hank and the PRI. Amado plans for the future.

3.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S03E09 - The Reckoning
3.plot: Andrea uncovers a startling connection, instigating a cascade of events. With Alex's help, Walt closes in on Benjamín. Hank threatens Amado.

3.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S03E10 - Life in Wartime
3.plot: Mexican and US authorities search in earnest for Amado. While in prison, Chapo makes moves to show he's the boss. Enedina sends Ramón on a mission.

meta.plot: See the rise of the Guadalajara Cartel as an American DEA agent learns the danger of targeting narcos in 1980s Mexico.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E01 - Down the Rabbit Hole
1.plot: Alice's tales of her adventures in Wonderland result in her father committing her to a mental asylum where she was about to be lobotomised to cure her supposed insanity, but the Knave of Hearts and the White Rabbit rescue her and bring her back to Wonderland when they reveal that her true love Cyrus is still alive. As Alice begins a quest to find him, the Red Queen and Jafar plot against her.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E02 - Trust Me
1.plot: Alice formulates a plan to rescue Cyrus by retrieving his bottle. Meanwhile, the Red Queen begins to question her role in Jafar's plan while they try to find the bottle as well. Also, the story behind how Cyrus got to Wonderland and how he fell in love with Alice is revealed.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E03 - Forget Me Not
1.plot: With the Genie's bottle in her clutches, the Red Queen sends the Bandersnatch after Alice since Jafar needs her in order to use Cyrus (who is discovered to have contacted her). Alice and the Knave of Hearts head to the house of the Grendel in the Whispering Woods to obtain the Forget-Me-Knot so that they can find out who stole Cyrus's bottle before Jafar could steal it. In the Knave of Hearts's flashback, it is shown that he joined up with Robin Hood's Merry Men back when he was Will Scarlet. It is also revealed that Wonderland's Red Queen was once his love Anastasia.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E04 - The Serpent
1.plot: When the Knave's life is in danger, Alice has to make the tough decision on whether to use one of her three precious wishes and what that would mean for her and Cyrus. Her new friendship with Lizard reveals some of the Knave's backstory and Cyrus plots to escape. Meanwhile, Jafar's plan to kill the Knave puts the Red Queen in a difficult position as she grapples with her feelings for him and her desire to get what she wants. In flashback, we explore Jafar's origins and find out what he truly wants from Cyrus.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E05 - Heart of Stone
1.plot: In a flashback, Will Scarlet and Anastasia jump through the looking glass to enter Wonderland against her mother's wishes, since she disapproves of Will. They both soon realize that life in Wonderland isn't exactly what they had both imagined. After being humiliated while attending a ball at the palace, Ana convinces Will to steal the crown jewels in order to get them out of poverty, but in an instant, Ana is caught red handed by the King who makes her a proposition she can't refuse – to marry him and be his Queen to avoid prosecution. Meanwhile, in current Wonderland, the Red Queen convinces Alice to help her acquire magic dust in exchange for information about Cyrus, who in turn has managed to skillfully escape Jafar's castle leaving the White Rabbit in a compromising situation.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E06 - Who's Alice
1.plot: Jafar heads to the asylum to find information on Alice; Alice travels to the black forest; Cyrus tries to avoid the Red Queen.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E07 - Bad Blood
1.plot: When Alice discovers that her father is in Wonderland, they begin healing their broken relationship, which leads to her having to make a difficult decision. In flashback, a young Jafar is emotionally distraught after his mother dies and we find out what drove him to become the unforgiving villain he is today.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E08 - Home
1.plot: A flashback reveals Cyrus' origin; Alice wants answers from the White Rabbit; disdain between the Red Queen and Jafar comes to a head.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E09 - Nothing to Fear
1.plot: Cyrus and Alice reluctantly work with the Red Queen to find Will but must also be prepared to defend themselves from Jafar. Will has troubles of his own when the caterpillar finds the bottle.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E10 - Dirty Little Secrets
1.plot: Cyrus remembers the events that led to the binding price he and his brothers have to pay; the Red Queen and the Knave are faced with the Jabberwocky.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E11 - Heart of the Matter
1.plot: Cyrus and Alice uncover alarming information; the Knave must surrender information to Jafar in order to help the Red Queen.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E12 - To Catch a Thief
1.plot: In flashback, the Knave hunts Alice per Cora’s directive and he finds himself striking a deal to get his heart back, while in present day Wonderland, Alice and the Knave’s friendship is tested as he does Jafar’s bidding and steals from her. Meanwhile, the Jabberwocky attempts to free herself from Jafar’s control and Jafar is confronted by his former partner.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E13 - And They Lived...
1.plot: The all-powerful Jafar succeeds in making his father love him and forcing Anastasia into thinking she loves him. After Alice, Amara and Cyrus escape, Jafar imprisons the Jabberwocky and calls upon an army of dead soldiers to do his bidding. Meanwhile, Alice and the White Rabbit raise their own army to fight Jafar for the realm and a final confrontation between Alice and Jafar takes place at the Well of Wonders.

meta.plot: In Victorian England, the young and beautiful Alice tells a tale of a strange new land that exists on the other side of a rabbit hole. Thinking Alice insane, her doctors aim to make her forget everything. While Alice is ready to put it all behind her, she knows this world is real. In the nick of time, the Knave of Hearts and the White Rabbit save her from a doomed fate. Together, the trio tumble down the rabbit hole to Wonderland, where nothing is impossible.

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E01 - I Hate This World
1.plot: Leon is reincarnated in the world of the "otome game" he was playing as the third son of an impoverished baron. While he's trying to find happiness as a "mob" or background character, he's offered a terrible marriage proposal.

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E02 - Hey, Girl. Wanna Get Some Tea?
1.plot: Leon officially begins attending the academy. Though the romantic interests he saw in the game are present, for some reason the girl with them is not the protagonist of the otome game, but a girl he doesn't recognize. Leon feels there is something off about the situation...

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E03 - Let's Duel, Prince
1.plot: Marie is being bullied by Angelica's followers. Because events don't match what happened in the otome game, Leon attempts to gather information on Marie.

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E04 - Mind If I Go Easy on You?
1.plot: Leon's Armor Arroganz is mocked for being old fashioned, and the weapon Luxion has prepared for him is... a shovel! The audience ridicules Leon, but will he be able to defeat his five opponents?!

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E05 - It's Awesome
1.plot: Leon's duel against Julius and his kingdom's best Armor begins. Why does Julius choose Marie over Angelica? His feelings drive him to attack Leon...!

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E06 - A Cultural Festival? It'll Be My First
1.plot: Leon and his friends open a cafe at the school festival. However, Julius' posse open their own cafe, and a mysterious girl trying to get close to Leon appears before Olivia. It looks like there's trouble ahead at this school festival...!

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E07 - We Both Hate Hot Guys
1.plot: Jilk appears in the bike race held on the final day of the academy festival. However, he is obstructed by the followers of his ex-fiancee and is badly injured. The situation develops further, and Leon finds himself dragged into it...

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E08 - This Isn't a Game
1.plot: Olivia finds herself pushed into a corner by Stephanie. Meanwhile, while understanding Olivia should resolve the pirate hunting situation, he chooses to prioritize efficiency and gets involved.

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E09 - She's a Doormat
1.plot: Leon's attempt to support Olivia backfires. He attempts to clearly define their relationship as one between mob and protagonist, but... Meanwhile, during a sword fight against Brad, he realizes the difference in their resolve.

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E10 - Unlike You Wannabe Nobles
1.plot: The school trip begins, and Leon heads to the southern island where the item he seeks can be found. Once there, he runs into Angelica and Olivia at a shrine dedicated to marriage while things are still awkward between them.

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E11 - What I Can Do Now
1.plot: Leon weaves his way through the horde of monsters alone in order to rescue Angelica. Meanwhile, Chris and Olivia battle fiercely alongside the other students on the passenger ship, but they're surrounded by the duchy's fleet...!

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E12 - No Matter How Tough the World of Otome Games Is
1.plot: Forced to face off against the Black Knight, Leon, through cunning tactics, manages to defeat his formidable opponent and bring the enemy forces to his mercy. This act gains him more fame and notoriety with the Holfort Kingdom, and he is appointed as Viscount.

meta.plot: An ordinary office worker is reincarnated as Leon into a particularly punishing dating sim video game, where women reign supreme and only beautiful men have a seat at the table. But Leon has a secret weapon: he remembers everything from his past life, which includes a complete playthrough of the very game in which he is now trapped. Watch Leon spark a revolution to change this new world in order to fulfill his ultimate desire...of living a quiet, easy life in the countryside!

1.title: FR - Don’t Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E01 - In this world where monsters are rampant...
1.plot: A knight and a foul-mouthed healer meet and are going to have a hard time together!

1.title: FR - Don’t Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E02 - Forced to travel with Carla, a healer...
1.plot: ...Alvin resumes his original quest to gather antidote herbs, but on the way he ends up getting attacked in a graveyard by ghosts which they manage to escape unexpectedly, but then he falls into a trap set by goblins and basically the first half of the episode is filled with great suffering but Carla's curse is still in effect so he can't get away from her and there's even more suffering in store nevertheless and anyway these titles are really long and kind of serve double-duty as next episode previews and we're pretty curious about how many people actually listen to the whole thing and that's the deal with episode 2.

1.title: FR - Don’t Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E03 - Despite the terrible time he's been having...
1.plot: While trying to demonstrate their skills, Alvin and Carla encounter a delicious and dangerous enemy.

1.title: FR - Don’t Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E04 - The first dungeon Alvin tackles with Carla is designed for...
1.plot: Just when Alvin and Carla are about to face their first dungeon experience, it turns out to be pure beginner's fun and so even Alvin is convinced that he can master it in no time.

1.title: FR - Don’t Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E05 - The owner of the inn they visit seems very nice, but...
1.plot: After leaving the dungeon, Alvin and Carla go to rest at an inn, but the healer doesn't seem to like the establishment or the attendant very much. Then they meet a somewhat suspicious old lady.

1.title: FR - Don’t Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E06 - As usual, Alvin and Carla have to overcome a series of crises...
1.plot: Rejuvenated, the witch gives Alvin and Carla the herbs they need. The two leave for the guild and obviously have another problem.

1.title: FR - Don’t Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E07 - This show is fairly unique in that Carla is the only recurring female character...
1.plot: Alvin and Carla decide to help a zombie get his revenge by confronting a powerful necromancer.

1.title: FR - Don’t Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E08 - Thanks to Altargaia (reminder: this is the mushroom's name)...
1.plot: Released from prison, Alvin reunites with Carla, who has decided to help Maria summon a particular soul.

1.title: FR - Don’t Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E09 - This Episode Features Even More Female Guest Characters Hot on the Heels...
1.plot: Alvin and Carla meet in the forest the Medusa and Dryad. What are they planning to do with them?

1.title: FR - Don’t Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E10 - In the second half of this episode, we enter the "What Story Is This?" arc...
1.plot: Alvin and Carla visit the adventurers' guild and meet an old companion of Alvin's there, who isn't particularly fond of our party...

1.title: FR - Don’t Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E11 - So, this is Part 2 of the "What Story Is This?" arc...
1.plot: Alvin once again finds himself in an awkward position from which he cannot free himself. Can Carla help him this time, or is she just making it worse?

meta.plot: The misadventures of a knight and a healer begin in this new fantasy comedy series!

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Bounty hunter Brisco is hired by the West's most powerful robber barons to bring down the John Bly gang.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E02 - The Orb Scholar
1.plot: Brisco follows a lead on Bly to the town of Poker Flats and finds Bly, the orb, and an old friend who once left him to die at the hands of the Swill brothers.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E03 - No Man's Land
1.plot: While tailing the bank-robbing Swill brothers (Will, Bill, Gil, and Phil), Brisco winds up in a town where sisterhood is the rule.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E04 - Brisco in Jalisco
1.plot: Brisco and Socrates head south of the border when the Westerfield Club orders them to recover some stolen guns.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E05 - Socrates' Sister
1.plot: Socrates'sister---who's also a lawyer---is tricked into aiding in the escape of her client, a Treasury-plate thief hauled in by Brisco.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E06 - Riverboat
1.plot: Socrates sends out an S.O.S. to Brisco when he loses Westerfield Club money to Brett Bones, a member of John Bly's gang, in a poker game. Brisco, Bowler, Socrates and Wylie set up a scam to get the money back and put Bones in prison.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E07 - Pirates
1.plot: Brisco and Lord Bowler compete to sink a band of pirates who have brought their swashbuckling ways onto dry land.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E08 - Senior Spirit
1.plot: Brisco gets help from his father's ghost when he tries to rescue a robber baron's son kidnapped by John Bly.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E09 - Brisco for the Defense
1.plot: Brisco is called upon by an old friend to serve as defense lawyer when the guy is accused of murdering a prominent citizen of a Wild West town.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E10 - Showdown
1.plot: Brisco takes over the duties of sheriff in his home town after it's taken over by a cattle baron. He also renews a relationship with the sheriff's daughter and his previous girlfriend.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E11 - Deep in the Heart of Dixie
1.plot: Brisco and Dixie find romance while on the run from an assassin in pursuit of Dixie, who has incriminating evidence against a politico.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E12 - Crystal Hawks
1.plot: Bounty hunter Crystal Hawks aims to bring in Brisco, who's wanted for a killing he didn't commit.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E13 - Steel Horses
1.plot: Brisco and Lord Bowler rev up to catch a gang that steals prototype motorcycles and roars off after the orb.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E14 - Mail Order Brides
1.plot: Three mail-order brides hire Brisco and Bowler to rope the Swill brothers, who've robbed them and are now seeking a prize bull.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E15 - A.K.A. Kansas
1.plot: Brisco pursues Dixie's ex-husband, who proposes that he and Dixie steal away after he heists a supercannon.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E16 - Bounty Hunter's Convention
1.plot: Brisco and Bowler joins other bounty hunters at an island lodge, where the hunters become the hunted.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E17 - Fountain of Youth
1.plot: Responding to a note from Prof. Coles, Brisco and Bowler end up on a collision course with Bly in pursuit of the orb.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E18 - Hard Rock
1.plot: Brisco and Bowler arrive in Hard Rock and try to stop local thug Roy Hondo from harassing Bowler's old flame, who resists the man's attempts to extort protection money.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E19 - Brooklyn Dodgers
1.plot: A pair of urchins wants to claim a gold mine, but needs Brisco and Bowler's help to dodge a ruthless New York gang to do it.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E20 - Bye Bly
1.plot: A figure from the future warns Brisco that Bly is going to escape from his orb prison.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E21 - Ned Zed
1.plot: A father reads his son a bed-time story from a dime novel, of how Brisco County and his “loyal sidekick” Lord Bowler brought in the notorious Ned Zed.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E22 - Stagecoach
1.plot: Brisco boards a stagecoach to escort a captured spy to the Mexican border for a prisoner exchange---and there's an assassin along.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E23 - Wild Card
1.plot: Brisco helps Dixie and her sister Dolly battle a mob seeking control of Reno gambling.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E24 - And Baby Makes Three
1.plot: A band of warriors are after the infant heir to the Chinese throne.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E25 - Bad Luck Betty
1.plot: Socrates is kidnapped by someone who's supposed to be dead.

1.title: FR - The Adventures of Brisco County, Jr. - S01E26 - High Treason: Part 1
1.plot: Brisco and Bowler are tried for treason after trying to help the Army retrieve a kidnapped heiress. Part 1 of 2.

meta.plot: A tough-as-rawhide cowpoke, debonair ladies' man and Harvard-educated smarty-britches roams from Frisco to Jalisco in pursuit of outlaws who killed his father...and in search of a mysterious orb possessing out-of-this world powers. Hot lead and cool anachronisms await Brisco as he and his sidekicks - including Comet, the intellectual equine who doesn't know he's a horse - fight for justice in the way, way, way-out West.

1.title: FR - Sky-High Survival - S01E01 - I Just Don't Get This World
1.plot: Transported to the top of a skyscraper, Yuri desperately tries to evade a masked killer, but her escape routes are few.

1.title: FR - Sky-High Survival - S01E02 - I've Found a New Goal
1.plot: Mayuko kills others without any hesitation, desperate to escape. An encounter with Yuri brings back her sense of humanity.

1.title: FR - Sky-High Survival - S01E03 - I'm Sorry, Mayuko Nise
1.plot: Rika confirms that his sister Yuri is still alive when she calls him. Soon after, he faces the wrath of a masked baseball pitcher.

1.title: FR - Sky-High Survival - S01E04 - I Won't Give in to This World
1.plot: Sniper Mask looks to help a scared Kuon. Yuri and Mayuko head toward Rika, but the saw-wielding Chef Mask has other plans for them.

1.title: FR - Sky-High Survival - S01E05 - That's an Incredible Ultimate Weapon
1.plot: Seeking revenge for his annihilated crew, Tanabe pleads for Yuri and Mayuko's help taking down "God Candidate" Aohara and his masked killer, Ein.

1.title: FR - Sky-High Survival - S01E06 - If I Become a Perfect God
1.plot: Mayuko vows to keep fighting until Yuri reunites with her brother, but she realizes it may only be a matter of time before she loses her mind.

1.title: FR - Sky-High Survival - S01E07 - I Will End This Realm
1.plot: Yuri acquires new powers. Rika and his allies reach Yoshida, but they face fierce opposition from Police Mask and her killer army.

1.title: FR - Sky-High Survival - S01E08 - I've Cast Off My Humanity, But That’s Fine
1.plot: Mayuko and Yuri reunite on top of a skyscraper amidst a grenade attack. Now held hostage, Rika is summoned before a God Candidate.

1.title: FR - Sky-High Survival - S01E09 - Which of Us Will Live a Cool Live?
1.plot: Aikawa deploys a sniper to Yuri's location in a move to eliminate other God Candidates. It's a battle of equals as Sniper Mask takes on the threat.

1.title: FR - Sky-High Survival - S01E10 - Our Enemy Is One Who Desires Chaos
1.plot: Aohara, Tanabe and the others approach Yuri to form an alliance. Mayuko and Kuon come to Sniper Mask's aid when he starts to lose his mind.

1.title: FR - Sky-High Survival - S01E11 - I AM Justice!
1.plot: With Yuri and her allies' location exposed, Aikawa dispatches an elite team led by Police Mask to purge those who disagree with his ideology.

1.title: FR - Sky-High Survival - S01E12 - This Is a High-Rise Invasion
1.plot: Archangel destroys everything in his path in the name of justice. Mayuko and the others stand in his way, but who will die, and who will prevail?

meta.plot: High-school girl Yuri suddenly finds herself on the rooftop of a high-rise building. She's trapped in a bizarre world surrounded by skyscrapers, where a masked man cracked open a man's head with an axe before her eyes. Finding a way to survive this bizarre world, find her beloved brother, and escape becomes her top priority, but she is beset by danger not just from the mysterious Masks, which possess both inhuman strength and cruelty, but other survivors turned cruel or desparate by the insanity of the high-rise world.

1.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S01E01 - The Adventure of the Clapham Cook
1.plot: A Mrs Ernestine Todd, from Clapham, asks Poirot to help her find her cook, Eliza, who has disappeared. Poirot, who aims to accept only really significant cases, is at first insulted by such a trivial request. However, after he sees the contents of the missing cook's trunk, he decides the case could prove to be worthy of his talents.

1.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S01E02 - Murder in the Mews
1.plot: Within hours of the Bonfire Night fireworks beginning Poirot finds himself investigating a violent death in Hastings' mews garage.

1.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S01E03 - The Adventure of Johnnie Waverly
1.plot: Country squire Marcus Waverly calls on Poirot for help in dealing with kidnap threats against his son. Hastings is appalled by the thought of someone going around kidnapping children and it becomes a race against time to find the identity of the mystery letter writer.

1.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S01E04 - Four and Twenty Blackbirds
1.plot: At a London restaurant where he often eats, Poirot notices that another regular customer has diverted from his usual meal. As old Anthony Gascoigne lies dying in Brighton, his estranged twin brother, Henry, falls to his death. A tragic accident, or murder? Poirot begins to see connections and decides the answer to the mystery lies in a blackberry pie.

1.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S01E05 - The Third Floor Flat
1.plot: Poirot discovers a murder in his own block of flats, and goes on the trail of boisterous neighbours and strange nocturnal noises in the lift shaft.

1.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S01E06 - Triangle at Rhodes
1.plot: Poirot is on holiday at the Palace Hotel, Rhodes, when an Englishwoman, Mrs Valentine Chantry, is poisoned. Poirot unravels several complicated relationships between those staying at the Palace Hotel.

1.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S01E07 - Problem at Sea
1.plot: Poirot and Hastings are on board a ship steaming towards Alexandria. Poirot recovers from his usual sea-sickness to take an interest in some fellow passengers, especially the Clappertons. On arrival at Alexandria, Mrs Clapperton is found murdered in her cabin.

1.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S01E08 - The Incredible Theft
1.plot: Lord Mayfield, an aircraft manufacturer, tries to trap a spy at his country house, but his plan goes terribly wrong. Lady Mayfield sends for Poirot, who tells a few home truths.

1.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S01E09 - The King of Clubs
1.plot: Lovely young actress Valerie St Clair, engaged to marry Prince Paul of Maurania, is the only witness to the murder of Henry Reedburn, a shady and overbearing producer. Prince Paul appeals to Poirot to save Valerie from police suspicion, and the great detective finds he has a conundrum to ponder on, 'When is a murder not a murder?'

1.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S01E10 - The Dream
1.plot: Millionaire business man Benedict Farley, a well known eccentric, consults Poirot about bad dreams he has been having. Mr. Farley has dreamed repeatedly of killing himself. Sadly, he does not follow Poirot's advice. When Farley is found dead, Poirot fails to believe that it is suicide and suspects a murder plot relying on hypnosis.

2.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S02E01 - Peril at End House
2.plot: Poirot and Hastings take a holiday in Cornwall, looking for peace and quiet. They meet Miss Nick Buckley, who lives near their hotel at End House, and she tells Poirot she has had three near-fatal accidents in a few weeks. He then finds a bullet hole in her hat, returns with her to End House and is drawn into a complex murder investigation.....

2.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S02E02 - The Veiled Lady
2.plot: Poirot calls to see the veiled lady of the title (Lady Millicent Castle-Vaughn) at her London hotel. Lady Millicent is about to be married, but a mean blackmailer called Lavington has got hold of a love letter she wrote years before to another man. Lavington wants twenty thousand pounds, and Poirot makes up his mind to recover the letter himself, even if it means impersonating a Swiss locksmith.

2.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S02E03 - The Lost Mine
2.plot: Hastings and Poirot are playing Monopoly when they are interrupted by Lord Pearson, the elegant Chairman of the London and Shanghai Bank. The banker asks them to investigate the disappearance of a Mr Ling - a highly-valued customer who before he went missing had arranged to sell Lord Pearson a map showing the location of a long-lost silver mine. Ling is found murdered, a young stockbroker is implicated, and Poirot has to untangle a complicated plot.

2.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S02E04 - The Cornish Mystery
2.plot: Poirot travels to Cornwall, summoned by a Mrs Pengelley, who suspects her dentist husband is poisoning her because he's fallen in love with his young assistant. Unhappily, Poirot finds Mrs Pengelley dead on his arrival, so he sets out to catch her killer.

2.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S02E05 - The Disappearance of Mr. Davenheim
2.plot: Matthew Davenheim, a rich banker, disappears on a walk from his country house to the village post office, and Inspector Japp of Scotland Yard is put onto the case. Poirot, who has developed an interest in conjuring tricks, bets Japp five pounds that he can solve the mystery without leaving his apartment.

2.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S02E06 - Double Sin
2.plot: Poirot tells a surprised Hastings he's decided to retire and suggests they take a holiday in the Lake District. On the way, Hastings befriends a young woman who is missing a collection of valuable miniatures. The case involves a famous writer and a beautiful woman in a sports car, and to the relief of Hastings Poirot's thoughts of retirement soon seem far away.

2.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S02E07 - The Adventure of the Cheap Flat
2.plot: A glamorous nightclub singer turned spy has stolen the US Navy's plans for a new submarine, and an FBI agent called Burt is in London to catch her. Burt dismisses Poirot as a gumshoe, and Poirot is likewise not impressed by the self-important G-man. Poirot is drawn into the case when it appears that the submarine plans will fall into the hands of the Fascist government in Italy unless they are recovered. When Poirot meets a young couple who've got an amazing bargain on a prime apartment, he sees a connection with the spy case.

2.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S02E08 - The Kidnapped Prime Minister
2.plot: Poirot is called in when the British Prime Minister and his secretary are kidnapped in France on their way to a League of Nations conference - and he is given just a day and a half to solve the case.

2.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S02E09 - The Adventure of the Western Star
2.plot: Marie Marvelle, a Belgian film star, receives threatening letters from a chinaman which demand her famous diamond, the Western Star. Marie visits her old friend Hercule Poirot in London, seeking his help, and Poirot tackles the case with relish.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E01 - How Does Your Garden Grow?
3.plot: Suggestions of a Communist conspiracy cast suspicion on a murdered woman's Russian servant. Meanwhile, Poirot has a rose named after him, and a ceremony at the Chelsea Flower Show makes him the centre of attention. Hastings receives a packet of seeds and develops hay fever.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E02 - The Million Dollar Bond Robbery
3.plot: The London and Scottish Bank is sending a huge shipment of Liberty Bonds to New York on the liner Queen Mary. Poirot, who suffers terribly from sea-sickness, is asked to see the bonds safely across the Atlantic.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E03 - The Plymouth Express
3.plot: An Australian shipping tycoon wants Poirot to check out his daughter's suitors. Then the young lady takes a trip on the Plymouth Express, and Poirot finds himself investigating a jewel theft on the train.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E04 - Wasps' Nest
3.plot: Poirot  visits a garden fete, where a wasps' nest adds to the tension. He meets the son of an old friend who has his girl-friend, a fashion model, with him, and Poirot soon suspects that they are both in danger. He has to solve a mystery which includes cyanide, failing brakes and mixed-up love lives. Meanwhile, Hastings has a new hobby which Poirot finds helpful in cracking the case.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E05 - The Tragedy at Marsdon Manor
3.plot: Poirot is summoned to Marsdon by the owner of a country inn there to solve a murder. But the inn-keeper is a would-be thriller writer, and to Poirot's dismay the murder turns out to be fictional. Thankfully, though, there is soon a real (if seemingly supernatural) murder at the big house. Things get even more interesting when a young wife claims that a tree in her garden is haunted by a laughing ghost, and there are also signs of black magic from East Africa. Poirot lays a clever ambush to smoke out the killer,confident that he or she will turn out to be human.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E06 - The Double Clue
3.plot:
Japp (who is really worried that failure could cost him his job) seeks Poirot's help in investigating a series of jewel thefts, and two remarkable things happen. Poirot falls in love (with the beautiful and clever Countess Vera Rossakoff) and he also meets a criminal intellect which he finds worthy of him. As the countess is his main suspect, Poirot spends most of his time with her - which for once leaves Hastings and Miss Lemon to do most of the actual detective work.

In the end, this case may have to be put down as the one that got away.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E07 - The Mystery of the Spanish Chest
3.plot: Poirot is called in to help a woman who lives in fear of her husband, and he is invited to a dinner party which goes horribly wrong.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E08 - The Theft of the Royal Ruby
3.plot: Poirot prepares to spend a quiet Christmas on his own with a box of chocolates, but he has to give up his plans when the British government asks for his urgent help. Prince Farouk, a  young member of the Egyptian royal family visiting London, has lost a famous ruby, and this is deemed to be a matter of national security.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E09 - The Affair at the Victory Ball
3.plot: Poirot attends the Victory Ball, a costume party where you are expected to dress as someone famous, as himself. However, when two members of a party of six dressed as characters from classical Italian comedy are subsequently found dead, Poirot finds himself working with Chief Inspector Japp to solve the case. The solution to the deaths of Viscount Cronshaw and Coco Courtney is to be found in determining the correct time of death and identifying an impostor at the ball. Poirot takes to the airwaves and reveals the identity of the killer on a live BBC radio broadcast.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E10 - The Mystery of Hunter's Lodge
3.plot: Hercule Poirot accompanies his friend Captain Hastings on a weekend shooting party at the home of Harrington Pace, but he isn't having a very good time. He comes down with the flu and takes to his bed but when Pace is shot dead in his study, he rises to the occasion to assist Inspector Japp in solving the case.

4.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S04E01 - The ABC Murders
4.plot: Beside the bodies of three murder victims lies a copy of the ABC Railway Guide.

4.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S04E02 - Death in the Clouds
4.plot: On an airplane, flying from Paris to London, one of the passengers is killed by a poison dart while Poirot sleeps.

4.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S04E03 - One, Two, Buckle My Shoe
4.plot: Poirot believes his dentist was murdered and Japp thinks it was a suicide.

5.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S05E01 - The Adventure of the Egyptian Tomb
5.plot: An archaeologist dies of a heart attack shortly after opening an ancient Egyptian tomb, but his widow thinks there is dirty work at the crossroads and calls Poirot.

5.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S05E02 - The Underdog
5.plot: A wealthy industrialist is found dead in his study. Is his death related to a discovery made at his chemical factory? And is his wife all she seems?

5.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S05E03 - The Yellow Iris
5.plot: Friends and family gather at a dinner party to mark the second anniversary of a woman's death. Meanwhile, Poirot is caught up in a coup d'etat and arrested as a spy, which prevents him from solving a murder at a French restaurant owned by an Italian in Buenos Aires.

5.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S05E04 - The Case of the Missing Will
5.plot: Poirot has to execute the final wishes of an old friend who has been killed.

5.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S05E05 - The Adventure of the Italian Nobleman
5.plot: Poirot is drawn into the underworld of London's Little Italy when Captain Hastings looks for a new car, but instead finds murder.

5.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S05E06 - The Chocolate Box
5.plot: Poirot returns to Belgium for the first time since the Great War. There he revisits a twenty-year-old murder mystery that was never officially solved.

5.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S05E07 - Dead Man's Mirror
5.plot: When Poirot investigates the mysterious death of a despised art dealer, he finds that he has more than enough suspects from whom to choose.

5.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S05E08 - Jewel Robbery at the Grand Metropolitan
5.plot: Mrs. Opalsen's famous pearls are stolen and Poirot is happily on hand to investigate. A complex theft calls for a sophisticated solution. Unfortunately, Poirot is hindered everywhere he goes by being mistaken for 'Lucky Len'.

6.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S06E01 - Hercule Poirot's Christmas
6.plot: Poirot's Christmas is interrupted by Simeon Lee, who believes his life is threatened. Simeon is soon killed and his diamonds stolen.

6.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S06E02 - Hickory Dickory Dock
6.plot: A string of thefts at a student hostel run by Miss Lemon's sister ends in death and Poirot has a number of plots and sub-plots to untangle. A certain mouse is the only witness to a string of murders.

6.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S06E03 - Murder on the Links
6.plot: Poirot and Hastings are on holiday in Deauville and receive a visit from Paul Renauld, who believes he's being cheated by Chileans. Renauld is kidnapped and his body is later found buried in a new golf bunker. French detective Giraud unwisely challenges Poirot to catch the killer before he can.

6.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S06E04 - Dumb Witness
6.plot: Poirot and Hastings are at Lake Windermere for an attempt on the world speed-boat record. An elderly widow is hurt by falling down stairs, then later killed by poisoning with phosphorus.

7.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S07E01 - The Murder of Roger Ackroyd
7.plot: Living quietly in the small village of King's Abbot, sleuth Hercule Poirot becomes involved in the murder of successful industrialist Roger Ackroyd. The number of potential killers is almost as great as the population of the village itself. As Poirot investigates he sees that there might be a connection to the suicide of a local woman, and the death the previous year of her husband.

7.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S07E02 - Lord Edgware Dies
7.plot: Lady Edgware has a dilemma in that her husband has consistently refused to give her a divorce. She asks Hercule Poirot to visit the man and see if there is any possibility of convincing him. When Lord Edgware is found dead, there is no great surprise, but there are a good number of suspects.

8.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S08E01 - Evil Under the Sun
8.plot: After collapsing with heart problems, Hercule Poirot visits a seaside health farm on Burgh Island. While there, the flirtatious heiress Arlena Stewart is found strangled on a secluded beach.

8.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S08E02 - Murder in Mesopotamia
8.plot: While accompanying his friend Hastings to a dig in Iraq, Hercule Poirot becomes involved in the murder of an archaeologist's wife.

9.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S09E01 - Five Little Pigs
9.plot: Lucy Crale hires Poirot to solve the murder of her father sixteen years before, and Poirot finds a number of possible suspects who are still alive.

9.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S09E02 - Sad Cypress
9.plot: Young Elinor Carlisle, engaged to marry the dashing Roddy Winter, finds herself charged with the fatal poisoning of Mary Gerrard, her rival in love. Poirot has the job of saving Elinor, but the evidence against her is overwhelming.

9.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S09E03 - Death on the Nile
9.plot: A wealthy British heiress honeymooning on a Nile cruise ship is stalked by a former friend, whose boyfriend she had stolen before making him her new husband.

9.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S09E04 - The Hollow
9.plot: Poirot is spending a week-end with the Angkatells, at their country house called The Hollow.

10.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S10E01 - The Mystery of the Blue Train
10.plot: After traveling on the Blue Train from Calais to Nice, Hercule Poirot is pressed into service to help solve the murder of heiress Ruth Kettering who is found savagely beaten in her compartment.

10.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S10E02 - Cards on the Table
10.plot: Hercule Poirot finds himself investigating the murder of his dinner host, Mr. Shaitana, who was stabbed in the heart while his guests played bridge.

10.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S10E03 - After the Funeral
10.plot: Hercule Poirot's solicitor, Gilbert Entwhistle, asks Poirot to help solve a riddle and a murder.

10.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S10E04 - Taken at the Flood
10.plot: Hercule Poirot finds himself trying to solve the mystery of the Cloade family

11.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S11E01 - Mrs McGinty's Dead
11.plot: James Bentley is arrested for the murder of old Mrs McGinty. It looks like an open and shut case, but Superintendent Spence is not convinced. He turns to Poirot for help, and together with Poirot's writer friend Ariadne Oliver they set out to find the real killer.

11.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S11E02 - Cat Among the Pigeons
11.plot: Poirot finds a connection between a recent murder and a revolution in the Middle Eastern kingdom of Ramat.

11.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S11E03 - Third Girl
11.plot: Three single girls share a London flat. The first works as a secretary; the second is an artist; the third, who comes to Poirot for help, disappears believing she is a murderer.

11.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S11E04 - Appointment With Death
11.plot: On holiday in Jerusalem, Poirot hears about an archaeological expedition to Syria led by the eccentric Lord Boynton and his son Leonard, who believe they are on the track of the head of St John the Baptist. Drawn to visit the dig, Poirot meets Boynton's dominating, fabulously rich, American-born second wife. However, events are overtaken by the discovery of Lady Boynton's dead body and revelations about her fortune.

12.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S12E01 - Hallowe'en Party
12.plot: Novelist Ariadne Oliver calls in her old friend Poirot to investigate a drowning at a Hallowe'en party

12.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S12E02 - Murder on the Orient Express
12.plot: On the Orient Express from Istanbul, a ruthless American businessman is found dead. Poirot investigates and makes a life-changing decision.

12.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S12E03 - The Clocks
12.plot: Four clocks surround an unidentified corpse in a blind woman's house, and a young typist is summoned to the crime scene. However, Poirot is convinced that the complicated setup is merely hiding a simpler solution.

12.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S12E04 - Three Act Tragedy
12.plot: Poirot is attending a dinner party when one of the guests chokes to death on a cocktail. With no trace of poison, and no apparent motive, can it be murder?

13.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S13E01 - Elephants Can Remember
13.plot: Poirot investigates a strange and gruesome murder of an elderly psychiatrist. Ariadne Oliver is pressed to try and uncover the truth behind two decade-old deaths. They soon find out that their separate investigations are linked and work together to try and solve the mystery.

13.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S13E02 - The Big Four
13.plot: With the world on the brink of WWII, there is more political turmoil when it appears that the famous Peace Party is in fact a cover for the Big Four.

13.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S13E03 - Dead Man's Folly
13.plot: Ariadne Oliver is asked to devise a murder hunt for a Devon fête, but her sense of foreboding summons Poirot to the scene. Her fears are realized when, during the fête, the girl playing her murder victim winds up well and truly murdered.

13.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S13E04 - The Labours of Hercules
13.plot: In an effort to recover his confidence after a rare professional failure, Poirot sets off for the Swiss Alps in pursuit of a missing maid.

13.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S13E05 - Curtain: Poirot's Last Case
13.plot: An ailing Poirot returns to Styles with Hastings nearly three decades after solving their first mystery together there in order to prevent an unscrupulous and ingenious serial killer from claiming more victims.

meta.plot: Hercule Poirot, ancien policier belge, a fui son pays pendant la Première Guerre mondiale. Désormais, il vit à Londres et exerce en tant que détective privé. Sa réputation d'enquêteur hors pair est internationale et de nombreuses personnes font appel à lui pour percer des mystères que la police n'a pas su résoudre.

1.title: FR - Black Butler OAV - S01E01 - His Butler, Able
1.plot: The Phantomhive estate bustles with preparations for an important meeting between the Young Master and a slithering captain of industry. The maid, the gardener, and the cook are fools, but the Butler is a man of hidden talents.

1.title: FR - Black Butler OAV - S01E02 - His Butler, Strongest
1.plot: Plans to suppress an uprising of the vermin variety are put on hold when the Young Master is abducted. The Butler is obligated to act decisively in such matters, and no one sets the table better than Sebastian.

1.title: FR - Black Butler OAV - S01E03 - His Butler, Omnipotent
1.plot: When the Young Master’s fiancée drops by for an unannounced visit, the Phantomhive Estate experiences a sickening outbreak of “cuteness.” Meanwhile, the Butler has his hands full with a suicidal apprentice.

1.title: FR - Black Butler OAV - S01E04 - His Butler, Capricious
1.plot: The Young Master dons an evening gown to apprehend a monster who’s been butchering women of the night, but if his talent for cross-dressing is discovered, the Phantomhive name will be irreversibly sullied.

1.title: FR - Black Butler OAV - S01E05 - His Butler, Chance Encounter
1.plot: The Butler and his Young Master scour the seedy back alleys of London in search of an infamous butcher. Imagine their surprise upon discovering that the ripper may actually be a reaper!

1.title: FR - Black Butler OAV - S01E06 - His Butler, at the Funeral

meta.plot: According to the Kuroshitsuji website, there are six OVAs included in the DVD releases. The second DVD features "Ciel in Wonderland (Part 1)," which reimagines the characters of Kuroshitsuji II in an Alice in Wonderland-esque tale inspired by Lewis Carroll. The third DVD, "Welcome to the Phantomhive's," provides a simulation game experience where Elizabeth invites a lady to attend a ball at the Phantomhive mansion. The fifth DVD, "The Making of Kuroshitsuji II," is a Hollywood-style documentary with behind-the-scenes interviews with Sebastian, Ciel, Claude, and Alois. "Ciel in Wonderland (Part 2)" again incorporates the characters of Kuroshitsuji II into a Lewis Carroll-inspired setting and is featured on the sixth DVD. On the eighth DVD, "The Tale of William the Shinigami" showcases William and Grell as they lead new shinigami training sessions and reminisce about their partnering years. To conclude, the ninth DVD, "The Spider's Intention," highlights the Trancy household and their care for Alois.

2.plot: Holden develops a controversial profile in the Atlanta slayings. Wendy conducts her first interview and finds being on the front lines suits her well.

2.title: FR - Mindhunter - S02E05 - Episode 5

2.title: FR - Mindhunter - S02E09 - Episode 9

meta.plot: An agent in the FBI's Elite Serial Crime Unit develops profiling techniques as he pursues notorious serial killers and rapists.

1.title: FR - The Outlaws - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Seven very different strangers begin their community payback sentences, renovating a derelict building in Bristol. But can any of these ‘outlaws’ really reform?

1.title: FR - The Outlaws - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: The outlaws find a bag of cash, clearly the proceeds of crime. But who does it belong to?

1.title: FR - The Outlaws - S01E03 - Episode 3

1.title: FR - The Outlaws - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: A lifelong scoundrel reflects on his past mistakes, the police recruit a surprising new deputy, and a young woman makes a decision which could endanger the lives of all of the outlaws. Can the outlaws launder their dirty money before the gangsters track them down?

1.title: FR - The Outlaws - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: The outlaws must hustle on two fronts — with a captain of industry, and a member of the landed gentry. An audacious break-in is planned, and an imposter is heartbreakingly exposed.

1.title: FR - The Outlaws - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Even with redemption seemingly in reach, the outlaws find their time running out, and the net closing around them. They face a stark choice — die apart, or survive together?

3.title: FR - The Outlaws - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: The Outlaws are moving on with their lives, but Rani’s shock return and the discovery of a dead body sends them hurtling back into mortal danger.

3.title: FR - The Outlaws - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: As the police investigate the crime and Rani's involvement, the other outlaws don't know who they can trust.

3.title: FR - The Outlaws - S03E03 - Episode 3
3.plot: Whilst Gabby considers motherhood, the Dean's defence is winning his case, and the police are closing in on the gang. Can the outlaws clear their names before it's too late?

3.title: FR - The Outlaws - S03E04 - Episode 4
3.plot: The outlaws unmask a traitor. Whilst reconciling their personal battles, they plan an audacious heist to steal evidence and take down the Dean.

3.title: FR - The Outlaws - S03E05 - Episode 5
3.plot: The outlaws must race against time to prove their innocence and keep the Dean behind bars. Will they finally be able to free themselves from a life of crime?

meta.plot: Seven strangers from different walks of life - people who would never normally interact - are forced to work together to renovate a derelict community centre. They resent the menial physical labour and they resent each other. But when one of their number gets dragged into a dangerous world of organised crime, they unite in ways none of them thought possible.

1.plot: Needing to prove herself to her bosses, Sadie must favor trade with Liberty Direct News reporter Kimberlyn to secure a critical interview.

1.title: FR - The Girls on the Bus - S01E03 - The Audacity of Nope
1.plot: In Las Vegas, Sadie schools Lola on the presidential pool, Kimberlyn snags a primetime slot and Grace pursues a candidate's medical records.

1.title: FR - The Girls on the Bus - S01E04 - Two Americas
1.plot: At an unexpected memorial service, Lola and Kimberlyn fall out over different expressions of grief. Later, Grace clashes with her daughter Annie, and Sadie gets an anonymous tip before her career is thrown into jeopardy.

1.title: FR - The Girls on the Bus - S01E05 - Everything Is Copy
1.plot: While Sadie must defend herself at work, Kimberlyn prepares for her engagement party and Lola contemplates a new relationship.

1.title: FR - The Girls on the Bus - S01E06 - The Debate
1.plot: When the bus breaks down just hours before the Democratic debate, a disillusioned Lola struggles to fulfill her sponsorships, Grace and Sadie scheme to find a source and Kimberlyn gets existential about her career.

1.title: FR - The Girls on the Bus - S01E07 - She Was Against It, Before She Was for It
1.plot: While on the road, Grace and Sadie track down new sources for their explosive story on one of Walker's donors, Lola confronts her family after an article about her past drops and Kimberlyn cracks under her own expectations.

1.title: FR - The Girls on the Bus - S01E08 - Life Is a Highway
1.plot: After breaking a crucial story, Grace must face her family issues when Annie goes radio silent. Later, Kimberlyn and Sadie bond while retrieving an important package and Lola discovers her social media has been hacked.

1.title: FR - The Girls on the Bus - S01E10 - The Everydays

meta.plot: Four female journalists follow every move of a parade of flawed presidential candidates, while finding friendship, love, and scandal along the way.

1.title: FR - 42 Days of Darkness - S01E01 - These Things Don't Happen Here
1.plot: After a woman disappears from her home, her husband alerts the police, a lawyer gets interested in the case, and her sister leads a search in the area.

1.title: FR - 42 Days of Darkness - S01E02 - If You Vanished, What Would They Say About You?
1.plot: The police receive an anonymous letter. Pizarro carries out his own investigation with the help of two associates and offers his services to the family.

1.title: FR - 42 Days of Darkness - S01E03 - The House Across the Street
1.plot: The media descend upon the Montes family's home. Mario draws suspicion when inconsistencies between his declaration and Verónica's call log are found.

1.title: FR - 42 Days of Darkness - S01E04 - Day 42

1.title: FR - 42 Days of Darkness - S01E05 - I Don't Believe What They Say
1.plot: After sharing the forensic report's conclusion with Cecilia, Pizarro and his team deepen their research. Years later, a new lead reopens the case.

1.title: FR - 42 Days of Darkness - S01E06 - Still In the Dark
1.plot: A confession reignites the family's hope to get justice, but the lack of evidence threatens to hurt the case. Kari asks her dad a painful question.

meta.plot: In a town in Chile, a woman leads a frantic search to find her missing sister amid a media storm and the police investigation. Inspired by a true case.

1.title: FR - Under the Bridge - S01E01 - Looking Glass
1.plot: In 1997, on a quiet island in BC, fourteen-year-old Reena Virk attends a party and never returns home. Her disappearance intrigues a novelist returning to her hometown, who finds herself drawn into the hidden world of the teen suspects…

1.title: FR - Under the Bridge - S01E02 - The John Gotti of Seven Oaks
1.plot: Cam is thrown by a shocking discovery, and the police rush to unravel what really happened under the bridge. Josephine makes a deal with Rebecca, while a look into the past reveals Reena's first rebellion.

1.title: FR - Under the Bridge - S01E03 - Blood Oath
1.plot: Upsetting news shakes the small town of Victoria, and as rumors surface, Rebecca and Cam reconnect. In the past, Reena enters Josephine's mafia fantasy world.

1.title: FR - Under the Bridge - S01E04 - Beautiful British Columbia
1.plot: In 1979, Suman and Manjit fall in love, setting into motion a series of events that will change their lives forever. In 1997, the Seven Oaks girls come to the Virk house for a dinner to remember, leading to the shocking revelation of Manjit's secret.

1.title: FR - Under the Bridge - S01E05 - When the Heat Comes Down
1.plot: Tensions rise as suspicions surround the teens. Rebecca and Cam hatch a plan — but an unexpected detour leads Rebecca down a strange rabbit hole, resulting in a new bond.

1.title: FR - Under the Bridge - S01E06 - In Water They Sink As the Same
1.plot: Past and present wounds entwine as Rebecca and Cam's alliance is tested. The Virks discuss taking matters into their own hands, and the teens use a school dance as cover for their escape plan — all as another life is threatened.

1.title: FR - Under the Bridge - S01E07 - Three and Seven

meta.plot: Reena Virk, a fourteen-year-old girl, went to join friends at a party and never returned home. Seven teenage girls and a boy were accused of the savage murder.

4.plot: Daisy goes to battle Ghost Rider at a terrible cost, and Coulson faces the new Director, and his bold agenda surprises them all.

4.title: FR - Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. - S04E03 - Uprising
4.plot: As Coulson, Mack and Fitz attempt to track down and neutralize a rogue group looking to end Inhuman Registration worldwide, Simmons and Dr. Radcliffe only have hours to save May before she succumbs forever to her mysterious illness.

4.title: FR - Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. - S04E04 - Let Me Stand Next to Your Fire
4.plot: As Ghost Rider's quest for vengeance brings him into an explosive confrontation with S.H.I.E.L.D., Coulson and Mack must rely on an unlikely ally in their time of desperate need; and Daisy reunites with a familiar face to stop the Watchdogs.

4.title: FR - Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. - S04E05 - Lockup
4.plot: As Robbie Reyes struggles to control the Ghost Rider; S.H.I.E.L.D. infiltrates a high-security prison to unravel the secrets that haunt them all.

4.title: FR - Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. - S04E06 - The Good Samaritan
4.plot: Robbie's shocking story on how he became Ghost Rider is finally discovered as Coulson and his team's lives hang in the balance.

4.plot: With the loss of half the team, the remaining members search for answers as the clock counts down for Ghost Rider.

4.plot: May works to uncover the truth about what happened to her; Aida's next move puts everyone's life at risk.

4.title: FR - Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. - S04E12 - Hot Potato Soup

4.title: FR - Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. - S04E13 - BOOM
4.plot: Daisy, Director Mace and the S.H.I.E.L.D. team must find a way to contain an explosive Inhuman. Meanwhile, Coulson and Mack come face-to-face with Radcliffe’s inspiration for Aida.

4.plot: As Daisy and Simmons struggle to discover an escape route to the real world, the identity of the Inhuman leader of the Resistance is revealed.

4.title: FR - Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. - S04E18 - No Regrets
4.plot: The truth behind Fitz's turn could bring down all of S.H.I.E.L.D..

4.title: FR - Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. - S04E19 - All the Madame's Men
4.plot: Daisy finds herself teamed up with an unlikely partner. Meanwhile, Aida prepares to put her ultimate end game into effect.

4.title: FR - Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. - S04E20 - Farewell, Cruel World!

meta.plot: Yamazaki Risako lives with her husband Yoichiro and 3-year-old daughter Fumika. One day, she receives a notification from the court that she has been selected as an alternate member of the jury for a shocking criminal case. The defendant in the case is Ando Mizuho, a full-time housewife who is the same age as Risako. She is on trial for causing the death of her 8-month-old daughter by dropping her into the bathtub. As a mother herself, Risako feels repulsed that Mizuho killed her own child. However, after the trial opens, Mizuho’s circumstances remind Risako of her own past and she soon becomes confused with the chaotic feelings that have lain dormant in her. (Source: jdramas.wordpress.com)

1.title: FR - History's Greatest Heists with Pierce Brosnan - S01E01 - The Antwerp Diamond Heist
1.plot: An elite crew of Italian thieves targets the vault of the Antwerp World Diamond Centre; after 27 months of planning, they execute their ambitious and intricate plan and make off with more than $100 million in diamonds, gems and cash.

1.title: FR - History's Greatest Heists with Pierce Brosnan - S01E02 - The Pierre Hotel Robbery
1.plot: A duo of highly skilled thieves who specialize in hotel jobs go after the biggest target of their careers: New York's famed Pierre Hotel; the team takes over the hotel, getting into the lobby vault and its hundreds of safe deposit boxes.

1.title: FR - History's Greatest Heists with Pierce Brosnan - S01E03 - The Baker Street Bank Burglary

1.plot: Two thieves dressed as fake cops make off with a half-billion dollars' worth of world-class artwork from a Boston museum; although the paintings are still missing, numerous suspects turn up dead.

meta.plot: Since the creation of currency, money has made the world go round and people have done anything and everything in their power to get their hands on a lot of it, including formulating some of the most devious and high-stakes heist attempts of all time. Using dramatic recreations, dynamic storytelling and cutting-edge visual effects, alongside first-person witness accounts from the people who were there, “History’s Greatest Heists with Pierce Brosnan” delves into the intricate schemes and audacity of the criminal masterminds who risked their freedom for a shot at a lifetime of wealth and riches. Brosnan, who is embedded into each heist through state-of-the-art technology, brings each global news headline to life by putting viewers at the heart of the action and breaking down every aspect of the plan including the conniving team, the mark, the execution and finally the aftermath.

La nuit où Macha sauve Gaby des mains de son agresseur, en l'occurrence un avocat du Cabinet Fichaud, les filles entament une quête pour se faire justice elles-mêmes. Ni vues ni connues, dans le gratte-ciel où elles travaillent de nuit, elles multiplient les petits actes de sabotage pour tenter de retrouver leur dignité et faire perdre à l'avocat son pouvoir, au risque de déraper.

Glamour, ego battles, extravagant celebrations and destructive passion: Witness how Karl Lagerfeld became a legend.

meta.plot: Percy Jackson a une mission dangereuse. Tout en déjouant des monstres et des dieux, il doit parcourir l’Amérique pour retourner l’Éclair primitif à Zeus et mettre fin à une guerre sans merci. Après avoir perdu sa mère, Percy trouve refuge à la Colonie des Sang-Mêlé, un sanctuaire pour les enfants demi-dieux. Il doit faire ses preuves et faire face à ses origines en découvrant qu’il est aussi un demi-dieu et poursuivre une quête périlleuse visant à pourchasser ses ennemis dans la recherche des Enfers. Avec l’aide de ses complices, Annabeth et Grover, Percy va poursuivre sa quête, qui le rapprochera des réponses qu’il cherche :  reverra-t-il sa mère et comment peut-il s’intégrer dans un monde où il se sent exclu et trouver son destin?
