5.plot: Grissom is called to a murder of a 17-year-old in a casino penthouse. Sophia Curtis (Louise Lombard) joins him in his research, she normally works in the day-shift. The entire team gets involved when its discovered that a kiddnapping took place along with the murder.

5.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S05E08 - Ch-Ch-Changes
5.plot: A woman who was pulled over by police is found murdered two miles up the road from the stop. It's not long before Robbins determines that the woman is, genetically speaking, not a woman.

5.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S05E09 - Mea Culpa
5.plot: Grissom is confronted with new evidence while on the stand of a murder trial of a restaurant owner. This development requires the reopening of the case and Eckley initiates an inquiry into Grissom and his team. The results of the inquiry lead to dramatic changes of the CSI team and the series.

5.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S05E10 - No Humans Involved
5.plot: Grissom and his team investigate the starving death of a five year old boy. They discover the boy has siblings who are in danger too. Catherine and her team determine who killed a prisoner in a holding cell brawl.

5.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S05E11 - Who Shot Sherlock?
5.plot: Greg, for his final proficiency, has to determine how the Sherlock Holmes of a Sherlock Holmes club was killed. Nick and Warrick try to determine how the driver of jeep was killed when the car ran off the road. They have to do this under budget while Catherine is watched by Ecklie.

5.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S05E12 - Snakes
5.plot: The swing shift has a busy time. Warrick looks into the murder of man by someone who apparently needs a wheelchair. Nick looks into the murder of woman in the subculture of the narcocorrido, songs about drug murders. The night shift is slow and lends help to Catherine's team.

5.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S05E13 - Nesting Dolls
5.plot: Catherine, Warrick and Nick find the body of two women at a construction site buried under tar. The swing shift are brought into the world of foreign "mail-order" brides. Sara and Catherine have a dispute in which Sara gets suspended by Ecklie for acting insubordinately towards Catherine and himself. Sara opens up to Grissom about her childhood past.

5.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S05E14 - Unbearable
5.plot: Grissom, Sofia, Sara and Greg investigate the disappearance of a woman coming home from a night out with a friend, her abandoned car found on the edge of a highway.  Catherine, Warrick and Nick investigate the deaths of a hunter and his prey, a Kodiak bear.

5.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S05E15 - King Baby
5.plot: When a major Las Vegas player is found dead, Ecklie orders both teams to investigate the case. The man who had secrets on everyone in Vegas had a very big one of his own.

5.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S05E16 - Big Middle
5.plot: Catherine, Nick, and Warrick investigate a badly mutilated body in the woods. The cause of death was a shotgun blast. Nearby is a beaver dam made in part with cash. Grissom, Sarah, and Nick try to determine how a man was killed in a hotel room. It leads them to a convention of big women.

5.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S05E17 - Compulsion
5.plot: A serial killer strikes again, and the CSI team tries new technology using evidence from a prior killing.  They find a fingerprint belonging to Jesse Acheson, who becomes the prime suspect.  A boy confesses to the killing of his brother, but evidence suggests that he may not have committed the crime.

5.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S05E18 - Spark of Life
5.plot: Grissom, Sara, and Nick investigate a wildfire that killed one man and badly burned a woman. Catherine, Nick, and Warrick get the case of a family of three murdered in their home.

5.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S05E19 - 4 x 4
5.plot: One night, four cases. Grissom and Brass get a stolen hummer and a taco stand. Warrick gets a dead car show girl. Sara and Greg get a dead bodybuilder. Nick gets a dead boy found on a bench.

5.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S05E20 - Hollywood Brass
5.plot: Brass travels to Hollywood, California to try to track down his estranged  daughter's friend, meanwhile trying to rekindle some kind of relationship with her.

5.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S05E21 - Committed
5.plot: Grissom and Sara investigate the murder of a mental-hospital patient and quickly narrow down the suspects to a handful of other patients and staff members.

5.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S05E22 - Weeping Willows
5.plot: A man (Alan Rosenberg) whom Catherine flirted with at a bar reappears in her life as a suspect in a murder investigation.

5.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S05E23 - Iced
5.plot: Two amorous freshmen are found dead on a sleeping bag in a dorm room, and Sara and Greg run into one dead end after another as they try to determine why the students were killed. Warrick, Nick and Catherine figure out how a man is found dead in the center of a crop circle. Ecklie is called into duty for a man found dead in his car and his body later goes missing.

5.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S05E24 - Grave Danger (1)
5.plot: The CSI teams come together to save one of their own when they learn one team member has been kidnapped and buried alive, and now they must find him before he suffocates under five feet of dirt.

5.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S05E25 - Grave Danger (2)
5.plot: The CSI teams come together to save one of their own when they learn one team member has been kidnapped and buried alive, and now they must find him before he suffocates under five feet of dirt.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E01 - Bodies in Motion
6.plot: The two forensic teams come back together under the leadership of Grissom and Catherine just in time to tackle three separate investigations: a murdered couple found in bed in a suspicious trailer explosion; a beautiful stripper discovered dead and dumped in the worst part of town; and two bodies found baked and decomposed after spending five days in the trunk of a car exposed to the hot Vegas sun, forcing the CSIs to ""wrap"" up the evidence and bring it back to the lab for further analysis.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E02 - Room Service
6.plot: An up-and-coming movie star is found dead in his hotel room after a night of partying with his groupies.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E03 - Bite Me
6.plot: The CSIs investigate a man's claim that his wife fell down a set of stairs in their home.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E04 - Shooting Stars
6.plot: The CSIs come across an abandoned military compound being used by a small cult. The CSIs grow suspicious when they see that a mass suicide has taken place, but only 11 of the 12 beds are occupied.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E05 - Gum Drops
6.plot: Nick takes the lead on a case where in the house a family of four, three pools of blood are found. Nick thinks that the little girl may still be alive, but Sara is doubtful, thinking that Nick's recent near-death experience is affecting his judgement.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E06 - Secrets and Flies
6.plot: A 28 year-old single mother is found dead. Initially, it's believed to be a suicide, but Catherine determines she was murdered. Also, Ecklie summons Grissom to refute the testimony of an entomologist in a murder trial.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E07 - A Bullet Runs Through It (1)
6.plot: The team must investigate the death of a police officer who died during a shootout leaving hundreds of bullets on the crime scene. The case becomes complicated when it turns out that Sofia Curtis and Jim Brass were with the victims during the shootout. When it turns out the officer died from friendly fire, it is up to the team to find out who fired the fatal shot. Meanwhile, Sofia is wondering whether she fired the fatal shot or not. She decides to hide the fact that the officer stepped into her line of fire, afraid it will ruin her career.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E08 - A Bullet Runs Through It (2)
6.plot: The CSIs sift through the overwhelming evidence from a shootout with drug dealers in order to determine who is responsible for the death of a police officer killed during the incident.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E09 - Dog Eat Dog
6.plot: Catherine and Brass investigate the case in which a man is found dead in a dumpster. It soon turns out the man had a serious food problem. The trail of his death soon leads to a hotdog-eating contest.Meanwhile, Nick and Sara investigate a not-so-amicable divorce with a bizarre twist. So bizarre it eventually lead to murder when both are found dead and it looks like the dog killed one of them.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E10 - Still Life
6.plot: The CSI's are called out to investigate the disappearance of a boy whose father died four years ago. Soon a couple is arrested at a convenience store with a boy matching the description of the missing kid. The only problem is they both claim it is their son.  Both parents have exactly the same picture of the boy, with a scar on exactly the same place on his face. They hope a DNA-test could confirm who the real parents are, but when this information comes to light, it lead to another bizarre twist, possibly murder.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E11 - Werewolves
6.plot: The CSI team investigates the murder of a man suffering from a congenital hypertrichosis, causing him to grow excessive body hair.  Elements of the case suggest a connection with a belief in werewolves. The case leads to the victim's sister, who suffers from the same disease.  Because of her condition, she'd been hiding from the world, but it turns out that she's hiding facts that are vital to solving the case.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E12 - Daddy's Little Girl
6.plot: The CSIs investigate the stabbing of a motocross racer who was about to leave town with a young woman he had been living with.  Also, Nick comes closer to finding the truth about his kidnapping.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E13 - Kiss-Kiss, Bye-Bye
6.plot: The CSIs crash an elegant party for the city's crème of the crème to discover who killed a young man.  The case gets a bit more personal for Catherine when her father, Sam Braun, is one of the suspects.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E14 - Killer
6.plot: The CSIs must investigate when a party girl is injured and killed in a traffic accident.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E15 - Pirates of the Third Reich
6.plot: The CSIs investigate the gruesome murder of Lady Heather's estranged daughter, Zoe, who was found in the middle of the Vegas desert.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E16 - Up In Smoke
6.plot: The investigation into a body found in a chimney leads the CSIs to re-open an investigation of an unsolved homicide of a female teenager named Caroline Fitzgibbons.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E17 - I Like To Watch
6.plot: The CSIs become the focus of a reality TV series, which follows them while they investigate a serial rapist, who recently gained access to a woman's apartment by posing as a fireman.  Also, Warrick's work on the late-shift is causing problems with his marriage to Tina.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E18 - The Unusual Suspect
6.plot: When a student is arrested and tried for the murder of a popular high-school girl, the suspect's 12-year-old sister confesses to the crime.  This results in the judge giving the prosecution 72 hours to re-examine the evidence before the jury delivers its verdict.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E19 - Spellbound
6.plot: The team investigates the death of a psychic who "saw" her own death while performing a reading for two other women.  Greg reveals a family secret to Grissom but Grissom believes that science will be what solves the case.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E20 - Poppin' Tags
6.plot: The CSI team is lead into the rap music world as they investigate the murders of three rival teen rappers.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E21 - Rashomama
6.plot: A wealthy defense attorney is killed at her son’s wedding but Nick’s car, containing all the collected evidence is stolen and the case is compromised. After discovering new evidence, the team suspects that someone from the wedding party may be responsible for the murder.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E22 - Time Of Your Death
FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E23 - Bang-Bang (1)
6.plot: A man accused of murdering his wife and co-workers leads the CSIs on a wild ride through a busy casino, eventually barricading himself and a hostage in a casino hotel room.  The CSIs process the evidence from the crime scene to determine whether or not the man acted alone or had an accomplice.  One of the CSIs eventually steps in as a hostage negotiator, putting himself in danger.

6.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S06E24 - Way To Go (2)
6.plot: In the season finale, the CSIs wait by the bedside of one of their own when he's shot in the line of duty.  One CSI faces a hard choice by having the power of attorney over their injured friend and colleague.  Meanwhile, the team also investigates the strange way of life of one man when he is found decapitated by a train.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E01 - Built To Kill (1)
7.plot: In part one of this two-part seventh season opener Grissom and Catherine handle the case of a women's dead body found at Cirque du Soleil by a performer. Meanwhile, an investor at one of Sam Braun's new casinos is shot to death during a party on the rooftop. Catherine's life is in jeopardy after visiting a nightclub with Nick. Grissom finds a miniature replica of a crime scene that he is investigating.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E02 - Built To Kill (2)
7.plot: In the second part of this two-parter Grissom investigates the murder of an aging rockstar who is found dead in his kitchen with an exact replica of the crime scene on the counter next to him. Meanwhile, Catherine probes her own abduction and learns that someone may be targeting her family.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E03 - Toe Tags
7.plot: Coming straight from the perspectives of five people: Donna, Rebecca, Jack, Lou and Ray. All with one thing in common. They’re all dead. Brass and Catherine get to handle the case of Donna, who’s a cop from San Francisco, moonlighting as a bodyguard. Warrick and Greg work the case of Rebecca, who’s a former supermodel who died while hiking with her new husband Gavin. Nick and Sofia handle the case of Jack, a returning veteran from Iraq, who was killed in front of his wife and baby daughter who he just met for the first time. Grissom and Sara take the case of Lou and Ray whose bodies were found in Lou’s garage.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E04 - Fannysmackin'
7.plot: Three tourists are beat up, badly. One is dead, Alfonzo. Jessica is badly beaten but is still alive. Stanley, the last tourist is saved by Greg who ends up severely hurt in turn and ends up hospitalized after having to make a life altering decision.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E05 - Double-Cross
7.plot: Grissom and Sara may be secret lovers, but they still find ways to surprise each other like when their religious beliefs surface when two nuns find a body of a woman crucified on a makeshift cross. The woman was found in a church where the priest may be a man of sin instead of a man of God.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E06 - Burn Out
7.plot: Grissom attempts to get a confession from a neighborhood pedophile by having him help in locating two missing boys.  The sex offender is the main suspect.  The investigation is more complex than the team ever thought it would be.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E07 - Post Mortem
7.plot: While investigating an elderly woman's murder, Grissom receives a miniature crime scene replica; Greg attends a hearing to ascertain his culpability in a teenager's accidental death.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E08 - Happenstance
7.plot: Identical twins are found murdered on the same night.  The CSI’s investigate the two separate murders only to find a twist in the investigation find that leads them in another new direction.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E09 - Living Legend
7.plot: The Cadillac of an infamous 1970’s mob boss turns up in a lake, even though he disappeared years ago. A photo of current murder victims also turns up in the car, so the team must determine whether this current murder spree is related to the missing gangster.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E10 - Loco Motives
7.plot: Grissom investigates when a worker at a poultry processing plant is found dead in a stun bath used to electrocute chickens before they are slaughtered. Nearby, a miniature replica of the crime scene is discovered. It's eerily similar to two other replicas left at scenes of homicides. Also, a man and a dead woman are found stuck in cement at a construction site; and an elderly Russian woman is discovered dead in her apartment with her head in a gas stove, but Warrick thinks she was murdered.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E11 - Leaving Las Vegas
7.plot: Catherine testifies in a murder trial in which a man is accused of murdering his own mother three years ago, but the suspect is found not guilty. Catherine, however, believes he did commit the crime and that he may also have killed two other people, so she sets out to find the other victims. Grissom prepares to leave on a four-week sabbatical.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E12 - Sweet Jane
7.plot: The team has a hard time trying to understand Michael who has become a team member since Grissom’s teaching hiatus.  They investigate the murder of an unidentified girl who may have been killed by a serial killer who has been killing since the early 1970’s.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E13 - Redrum
7.plot: At Keppler's request Catherine uses a different approach to catch the killer, and in doing so she deceives the rest of the CSI team.  The team soon discovers that something is amiss in Catherine’s investigation.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E14 - Meet Market
7.plot: Nick and Keppler investigate the bizarre world of the black market sales of body parts after they find a body that has been burned and the organs removed.  The rest of the CSI team investigates the death of rich woman who was killed in her own home.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E15 - Law of Gravity
7.plot: Grissom returns from his sabbatical; Keppler is put into a compromising position when the bodies of a Trenton police officer and a hooker are found in a hotel room. The man who found them is a retired New Jersey cop and close friend to Keppler, who doesn't reveal their relationship.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E16 - Monster in the Box
7.plot: Once he unseals a package sent to him through the mail, Grissom is floored when he finds a miniature crime scene inside. The finding is entirely more perplexing since the successive killer accountable for earlier related miniature crimes is now deceased. Grissom plows to examine the miniature and discover the actual location, when the investigation makes it clear the murder showed has yet to happen, but is probably going to happen soon.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E17 - Fallen Idols
7.plot: Grissom and his team are discouraged when they find a pool of blood as they begin investigating the disappearance of a high school basketball star and his cheerleader girlfriend.Grissom's quip that the young lovers may have run off to Mexico is soon quashed by the discovery of drops of blood by Ryan's vacant parking spot at the school. After finding a letterman jacket and cheerleading sweater in the field house and a pool of Ryan's blood nearby, the team tries to determine what went awry.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E18 - Empty Eyes
7.plot: The terrified eyes and cryptic words of a murder victim haunt Sara while she processes the house where several showgirls were killed.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E19 - Big Shots
7.plot: After a man is killed in his limousine, Greg finds that the murder victim has ties to the man he had to kill in self-defense.  The team finds that the brother is involved in this investigation and has to deal with him and his hostile mother.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E20 - Lab Rats
7.plot: The CSI labrats take center stage to discuss the case of the Miniature Killer.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E21 - Ending Happy
7.plot: When a has-been boxer is killed, the CSIs must establish which of several life-threatening acts actually killed him.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E22 - Leapin' Lizards
7.plot: Several suspects in a murder case are UFO-club members who believe shape-shifting aliens have been working to conquer the human race for centuries

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E23 - The Good, the Bad, and the Dominatrix
7.plot: Grissom investigates when a sadistic client tries to murder Lady Heather (Melinda Clarke), who makes the probe more difficult when she refuses to name her attacker. Also, Grissom's reunion with Lady Heather makes Sara uneasy.

7.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S07E24 - Living Doll
7.plot: As the CSI's continue their search for and discover the identity of the "Miniature Killer", Grissom and Sara's relationship gets exposed to the rest of the team as she goes missing during the investigation. The "Miniature Killer" is finally captured, but not before a member of CSI becomes the killer's final victim.

8.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S08E01 - Dead Doll
8.plot: With time, the weather, and the desert against them, the CSI team must work together to find Sara before she dies from the miniature killer's attack.

8.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S08E02 - A La Cart
8.plot: The CSI team investigates two unusual cases, one involving the suspicious death of a go-cart racer who took his hobby to the highway and paid the price with his life, and a murder at a hip new restaurant where patrons dine in the dark

8.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S08E03 - Go To Hell
8.plot: The team investigates a girl whose whole family had been killed and she is supposedly possessed by the devil.

8.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S08E04 - The Case of the Cross-Dressing Carp
8.plot: Grissom investigates the mysterious hanging death of a young man whose body looks like that of a female.

8.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S08E05 - The Chick Chop Flick Shop
8.plot: Grissom and his team investigate when an actress is killed on the set of a horror porn film.

8.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S08E06 - Who and What (I)
8.plot:
Grissom and the team join forces with Jack Malone, an FBI Agent from New York to track a serial killer.

The crossover continues on Without A Trace S06E06 Where & Why (II).

8.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S08E07 - Goodbye and Good Luck
8.plot: Sara questions her future as a CSI when a past case comes back to haunt her, the 12 year old Hannah, who has to back up her brother one more time with all new tricks up her sleeves.

8.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S08E08 - You Kill Me
8.plot: Hodges stages hypothetical murders in the lab in order to give his fellow lab techs a chance to play CSI, but unbenownst to them he has other motives behind his actions.  Meanwhile, after Sara's farewell, everyone tries to comfort Grissom.

8.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S08E09 - Cockroaches
8.plot: The team investigates an underground mob.  Warrick ends up becoming the prime suspect in a murder that's related to the mob, and his addiction to pills starts to have a significant impact on his job as a CSI.

8.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S08E10 - Lying Down With Dogs
8.plot: The world of illegal dog fighting is explored by Grissom and the rest of the team when they take on the case of a wealthy socialite who was murdered.  Meanwhile, Warrick struggles to clear his name in the recent exotic dancer murder case.

8.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S08E11 - Bull
8.plot: Two murders that happen during Las Vegas' annual bull riding rodeo are investigated by the CSIs, who find that the murders might be connected to illegal bull breeding.

8.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S08E12 - Grissom's Divine Comedy
8.plot: Grissom and his team battle the flu when they are called upon by D.D.A. Klein to investigate the deaths of several key witnesses for a grand jury case against a dangerous Las Vegas gang.

8.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S08E13 - A Thousand Days on Earth
8.plot: CSI investigates the death of a little girl whose identity remains unknown.

8.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S08E14 - Drops Out
8.plot: Brass, Catherine, Grissom and Nick work the case of a female victim found in an apartment building with a gun shot wound. Drops becomes a person of interest during the investigation, even though he is still in jail.

8.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S08E15 - The Theory of Everything
8.plot: A deer is illegally killed, and the person found with the body in the back of his truck apparently dressed it in a tutu. The man, who was completely drunk when arrested, was being interrogated by Nick and Brass, and suddently tries to escape and is pepper sprayed. Unfazed by the spray, officers then taser him and he bursts into flames and dies. Meanwhile an unbalanced woman wearing a tinfoil outfit at the front desk tries to warn people (including Nick) of an alien invasion. After observing the burning man, she later turns up dead with green-tinted blood. When other people turn up with the same problem, it's up to the team to figure out why. Meanwhile, an old couple dies, apparently in their sleep... but there is evidence the cases are related.

8.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S08E16 - Two and a Half Deaths
8.plot: Grissom, Catherine, Nick, Greg and Brass are investigating the death of a well known TV star called Annabelle.

8.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S08E17 - For Gedda
8.plot: Catherine comforts Warrick when he is accused of murdering a famous Vegas gangster and even he is uncertain of his guilt or innocence.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E01 - For Warrick
9.plot: After Warrick is shot in a Las Vegas alley, the CSI team comes together to deal with the aftermath.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E02 - The Happy Place
9.plot: A hypnotist bank robber becomes the prime suspect in a murder investigation.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E03 - Art Imitates Life
9.plot: After several victims are found dead while performing normal, everyday activities, the CSIs must find the reason as to why each of the victims remain upright after dying.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E04 - Let it Bleed
9.plot: The team investigates the death of a woman who turns out to be the daughter of a wanted criminal.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E05 - Leave out All the Rest
9.plot: Grissom asks Lady Heather for help when the team investigates a case connected to the world of domination.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E06 - Say Uncle
9.plot: The team has a hard time investigating a shooting in Koreatown when none of the witnesses will talk about the crime.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E07 - Woulda, Coulda, Shoulda
9.plot: The murder of a mother and her child seems to be connected to a murder case from 12 years earlier.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E08 - Young Man with a Horn
9.plot: A popular young singer is found dead outside an infamous Las Vegas nightclub, leading the CSI team to uncover a link between that crime and a murder 50 years earlier.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E09 - CSI-19 down
9.plot: When the team discovers a connection between a new murder and a serial killer, Grissom secretly joins the class of a criminal pathologist (Laurence Fishburne) to help crack the case.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E10 - One to Go
9.plot: The CSI team is shocked and saddened when, after working with Dr. Raymond Langston (Fishburne) on the "Dick & Jane" murders, Grissom announces that his time as a CSI has come to an end and offers Langston a permanent position on the CSI team.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E11 - The Grave Shift
9.plot: The first day on the job for Dr. Langston turns from bad to worse when a simple burglary case quickly overlaps with a complicated arson and homicide case.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E12 - Disarmed and Dangerous
9.plot: The detectives search for the murderer of FBI agent Billy Ray Jackson, only Billy Ray isn't really an FBI agent, and neither are his impressively capable partners, Miles Baker and Emma Solomon.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E13 - Deep Fried and Minty Fresh
9.plot: Langston and Nick are called to investigate a murder at a fast food restaurant and have quite a task ahead of them when they discover that much of the evidence is coated in cooking oil.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E14 - Miscarriage of Justice
9.plot: While Langston testifies in the trial of a respected Congressman, new evidence sends the CSIs back to the lab to reopen the investigation.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E15 - Kill Me If You Can
9.plot: The CSI are called to three different crime scenes in one night that are seemingly unrelated, but each case's forensic evidence reveals a common link

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E16 - Turn, Turn, Turn
9.plot: When the CSIs are called to a murder scene at a familiar motel, Nick is thrown for a loop as he pieces together three separate murder investigations that all took place at the same establishment over the course of a year.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E17 - No Way Out
9.plot: Langston and Riley are taken hostage during the aftermath of a shootout in an usually calm Las Vegas community.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E18 - Mascara
9.plot: Langston is shocked when his former student is found murdered and becomes the focus of a CSI investigation into the world of Mexican wrestling.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E19 - The Descent of Man
9.plot: When a seasoned sky diver is paralyzed after free falling to earth when his parachute doesn't deploy, he turns out to be linked to the strange death-by-airborne-toxins of two wealthy men with ties to Iran.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E20 - A Space Oddity
9.plot: When the producer of the reboot of a classic SF show is murdered at a Las Vegas science-fiction convention attended by both Hodges and Wendy (both, unknown to each other, fans of the original show), they find a connection with each other as the team investigates the crime.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E21 - If I Had A Hammer
9.plot: Catherine revisits one of the very first cases she worked as a CSI when the convicted felon in the murder claims the verdict was based on faulty evidence.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E22 - The Gone Dead Train
9.plot: A series of indeterminate deaths test the deductive powers of the CSI team, who fear that a public health emergency may be in the offing. Meanwhile, a friendly rivalry over who will win an upcoming bikini contest takes a deadly turn...

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E23 - Hog Heaven
9.plot: A band of vicious bikers is given the go-ahead to take down one of their own when it's discovered that the guy is an undercover cop.

9.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S09E24 - All In
9.plot: A cache of missing chips from a closed down casino turn up in Vegas and a string of murders follow, leading Langston to use deadly force for the first time in his career as a CSI.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E01 - Family Affair
10.plot: A rising young star is killed in a wreck and her determined stalker claims credit, but the team finds out there's more to this tragedy than meets the eye.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E02 - Ghost Town
10.plot: The son of a notorious killer is arrested on suspicion of murder, and the CSI team must overcome their natural prejudices against the boy's antecedents in order to track the true culprit.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E03 - Working Stiffs
10.plot: The team investigates the murder of Jason, a troubled computer geek working at a low-level casino support industry job who lures a colleague, Paulie, into a dangerous plan to make a working stiff's dream come true.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E04 - Coup de Grace
10.plot: When a policeman kills another officer, the CSIs must look to the evidence to determine if the shooting was premeditated or an accident.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E05 - Bloodsport
10.plot: After a beloved college football coach is found dead and his house drenched and spattered with his blood, the CSI team hunts for the killer who didn't find Coach Jimmy lovable at all.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E06 - Death and the Maiden
10.plot: When two seemingly different crimes turn out to be related, the CSIs discover they're interlocking parts of the same revenge plot.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E07 - The Lost Girls (III)
10.plot:
The CSI team helps Ray Langston investigate a prostitution ring that may have harbored a hostage he has been looking for in Miami and New York.

The crossover starts on CSI: Miami S08E07 Bone Voyage (I) and CSI: New York S06E07 Hammer Down (II).

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E08 - Lover's Lanes
10.plot: A bowling tournament is disrupted when an important piece of evidence is uncovered, leading the CSIs to investigate a murder at the same bowling alley.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E09 - Appendicitement
10.plot: When Nick, Greg and Hodges take Henry to celebrate his birthday at a biker bar, they uncover a double homicide and find several suspects still at the bar who may be the murderers.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E10 - Better Off Dead
10.plot: The CSIs dig to find the truth about how a recent shootout at a gun store might connect to a young woman who may have committed suicide.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E11 - Sin City Blue
10.plot: Two secretaries on holiday from Arizona attempt to steal a man's wallet and ATM pin number in a scam, and wind up dead in different locations. Meanwhile, the CSI team also investigates a disturbing medical mystery involving the dumping of human organs in a wildlife refuge.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E12 - Long Ball
10.plot: The CSI investigates the mystifying death of a former pro golfer whose allegiance to the game might have cost him everything.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E13 - Internal Combustion
10.plot: The case of two high school students, one dead and one missing, lead the CSIs into the underbelly of streetcar racing and a tangled web of deadly competition.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E14 - Unshockable
10.plot: When a band member of Rascal Flatts is electrocuted by his own guitar during a concert, the CSI team investigates if it was a case of foul play.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E15 - Neverland
10.plot: When a young boy is found murdered, the CSI team uncovers evidence that may link his death to an old case that recently resurfaced.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E16 - The Panty Sniffer
10.plot: Catherine and Detective Vartann are thrown together in a hotel room for 24 hours as they stake out a duo making drugs in the room next door. Meanwhile, Nick and Langston work a case that involves a fetish which has become big business in Vegas.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E17 - Irradiator
10.plot: When the CSI team investigates the brutal murder of a family, they trace the killer to the house next door, which might belong to the "Dr. Jekyll" serial killer.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E18 - Field Mice
10.plot: When Hodges and Wendy take a group of high school CSI Explorer Scouts on a field trip, they embellish their role in solving cases and take their assignment a little bit too far.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E19 - World's End
10.plot: When a student is discovered murdered at Lindsey's school, the investigation takes a sharp turn when the CSIs uncover an unlikely connection between the boy's death and atrocities of the past.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E20 - Take My Life, Please!
10.plot: A legendary comic from the good old days of Las Vegas is set to reunite with his partner on stage for one night only, until one half of the famous duo is found dead.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E21 - Lost & Found
10.plot: A mother thought to be grieving for the loss of her family three years ago becomes a suspect in a CSI investigation.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E22 - Doctor Who
10.plot: The CSI team must investigate one of their own when Langston is accused by a former colleague of being part of the Dr. Jekyll murders, on part one of a two-part season finale of CSI.

10.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S10E23 - Meat Jekyll
10.plot: The CSI's lives are on the line as they close in on the elusive Dr. Jekyll, and more than one member of the team may not live to see his capture, on part two of a two-part 10th season finale of CSI.

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E01 - Shock Waves
11.plot: The CSI team investigates a well-orchestrated bombing at the funeral of Officer Franklin Clark

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E02 - Pool Shark
11.plot: The team investigates when a woman is attacked by a shark in the pool at a Las Vegas casino.

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E03 - Blood Moon
11.plot: A vampire and werewolf convention becomes the center of a murder investigation.

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E04 - Sqweegel
11.plot: The CSI team investigates a mad slasher who strikes without leaving a trace -- because he wears a form-fitting black latex suit that leaves not a molecule of evidence behind

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E05 - House of Hoarders
11.plot: The CSI team investigate a murder at the home of Marta, a "level 5 hoarder" whose home is stacked high with possessions and garbage--and more than one dead body

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E06 - Cold Blooded
11.plot: The CSI team investigate the murder of a man whose daughter was killed five years ago, and the bizarre death of a young man who appears to have been killed by a T-Rex.

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E07 - Bump and Grind
11.plot: When shredded remains of a man are discovered, evidence leads to multiple possible suspects.

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E08 - Fracked
11.plot: The CSI's investigate a series of deaths related to an energy company's grotesque cover-up of tainted water.

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E09 - Wild Life
11.plot: The sky is falling or at least people are. The CSI's try to figure out if it was murder or sucide after a man is dead after falling from a hotel. Across town, a elderly woman falls through her table and her husband dead in the shower. The only two witnesses to the crime are an incooperative cat and a parrot who pleads the fifth.

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E10 - 418/427
11.plot: The CSIs set out to track down a pedophile suspected of murdering an FBI agent's wife and kidnapping his children.

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E11 - Man Up
11.plot: The CSIs question the validity of an online picture depicting a murdered call girl until they find the same woman strangled to death in the dumpster that appears in the photo.

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E12 - A Kiss Before Frying
11.plot: A body with unusual burn marks is discovered on the side of the road; Greg asks a teacher (Dita von Teese) out on a date.

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E13 - The Two Mrs. Grissoms
11.plot: Sara clashes with her mother-in-law and a woman from Gil's past.

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E14 - All That Cremains
11.plot: The Crime Scene crew investigates the gruesome murder of a high-powered, widowed lawyer, while Ray faces that it is time to move on from his old life.

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E15 - Targets of Obsession
11.plot: Jason McCann contacts Nick and says that he's in imminent danger. Langston has a courtroom war of nerves against serial killer Nate Haskell. A bomb tech disarms a bomb attached to Nick's house. But when he accompanies Nick, Catherine and Vartann to a warehouse with multiple booby-traps per square inch, Kip has to really earn his paycheck to find a safe way out for the CSI team.

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E16 - Turn On, Tune In, Drop Dead
11.plot: The team investigates two apparent corpses who aren't exactly dead at all.

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E17 - The List
11.plot: While investigating the murder of a convicted ex-cop, the CSIs stumble upon a list in his prison cell with names of several individuals he believed might have been his wife's true killer.

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E18 - Hitting for the Cycle
11.plot: A string of deaths, including a gamer found dead on his couch and a newly divorced man at the bottom of a pool, instigate a bet among the CSIs as to whether they've "hit for the cycle" - a homicide, a suicide, an accidental and a natural death all in one night

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E19 - Unleashed
11.plot: Langston and Sara turn to Lady Heather for help in tracking down the culprit responsible for injuring a woman before she was seemingly mauled to death by a mountain lion. Meanwhile, Nick and Dr. Robbins manage to rescue the unborn baby of a teenage girl who appears to have committed suicide

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E20 - Father Of The Bride (1)
11.plot: Following his escape, Nate Haskell, the notorious "Dick & Jane" killer, resurfaces when he e-mails a disturbing video to the father of one of his brides, threatening to take her life.

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E21 - Cello and Goodbye (2)
11.plot: Langston becomes more determined than ever to track down Nate Haskell, the notorious "Dick & Jane" killer, after discovering that he's kidnapped his ex-wife, Gloria.

11.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S11E22 - In A Dark, Dark House (3)
11.plot: After years of pursuit and a countless number of murders, Langston comes face-to-face with serial killer Nate Haskell inside the house where his killing spree began.

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E01 - 73 Seconds
12.plot: After multiple attacks on a public tram, the team has just one witness and a lot of questions.

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E02 - Tell-Tale Hearts
12.plot: When three people confess to killing a family, the team must decide who is telling the truth.

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E03 - Bittersweet
12.plot: During a date, Stokes discovers decomposing body parts in part of an art exhibit; D.B. Russell deals with a staff member confrontation.

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E04 - Maid Man
12.plot: The investigators attend the gala grand opening of a mob museum, only to witness an attempted hit on mob lawyer and former mayor Oscar Goodman.

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E05 - CSI Down
12.plot: The CSI unit investigates when Frank, an apparent murder victim, sits up and needs help but is he just another victim?

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E06 - Freaks & Geeks
12.plot: The murder of a popular sideshow performer sends the team behind the scenes at a carnival freak show.

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E07 - Brain Doe
12.plot: The CSI crew is stumped when they discover a disembodied brain at a crime scene where all the other brains are accounted for.

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E08 - Crime After Crime
12.plot: Three new murders related to three unsolved (or incorrectly solved) crimes from the past come back to haunt the CSIs.

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E09 - Zippered
12.plot: The murder of a retired Army Ranger brings the FBI in on the case, to Russell and Catherine's initial chagrin.

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E10 - Genetic Disorder
12.plot: When a man's dead body turns up naked in the bed of Doc Robbins' wife, the detectives try to "just work the scene" without bringing their pre-judgments to the table, but it sure looks like a case of Death During Adultery.

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E11 - Ms. Willows Regrets... (1)
12.plot: Catherine's friend Laura's mogul husband Mark has a lot to hide behind his successful international corporation, and he's hired a crack team of assassins to carry out the murders of anyone who might be aware of what he's doing, and that includes Laura's lawyer and Laura herself.

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E12 - Willows in the Wind (2)
12.plot: The CSI team says goodbye to Catherine Willows as she makes a life-changing decision.

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E13 - Tressed to Kill
12.plot: When a woman is found dead and her hair is done up '70s style complete with vintage clothes, the CSI team discovers clues that point to a killer with a hair fetish.

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E14 - Seeing Red
12.plot: Russell seeks advice from a former colleague during an investigation into the death of a man's ex-girlfriend.

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E15 - Stealing Home
12.plot: When a house is stolen completely off its foundation, the CSIs are on the case in search of answers. Meanwhile, new CSI Julie Finlay showcases her skill in blood analysis.

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E16 - CSI Unplugged
12.plot: When a blackout cripples the city, the CSIs must revert to old-school methods to solve the case of a missing child.

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E17 - Trends with Benefits
12.plot: When a photo of a dead college student starts trending on the Internet, the team steps in to investigate.

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E18 - Malice in Wonderland
12.plot: The team has few leads to go on when investigating a robbery-homicide at a themed wedding

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E19 - Split Decisions
12.plot: When the CSI team is called in to investigate a man who is shot at point-blank range in a local casino, they shut down the entire building to find their killer.

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E20 - Altered Stakes
12.plot: When Stokes learns that a man he helped put in prison is going to have his conviction overturned, the CSI team needs to prove the killer is guilty again or he will be released.

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E21 - Dune and Gloom
12.plot: When a bomb kills an off-road race truck driver mid-race, the CSI team is called on the scene to investigate why.

12.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S12E22 - Homecoming
12.plot: Season finale: The investigation of a triple homicide leads to the discovery of corruption running rampant throughout the LVPD. The closer they get to the truth, the more serious are the repercussions. To be continued...

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E01 - Karma To Burn
13.plot: D.B. Russell leads the CSI team on a hunt to find his kidnapped granddaughter.

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E02 - Code Blue Plate Special
13.plot: The CSIs arrive at their favorite diner only to discover a gruesome crime scene with eight dead victims and a lot of questions

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E03 - Wild Flowers
13.plot: When a girl is shot and killed at a large rave in the desert, the CSI team has to search for clues, find her missing friend and bring the killer to justice.

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E04 - It Was a Very Good Year
13.plot: When a famed music historian is murdered and left in a piano, it has an emotional effect on Sanders, who had a past with her.

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E05 - Play Dead
13.plot: When a K-9 is blamed for the death of his partner, the CSI team discovers there's more to the case. Meanwhile, Finlay and Morgan investigate the death of a high-profile divorce lawyer with a lot of enemies.

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E06 - Pick and Roll
13.plot: Things get personal when D.B. Russell is drawn into the investigation of the death of his son's basketball coach.

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E07 - Fallen Angels
13.plot: The CSI team investigates the death of a reverend who was killed at the grave site of former CSI Warrick Brown.

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E08 - CSI on Fire
13.plot: When eight bodies are found in what appears to be a meteor site in the middle of the desert, CSI Finlay recognizes one of the casualties, prompting her to revisit her past.

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E09 - Strip Maul
13.plot: The CSI team lends a hand to local law enforcement on the strip with several arrests until a John Doe is found in car. Also, things become personal for Captain Brass when he discovers some facts about his daughter.

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E10 - Risky Business Class
13.plot: When five people are killed in a small plane crash a mile off the Vegas strip, the CSI team is called to investigate. Also, Sara feels the strain of having a long-distance relationship with Grissom when a former lover of hers is involved with the crash investigation

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E11 - Dead Air
13.plot: The CSIs investigate the demise of a prominent news anchor during a live broadcast.

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E12 - Double Fault
13.plot: The CSIs need to ace the case involving a rising tennis star. Meanwhile, the CSIs are surprised to hear Hodges is engaged to an Italian bombshell.

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E13 - In Vino Veritas (I)
13.plot:
When CSI Mac Taylor decides to surprise his girlfriend in Vegas, he discovers she’s missing and asks his friend D.B. Russell for help.

The crossover concludes on CSI: New York S09E15 Seth and Apep (II).

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E14 - Exile
13.plot: The CSIs investigate the demise of a famous Cuban singer’s sister who’s in town as part of a U.S. tour. Meanwhile, Hodges begins to get cold feet at the prospect of marrying his Italian bombshell girlfriend.

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E15 - Forget Me Not
13.plot: Sara is a lead suspect in an investigation after a brief encounter with another man in which she was the last person to see him alive. Also, her separation from Grissom begins to take a toll.

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E16 - Last Woman Standing
13.plot: When several prominent poker players lose their lives, the CSI team is called to investigate before more victims surface.

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E17 - Dead of the Class
13.plot: At his wife's urging, David reluctantly attends his high school reunion -- which becomes a crime scene when the bitchy former high school queen is found dead in a back room.

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E18 - Sheltered
13.plot: When the CSIs find a body near a forest reserve, they discover what might be a serial killer and his bizarre lair.

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E19 - Backfire
13.plot: When the CSIs investigate a triple homicide, Russell has to find a way to connect with a 6-year-old girl who was the sole survivor and witness.

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E20 - Fearless
13.plot: The CSI team investigates a popular spiritual retreat when a body is found floating in a mud bath. Meanwhile, Hodges questions his marriage plans to Elisabetta.

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E21 - Ghosts of the Past
13.plot: The CSIs investigate the mysterious death of a ghost hunter and experiences déjà vu when the victim has eerie similarities to an old case.

13.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S13E22 - Skin in the Game
13.plot: The crime lab searches for a serial killer inspired by Dante's Inferno, and Brass's daughter may be one of the killer's next victims.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E01 - The Devil and D.B. Russell
14.plot: D.B. Russell leads the CSI team on a hunt to find Morgan and Ellie Brass following their kidnapping by a ritualistic killer.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E02 - Take the Money and Run
14.plot: The CSI team investigate a murder at a high stakes poker game.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E03 - Torch Song
14.plot: The CSI team investigates a fire at a music venue that leaves four people dead, including two band members.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E04 - Last Supper
14.plot: When contestants on a reality cooking show accidentally eat human flesh during a competition, the CSI team is brought in to investigate.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E05 - Frame by Frame
14.plot: The team meets a blast from the past, with a chance to solve a cold case that has haunted the team for 14 years.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E06 - Passed Pawns
14.plot: The CSI team investigates the death of a homeless man who had a huge winning streak at a small casino.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E07 - Under a Cloud
14.plot: A body is discovered during torrential rain in Vegas; Sanders is accused of framing a man for murder seven years ago.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E08 - Helpless
14.plot: A dead man is found inside a human-size hamster ball; the team collaborates on a serial rapist investigation.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E09 - Check In and Check Out
14.plot: The CSI team is called in to investigate the stabbing of a couple found at a local motel that is reminiscent of two incidents that occurred in the same room.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E10 - Girls Gone Wild
14.plot: A spa weekend for Sara, Finlay and Morgan turns into a murder investigation and missing persons case when Finlay disappears, as the CSI team must piece together what happened in detail to find her.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E11 - The Lost Reindeer
14.plot: When a man is found murdered at an elaborate holiday party complete with real snow and live reindeer, the CSI team is brought in to investigate.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E12 - Keep Calm and Carry-On
14.plot: An inbound plane’s passengers become the victims of an onboard thief, but when one of the passengers is found dead, the petty crime turns into a murder investigation.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E13 - Boston Brakes
14.plot: The CSIs are shocked when they discover that a victim in a car crash is someone they are familiar with.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E14 - De Los Muertos
14.plot: When a woman is found dead in Mexico and a murdered couple is discovered in a driveway, evidence from one investigation could help the other.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E15 - Love for Sale
14.plot: Greg and Nick investigate the death of a 16-year-old girl with ties to a brothel.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E16 - Killer Moves
14.plot: A murdered Elvis impersonator has a strange connection with a bird.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E17 - Long Road Home
14.plot: A murdered groupie and a missing prostitute both have connections to a mysterious band.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E18 - Uninvited
14.plot: The team investigates when a whole family is reported to have been missing for a month.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E19 - The Fallen
14.plot: When a teen opens fire in a police station, Russell is taken hostage.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E20 - Consumed
14.plot: As the CSIs hunt a cannibalistic killer, they realize there is more than one.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E21 - Kitty
14.plot: The team investigates the cyber-related murder of a prominent casino owner's wife and receive help from the FBI's Cyber Crime Division.

14.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S14E22 - Dead in His Tracks
14.plot: The CSIs investigate a crime that has ties to a 25-year-old mob heist; Brass is faced with a decision when his daughter tries to commit suicide.

15.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S15E01 - The CSI Effect
15.plot: Finlay must deal with a bomb planted in her car. Russell gets a call from someone claiming to be the Gig Harbor killer.

15.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S15E02 - Buzz Kill
15.plot: The CSI team investigates a robbery and fatal shooting at a medical marijuana shop.

15.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S15E03 - Bad Blood
15.plot: Sara and Greg are quarantined after responding to a crime scene that’s contaminated with a deadly pathogen.

15.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S15E04 - The Book of Shadows
15.plot: A chemistry teacher's science experiment goes horribly wrong.

15.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S15E05 - Girls Gone Wilder
15.plot: Morgan, Sara and Fin try to relax at a forensics conference when a mass shooting occurs on site.

15.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S15E06 - The Twin Paradox
15.plot: Frustration mounts for the CSI team as another victim surfaces who is linked to the Gig Harbor Killer.

15.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S15E07 - Road to Recovery
15.plot: The CSI team take a look into the death of a woman who has been drinking and taking drugs in a pool at a rehab facility.

15.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S15E08 - Rubbery Homicide
15.plot: The CSI team find themselves taking a look into the kinky world of “rubber dolls” as they investigate the murder of a man stabbed in an alley.

15.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S15E09 - Let's Make a Deal
15.plot: The CSI team investigates a murder at Clark County jail after an inmate stumbles upon a body while running away from officers.

15.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S15E10 - Dead Rails
15.plot: The CSI team investigates the bizarre death of a man who was killed not once, but twice.

15.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S15E11 - Angle of Attack
15.plot: The CSIs' investigation of the victim of an apparent hit and run leads them into the world of aeronautics.

15.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S15E12 - Dead Woods
15.plot: The CSI team reopens a 10-year-old murder/suicide case when the sole survivor claims her accused father was innocent.

15.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S15E13 - The Greater Good
15.plot: The CSI team continues their investigation into the kidnappings and murders of young women when they learn their main suspect, Jared Briscoe, is released from jail due to lack of evidence.

15.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S15E14 - Merchants of Menace
15.plot: The CSI team investigates a homicide at a convention for people who collect macabre murder memorabilia.

15.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S15E15 - Hero to Zero
15.plot: The CSI team investigates the murder of a young victim dressed as a superhero.

15.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S15E16 - The Last Ride
15.plot: The CSI team investigates a death involving a vintage Rolls Royce and a chrome-covered victim.

15.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S15E17 - Under My Skin
15.plot: The CSI team investigates a murder with ties to two teenaged kidnapped girls.

15.title: FR - CSI: Crime Scene Investigation - S15E18 - The End Game
15.plot: The CSI unit faces the final showdown with the Gig Harbor killer whose motives are finally revealed. Meanwhile, Nick Stokes makes a decision that will affect the entire team moving forward.

meta.plot: A Las Vegas team of forensic investigators are trained to solve criminal cases by scouring the crime scene, collecting irrefutable evidence and finding the missing pieces that solve the mystery.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: It's 1995 and 11-year-old hip-hop loving Eddie Huang has just moved with his family from Chinatown in Washington D.C. to suburban Orlando. They quickly discover things are very different there. Orlando doesn't even have a Chinatown -- unless you count the Huang house.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E02 - Home Sweet Home-School
1.plot: Jessica thinks school must be too easy for the boys and gives them extra homework; Louis tries to get Jessica to ease up on her strict approach.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E03 - The Shunning
1.plot: When the cul-de-sac plans a block party to celebrate NASCAR, Louis urges the family to use the event to make new friends (and promote Cattleman’s Ranch Steakhouse). But Jessica has problems fitting in, especially after she befriends a beautiful trophy wife the roller blade moms don’t like. Meanwhile, Eddie schemes to win the respect of the neighborhood kids

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E04 - Success Perm
1.plot: A visit from Jessica's sister and her affluent husband creates out-of-control family rivalry.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E05 - Persistent Romeo
1.plot: Louis has to hire a professional instructor to give the restaurant staff a sexual harassment seminar after Jessica's attempts fall flat. Meanwhile, Eddie tries to pass off the seminar's instructional tape as a "dirty movie" to his friends in an attempt to impress them and get them to come to his house for a sleep over

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E06 - Fajita Man
1.plot: Eddie takes a job at the restaurant so he can earn money for a new video game.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E07 - Showdown at the Golden Saddle
1.plot: A billboard for the restaurant is struck by vandalism. Eddie tries to get a girl's attention.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E08 - Phillip Goldstein
1.plot: Eddie tries to befriend the only other Chinese kid in school, but he's in for a letdown after he finds out that they have nothing in common; Louis feels betrayed when Mitch accepts a job at the rival Golden Saddle.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E09 - License to Sell
1.plot: Jessica worries she can't compete with a top realtor and puts off taking the exam for her license.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E10 - Blind Spot
1.plot: Jessica's college boyfriend, Oscar Chow, comes to visit. She's a bit miffed that Louis isn't a little more jealous....but she's got a blind spot and is completely oblivious to the fact that Oscar is gay. Meanwhile, Eddie goes to great lengths to get out of the school science fair.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E11 - Very Superstitious
1.plot: Jessica’s superstitions get the best of her when she sells a house with the address 44 West 44th Street – the number 4 being bad luck in Chinese culture. At the urging of the new school counselor, Eddie decides to run for school president, but Jessica’s bad luck gets the best of him too when a white lie spirals out of control.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E12 - Dribbling Tiger, Bounce Pass Dragon
1.plot: Louis and Jessica get pressured into volunteering at the kids’ schools because of budget cuts. Eddie sees a whole other side of his dad when Louis – a former semi-pro basketball player back in Taiwan — coaches the basketball team, while Emery and Evan see a side of Jessica they wish they hadn't when she grudgingly takes on producing their school play, and puts her own spin on it.

1.title: FR - Fresh Off the Boat - S01E13 - So Chineez
1.plot: Jessica fears her family has assimilated so much to life in Orlando that they’ve lost their Chinese identity. So she drives everyone nuts making them reconnect with their culture, from Louis, who she insists decline an invite to join the country club, to Eddie, who she makes do a report on China for his World Day project.

meta.plot: A '90s-set single-camera comedy about a hip-hop-loving Asian kid growing up in suburban Orlando, being raised by an immigrant father obsessed with all things American and an immigrant mother often bewildered by white culture.

1.title: FR - The Other Black Girl - S01E01 - They Say I'm Different
1.plot: Nella meets Hazel, a new coworker at Wagner Books, who may not be exactly what she seems.

1.title: FR - The Other Black Girl - S01E02 - After the Storm
1.plot: After the blow up with Colin, Nella has to decide whether or not to apologize, and whether or not she can trust Hazel.

1.title: FR - The Other Black Girl - S01E03 - I Know a Place
1.plot: Nella and Hazel try to start over, while Nella digs deeper into the mystery of Kendra Rae Phillips.

1.title: FR - The Other Black Girl - S01E04 - What About Your Friends
1.plot: Nella meets Diana Gordon, a famous author and her hero, and Nella invites Hazel over to meet her friends.

1.title: FR - The Other Black Girl - S01E05 - Don't You Want Me
1.plot: A leak of Colin’s book causes pandemonium at Wagner, and tensions boil over between Nella and Vera.

1.title: FR - The Other Black Girl - S01E06 - Fake Smile
1.plot: As Hazel maneuvers her way deeper into Nella's life, Nella begins to feel overwhelmed by mounting responsibility at work and growing suspicion of Hazel.

1.title: FR - The Other Black Girl - S01E07 - Caught in the Rapture
1.plot: Hazel invites Nella and Malaika to her house for a girls' night, but the more of Hazel's life they see, the more uneasy they feel.

1.title: FR - The Other Black Girl - S01E08 - The End of Love
1.plot: Nella's worst fears begin to come true as she tries to put all the pieces together before the launch of Diana's new imprint.

1.title: FR - The Other Black Girl - S01E09 - To Be Young, Gifted and Broke
1.plot: We learn more about Hazel and exactly what happened in Boston.

1.title: FR - The Other Black Girl - S01E10 - Down with Disease
1.plot: Nella faces the ultimate decision and must choose between everything she's worked for and the safety of everyone she loves.

meta.plot: Nella, an editorial assistant, is tired of being the only black girl at her company, so she’s excited when Hazel is hired. But as Hazel’s star begins to rise, Nella spirals out and discovers something sinister is going on at the company.

meta.plot: De joies en déceptions, les vies amoureuses et professionnelles de Laure, Caroline et Jessica ne manquent jamais de rebondissements sous le soleil de Saint Tropez !

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E01 - Ji A Looks For A Psychic | Dream Officetel
1.plot: Hong Ji-a looks to hire help for a difficult assignment, but it seems none can stand up to the task. Oh In-beom's client takes his business elsewhere.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E02 - Father And Son | Britium, The Art Museum
1.plot: Despite her disapproval of frauds like In-beom, Ji-a knows she desperately needs his special ability. In-beom turns his attention to his next job.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E03 - Team Daebak | The Artist
1.plot: In-beom agrees to a partnership with Ji-a, hoping to find out more about the death of his uncle. Ji-a scans an art gallery for spirits.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E04 - Side Effect | The Truth Unraveled
1.plot: In-beom is plagued by memories that are not his. But when he also inherits a talent he never had, he seeks to exploit it for profit.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E05 - Mother & Daughter | Life in Vain
1.plot: Ji-a encounters two spirits: a victim of real estate fraud who does not realize she is dead and her mother's last client.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E06 - Faceless Boy | The Basement Wall
1.plot: Despite Ji-a's warning, In-beom involves himself in a murder case. Ji-a questions her memory of the events leading up to her mother's death.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E07 - A Sweet Tooth | Reconciliation
1.plot: Ji-a seeks new insight into the incident that happened 20 years ago. In-beom spots a familiar face in the lobby of Dohak Construction.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E08 - Eun-byeol, The Child Spirit | Oh Seong-sik's Mother
1.plot: Ji-a's next job takes her to an apartment complex that is haunted by the ghost of a child. Do Hak-seong looks for a missing document.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E09 - Murder In A Parking Lots | The Police Interfere
1.plot: In-beom returns to his grandmother’s home. Ji-a buries herself in her books. A woman calls the agency after being tormented by a spirit in her building.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E10 - Luring A Murderer | A Mother To The Rescue
1.plot: Bae Su-jeong seeks to repay a debt. In-beom learns what became of his uncle. A new client visits Daebak Realty with stories of ghosts in a warehouse.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E11 - Ji-a Forfeits Daebak Reality | Do Hak-seong's Exorcism
1.plot: Ji-a finds out what had kept her mother from moving on. In-beom investigates the two life-threatening incidents and their relationship to Hak-seong.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E12 - Oh Sung Sik's Memories | The Egg Ghost
1.plot: In-beom relives Oh Seong-sik’s last days. Ji-a’s search comes to another dead end. Hak-seong finally gets his hands on the property he wanted.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E13 - Ji-a Quits Being an Exorcist | Chang-hwa Returns Home
1.plot: Ji-a recovers her memories and confronts the person who planted fake ones in her mind. She seeks solace to clear her head.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E14 - The Jackpot | In-beom Goes After Do Hak-seong
1.plot: When guilt sends Ji-a down a spiral, In-beom makes sure she’s not alone. Hak-seong grows desperate as the corruption investigation narrows in on him.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E15 - The Egg Ghost Returns | Do Hak-seong Hunts Ji-a
1.plot: Ji-a decides to put her life on the line before the faceless ghost is able to cause more damage. Hak-seong prepares for revenge.

1.title: FR - Sell Your Haunted House - S01E16 - A Glorious Injury | Ji-a Loses Her Power
1.plot: The special ending Ji-a had prepared for Hak-seong causes an unexpected side effect. She asks In-beom to help her one final time.

meta.plot: A real estate agent who rids haunted buildings of vengeful ghosts, partners with a con man to solve a 20-year-old case that is close to her heart.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S01E01 - First Light
1.plot: Tandy Bowen and Tyrone Johnson – two teenagers from very different backgrounds, find themselves burdened and awakened to newly acquired superpowers which are mysteriously linked to one another. The only constant in their lives is danger and each other. Tandy can emit light daggers and Tyrone has the ability to control the power of darkness. They quickly learn they are better together than apart.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S01E02 - Suicide Sprints
1.plot: Tandy and Tyrone try to grasp what has happened to them with their new-found powers, while Tandy’s past catches up with her and Tyrone becomes consumed with revenge. Meanwhile, Detective Brigid O’Reilly works an interesting case that has ties to Tandy.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S01E03 - Stained Glass
1.plot: Tandy is on the run as Detective O’Reilly closes in on her, but the detective may not be after her for the reasons Tandy thinks. Tyrone is desperate for answers and turns to Evita and her Auntie Clarisse, a Voodoo priestess, for help.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S01E04 - Call/Response
1.plot: Tandy and Tyrone come face-to-face as the two are able to sit down and talk. Having not been able to tell anyone else what they have been experiencing, both take the opportunity to finally confide in the one person who may truly understand what they are going through. Meanwhile, Otis reveals a secret side of himself and Greg seems to be onto something with Melissa’s case against Roxxon.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S01E05 - Princeton Offense
1.plot: Tandy is consumed with getting answers about the Roxxon cover up. To get the answers she is looking for, Tandy tests out her power to gain new insights. Tyrone, on the other hand, is focusing on being a normal kid as the basketball state finals approach. With so much weighing on him lately, can he truly push everything to the side and win the big game for Billy? Meanwhile, Det. O’Reilly looks into the city’s drug problems to get some answers of her own.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S01E06 - Funhouse Mirrors
1.plot: Tyrone heads down a dangerous path to get closer to Det. Connors, as Tandy pretends to be a Roxxon intern in an attempt to get answers. Her “internship” hits a little too close to home for Tandy when she gets a glimpse at what her life could have been like. Meanwhile, Det. O’Reilly gets closer to Det. Connors and Evita’s Aunt Clarisse worries about Tyrone’s future.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S01E07 - Lotus Eaters
1.plot: A mysterious man may be the key for Tandy to finally clear her father’s name. Unfortunately, getting the answers she needs will be difficult as the man has been in a catatonic state for almost a decade, but it might not be so impossible for two people with extraordinary powers. With Tyrone alongside to help, the two test their combined powers for the first time.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S01E08 - Ghost Stories
1.plot: Tandy and Melissa prepare to commemorate the 8th anniversary of Nathan’s passing with their annual memorial tradition. When Tandy gets a key piece of information regarding her father, she uses this day to try and finally clear her father’s name. Meanwhile, Tyrone’s parents prefer not to mark the day Billy passed, but Tyrone’s need to keep Billy’s memory alive causes conflict among the three. Deciding today is the day he gets a confession out of Det. Connors, Tyrone goes to Det. O’Reilly for help.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S01E09 - Back Breaker
1.plot: When triumph turns sour, both Tandy and Tyrone regress back to their old ways. But after everything that has happened, and actions that have been set into motion, can they truly go back to the way things once were? Meanwhile, Det. O’Reilly tries to deal with the recent fallout.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S01E10 - Colony Collapse
1.plot: Everything comes to a head for Tyrone and Tandy as the city of New Orleans is thrown into chaos. The two realize that it is time they face their destiny and test their powers as “The Divine Pairing” to save the city.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S02E01 - Restless Energy
2.plot: Now living very different lives, Tyrone and Tandy try to stay under the wire while still honing their powers. After coming to terms with their destiny, the two now find it difficult to just stand by and do nothing while bad things continue to happen throughout the city. Meanwhile, Brigid is struggling from her recovery.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S02E02 - White Lines
2.plot: Desperate to help, but only finding they cause more problems than solving them, Tyrone and Tandy continue to struggle with their situation. What is the point of having superpowers if you only seem to make things worse?

2.title: FR - Marvel's Cloak & Dagger - S02E03 - Shadow Selves
2.plot: After learning about a group of young girls who have gone missing, Tandy and Tyrone look to see if they can find out what has happened to them. But when Christine gets to Fantasy Island, she'll realize that she's hungry for much more than food. Roarke's other guests include Ruby Akuda who is afflicted with a terminal illness and is given a new lease on life.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - His and Hers; The Heartbreak Hotel
1.plot: Two adventurers, whose marriage has grown stale want to have the ultimate adventure together. Meanwhile, after sleeping for 35 years, widower Brent, must decide if he is ready to face his grief awake.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Quantum Entanglement
1.plot: Flamboyant, eccentric Eileen wants to spend time with her estranged daughter and her family, but they refuse to see her. Disillusioned physics professor Charles wants to know if there is something more out there.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Once Upon a Time in Havana
1.plot: Percussionist Alma wants to be accepted by her tight-knit Cuban family, but to understand why they disapprove of her musical career, she must revisit their history.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - The Big Five Oh
1.plot: When old friends Nettie, Camille and Margot come to the island to celebrate their 50th birthdays, their fantasies expose fault lines in their friendship.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - The Romance & the Bromance
1.plot: A bookworm who wants to say yes to life goes back in time to meet her favorite author, and a competitive survivalist learns that the ultimate challenge is something he hasn’t trained for.

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Día del los Vivos

1.title: FR - L'Île fantastique [VOSTFR] - S01E10 - Welcome to the Snow Globe (2)

Andi wants to know if her cat BoBo loves her as much as she loves him. Roarke juggles a secret romance, as Ruby and Gina spend more time together.
